tei:div.tei:p: byaḥ/bka'agu/ //spya chi/hā sdu 77/mesbya 'jiciXng060jib jing 505533 7 bci kho zhugaX 50 yokhog
'bring rim slobama'i klogadebanorabu'i bangamadzod/
'bringarimarlobama'iklobadebarorabu'ibangamadzod

dkar chaga'ago brjod/ ( 1 )gna' bo'i pa pi lun gyi rgyal po han mu'u la pi/ ( 4 )rlabs chen gyi khrims 'dzugs mkhan so lun/ (17)gna' bo ro ma'i dmangs skyong dpon ki la ko'u spun mched/ (30)cod pan mnabs ma myong ba'i rgyal po chen po zis zar/ (45)'jar pan gyi ta hwa gsar brje chen mo'i skul 'ded mkhan rgyal sras krung ta zhung / (59)gong ma chen po char lbe/ (70)mā ting lu'u ti dang chos lugs bcos bsgyur/ (83)hra hong pis ti sku phreng dang po dang kho'i bcos bsgyur/ (96)a me ri kha'i dmangs gtso'i lam lugs kyi rmang 'dzugs mkhan gye bar sin/ (109)h+pha ran si'i ma rtsa ring lugs kyi phul du byung ba'i gsar brje ba ro bho zi bhe ar/ (124)yo rob gling gi lo rgyus kyi skyes chen nā pho lun/ (138)6 ches shes rab ldan pa'i mi mi ste ma'o ha ma'o rdi a lis/ (154)a ri'i gling lho ma'i bcings 'grol mkhan te po li war (166)mo zhi kho mi rigs kyi dpa' rgod dang tsung thung hu'u ya li zi/ (178)mi gshis gser las lhag pa'i skyes bu/wa wa.a ri'i skabs 16pa'i tsung thung lin khun/ (103)

dpa' zhing brtul phod che ba'i blon chen nyis zi ma khi/ (207)mdzad rjes dang snyan grags bskal ba ma stong bar du brtan gyur cigawa wagasar brje'i slob dpon mar khe si'i 'od stong 'bar ba'i mi tshe (221)mar khe si'i blos thub kyi grogs mchog ste en ke si/ (240)gsar gtod kyi lam chen 'di ru nga tsho mdun nas mdun du bskyod dgos/wa waming kri gsar bsgyur gyi mdzad rjes can blon chen tā kyig pa'o li thung / (257)i tho phi ya'i gong ma phrin nyi lis khi sku phreng gnyis pa/ (268)'phags pa'i skyes bu chen po snyan rdis/ (280)le nyin dus rtag tu nged cag gi sems khong du gson yod/ (294)rlabs chen gyi mar le ring lugs pa si ta lin/ (317)dbyin ji'i dbu bzhugs blon chen chir khye'o/ (335)thur khe rgyal khab kyi yab chen cis mar/ (350)rkub stegs 'khor lo ru bzhugs pa'i a ri'i tsung thung ro si wo khri/ (364)tsa drug gcig brgyad don rkyen migyi dpa' rgod ta'e ko li/ (381)snying stobs ngar lcags las mkhregs pa'i tsung thung thi'e thu'o/ (395)ar jin ṭi na'i lo rgyus kyi mi sna grags can pe rong / (409)lag rogs nas tsung thung gi khrir 'dzegs pa'i sa ta thi/ (423)

'gobarjod/tso rgyal gyi chab srid mi sna grags can 〉zhes pa'i dpe deb 'di ru gna' deng gi chab srid mi sna grags can rnams kyis rang nyid kyi mes rgyal dang mi rigs kyi ched du/ tshe srog dang zungs khrag blos btang ste ji ltar mi rigs bcings 'grol dang rgyal khab yar rgyas su bskul ba'i gtam rgyud sna tshogs bkod nas/ nga tsho mi su zhig yin rung rgyal khab dang mi rigs nyen kha'i gnas su lhung tshe blo brtan 'gyur med kyis rang nyid kyi las dbang dang mi rigs kyi las dbang gnyis zung du sbrel te/ gang du gnya' gnon yod na de ru ngo rgol yod ces pa'i dpe bzhin rang nyid kyi bde sdug rgyab tu dor nas mi rigs nyen skyob kyi 'thab rtsod du zhugs dgos lugs mtshon yod/ cis mār gyis 66'tsho gnas dang rang btsan gyi phyir du zungs khrag dor ba'i mi rigs sheg yin tshe de ni nam yang pham par rgyag mi srid ’ ces dang / mar khe sis 64gsar brje'i lag thabs ni drag spyod la brten dgos phyir/ gsar brje'i rgyal kha yod tshad kyang 'di la brten nas ma thob pa gcig kyang med ces bstan pa bzhin dmag 'khrug gi dus rabs su drag po'i 'os langs ni gsar brje yi sngon 'gro yin/ mar khe sis 6 gsar brje las nga tsho la shor ba ni lcags sgrog las ci yang med ces pa'i bka' slob gnang ba bzhin/ dka' sdug dang bkres ltogs myong bzhin pa'i mi dmangs kyis ma 'ongs pa dang re ltos kyi phyir du ngo rgol zing 'khrug bslangs te mthar 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa'i rjes su mi rigs rgyal khab khag bsdud mar rang btsan thob pa'i dga' 'os pa'i rnam pa zhig mngon byung / si ta lin gyis rjes lus ca/ la

rgyal kha med ces pa ni bden gtam sha stag tu snang ste/ mi'i rigs kyi skyo gar yod tshad kyang btsan gnyom dang dbul phyug las byung zhing / btsan pos gnyom chung la gnya' gnon dang phyug pos dbul bo la brnyas bcos byed pa ni 'das zin pa'i lo rgyus tsam du ma zad/ da rung da lta dang ma 'ongs pa'i dus nam zhig la slobs rung med thabs bral ba'i gral rim gyi 'gal ba yin/ de yang log spyod dang rul sungs kyi spyi tshogs shig gi rtsa ba'i snang tshul zhig kyang red/ 'di lta bu'i spyi tshogs kyi gnas bab 'og ngas bshad 'dod pa zhig ni le nyin dang nyen rtog pa'i dbar gyi rtsod gleng ste/ gsar bu/ mgo bos brag la brgyab na rang sdug dang 'gram sha lag pas 'then na rang sha ma yin nam zhes nyen rtog pas bshad pa na/ le nyin gyis red lags/ de ga rang red/'on kyang de ni zhig ral tu gyur ba'i byang chag cig yin phyin mgo bos bsnun pa tsam gyis 'gyel 'gro nges red ces gsungs pa bzhin/ mi zhig yin tshe mi rigs bcings 'grol gyi las 'gul du rang nyid la gsar brje dang mdun skyod kyi chod sems ldan dgos/ dus rabs re la dus rabs de'i lo rgyus kyi 'os 'gan re mchis na/ dus rabs re la dus rabs de'i mi rigs kyi dpa' bo re yang los yod/ de'i phyir nga tsho mi su zhig yin rung mi tshe la phugs bsam ldan zhing thun mong gi bde skyid la brtson pa ni da gzod bde skyid kyi mchog yin pa dang / mi rigs dang rgyal khab kyi phyir du nga chos dus dang rnam pa kun tu ཿsa rak+tas dang lo rgyus kyi 'os 'gan phrag steng du len rgyu'i sta gon la ba na /pe sna/ba 'dir tshud pa'i mi ming dang sa ming rnams am skad gzhir bzung ste bsgyur cing mjug tu rgya yig bkod pa rnams go 'dzol mi yong ba'i ched du dbyin skad dang rgyal khab kyi ming rnams lha sa'i skad ltar bsgyur ba yin/spyi/ rang nyid kyi thos brtson dman zhing khom long cher ma mchis stabs dpe
deb tu nyog bshad dang log bshad mang du byas par gdon mi za bas/ gzur gnas kyi mkhas dbang dang klog pa po rnams kyis skyon brjod gnang bar mkhyen/sgyuX ༵ ༵ kā/ 1

gna'atho'i pa pi lun gyi rgyal po nyan mu'u la pi/nub phyogs su bzhur bzhin pa'i yi'u h+pha tho la ti gtsang po (209618 03 26762 rmi'i34 na khri'am)dang shar phyogs su 'bab pa'i ti ke li si (11 6113 21 507 974lo7)gtsang — cipo gnyis ni e sha ya'i nub rgyud kyi gtsang bo ri chen po gnyis yin la/ chu 'go ar mun nyis ༷ ya'i ri tshogs la thug cing mthar stag gzig mtsho 'gag tu 'bab/ gtsang bo gnyis dbar ri cho gyi yangs shing rgya che ba'i skam sa chen po la ke ri — —se (670000 skotsho)yi skad du me so pu ta mis han mu'u la pi yi dbu brnyan/yā ste gtsang bo'i dbar gyi skam sa zhes 'bod cing / ngag rgyun du gtsang po gnyis kyi 'bab yul zhes grags/ gtsang bo gnyis kyi 'bab yul ni mi'i rigs kyi shes rig gi 'byung gnas shig kyang yin te/ spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo 3000yas mas su gnas de ru bran g.yog lam lugs kyi rgyal phran mang du byung myong / spyi lo'i sngon gyi 894lor su'u mu'u a pu'u mu'u zer ba'i a mo lis rigs kyi mi zhig gi sbyor ngan gyis rgyal phran phan tshun dgra ru langs shing / gang sa gang du dmag 'khrug gi me lce dgung du 'phyur bzhin pa'i go skabs dang bstun nas/ rang gis rang nyid gong mar bskos te pa pi lun (3 2lko〉)zhes pa'i rgyal rabs btsugs/ pa pi lun rgyal rabs

btsugs rjes kyi thog ma'i lo ngo brgya lhag tsam gyi ring du nyam chung nus med kyi rgyal phran zhig yin te/ skabs rer rgyal phran gzhan la mgo 'dogs pa dang skabs rer rgyal phran gzhan la dpya khral 'jal dgos byung / 'on kyang /rgyal rabs drug pa han mu'u la pi (phal cher spyi lo'i sngon gyi 1792lo nas 1750lo'i bar srid bskyangs )yi sku ring du/ rgyal phran 'di mgyogs myur ngang 'phel rgyas byung zhing dpung stobs gtsang bo gnyis 'bab yul gyi yul gru phal mo che la khyab pa byung / de ni tan mu'u la pi (527751891tshoṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭhakhyi6)yi srid skyong thabs jus dang 'brel ba dam po mchis par ma zad/ khong gi brtul phod cing shes rab kyis phyug pa'i chab srid kyi spobs pa chen po dang yang 'brel ba dam po mchis so//gna' rdzas rtog zhib kyi grub 'bras/han mu'u la pi kyis rgyal khab ji ltar dbang du bsgyur tshul dang pa pi lun yang nyam chung zhig nas stobs ldan du gyur te/ gtsang po gnyis kyi 'bab yul gcig gyur btang ba sogs lo rgyus snga drags pas nga tshos gsal po zhig brjod dka' na yang / dus rabs 'di'i gna' rdzas rtog zhib kyi grub 'bras las lo rgyus pas nga tsho la dris lan gsal po zhig gnang byung /1901lo'i zla 12pa nas 1902lo'i zla 1po'i bar du/ h+pha ran si'i gna'aphas 'tshol zhib ru khag cig gis grang ngar la ma 'dzem par dbyi rang (178077)lho phyogs kyi zo'u sā zhes pa'i sa char (gna' bo'i e lan rgyal khab kyi rgyal sa )rtog zhib byed pa'i tshe na/ 'tshol zhib mkhan rnams kyis me grub brag rdo nag po leb mo zhig rnyed byung la/ nyin 'ga'i rjes su yang leb mo gnyis rnyed byung bar rdo leb de gsum phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa na 'a/nga

dbyibs kyi ka zlum rdo ring zhig grub byung / rdo ring de'i mtho tshad la li smi 225dang ston kyi sgor tshad la li smi 163 smad la li smi 190tsam mchis rdo ring gi stod du gson nyams ldan zhing spus legs pa'i 'bur brkos shig dang /smad du khyi'u dbyibs yi se 8000yas mas brkos pa rnams yig gzugs bsal zhing nyams kyis phyug brtag dpyad gnang ba ltar na de rmi tan mu 'u la pi kyis gtan la phabs pa'i khrims gzhung yin par thag nas chod/ de la gleng sa'i dang gzhung dngos/ mjug byang bcas khas gsum du 'dus shing / gleng gzhi dang mjug byang sanyis ni snyan ngag gi lam nas brjod yod la khrims gzhung hril po'i 175tsam zin 'dug gzhung dngos la don tshan 282ldan cing gtso cher gtug bsher byed lugs dang stong 'jal lugs/ dmag mi'i sa skal/ bogs len gla ba/ tshong las kyi skyed la bun bran/ shul 'dzin dbang cha/ gnod bskyal ba'i chad pa/ bran g.yog gi thob thang sogs phyogs yongs nas gna' bo'i pa pi lun spyi tshogs kyi rnam pa gsal por mtshon yo da la /rgyal ngo han mu'u la pi kyi dbang sgyur gyi thabs shes kyang bye bras tu mngon par bkod yod/ de ni mi rnams kyis tan mu'u la pi dang gna' bo'i gtsang po gnyis 'bab yul gyi spyi tshogs dang chab srid/ dpa la 'byor bcas la zhib 'jug byed par rin thang ches cher ldan pa'i thog ma'i dpyad gzhi ru gyur/der brten/ sa 'og nas bton pa'i ka zlum dbyibs kyi khrims gzhung rdo ring de 'dzam gling hril po'i rna ba gtod pa'i gna' rdzas rtog zhib kyi gsar 'gyur gal chen zhig tu gyur cing / nang sgos su h+pha ran si'i gna' rdzas 'tshol zhib ru khag de su bas kyang dga' ba 'bum gyis myos bzhin/ gang myur sgos rdo ring de h+pha ran si ru bskyal te nyar tshags gnang / deng gi dus su yang pha ri si (98113 3 )yi lte ba'i lu'u glor dngos mang bshams ston khang du ka zlum dardibs kyi khrims gzhung rdo ring de nged cag gi mig lam du snang thub/ de'i

rjes kyi mi lo lnga bcu nas drug cu tsam gyi dus yun du/ gna' rdzas rtog zhib pa tshos mu mthud du han mu'u la pi dang pa pi lun gyi 'brel yod yig cha gang mang bstud mar gsar rnyed byung la/ de dag gi gras su han mu'u la pi kyi springs yig brgya lhag mchis pa de/ 'u cag gis rgyal po han mu'u la pi la gom gang mdun spos kyis rgyus lon dang zhib 'jug byed par med du mi rung ba'i dpyad gzhi'i yig cha ru gyur yod/rgyal khab khrimasakyis bskyangs tshul/han mu'u la pi srid khrir mnga' gsol nas pha shul bus 'dzin byed skabs/ pa pi phun ni mnga' khongs hril por shar nub tu spyi le 130dang lho byang la spyi le 20lhag tsam las med pa'i rgyal phran chung ngu zhig red/ mnga' khongs rgya bskyed dang rgyal khab kyi go gnas mthor 'degs gtong dgos na rgyalakhab stobs ldan du bsgyur dgos par dgongs te/ khong gis lo ngo drug tsam gyi ring la thugs nus yod rgu bton nas rgyal nang gi chab srid dang dmag don gyi 'dzugs skrun/ khrims gzhung gtan 'bebs/ stobs shugs gsog 'jog gnang bar ma zad/ byang phyogs kyi rgyal khab chen mo yā hru'u la mgo bsgur nas skyabs bcol nas bde 'jags kyi rgyal spyi'i khor yug bzang bo zhig bskrun yod pa red/ pa pi lun ni rgyal pos srid dbang sger 'dzin gyi lam lugs gnyer ba'i rgyal khab zhig red/ han mu'u la pi nas dus dang rnam pa kun tu krung dbyang gis dbang cha gcig sdud la shugs snon dang / srid 'dzin dang khrims 'dzugs/ khrims 'dzin/ dmag don bcas kyi dbang cha yongs su sger 'dzin byas shing / blon chen ched bskos kyis rgyal srid la rogs skyor dat+ta sa

gnas so sor spyi dpon mngags gtong lam lugs gsar du btod/ krung dbyang dang sa gnas so so'i zhi drag dpon blon yongs kyis dus nam yang kho'i bka' gsung yod do cog dpral ba'i mig ltar gces dgos/ han mu'u la pi nas kyang rang nyid kyi srid dbang sra brtan du gtong phyir sna rgyal po'i dbang cha lha nas bstsal ’ bar 'ud sgrog byas/ khrims gzhung du khos gnam lha an no'u dang gzhi bdag yin lir lta bu'i lha'i tshogs kyis rgyal khab kyi srid dbang khong la gnang bas/ khong ni lha'i pho nya'am 6 rgyal po'i nang gi rgyal po/’ 6 pa pi lun gyi nyi ma rang yin par gleng / rdo ring du snang ba'i 'bur brkos ri mo de dag ni khos rtogs bzo byas pa'i 6 rgyal po'i dbang cha lha nas stsol ’ bzhin pa'i rnam pa yin/ de yang ji lta bu zhig red snyam na 'bur ris de ru mi gnyis yod de/ g.yas phyogs su nyi lha hra ma hri tsog pur bzhugs shing / g.yon phyogs su rgyal po han mu'u la pi nas gus pa'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas nyi lha'i phyag nas srid kyi khrims dbyug chen mo tshur bzhes bzhin pa'i tshul brkos yod/de ni han mu'u la pi nas rang nyid kyi srid dbang sra brtan du gtong ba'i gzhung lugs kyi gzhi 'dzin sa gtso bo'ang yin/gna' bo'i pa pi lun gyi bran g.yog spyi tshogs su spyi dmangs rnams bran g.yog dang dmangs rang dbang can gnyis su bkar zhing / dmangs rang dbang can yang a we la'u dang mu'u hri chin nu'u zhes rigs gnyis su bkar yod/ han mu'u la pi nas dbang sgyur la go 'dzol mi 'byung ba'i phyir du rim pa so so'i spyi dmangs kyi go gnas gtan 'bebs gsal por gnang yod de/a we lu'u zer ba ni dbang cha cha tshang longs su spyod rgyu yod pa'i dmangs rang dbang can dang / mu'u hri chin nu'u ni dbang cha cha shas las ma thob pa'i dmangs yin/ tan mu'u la pi yi khrims gzhung ltar na/ gal te mi su zhig giswā a we lu'u mi'i lus phung la rmas skyon btang tshe so la so tshab dang mig la

mig skyin 'jal dgos/ 'on kyang mu'u hri chin nu'u zhig la rmas skyon phog tshe dngul chad phran tsam 'jal bas chog de las gzhan dmangs rang dbang can 'di gnyis kyi ngal rtsol las thob pa'i gla phogs kyang gtan nas mi 'dra ste/gal te sman pa zhig gis ling tog gi nad phog pa'i a we lu'u zhig la bshag bcos byas pa'i yong 'bab ni dngul hre khe li 10(khe34 16dang 'dra )yin la/mu'u hri chin nu'u zhig la gong dang gcig mtshungs kyi bshag bcos byas rung dngul hri khe li 5yi sman yon tsam las thob mi thub/ pa pi lun rgyal rabs kyi bran g.yog bdag po phal cher a we lu'u la gtogs shing / mu'u hri chin nu'u ni dpal 'byor steng pho brang la dbang ba'i mi ser yin pa ste/ 'ga' zhig ni pho brang la skyabs bcol nas sa zhing dang khang khyim thob pa'i dpya khral 'bul mkhan nam de dag gi mi rgyud yin pa dang / 'ga' zhig ni sa zhing dang khang khyim gyi bgos skal thob rjes gra sgrig dmag dpung du zhugs pa'i dmag mi sha stag red/ bran g.yog la mtshon na kho tsho ni bran bdag gi sger la dbang ba'i rgyu nor lta bu yin pas gang 'dod du nyo tshong dang gnang sbyin/ gta' mar 'jog pa bcas byas chog bran g.yog gi rin gong de spyir btang du dngul hre khe li 20yin pa de sgo zog gcig gi rin gong dang 'dra tsam yin/ kho tsho la bca' khrims thog dbang cha ci yang med pas/ bran g.yog la shi rmas byung ba de rmo phyugs bsha' ba'am ca lag yo byad gcog pa ltar khrims 'gal du mi brtsi bar bran bdag la gsab dngul 'os 'tsham sprod pa las bca' khrims kyi nyes chad ci yang 'khur mi dgos/han mu'u la pi'i khrims gzhung du gang nus sgos bran bdag gi khe dbang la srung skyob byas yod de/ bran bdag gi sgo phyugs dang 'bru rigs/ ca lag yo byad sogs rku mkhan la nyes chad lci mo gcod pa dang / lha khang dang pho brang gi rgyu nor brkus tshe srog khrims gcod pa/ nor lug dang bong bu/ phagazha gru

gzings sogs brkus pa la rin gong gi ldab 10nas 30bar gyi dngul chad 'jal dgos/ gal te dngul 'jal ma thub tshe srog khrims gcod pa bcas kyi gtan 'bebs byas yod do/bran bdag la thon skyed rgyu cha tsam dbang bar ma zad/ da dung thon skyed mkhan te bran g.yog kyang dbang ba ni bran g.yog spyi tshogs kyi khyad chos gtso bo zhig yin/ bran bdag gis bran g.yog bdag gir 'dzin lugs srung skyob byed ched du han mu'u la pi nas 'di ltar gtan 'bebs gnang don/ gal te bran g.yog gis bran bdag la khyod ni nga'i bdag po min lta bu'i tshig cig smras na kho'i rna ba gnyis gcod chog bran g.yog rnams gnyen bsgrigs chog la phru gu'ang skyes chog 'on kyang bran g.yog gi bu phug kyang kho'i pha ma dang 'dra bar nam yang bran g.yog yin/ bran bdag gi mnar gcod ma bzod par bran g.yog rnams yul gzhan la bros byol du 'gro mi mang bar brten/ han mu'u la pi nas bran g.yog la bsreg tham rgyag tu bcug pa dang / bran g.yog so so'i skra sla tshul yang gzhan dang mi 'dra ba bya dgos pa'i bka' bstsal/ gal te skra bzhar mkhan gyis rang 'dod du bran g.yog gi sku'i sla tshul bsgyur na bran bdag gis kho tsho'i mdzub mo gcod chog bros byol du song ba'i bran g.yog rnams 'dzin bzung thebs rjes phyir bran bdag la sprod dgos pa las rang 'aspyad sdus nyo tshong ngam sba gsang byed mkhan la srid gzhung gis srog khrims ga da /spri dbang dmangs rang dbang can nang khul gyi 'brel ba legs bcos dang bran g.yog lam lugs kyi rmang gzhi sra brtan du gtong phyir/ han mu'u la pi kyis sger la dbang ba'i lam lugs dang bran bdag gi khe phan la srung skyob byed pa'i dus mtshungs su/ bran bdag gis 'dzem bag med par sger dbang mdi/ chung chung can la bsha gzhog byed par bkag 'gog gnang myong / skyed

mtho'i dngul bun la dper mtshon na/ gal te bu lon 'jal mkhan gyis 'bru rigs dang dngul gyi bu lon 'jal ma thub tshe/ nor rdzas dang mi lus gta' mar 'jog dgos shing / 'on kyang bun bdag gis bu lon 'jal mkhan brda ci yang ma sprad par gta' ma len mi chog mi lus gta' mar bzhag pa'i bun bran la mnar gcod btang ste sdug shi thebs su 'jug mi chog par ma zad/sdu/ zlonā ñcā /na tshad lo gsum las 'da' mi chog pa sogs kyi gtan 'bebs han mu'u la pi la grangs mang zhing g.yul du dpa' ba'i dmag gi dpung stobs btsan po zhig yod la/ de ni bo'i srid dbang sra brtan du gtong byed stobs shugs gtso bo yin/ dmag mi'i rgyab skyor thob par ma zad dam ga khungs 'dzad mtha' med pa zhig yong phyir/ khos rgyal khab kyi sa zhing de dmag dpon dang dmas mi'i khyim tshang la gnang sbyin byas/ 'di lta bu'i sa zhing yod tshad mi rabs nas mi rabs su rgyud 'dzin byed chog mod kyang rang 'dod du nyo tshong byed mi chog dmag dpon gyis dam ga mi'i rgyu nor btsan 'phrog byed pa la srog khrims gcod pa'i gtan 'bebs byas yod/zhing las thon skyed ni pa pi lun gyi dbya khral gyi 'byung khungs 'gyur med brtan po yin pas/ chu yur bzo skrun dang de'i do dam gyis zhing la sa kyi yong 'bab la thad kur shugs rkyen thebs kyin yod/ han mu'u la pi yi sku ring du khos thengs 'gar yul mi bsdus te chu rags 'dzugs skrun dang / sku dngos kyis 6 chu yur pho nya bskos te chu bed 'dzugs skrun la do dam byas/ sa zhing rmo 'debs byed par phan ched du rtag par dpon rigs khag la bkod 'doms mdzad de zhing nang du yur chu 'dzad med du 'dren rgyu yod pa'i khag theg bya rgyu'i mdzub ston gnang / han mu'u la pi khong nyid ni thugs ngal la mi 'jom par srid don phran tshegs tsam yang sku dngos kyis thugs 'khur /spyang

mkhan zhig yin phyir/ dmag dpung mngags gtong dang bca' khrims gtan 'bebs/ dpon rigs bsko bzhag mis bzos gtsang po'i 'dzugs skrun/dpya khral bsdu ba/ lha khang do dam/ tha na gzhung las ngal rtsol gyi bkod sgrig dang rul sungs dpon ngan la nyes chad gcod pa sogs kyang thugs su 'dogs pa'i rgyal po chen po zhig yin 'dugadrag po'i dpyang gis rgyal khams dbang du bsdus tshul/han mu'u la pi nas lo ngo drug ring gi dka' spyad 'bad 'bungs brgyud de rgyal khab kyi stobs shugs ches cher rgyas byung / gtsang po gnyis 'bab yul gyi rgyal khab stobs ldan khag gis dus yun ring por dmag 'khrug gi rgyun ma chad stabs rgyal khab so so'i stobs 'byor la nyams nyes chen po byung yod par brten/ tan mu'u la pi nas da ni phyi phyogs su mnga' khongs rgya bskyed pa'i dus la babs par dgongs te/ rgyal phran phan tshun dbar gyi 'gal zla bed spyod dang ring 'grogs nye rgol gyi rtsa ba'i dmag jus lag len du bstar/ khos sngar bzhin yā hru'u rgyal khab kyi dbang sgyur khas len byed pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng du/ byang phyogs kyi mā lis dang lho phyogs kyi lar sā sogs rgyal khab khag la mnyam 'brel gyis lho phyogs kyi khyim mtshes dbyi zhin rgyal khab rdul du brlags/dbyi zhin dbang du bsdus rjes lar sā rgyal khab ni pa pi lun gyi lho phyogs su ches nye ba'i khyim mtshes su gyur/ han mu'u la pi kyis snga mo nas bzung stobs 'byor che ba'i lar sā dang rgyal pham gyi shan 'byed ched du mā lis rgyal khab dang mna' 'brel gyi 'brel ba je dam du btang / khong dang mā lis rgyal po'i bar phan tshun la springs yig rgyug che zhing spun zla ltar mdza' brtse zab pas/rgyalaspyi'i bya gzhag khrod mnyam 'brel byed rgyu dang dmag don thad phan tshun rgya snror byed rgyu'i kha chad bzhag tan mu'u la pi kyis mā lis rgyal khab la

rgyab skyor mdzad de yā hru'u yi dbang sgyur las thar cing rgyal khab gzhan gyi btsan 'dzul mkhan rnams yod tshad pham par btang / khong gi sku drin 'jal slad du mā lis rgyal pos kyang pa pi lun gyis lar sā ru dpung 'jug byed skabs mthun rkyen sbyor rgyu'i khas len phul/lar sā dang pa pi lun rgyal khab gnyis po de yi'u h+pha la ti gtsang po'i sked rgyud du gnas shing / pa pi lun ni lar sā las kyang cung stod rgyud du chags yod/ han mu'u la pi nas sa bab kyi cha rkyen bzang po 'dir brten nas gtsang po'i bzhur rgyun gcod pa'am/ yang na chu sgo glo bur du phyes te lar sā la than pa dang chu log gi gnod 'tshe ya nga ba thebs su 'jug gin yod/lo 'ga'i ring gi gnod 'tshe khel mthar lar sā rgyal khab kyi stobs shugs nyin bzhin nyams rgud du gyur cing / spyi lo'i sngon gyi 1763lor tan mu'u la pi nas lar sā la dngos su phar rgol byas/ pa pi lun gyi dmag dpung gis lar hā'i btsan rdzong gi mtha' dam por bskor cing zla 'ga'i rjes su han mu'u la pi la mgo 'dogs mi byed thabs med byung /han mu'u la pi lar sā las rnam par rgyal ba des mā lis kyi rgyal por dngangs skrag chen po bslangs/ khos gang myur sgos pa pi lun la dmag rogs su bskyod pa'i dmag dpung slar bkug rung / blo yul las 'das pa zhig la pa pi lun gyi stobs shugs mā lis las lhag par ma zad/ han mu'u la pi nas dmag dpung la ngal gso dang sbyong brdar yun thung zhig byed du bcug rjes/byang phyogs kyi mā lis su dmag sna drangs te mthar dpung med nyam chung du lus pa'i mā lis kyis kyang mgo mi 'dogs thabs med byung / dus de nas bzung han mu'u la pi nas drag po'i g.yul gyi bya bar brten nas shar phyogs kyi e hri no'u nā sogs rgyal phran rnams dbang du bsdus shing / sngar pa pi lun la yun ring du dbang sgyur byas myong ba'i yā hru'u dang g.yul bshams par/ rdi sna'u

rgyal khab rtsa bslog gtong ma thub rung de'i lho phyogs kyi mnga' khongs yongs dbang du bsdus/lo lnga'i ring gi dmag 'khrug brgyab pa brgyud de mthar tan mu'u la pi nas gtsang po gnyis kyi 'bab yul phal che ba gcig gyur mdzad cing / sngar mnga' khongs yongs su spyi le gru bzhi ma 3000tsam las ma mchis pa'i rgyal phran zhig da lta stag gzig mtsho 'gag ( nyu4467spyo)nas sa dkyil rgya mtsho chen mor thug gi bar stobs kyis khyab pa'i rgyal khab chen mo zhis tu gyur/ mnga' khongs gsar ba ru dbang du bsdu ba dang srid dbang sra brtan gtong slad du han mu'u la pi nas spyi dpon bsko bzhag dang khos gtan 'khel gnang ba'i khrims srol lag len du bstar/ khos btsan rgyal nang khul gyi sa gnas so so'i srol rgyun gyi rig gnas la'ang mthong chen dang brtsi 'jog byed pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan/ han mu'u la pi nas ka zlum dbyibs kyi khrims pa pi lun grong khyer gyi mchod lha zhes pa lha'i gzhung rdo ring /tshogs kyi dbang bor bskos shing / krung dbyang gis dbang cha gcig sdud kyi dgos mkho dang dbang sgyur sa khul so so'i dad ldan mang tshogs kyi brtse dung la brtsi 'jog byed ched du/ grong khyer so so'i srung ma'i lha sku dang mchod khang sogs slar gso dang gsar bzhengs mdzad/ yin na'ang dbang sgyur sa khul so /sbya ngo log zing 'khrug la khos snying rje bral ba'i dras gnon byas myong /

dper na spyi lo'i sngon gyi 1757lor mā lis rgyal pos ngo log zing 'khrug bslangs par/ han mu'u la pi nas dpung chen btegs te longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa'i mā lis grong khyer shul med du bzos shing / mā lis rgyal pos lag zung gis bskrun pa'i brjid chags kyi pho brang yang mer bsregs/tan mu'u la pi ni e sha ya'i nub phyogs su byon pa'i bran g.yog bdag po'i gral rim gyis ngo gnongs mi dgos pa'i phul du byung ba'i chab srid pa zhig yin te/ khos gtsang po gnyis 'bab yul gyi sa khul yongs gcig gyur btang ba des tshad nges can gyi steng nas sa khul de'i lo rgyus la skul 'ded kyi nus pa chen po thon yod/ der brten pa pi lun grong khyer yang e sha ya'i nub phyogs kyi ches che ba'i chab srid dang dpal 'byor/ rig gnas bcas kyi lte bar gyur cing / mi'i rigs shes rig gi 'phel rgyas la rlabs chen gyi byas rjes bzhagatan mu'u la pi nas kho'i btsan rgyal 'di ji srid du gnas pa'i bsam 'dun bcangs te/ tshe smad du khong gis gtan la phab pa'i khrims gzhung de 'jong dbyibs can gyi rdo ring du brkos te mar tu'u khe'i 'du khang chen mo ru bzhengs shing / kho'i bu rabs tsha rgyud kyis kyang khong gi lugs srol ltar srid 'gan bzhes ched khrims gzhung de'i mjug byang du/ gal te rjes rabs pas nga'i rdo ring du brkos pa'i bka' gsung snang med du brtsis na/ kho'i gzi brjid lha yis 'joms shing bka' yig 'thor/ las dbang la dmod thebs te 'chi bar gdon mi za zhes bkod/ blo phangs pa zhig la han mu'u la pi gshegs nas cher ma lon par pa pi lun du 'thab 'khrug gi me lce drag tu mched cing /phyi dgra bo'i btsan 'dzul 'og btsan rgyal thor zhig tu gyur cing gtsang po gnyis kyi 'bab yul du bdag po brje spo mang du byung / tha na mar tu'u khe'i 'du khang chen mo'i ka zlum dbyibs kyi khrims gzhung rdo ring de yang / spyi lo'i sngon gyi dus rabs 13par dbyi rang mtho sgang gi btsan 'dzul mkhan te1/3 e
tsan nga ngo

rlabs chen gyi khrims 'dzugs mkhan so lun/ spyi lo'i sngon gyi dus rabs 8pa nas 6pa'i bar ni gna' bo'i ke ri se'i bran g.yog lam lugs kyi grong khyer mna' 'brel rgyal khab dbu brnyes pa'i dus skabs yin/ grong khyer mna' 'brel zhes pa ni mtha' 'khor grong sde'i sa khul 'dus pa'i grong khyer zhig lte bar bzung pa'i gcig gyur gyi dpal 'byor dang chab srid kyi thun mong gi tshogs pa zhig la go zhing spyir btang du ha cang chung / ke ri se'i phyed gling du 'di lta bu'i rgyal khab brgya phrag kha shas mchis/ya ten (sa 'i bcu sko)ni de dag las grong khyer mna' 'brel gal chen zhig ༷na la bran g.yog bdag po'i dmangs gtso'i chab srid kyi dpe mtshon yang na/ grong khyer mna' 'brel dbu brnyes pa'i thog ma'i dus rim du ya ten nas sngar bzhin rus rgyud lam lugs kyi lhag 'phro tshar gcod thub med pas/rgyal khab kyi dbang cha yod tshad rus rgyud sku drag rnams kyi lag tu tshud yod/kho tsho kho nar da gzod ches mtho'i srid 'dzin dpon te srid skyong dang / ches mtho'i jus 'don las khungs te sku drag gros khang gi 'thus mi ru 'dems pa'i khe dbang yod/ sku drag la khrims 'dzugs dang srid 'dzin/ khrims 'dzin sogs kyi dbang cha chen po ldan/ rus rgyud kung hre'i dus skabs kyi dbang 'dzin las khungs te spyi dmangs tshogs chen rim bzhin nyams rgud du gyur cing byed nus ci yang 'don mi thub pa/ sku drag rnams kyis srid dbang sger 'dzin byed 'go tshugs pa dang tshong las kyi sted mtho'i dngul bun gyi ||la

'byor 'phel rgyas su phyin pa dang chabs cig ya ten gyi sku drag dang mi ser gyi 'gal ba nyin bzhin dza drag tu gyur pa red/ sku drag bun bdag gis dbang shugs dang dpal 'byor gyi cha rkyen 'dzoms par brten nas mi rigs gzhan gyi bran g.yog la mnar gcod btang bar ma zad/ skyed mtho'i dngul bun gyi bshu gzhog byas drags pas rgya che ba'i grong gseb kyi mi ser dkyus ma ste/zhing ba dbul po dang lag shes bzo las pa chung gras rnams kyis bu lon 'jal phyir du sa zhing dang bu dang chung ma btsongs pa/ tha na rang lus kyang gta' mar bzhag ste bun bran gyi gnas su lhung / dka' sdug dang nyam thag gi 'tsho ba'i mdun du rgya che ba'i mi ser gyis sku drag gi dbang sgyur la zhe sdang dang khong khro chen po skyes byung /rus rgyud sku drag gi dmigs bsal dbang char yang mtho rim mi ser te gsar dar bzo tshong las rigs kyi bran bdag rnams kyi blor mi 'bab pa byung yod/ ya ten gyi rang byung thon khungs ha cang phun sum tshogs la bde thang sa khul du rgun 'brum dang skyu ru ra sogs dpal 'byor can gyi skye dngos dang /ri khul du dngul gter dang rdo ka ma ru/ rdzo sa spus legs can rnams mchis shing / rgya mtsho'i 'gram rgyud kyi gru kha'i bzo tshong las rigs dang phyi 'brel nyo tshong gi 'phel rgyas ha cang myur bas/ tshong las gnyer bzhin pa'i bran g.yog bdag po'i dpal 'byor gyi stobs shugs nyin bzhin che ru phyin/ 'on kyang gsar dar gyi bran g.yog bdag po phal mo che'i skye khungs dman stabs rus rgyud sku drag yin pa rnams kyi mthong chung myong dgos pa dang / grong khyer mna' 'brel gyi srid dbang la the gtogs byed mi chog pa/ rus rgyud sku drag gi bshu gzhog tshad las brgal bar brten/ ya ten gyi mi 'bor nyin bzhin nyung du phyin cing thon skyed je zhan/ rgyal nang gi tshong ra'ang chung du phyin pa dedi zlozo tshong las rigs gom gang mdun spos kyis 'phel rgyas su 'gro bar

bkag rgya thebs/ bzo tshong las rigs kyi bran g.yog bdag po rnams kyis sku drag gi rgyud 'dzin khyad dbang med par bzo ba dang / rus rgyud lam lugs kyi lhag ro rtsa med du btang ste grong khyer mna' 'brel gyi dbang sgyur la chab srid kyi dbang cha brtson len byas nas bran g.yog bdag po'i dpal 'byor gyi 'phel rgyas la mdun lam yangs por phye rgyu'i rme thur+sha9 re 'dun chen po 'ching bzhin yod/ spyir nyatredzengasna bzo tshong las rigs kyi bran g.yog bdag po tshori dang mi ser dkyus ma 'i bar du 'gal ba che chiyang / dus rgyud sku drag la ngo rgol byed ched du /bo tsho tshang mas mdzub mo lnga bcings khu tshur/ tsho lcags rdo sngon mo'i rang tshugs kyi dpe bzhin dpung ba ma/nyam gshib kyis 'thab rtsod yun ring du byas/ de dag gi brgyud rim brod phul du byung pa'i chab srid pa'ang mang du byon myong ‘la so lun ni kho tsho'i gral gyi skyes chen zhig yin so lun gyi dbu brnyan/par ma zad/ ya ten gyi dmangs gtso'i chab srid la rmang gzhi brtan po 'ding bar byas rjes rlabs chen bzhag yod/sa la smi si dgra lag nas phyir 'phrog pa/so lun ni spyi lo'i sngon gyi 638lor nyams rgud du gyur ba'i sku drag cig gi khyim du sku 'khrungs shing / lo na gzhon pa'i dus su khyim gyi 'byor ba zhan stabs/ 'tsho gnas kyi ched du khos nam rgyun tshong las gnyer te ke ri se'i grong khyer gang mang dang a she ya chung ba sogs su phebs myong / rus rgyud sku drag gi khengs dregs dang mi ser gyi sdug bsngal sna tshogs zhal gyis gzi/sdu pa

des/ khong nyid skye khungs rigs nus mtho yang chab srid kyi steng nas blo kha bzo tshong las rigs kyi bran g.yog bdag por phyogs shing sku drag gi dbang sgyur la ngo rgol byed 'go tshugs/ so lun gyis tshig sbyor btsan la tshor 'du shugs drag pa'i snyan ngag mang du brtsams te rus rgyud sku drag gi ham sems r+shadro /hāg rtsub la sun 'byin dang ther 'don drag po gnang myong / dper na /stobs dang 'byor ba sa 'dzin las brjid zas gos mod pa'i sku drag 'dod pa'i rta rgod khog tu gcun te ham sems dri ngan ring du thor//ngasbya snyam pa'i dregs gtam spangs shing khengs skyungs pad+mo grol bar /nga kā/sdu 'dod don ji bzhin mi srid gzhan gyi ngag la nyan rkyang byed zhe shā r+sha su/ngas/ so lun khong nyid snyan ngag 'bri rgyur dga' bar ma zad snyan ngag pa'i mtshan snyan thob yod pa bden rung / khos ya ten gyi srid stegs su rang mdangs mngon thub pa de yang kho'i rtsom rtsal tsam ma yin par rgyal gces kyi spobs sems dang dmag 'thab kyi byas rjes rang yin no//spyi lo'i sngon gyi dus rabs 6pa'i dus mjug tu sa la smi si (9khri stsalo)gling phran gyi ched du ya ten dang kho'i khyim mtshes rgyal khab mo ca la bar 'khrug rtsod byung / sa la smi si de ya ten gyi mtsho kha ru gnas yod pas rgyal khab 'di'i phyi 'brel nyo tshong gi 'phel rgyas la go gnas gal chen zin yod/ thengs 'ga'i g.yul 'gyed khrod ya ten la pham kha chen po bzos rkyen gnyon chung nus med kyi dbang sgyur pas mgo 'dogs byed ched du/ 6 deng phyin chad nas bzung mi su zhiswā spyas sa la smi si zhes pa'i ming tsam gleng na kho la srog khrims gcod rgyu

yin ’ zhes bka' yig bkrams/ sa la smi si ni ya ten gyi mnga' khongs bsnyon med yin rung / dbang sgyur pa'i nus med nyam chung gi bya spyod de mi rigs rangagi ngo tsha ru mthong ste/ so lun smyon par brdzus te dbu la me tog gi cod pan mnabs shing lu ba'i sgrog bu lhod de sa lding gnam lding gis thang chen du rgyug zhor du/ mthar nye 'khor du 'dus pa'i mang tshogs la rang nyid kyi snyan ngag gyer thengs rer lag zung gis brang khog rnga chen ltar brdung ste/6 kye ma/ nga tsho'i snying sdug gi sa la smis zir/spobs pa cher bskyed kyis mdun du bskyod dang /brjid chags kyi gling phran 'di'i phyir du/yab mes kyi la rgya yi phyir du/dpungatsho rdin gyi gom stabs mdun phyogs su bgrod cigakhong gis // rgyal/ la bcangs pa'i tshor 'du drag po'i brtse dung gi sgul shugs 'og ya ten pa rnams slar yang re bas khengs te/ rgya che ba'i mang tshogs kyi ngo rgol 'og srid gzhung gis rgyal khab kyi bdag dbang dang la rgya shor ba'i bka' yig de med par mi bzo thabs med byung / spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo 600bar/ rang lo 38son pa'i dmag spyi chen mo so lun gyis mdzangs shing brtul phod kyi dmag dpung zhig gi sne khrid de g.yul 'thab drag pos sa la smi si dgra lag nas phyir 'phrog gling phran de gna' snga mo'i dus nas bzung ya ten gyi mnga' khongs yin par bden dpang byed ched du/ so lun gyis dur sa 'ga' zhig bsngogs te mi rnams la/ bem po dang dur khung gi gdong kha shar phyogs kyi mtshams sprin la gtad de/ 'das po'i ming dur byang du mi brko bar sa ming brko ba de ya ten pa dang gnyis su ma mchis par bden dpang mdzad/sa la smi si phyir dgra lag nas 'phrog rjes/ so lun gyi mtshan snyan g.yu drisag

ltar ldir zhing mi ser rnams kyi brtsi bkur bla na med pa thob/bcos bsgyur gyi 'go brtsams pa/mi ser dang sku drag bar gyi 'thab rtsod khrod du mi ser dkyus mas drag shugs la brten nas rang nyid kyi re 'dun mtshon gyin yod/ spyi lo'i sngon gyi 594lor/ mi ser dkyus mas yang bskyar 'os langs byed grabs mchis pa'i nyen kha'i 'og ya ten gyi sku drag rnams kyis so lun dbu bzhugs srid skyong dpon du mi bsko thabs med byung / dus de nas bzung khong gi chab srid bcos bsgyur gyi phugs bsam yang rim gyis mngon 'gyur byed 'go tshugs/lo de'i zhogs pa zhig la/ so lun gzi brjid dang bcas 'chad stegs su bud de zhing pa dang lag shes bzo las pa/ gsar dar bzo tshong las rigasakyi bran bdag sogs mang tshogs khri stong mang bor yā ten grong khyer gyi thang chen nas gtam bshad gnang / khong der bslangs pa'i shing sgrom zhig gi mdun du slobs pa na mtshar snang skye bzhin pa'i mang tshogs rnams de ma thag dal cag ger gyur cing / ci yin snyam pa'i mig zung che ru bgrad de khong la bltas 'dug par/ so lun gyis shing sgrom der sor mos dal gyis brdungs pa na shing sgrom gyi bar du btsir ba'i shing leb de snyoms 'khor zhig brgyab pa dang bstun/ de'i rgyab ngos kyi bca' khrims gsar ba'i don tshan rnams mi rnams kyi mig mdun du mngon byung / khos shing leb de ston bzhin skad gseng mthon pos 6 dus de ring nas bzung / gzhung dang sger gyi bu lon yod tshad med par bzos pa yin pa dang / bu lon gyi tshab tu sa zhing gta' mar bzhag pa rnams phyir bdag por sprod dgos shing bu lon gyi dbang gis rang lus btsong pa'i bun bran rnams kyi mi lus rang dbang slar gso bya dgos pa/ phyi rgyal du ba~Xs pa'i bun bran rnams rgyal khab kyis tshur blu nyo byed rgyu dang / deng

phyin mi su zhig yin rung rang lus bu lon gyi gta' mar 'jog mi chog par gtan la phabs shing / bca' khrims 'di'i spyod yun lo 100yin par srid khrims kyi 'gan len yod ces so lun gyis don tshan re bklags pa dang thang chen du mi tshogs kyi dga' spro'i 'bod sgras khengs shing ya ten yongs su dga' ston gyi dpal gyis khyab/ khong gi bca' khrims kyi gtan 'beb gsar ba 'di la snyan grags che ba'i 8 khur 'bebs bka' yig ces grags/6 khur 'bebs kyi bka' yig lag len du bltar phyir so lun gyis thog mar rang dpe gzhan ston mdzad de/ bun bran rnams kyis rang gi pa'i bu lon chad rigs 'jal mi dgos pa zhal gyis bzhes shing / rgyal dmangs yongs kyis khong gi lad zlos bya dgos pa'i 'bod skul btang / khur 'bebs kyi bka' yig rgya khyab tu spel ba des skyed mtho'i bu lon len pa'i sku drag 'ga' shas kyi khe phan la gnod 'tshe thebs rung / bu lon chad mkhan gyi khe phan la srung skyob dang mi ser dkyus ma'i sdug bsngal gyi khur po je yang du btang zhing spyi tshogs kyi thon skyed nus shugs bcings 'grol thob/ bka' yig 'dis tshong rdzas sger la dbang mkhan chung 'bring gi dpal 'byor gyi 'phel rgyas la mthun rkyen bskrun cing / phyogs gzhan zhig nas dmangs rang dbang can thun mong nas gzhan rigs kyi bran g.yog la 'phrog bcom dang rus rgyud gzhan par bshu gzhog byed par bgrod lam gsar du btod/ dus de nas bzung ya ten bran g.yog lam lugs kyi dpal 'byor mgyogs myur ngang 'phel rgyas byung /so lun gyis da dung bcos bsgyur gyi thabs shes gal chen gnyis spyad yod de/ gcig ni 'byor ba'i chu tshad ltar ya ten pa rnams dmangs rim pa bzhi ru bkar khar de rmang gzhir bzung ste dmag dpung sgrig 'dzugs byas/lo rer yong 'bab 'bru breX 5rtsiyan zin pa la dmangs rim dang po 2)nga /

'bru bre 300yan zin pa rnams dmangs rim gnyis pa/ 'bru bre 200yan chad zin pa dmangs rim gsum pa/ 'bru bre 200man chad rnams dmangs rim bzhi bar bkar zhing / dmangs rim dang po dang gnyis pa'i spyi dmangs te sku drag dang bzo tshong las rigs kyi bran g.yog bdag pos rgyal khab kyi ches mtho'i srid 'dzin dpon gyi 'gan bzhes chog cing srid gzhung la skya dmag 'don sprod bya dgos/ dmangs rim gsum pa'i spyi dmangs kyis rgyal khab kyi dpon gnas phal ba dang go mtshon lci mo khur ba'i rkang dmag gi dpung 'dzugs dgos/ dmangs rim bzhi pa'i spyi dmangs (mi 'di dag sngar ha cang dbul bas drag chas ci yang med la spyi dmangs kyi dbang cha yang med )kyis dpon 'gan bzhes mi chog rung spyi dmangs tshogs chen dang khrims rar zur zhugs byas chog la/ dmag dpung du 'gan yang ba'i rkang dmag tu zhugs dgos pa'i gtan 'bebs gnang / bcos bsgyur byed thabs 'di dag brgyud nas so lun gyis rus rgyud sku drag rnams kyis srid dbang sger 'dzin gyi rmi lam sil bur gtor te/ bran g.yog bdag po'i dbang sgyur gyi rmang gzhi rgya skyed dang gsar dar bzo tshong las rigs kyi bran bdag gis srid 'gan bzhes par sgo 'phar yangs por phyes shing / mi ser dkyus mar 'dra mnyam gyi chab srid dbang cha ma thob rung kho tsho'i spyi tshogs kyi go gnas mthor 'degs chen po byung /so lun gyi rlabs chen gyi bcos bsgyur gzhan zhig ni 'thus mi bzhi brgya'i tshogs 'du dang khrims rar zur zhugs gnang rgyu de red/ 'thus mi bzhi brgya'i tshogs 'du zer ba ni tsho ba bzhi bo las 'thus mi 100re bdams shing / dmangs rim thog ma gsum po'i spyi dmangs shig yin phyin 'dems bsko byed pa'i dbang cha yod/ kho tsho'i las 'gan ni spyi dmangs tshogs 'dur groX /zhi gra sgrig dang grabs sgrig gros zhib bya dgos/ der brten spyi dmangs

tshogs 'du de sku drag tshogs 'du'i dbang sgyur las thar zhing / sku drag tshogs 'du'i dbang char tshod 'dzin byed pa'i stobs shugs gal chen zhig tu grub/khrims rar zur zhugs gnang mkhan de yang dmangs rim bzhi po las bdams thon byung ba'i khrims 'dzugs las khungs shig tu gyur yod la/ des sku drag kho nas khrims ra sger 'dzin gyi lo rgyus la rdzogs byang bris pa red/so lun gyis bcos bsgyur gyi brgyud rim khrod du bzo tshong las rigs kyi dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas dang / gsar dar bzo tshong las rigs kyi bran g.yog bdag po srung skyob byed pa'i srid jus dang bya thabs sna tshogs spel/khos phyi 'brel nyo tshong dang skyu ru ra'i snam gyi phyi tshong la skul ma btang nas de 'phel rgyas su song rung / rgyal nang gi 'bru rigs kyi dgos mkho skong ched 'bru rigs phyir gtong mi chog pa'i bka' yig bsgrags/ lag shes bzo las gong 'phel gtong phyir du lag rtsal brgyud 'dzin gang legs bya dgos te gal te a phas bu la lag rtsal ci yang ma bslabs na/ a pha na so rgas tshe bus gnyor skyong mi byed pa'i dbang cha yod/ so lun gyis da dung phyi rgyal gyi lag rtsal mkhas can gang mang ya ten du gtan sdod byed par skul lcag dang ya ten spyi dmangs kyi dbang cha spyod chog pa'i thag gcod gnang / rgyal yongs su 'jal byed gcig gyur dang dngul lor lam lugs la bcos bsgyur sogs don chen mang du spel/ 'di dag las gzhan khong gis khrims lugs gal chen 'ga' yang gtan 'bebs mdzad myong ste/ dper na/ sku drag tsho'i dur mchod kyi rgyas spros dang 'gro gron la tshod 'dzin/ yab mes kyi shul nor bag med du spyod mkhan yod na spyi dmangs kyi dbang cha 'phrog len dang / mi su yin rung srid gzhung la skyid 'dod las g.yol byed mkhan rnams gsang rtol byed chog par ma zad/ lus rtsal 'gran sdur gyi bya dga'i ma dngul tshod 'dzin gyis g.yul sar rang srog blos btang ba'i dpa' bo'i bya dga'i dngul mazlo du

btang ste khong tsho'i bu phrug rnams la 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen gzhung nas sbyor bar khag theg mdzad/ gtan 'bebs 'dis dmangs dmag la skul shugs thebs py-i /yul du 'chi ba de rang nyid kyi la rgya dang gzi brjid du brtsi mkhan mang du bcos bsgyur brgyud nas so lun gyis dpal 'byor dang chab srid sogs phyogs yongs nas rus rgyud sku drag gi stobs shugs la rdung rdeg drag po btang zhing / ya ten du gzhan rigs kyi bran g.yog bkol ba'i gna' bo'i bran g.yog lam lugs kyi spyi tshogs la rmang gzhi brtan por bting / da dung ya ten du sku drag gi chab srid nas bran bdag gi dmangs gtso'i chab srid du gong 'phel gtong bar mthun rkyen bskrun yod mod/ 'on kyang so lun khong nyid kyang bzo tshong las rigs kyi bran bdag gi tshab byed mkhan zhig las ma 'das pas/ kho'i bcos bsgyur gyis mi ser dkyus ma'i sa zhing thob 'dod kyi re ba bskangs ma thub la skong thabs kyang med par ma zad/ sngar mus bzhin sku drag gi khyad dbang gang mang sor bzhag byas yod/ lo du ma'i rjes su/ rus rgyud sku drag dang rgya che'i mi ser dkyus ma'i blor ma babs pa'i rnam 'gyur tshabs chen du song stabs/ so lun gyis las don la kha g.yar te ya ten nas rgyal khams kun tu ljongs rgyur phebs/su ni ches bde skyid ldan pa'i mi yin/so lun yā ten dang kha bral rjes e cib (2679 ṣ+ṭha1)dang seb ru si (05bskus tsho lo)/ a she ya chung ba sogs kyi sa char lo bcu'i ring la 'tsho ba ci dgar rol/ shes bya sbyong 'dod kyi kun slong drag pos khong sa gnas so so'i rang byung gi mdzes ljongs la gnas mjal du phebs pa'i bar ska sdu su/ mi rigs khag gi yul srol goms gshes dang chab srid lam lugs

sna tshogs zhib bsdur byas pa brgyud/ khong la blo bskyed gsar ba thob myong bas mi tshad mi sems spro ba 'phel ba'i gtam rgyud kyang mang du bzhag yod par snang / a she ya chung ba'i nub rgyud du ming la lu'e ti ya zer ba'i rgyal khab cig yod/ so lun gnas der 'byor rjes kyi nyin zhig la yul de'i rgyal pos khong pho brang du gdan 'dren zhus/ rgyal po khi lo'o yi sīs lus la 'byor lwa mnabs shing mu tig sna tshogs kyi rgyan spras yod la/ khengs dregs dang bcas zhabs phyi la bang mdzod kyi sgo mo phye zhig ces bka' bsgos rjes so lun la gzigs bzhin 6 ya ten nas phebs pa'i sku mgron lags/ nga tshos khyed ni shes byas thugs rgyud phyug pa'i mi blo rig bkra ba zhig yin pa gna' nas bzung go thos byung yod/ mi ji lta bu zhig la da gzod ches bde skyid ldan pa'i mi zer ba yin nam 7zhes dris pa na/ rgyal po'i sems su kho ni 'jig rten 'dir ches bde skyid ldan pa'i mi gcig pu rang yin snyam rung / so lun gyis 6 mi de ni ya ten gyi the lo'o zi las ma 'das/ rgyu mtshan ni mi des grong khyer mna' 'brel dar rgyas su btang bar ma zad kho'i bu dang bu mor 'jon thang ldan/mthar rang nyid kyang g.yul du bkrongs pa red ’ ces lan btabs/ rgyal po de ha cang yi ma rangs par yang skyar/ khong la 6 de las gzhan su zhig red dam ’ zhes sems su thengs 'dir nga rang las ma 'das snyam rung / so lun gyis 6 de yang a ko zi yi khe la'e o si dang pis tun spun mched yin la/ khong gnyis gzugs stobs rgyas shing lus rtsal 'gran sdur steng bya dga' thob myong bar ma zad/ de bas kyang bsngags brjod kyi me tog gtor 'os pa ni yum chen la bkur bsti byed pa'i kun spyod yag po de rang red/ a ko zi'i mi rnams kyis lha mo zhes 'ar (ge ri se'i lha sgrung du gling ba'i lha'i rgyal mo )mchod 'bul gyi nyin mo ru/ mi rnams kyis rang gi yum chen shing rta ru bzhu/lha te

mchod mjal du 'gro srol mchis/ 'on kyang nyin der kho tshang gi ba glang ri la shor stabs dus tshod 'gor 'gyangs mi yong ba'i ched du/ spun mched gnyis kyis mthar rang gi lus stobs la brten nas ma yum dus ltar lha mchod kyi mdzad sgo ru bskyal yang / phangs pa zhig la thang chad drags pa'i spun mched gnyis de ma thag mi yul dang gtan du gyes/ a ko zi pas khong gnyis kyi kun spyod la gus bkur 'os pa zhig yin snyam te du/ spun mched gnyis kyi 'jim sku lha khang du bzhengs te gzhon rabs rnams la skul ma gtong bzhin mchis ’ zhes gsungs/ der bstun so lun gyis rgyal po de la bde skyid kyi gnas lugs mang du brjod de/ 'phral gyi bde ba tsam thob pa la nga rgyal dang khengs dregs mi byed par gtan gyi bde ba 'tshol rgyu de mi'i bde skyid kyi mchog tu brtsi zhing /mi de yang ming don mtshungs pa'i ches bde skyid ldan pa'i mi yin no zhes gsungs pa la/ rgyal po de'i gdong la sprin nag 'khrigs shing mig zung las glog dmar 'khyug bzhin bgro gleng gi mtshams bcad cing so lun pho brang gi phyir bskud/ so lun gyi grogs po kha shas kyis khong la gzhan gyis rnga ji ltar brdung na/ khyed kyis bro de ltar 'khrab na cis mi bzang zhes 'khang ra byas pa na so lun gyis 8 de mi chog gtan nas mi chog gzhan la ngo bstod byed pa las phan pa'i drang gtam gleng bas dga' zhes gsungs/spyi lo'i sngon gyi 546lor/ stag gzig gis lu'e tis ya pham par brgyab zhing / sngar khengs dregs dang rang blo tshim pa'i rgyal po de yang da lta btson par gyur te srog khrims bcad/ gtam ngan de thos rjes khi la'o yis zi yis cos los hri dang stag gzig dmag mi'i mdun nas rang dbang med par 6 kye ma/ so lun zhes thengs gsum du bos byung / cos los hri'i dmag mi rnams ha cang ya mtshar ba'i ngang nas kho la ci lan zhes dris tshe/ khos dmag mi /sdus kyis so lun gyi zhal ta dang slob ston la ma gsan pas da lta btson

par gyur ba red ces 'gyod snang chen po skyes pa la/ cos los hri'i dmag mi rnams sems 'gul thebs te khi la'o yis zi btson grol btang /so lun sku tshe smad la phyir ya ten du log mi ser dang sku drag gi 'thab rtsod ha cang dbal tsha na'ang khong thengs de'i 'thab rtsod du ma zhugs par/rang khyim du zhib 'jug dang phyag rtsom gyi las la gzhol te bcoms chos mang du yod par grags kyang / da lta nged cag gi mig mthong lag zin du snang ba ni snyan ngag thar thor 'ga' las ci yang ma mchis so// spyi lo'i sngon gyi 559lor ya ten bzo tshong las rigs kyi mgrin tshab pa dang bcos bsgyur mkhan so lun glo bur du tshe las 'das/ kho'i nye du tshang mas khong gi zhal chems bzhin sngar khong gis zungs khrag 'pho sa'i sa lā mis zi'i gling du gdung thal gtor/ khong gi mdzad rjes la rjes dran gyi ched du ya ten pas so lun la 'jim sku zhig bzhengs shing rmang stegs su/ mtshar sdug yid 'ong sa lā mis zi ru// sngo zi ba yi khengs dregs me lce che// drag po'i g.yul dang thabs kyis rnam 'joms mkhan// so lun zhes bya'i skyes chen bskal brgyar bstod ces bkod do// / /29

gna'apha'i ro ma'i dmangs skyong dpon kig ko'u smyan mched/sa dkyil rgya mtsho chen mo'i dbus khul na chags pa'i dbyi tha li (1 7skyar+sālkolko1)gling phran gyi gna' bo'i ro ma rgyal khab kyang ya ten dang 'dra bar/mi ser dang sku drag gi 'thab rtsod kyi dus yun ring zhing spyi tshogs la ha cang dza drag che/ spyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes pa'i dus 'gor rgyal khab gzhan dag dngagayul sprod pa'i tshe na/ mi ser rnams kyis sku drag srid gzhung la blo mi 'dod pa mtshon phyir drag chas spras te ro ma (5070 76)nas bros byol du 'gro mkhan mang du byung ba'i mthus/ sku drag tshos mi dmangs la bzod sgom mi byed thabs med byung / spyi lo'i sngon gyi 494lor mi ser gyi re 'dod bzhin/ kho tsho'i khe phan dang dbang char khag theg byed pa'i ki la ko'u spun mched/dmangasaskyong dpon 'dems bsko byed pa'i chog mchan thob/(dang thog mi gnyis dang rjes su mi lnga/ mthar mi bcu ru 'phar/) dmangs skyong dpon gyis spyi dmangs tshogs 'du ru gros gzhi 'don pa'i dbang cha yod la/ rgan gras khang ngam srid gzhung gi khrims 'gal gyi gros chod la chod slog byed pa'i dbang cha ༵༵'a ba des/ kho tshos ro ma'i mi ser dang sku drag gi 'thab rtsod khrod

gzhan gyis tshab byed mi thub pa'i byed nus gal chen 'don pa'i nus pa ldan/this pis led ki la ko'u (spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo163 — 132lo'i bar )dang ku'e ye gi la ko'u(spyi lo'i sngon gyi153 — 121lo'i bar)ni sku drag gi khyim du 'khrungs pa'i spun mched gnyis yin/ kho tsho'i yab kyis kyang srid skyong dpon gyi 'gan bzhes myong zhing las don la tan tig dang bcos bsgyur gyi snying stobs che bas snyan grags shin tu che/ spun mched gnyis kyis ke ri se'i mkhas dbang slob dpon du bsten nas bran g.yog bdag po'i dmangs gtso'i chab srid dang spyi dmangs 'dra mnyam gyi bsam blo'i bag chags zab mo thebs shing / so lun dang pa'o lis khi lis sogs ke ri se'i chab srid bcos bsgyur mkhan rnams la mi phyed pa'i dad pa mchis/ spyi lo'i sngon gyi dus rabs gnyis pa'i lo rabs nyi shu pa nas sum cu pa'i ring la this bas len (11 1153561970ba10307700553 7rgyukhyi'isgom)dang ku'e ye (6453 561970 210ba 5361800603224)spun mched gnyis bstud mar dmangs skyong dpon du bskos pa des/ spun mched gnyis kyis snga 'gyel phyi langs kyi dpe bzhin sa chen dbangaba'i lam lugs la tshod 'dzin gyis mi ser la phan pa'i sa zhing bcos bsgyur lag len du bstar bar mi yul du ngo mtshar gyi gtam rgyud bzhag yod/this bras med dmangs skyong dpon du bskos pa/this pis len khong nyid ku'e ye las lo bcu yis bgres shing / this pis len kyis ro ma'i srid stegs su chab srid kyi go gnas bzhes dus kho'i gcung po da dung grags 'gul ci yang med pa'i mi dkyus ma zhig yin/ this pis med kyi mi tshe yang dmag dpon gyi go gnas nas 'go brtsams par grags/ rang lo17steng a h+phe ri ga'i gling gi kya tha'e cis su g.yul bshams pa'i tshe na/ khong ṣ+ka sgrig khrims brtsi zhing dpa' ngar che ba tsam du ma zad/ ches thog makā /gra

bo'i rdzong mkhar phab mkhan rang yin pas g.yul 'gyed du byas rjes rlabs chen bzhagaspyi lo'i sngon gyi137lor ro ma'i dpung chen si phen (59go po lko)gyi grong khyer chen mo nyig man zhis ya ru dpung 'jug byed skabs/ this pis led kyis rgyang skyod dmag dpung gi rtsis dpon gyi 'gan bzhes myong / nyig man zhis ya'i mi rnams dpa' ngar che zhing g.yul la mkhas pas thengs 'ga'i phar rgol du ro ma'i dmag la pham nyes chen po bzos/ ci bya gtol med du gyur ba'i gnas bab 'og kho chos mtshan mo'i smag rum la brten nas dmag dpung gis rdzong mkhar bskyur nas phyir 'bro snyam rung 'bro thabs ma byung bar/dgra bo'i skor rgya ru tshud de mi rta gcig kyang thar thabs bral ba'i nyen kha'i 'ogathis pis len kyis the tshom ci yang med par dpa' khas len gyis dgra bo'i dmag sgar du zhi gros byed pa la phyin te nyig man gis ya'i mi dang blo gros kyi phyi 'brel 'brel ba'i thabs kyis zhi chings bzhag no ma'i dpon dmag nyis khri lhagagi tshe srog bskyabs pa'i 'phrin bzang de ro mar khyab rjes/ mi dmangs kyis this pis len la bstod bsngags dang / khyad par du g.yul 'thab tu zhugs pa'i dmag mi'i bza' mi yongs kyis khong ni srog skyob kyi drin chen du brtsis byung / 'on kyang srol rnying mkhregs 'dzin byed pa'i rgan gras khang gis zhi chings 'jog pa ni snar ma wa yi ngang tshul yin la/ rgyal khab kyi bla btsongs pa dang rgyal khab kyi ngo tsha yin snyam ste this pis len la nyes chad gcod rgyu'i gros thag bcad kyang / mthar mi dmangs kyi ngo rgol dang gnon shugs drag po'i 'og khong la nyes chad gcod rgyu'i thag bcad phyir 'then ma byas thabs med byung / rkyen ngan dge ba'i grogs zer ba'i dpe bzhin thengs 'di'i don rkyen gyis/ khong gis rgan gras khang gi rul sungs dang khrel med lugs med kyi bya rdotā la ngos zin zab mo thob pa dang / phyogs gzhan nas mi ser gyi khrod du

kho'i mtshan snyan ches cher rgyas shing mi ser dang 'brel lam je zab tu phyin/de nas bzung / khong dang rgan gas khang gi 'gal ba nyin bzhin je cher gyur la sa zhing gi gnad don ni ches 'bur du thon pa'i rtsod gzhi ru gyur/ spyi lo'i sngon gyi dus rabs 2pa nas bzung / ro ma'i bran g.yog lam lugs kyi gzhis ka chen po'i 'phel rgyas je mgyogs su phyin cing sa zhing zla sgril gtong ba'i rnam pa dza drag tu gyur/ zhing ba chung gras kyi dpal 'byor la gtor brlag thebs shing mi ser rnams la gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis gyong gud tshabs chen thebs te dgag tu bgrod pa'i cha rkyen tsam yang med par gyur/ rgan gras khang gi sku drag yod tshad ni sa zhing gi bdag po chen mo sha stag rang yin pas/ sa zhing zla sgril gtong ba'i srid jus la shugs snon rgyag pa las mi ser gyi 'tsho bar do snang byed mkhan gcig kyang yod ma byung / mig rgyang cung ring ba'i bran g.yog bdag po'i sku drag cig yin byin/ this bas led kyis sa zhing chen po dbang ba'i lam lugs des mi ser dang sku drag gi 'gal ba je zab tu btang ba dang spyi tshogs kyi bde 'jags la gnod pa/ dmag grangs je nyung du song ste ro ma'i dpung stobs nyams rgud du gyur bar ma zad/ bran g.yog bdag po'i dbang sgyur la yang gnod pa tshabs chen thebs kyi yod pa mthong ste/khong gis sa zhing yang bskyar snyoms bgo rgyag pa'i lta tshul bton par rgya che'i mi ser gyi dga' bsu chen po thob/spyi lo'i sngon gyi 134lor ro ma'i mi ser gyis mkhar grong du sa zhing bcos bsgyur byed re che zhing / dbul phongs kyis mnar ba'i zhing pa mang tshogs kyis lha khang dang 'dzugs skrun sna tshogs kyi mkhar gyang / bar khyams kyi ka ba/dur byang sogs gang sa gang du 'bod tshig sbyar zhing this pis len kyis dbul bor rgyab rogs byed dgos pa'i re ba bton/ spyi tshogs bcos bsgyur gyi cha rkyen 'thus tshang du gyur bar mthong ste this pis len kyis rang nyid t+t+waṃ spya'i

dmangs skyong dpon gyi 'dem bsko ru zhugs rgyu'i gros thag bcad/ rgya che'i mi ser dang dmag mi rgan pa'i rgyab skyor 'og spyi lo'i sngon gyi 133lor khong nyid bde blags ngang dmangs skyong dpon khur zhing / sa zhing gi gnad don lte bar bzung ba'i bcos bsgyur gyi las 'gul zhig 'di ltar 'go bcoms byung /this bras led kyi bcos bsgyur/6 dud 'gro la yang rang rang 'dzul sa'i khung bu re mchis na/ dbyi tha li'i ched du dpa' ngar chen pos 'bad 'thab byed mkhan dpa' rgod tshor mkha' dbugasadang nyi 'od las ci yang med pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin/ kho tshor nges gtan gyi sdod gnas med la sprang khyi bzhin bu dang chung ma khrid nasagazhan yul ldom dgos byung 'dug dmag dponatshos dmag mi tshor pha mes kyi dur sa dang mchod gzhis kyi phyir du g.yul sar badz+rangs pa ni g.yothabs las ma 'das te/ dmag mi tshor pha mes kyi dur khung med la mi rabasanasami rabs subargyud pa'i mchod gzhisakyang med/ kho tshos g.yul sa ru rang srog blos btang yang mi gzhan gyi bag med rul sungs kyi 'tsho ba rol rgyu la gnod pa 'chor du trī bsteg pa tsam las tha na kho tshor rang la dbang ba'i gzhing lag mthil tsam yang lupas tā/sa pis len kyis spyi dmangs tshogs 'du ru gtam bshad gnang ba de la/ spro sems rab tu 'khol ba'i mi ser dkyus ma rnams kyis khong la dga' spro'i thal mo yun ring du brdabs byung / der bstun nas this pis len kyis sa zhing bcos bsgyur gyi jus gzhi bton/ jus gzhi las gtan la phab don/ mi rer dbang ba'i sa zhing de yu'u ke 5rtsi(gna' bo'i ro mo'i sa khyon gyi 'jal byed cig yin la/ yi'u ke gcig ni spyi mu'u gnyis yin )las brgal mi chog bu gnyis tshad gzhir bzung ste so sor yi'u ke 250yi sa zhing bgo thub/ de la'ang khyim tshang gcig la mang na'ang yi'u ke 1000gi sa zhing las lha/ ༵ bzung mi chog par bzos shing / lhag ma rnams rin mi dgos par

srid gzhung la phyir sprod dgos par gtan 'bebs byas pa der/ zhing bdag sku drag tsho snying rlung stod la 'tshangs pas jus gzhi de la ngo rgol drag po byas/kho tshos mi ser la mgo skor gtong ched du lus su gos rnying hral hrul dang gdong la mag sog gi dri mangs gos shing / ha cang nyam thag pa'i tshul gyis khromasang dang thang chen du 'khyam ste mi dmangs kyis gu yangs su gtong ba'i g.yo jus bshams/ nam rgyun khengs dregs dang nga rgyal gyi mgo bo mtho ru 'degs pa'i lha lcam dag nas kyang skra lo 'dzing zhing gdon gyis brlams pa bzhin lha khang so so ru brgyugs te lha la skyabs 'jug zhus/jus gzhi thag gcod la nye tshe/ sku drag tshos wu'u ta we zhes pa'i dmangs skyong dpon de nor gyis bslus shing / 'dems shog blug sgam rku ru bcug stabs spyi dmangs tshogs 'du tshogs mtshams mi 'jog thabs med byung /bar skabs der this pis len kyis rang sems rnal du phabs te wu'u ta spe la bcos bsgyur gyi gal chen rang bzhin nan gyis brjod de/ tha na rang sger gyis khor gun gsab byed rgyu khas blangs kyang phan 'bras ci yang thon ma thub/tshogs 'du slar 'tshogs rjes/ this pis ched mgyogs myur ngang 'chad stegs su bud de skad gdangs mthon pos 8 'thus mi rnam pa tsho/ wu'u ta we nas dmangs skyong dpon gyi 'gan bzhes yod na yang mi dmangs kyi khe dbang rgyab tu dor zin pas/ nged cag la 'di lta bu'i dmangs skyong dpon zhig mkho'am mi mkho zhes gsungs ma thag khong khro me ltar 'bar pa'i mi ser kun gyis 8 mi mkho dang tsa myur du dpon gnas las phobs shig sogs kyi 'bod skad 'brug sgra ltar ldir/ mthar mi dmangs kyis drag shugs la brten nas wu'u ta we tshogs khang gi phyi ru bskud/ rnyog 'dzing gi 'thab rtsod gang mang brgyud rjes this pis lid kyi jus gzhi la gros 'cham byung ste bca' khrims su gyur/ bca' khrims 'di lag len du bstar ched spyi dmangs tshogs di/sa

sa zhing bgo bsha' byed pa'i mi gsum las grub pa'i tshogs pa btsugs/ mi de dag ni this pis len las gzhan kho'i nu bo ku'e ye dang sgyug po a pis an khri la'o tis bcas red/ khong rnam pa'i gzigs skyong 'og sa zhing bral ba'i zhing ba dbul bor sa zhing gi bgos skal thob cing / bica' khrims 'di gom gang mdun spos kyis lag len du bstar phyir/ this pis len khong nyid thengs rjes ma'i dmangs skyong dpon gyi 'dems bsko ru zhugs rgyu'i 'dun pa bcangs/sku drag tshor mtshon na de las snying na ba zhig mi 'dug pas kho tshos mi gcig gis dmangs skyong dpon gyi 'gan bstud mar bzung mi chog pa dang / this pis len la chab srid kyi ham sems yod pa'i skur 'debs dang tha na lkog gsod bya rgyu'i jus ngan 'then/ 'dems bsko'i nyin mo ru/ mi ser khri stong mang po ro ma'i thang chen du 'tshogs te blo rtse gcig sgrim gyis this pis len kyi gtam bshad la gsan rjes/ 'dems shog 'phen pa'i 'go bcoms byung /ngo rgol phyogs khag gi pas glags 'di dam 'dzin gyis mi ser gyi khrod du zing 'khrug bslangs pa na/ mi zhig dbugs hal hal ngang this pis len kyi mdun du bcar te brel 'tshub dang bcas khong la/ tsa phyug po chen po rnams kyis drag chas sgrig 'dzugs byas nas khyed rang dgrongs rtsis byed kyin 'dug ces zhus rjes/ this pis len kyis gnas tshul de de ma thag mang tshogs la brgyud bsgrags bya dgos snyam rung / 'du 'dzi dang 'ur zing che drags pas mang tshogs kyis ci yang thos ma byung / ci bya gtol med du gyur ba'i this bas len kyis mdzub mos rang gi mgo bo bstan te rang nyid kyi tshe srog la nyen kha mchis tshul bstan rung / ngo rgol phyogs khag gis this pis len kyi lag brda de mang tshogs la rang nyid rgyal po ru 'dems dgos zhes go don yin par bsnyad btags te rgan gras khang la gtug bsher zhus song / sku drag rnams kyis kyang khoX sdu khag 'gel sa med par sems khral byed bzhin pa'i sgang der gtug

bsher de thos 'phral/ rgan gras khang gi ngo rgol ba'i gtso 'dzin dang mchod dpon nā zhis khā de khyi smyon bzhin 6 bca' khrims srung skyob byed mkhan rnams nga'i rjes su shog ces bya 'phur ba bzhin gyi gom stabs kyis rgan gras dang a phrag skor zhig khrid de tshogs rar rub yong ste/ kho tshos dbyug pa dang shing rlob/ rkub stegs sna ring / rdo gor mo sogs mtshon cha byas te this pis len dang kho'i rjes 'brang rnams la glo bur du 'jab rgol byas/ gra sgrig ci yang med pa'i bcos bsgyur tshogs par shi rmas mang du thebs shing / la la'i klad zho phyi ru blugs te de ma thag dbugs chad pa dang la la'i mig rmas te na zug ma bzod par smre sngags 'don pa/ la la'i yan lag bcad de thang du 'gre log rgyag pa sogs blta bas mi bzod pa'i bshas ra lta bu de ru/ this pis len dang rjes 'brang 38lhag gi tshe srog shor zhing / srin po las kyang bag tsha ba'i mi srin de dag gis kho tsho'i bem po tsam yang sa steng du ma bzhag par tha'e pa'o gtsang po ru 'phangs byung /ga'e ye dmangs skyong dpon du bskos pa/rgan gras khang gi rtsub spyod de mgyogs myur ngang ro ma rgyal yongs su khyab cing mang tshogs la snying nad chen po bslangs/ mchod dpon nā zhis khā mi dmangs kyis 'khon 'dzin byed pa'i gte bo ru gyur te mthar ro ma dang mi 'bral thabs med byung zhing gzhan yul du sdug shi thebs/ mi dmangs kyi khong khro ma nyams pa'i gnas bab 'og tu/ rgan gras khang gis sa zhing skor gyi bca' khrims 'ol tshod kyis rtsa med du bzo ma thub par mi gsum tshogs pa bskyar 'dems byas mur sa zhing bgo bsha'i las su gzhol du bcugathis pis len sku dgrong ba'i tshe na kho'i nu bo da dung dmag khral du song yod/ phu bo bkrongs pa'i bkra ma shes pa'i gtam ngan de 'byor rjes t+t+waṃ snang

myur sgos ro ma ru phyir log ta las dgos pa zhig rmo khos phu bo'i 'das don dang chab srid kyi las 'gul ci la yang the gtogs mi byed par/ cang mi smra bar rang khyim du 'dzul 'dug par mi rnams kyi sems su kho rang dgra bo'i rtsub spyod kyis spa bkong ba ma yin nam snyam na/ ma yin te/ khos rgan gras khang gis dogs zon mi byed pa dang phu bo'i las don shul 'dzin/ rang nyid kyi dmigs 'ben mngon 'gyur bcas byed pa'i ched du yin te/ this pis len sku gshegs rjes kyi lo 6pa ste spyi lo'i sngon gyi 126lor/ ku'e yos bka' mngag ltar sā ting gling phran gyi rtsis dpon gyi 'gan bzhes su phebs/ khong gshis rgyud drang zhing las la brtson pa/ bden par smra zhing grogs la mthun pas mi rnams kyi dga' bsu thob/ lo gnyis kyi rjes su/ ro ma'i mi ser gyi sa 'ing las 'gul yang bskyar je drag tu gyur te bcos bsgyur mkhan dang rnying zhen pa'i 'thab rtsod yang bskyar ha cang dza drag tu gyur/ ga'i ye yis kyang da ni gnam gyis gnang ba'i go skabs bla med cig red snyam ste phyir ro ma ru log rgyu'i re ba phul/ rgan gras khang gis ku'e ye ro ma grong khyer dang rgyang thag ring ba'i sā ting gling phran tu mngags pa ni/ khos kho tshor dka' tshegs bzo bar skrag pa yin phyin/ khong phyir ro ma ru log rgyu'i thad du mos mthun gtan nas ma byung bar thabs brgya jus stong gis bkag rgya sna tshogs bzos/ khong khong khro dang bcas te bka' yig yod tshad snang med du bskyur cing phyir ro ma ru logami la las khong las 'dzol shor ba'i nyes pa yod par gleng skabs ku'e ye yis gsungs don/66bca' khrims ltar na rtsis dpon gyi 'gan yun lo gcig yin pa gtan 'khel yod pas/ ngas 'gan 'di bstud mar lo thengs gnyis la 'khur cing da lta ro ma ru slar log na cis mi chog rgan gras khang gis da lta nga la dī hās kha g.yogs byed pa ni bca' khrims dang 'gal ba ma yin nam ’ zhes

dgag lan sprad par sku drag rnams kyang dgun gyi khu byug gi brtul zhugs mi 'dzin thabs med byung / khong gis kyang stag gi rnga mas mi 'dzin gal che/bzung pa'i nyin mor gtong mi nyan zhes pa'i dpe bzhin lo de'i dmangs skyong dpon gyi 'dems bsko ru zhugs rgyu'i sems thag bcad/ 'dems bsko'i nyin der/ phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas 'dus pa'i mi tshogs rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs 'phyar ba bzhin khrom chen du 'tshogs te/ dga' ba'i bgro gleng dang skyid pa'i rke bso sgrog bzhin ku'e ye kho tsho'i dmangs skyong dpon du 'dems par re ltos kyis khengs/ dga' 'os pa zhig la spyi lo'i sngon gyi 123lor ku'e ye bde blags ngang dmangs skyong dpon du bdams thon byung /ga' ye yi bcos bsgyur srid jus/ku'e ye dmangs skyong dpon du bdams rjes/ khos mngon lkog bral bar this pis len kyi ya nga ba'i 'das don la phyir dran dang dbang 'dzin pa'i rtsub spyod la kha rdung drag po btang ste/ phu bo'i bsam 'dun ma 'grub pa mtha' 'khyol bya rgyu'i bsam tshul bstan/ku'e ye yis sngar bzhin sa zhing gi gnad don thag gcod bya rgyu de rang nyid kyi dmigs 'ben zhig tu brtsis te/ this pis len kyi khrims gzhung mu mthud du rgyun 'khyongs dang sku drag gi sa zhing lhag ma yod tshad gzhung bzhes mdzad nas zhing pa dbul bor gnang sbyin btang / khos da dung 'bru rigs kyi bca' khrims dang dmag don gyi bca' khrims/ca 'dri gcod kyi bca' khrims sogs khrims gzhung 'ga' gsar du gtan la phabs/ 'bru rigs kyi bca' khrims kyis 'bru gong tshod 'dzin byas te mi ser gyi 'tsho bar khag theg mdzad pa dang / 'dri gcod bca' khrims ni 'dri gcod dbang cha rgan gras khang nas skya dmag②gi lag tu sprad de/ kho tsho'i go gnas mthor 'degs dang rga/ /sa

khang gi stobs shugs je zhan du btang / dmag don gyi bca' khrims zhes pa ni dmag mi'i gyon gos dang mtshon cha sogs rgyal khab kyis gnang ste (sngar 'gro gron yod tshad mi sger nas sbyar dgos )dmag khungs rgya bskyed btang /ga'iye yi bcos bsgyur la mi ser dang dmag mi/ skya dmag sogs kyi rgyab skyor thob cing lag len gyi khrod du mi rnams la spro snang 'phel ba'i grub 'bras g.yur du za ba smin/ de yang khong ni don dam pa bsgrub mkhan zhig yin phyir/ bsgyur bcos kyi rnam grangs mtha' dag la sku dngos kyis bka' 'dri dang / tha na bcos bsgyur thad kyi lag bstar gyi 'chad gzhi dang lta rtog gi 'gan yang bzhes myong / khong nyid dus rgyun du las ka 'gan len byed pa'i skya dmag dang ar las lag rtsal ba/ dmag dpon/ dmag mi dang mang tshogs sogs kyis mtha' bskor te dri ba sna tshogs bton par khos sun snang med par re re bzhin dris lan 'debs mkhan zhig yin/ khong nyid rnam rig bkra zhing yon tan gyis phyug pa/ gshes ka 'jam zhing grogs le brtse bas mi dmangs kyi gong bkur bla med thob/lo rjes mar ku'e ye 'dems bsko brgyud ma dgos par bstud mar dmangs skyong dpon du bskos/ spyi lo'i sngon gyi 122lor khos bca' khrims gsar ba gnyis bton zhing / gcig ni kyā the cis su mi ser spel yul btsugs nas ro ma'i mi ser skor zhig mnga' khongs gsar ba de ru gnas spor rgyu'i 'dun pa bcangs/ skabs der dbyi tha li'i rgyal nang gi sa zhing yongs su bgos tshar rung dbul bo mang tho zhig la da dung sa zhing gi bgos skal thob med/ khrims gzhung gzhan zhig ni dbang sgyur gyi rmang gzhi rgya che ru gtong phyir dbyi tha li ba yongs la ro ma'i spyi dmangs kyi dbang cha bstsal yod/ spyir khrims gzhung 'di gnyis po lo rgyus kyi 'phel 'gros dang mthun pa bston du medasdu da/ 'on kyang skabs der spyi tshogs kyi cha rkyen da dung 'thus tshang du

gyur med pa'i rkyen gyis ro ma'i mi rnams rang yul dang gyes te mi med lung stong du gnas spo 'dod med pa dang / spyi dmangs kyi dbang cha je cher btang ba las kho tsho'i sngar yod kyi khyad dbang gang mang je nyung ngam med par 'gro bar 'jigs snang de bas skye bzhin yod/ khrims gzhung dang por 'thad la ma 'thad kyis gros chod byung yang khrims gzhung gcig shos der mos mthun gtan nas 'byung ma thub/ dus mtshungs su sku drag tshos kyang thabs brgya jus stong gis mi ser dang ku'e ye'i bar du dbyen dang phra ma bcug cing / kho tshos dkrog gtam bzos te ku'e ye yis kyā the cis su rdzong mkhar brtsigs tsa na dar chen rlung 'tshub kyis hral hral du gshags pa dang / mchod stegs su bshams pa'i mchod rdzas kyang rlung gis 'khyer tshul/ spyang tshogs kyis grong khyer gyi mtshams tho 'khur te mi med lung stong du 'phangs tshul sogs gleng ste/ kyā thi cis su rdzong mkhar brtsigs pa de lha'i 'dod blo dang 'gal bas rnam smin mngon pa red ces bsgrags/ de dang dus mnyam du kho tshos don dngos dang mi mthun yang mi ser gyi bag 'khum bsam blor 'tsham pa'i bca' khrims sna tshogs gtan 'bebs byas pa sogs kyis ku'e ye yi mtshan snyan la sngar yod ma myong ba'i god chag chen po byung /spyi lo'i sngon gyi 122lo'i ston kur/ thengs gsum pa'i dmangs skyong dpon gyi 'dems bsko ru ku'e ye gzhan las pham zhing / bcos bsgyur mkhan dang rnying zhen pa'i bar gyi 'gal ba'ang sngar las dza drag tu gyur/ lha mchod kyi mdzad sgo zhig tu ku'e ye yi dgra zla ste srid 'dzin 'go ba o phis smi bo'u yi ngan skul 'og kho'i zhabs phyi zhig gis bcos bsgyur mkhan la zur za byed phyir du mchod stegs las mchod rdzas rnams thur blangs te ku'e ye sogs la/ru gtor brlag mkhan khyod tshos nga la lam mi phye don ci yin zhes skyon 'dzugs byas par/ ku'e ye yi rgyab skyor mkhan rnams khrong khro gting /sa

langs bzhin mi de gris bsnun te bsad/ don rkyen de rgan gras khang gis bcos bsgyur mkhan la btsan gnon byed spyad kyi khag dkris ru gyur te/ phyi nyin kyi zhogs par kho tshos myur stabs kyis tshogs 'du bsdus shing grong khyer hril bor nyen zon dam bsgrags kyi bka' rgya bsgrags/ srid 'dzin dpon thengs de'i sger gcod dpon du bskos te rgan gras dang skya dmag (de dus skya dmag mang shos kyis ku'e ye la rgyab 'gal byas zin )la bka' phab ste dmag gis ri rtse zhig bzung nas 'khrug chen thengs gcig bya rgyu'i sta gon byas/ ku'e ye yis kyang mi dmangs kyis dran skul btang 'og ri rtse zhig bzung yang dmag dpung gi snying stobs zhan pa'i rkyen gyis khos pho nya mngags te sger gcod dpon dang gros mol bya rgyu'i re ba zhus kyang / sger gcod dpon gyis pho nya bkag nyar byas ku'e ye gnas sa'i ri bo'i mtha' nas bskor/ bcos bsgyur tshogs khag gi stong mda' dang 'phen mdung char ltar 'phangs pa des/ spyir dmag grangs nyung zhing drag chas zhan pa'i ku'e ye yi dmag dpung la shi rmas tshabs chen bzos/ ku'e ye khong nyid kyang grogs po tsho'i 'gebs srung 'og tha'e pa'o gtsang po brgal te nags gseb cig tu sbas rung / dgra bo'i ra mdar rgyug mkhan je nye nas je nyer song ba'i skabs su kho'i gam du zhabs phyi gcig las mi snang bas/ ci nas kyang dgra lag nas thar mi thub pa mkhyen te wa ltar gson pa las/ stag ltar 'chi ba dga' zhes pa'i dpe bzhin zhabs phyi la rang nyid dgrong du bcug khong nyid bkrongs rjes zhabs phyi bas kyang 'jigs pa spu tsam bral bar rang srog rang gis bcad/bcos bsgyur tshogs pa'i mi sum stong lhag thengs de'i dmar gsod khrod srog shor zhing / kho tsho'i bem ro yang gcig kyang ma lus par this pis len ltar tha'i pa'o gtsang por bskyur/ der bstun rgan gras tshogs pas bcos bzhi/ tshogs khag gi tshogs mi rnams gang 'dod kyis 'dzin bzung dang

dmar gsod btang / kho tshos bskud mar ki la ko'u spun mched kyi bcos bsgyur bca' khrims rnams rtsis med du bzos shing / mi gsum tshogs pa yang bskyar 'thor du bcug sa zhing sger 'dzin la tshod 'dzin byed ma thub par brten/ zhing pa'i 'tsho gnas nyin bzhin tshabs chen dang bran g.yog lam lugs kyi zhing ra chen po nyin bzhin je rgyas su phyin/ zhing pa chung gras kyi dpal 'byor nyams rgud du gyur te mthar ki la ku'o spun mched kyi gsar brje yongs su pham par gyur to// sneci'i phyir bcos bsgyur la pham kha nyos pa red zer na/ de la rnyog 'dzing che ba'i spyi tshogs kyi gnad don mang du 'dus yod de/ bran g.yog lam lugs kyi dpal 'byor mu mthud du gong 'phel la 'gro bzhin pa'i skabs der/ ki la ku'o spun mched kyis bcos bsgyur la brten nas zhing pa chung gras kyi dpal 'byor slar gso dang bdag skyong bya snyam pa ni stong bsam kho na yin la/ nam yang mngon 'gyur byed thabs med/ spyir thengs de'i bcos bsgyur la pham kha chen po byung na'ang / ro ma'i spyi tshogs 'phel ba'i lo rgyus su don rkyen de la don snying gal chen ldan/ bcos bsgyur 'dis tshad nges can zhig nas sa zhing zla sgril gtong ba dang sa zhing chen po'i lam lugs la tshod 'dzin thebs shing /'ing las thon skyed kyi 'phel rgyas la skul 'ded chen po thon/ mar khe sis 6 ro ma'i rgyal nang gi lo rgyus ni sa zhing chung ba'i lam lugs dang sa zhing chen po'i lam lugs bar gyi 'thab rtsod du snang zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ gi la ku'o spun mched kyi bcos bsgyur ni 'thab rtsod 'di'i mtshon byed du gyur yod/khong spun mched gnyis ni gna' bo'i ro ma'i snyan grags 'bar ba'i chab srid bcos bsgyur mkhan gnyis red/ khong gnyis kyis mi ser 'tsho gnas kyi ched du dka' spyad 'bad brtson gyis tha na rang srog blos btang ba'i snying stobs la ro ma'i mi dmangs kyis ji srid bar du brtsi bkur dang / 4/nga

rnam gnyis la rjes dran byed ched du ro ma'i mi dmangs kyis ki la ko'u spun mched la spus legs pa'i 'jim sku gnyis bzos te ro ma grong khyer gyi ches mdzes sdug ldan pa'i sar bzhengs shing / nyin re bzhin mi rnams rang 'gul rgyus khong gnyis kyi 'jim sku la mchod 'bul dang rjes dran byed bzhin mchis

cad pan mnabs ma myong ba'i rgyalawo chen po ris zar/spyi lo'i sngon gyi dus rabs drug par ro ma bran g.yog lam lugs kyi spyi mthun rgyal khab tshugs pa nas bzung / lo brgya phrag lhag gi phyi phyogs su btsan 'dzul dang rgya bskyed btang ba'i mthus mnga' khongs yo rob gling dang — pyanā a she ya/ a h+phe ri kha gling bcas gling chen cha gsum la khyab pa'i rgyal khab stobs chen zhig tu gyur yod/ 'di ltar dus yun ring zhig tsho —'gor te spyi lo'i sngon gyi dus rabs gcig dzi 5snye par slebs tsa na/ ro ma'i spyi mthun lam 14 tsho lugs de nyi nub lam zad du gyur cing bran / rnga —— ༅g.yog 'os langs gcig 'jags gnyis ci treng r+sha langs kyi dpe bzhin spyi tshogs kyi gnas bab / rdo ha cang dza drag tu gyur/ chab srid dang ‘ ci dmag don/ dpal 'byor gyi stobs shugs sku la go khrab gsol mchis pa'i sku drag rnams kyis rang rang sar ba'i zis zar/ dmag don sger gcod kyi srid dbang btsugs te bran g.yog 'os langs dang dbangasgyur sa khul mi dmangs kyi 'thab rtsod la drag gnon byed pa'i dus mtshungs su/ rgyal nang gi srid khrir 'dzegs ched dbang sgyur mkhan pha/ snron

dbar du'ang khyod shi nga gson gyis mi lo bcu phrag lhag gi nang dme byung /ku'e bo'u za yig lis bo'u zi ris zar (bsgyur srol gzhan zhig la kha'e sa zer te/ phal cher spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo 100nas lo 44bar tsam gyi mi yin )ni kho tsho'i khrod kyi mtha mjug gi rgyal kha blangs mkhan red/ khos rang nyid kyi stobs shugs ngo ma dang blo gros la brten nas kha gtad rnams pham par brgyab pa dang / ro ma rgyal khab de spyi mthun lam lugs nas gong ma'i lam lugs su bar brgal byed par su bas kyang 'gran zla bral ba'i mdzad chen bzhagadamangs gtso'i phyogs khag gi gtso 'dzin/zis zar (6753/51143 080tshong/phya )ni ro ma'i snyan grags che ba'i khyim rgyud chen po zhig tu sku 'khrungs shing / khong gi yab ni ro ma'i khrims dpon chen mo dang / a myes dang zhang bo sogs kyis srid skyong dpon dang dmangs skyong dpon sogs kyi 'gan yang bzhes myong la/ snyan pa'i ba dan g.yo ba'i bran g.yog bdag po'i dmangs gtso tshogs pa'i gtso 'dzin mā med ni kho'i a ne'i zla bo yin/ 'on kyang / zis zar sku 'khrungs pa'i dus ni khyim rgyud rgud 'go tshugs shing spyi tshogs kyi go gnas cung zad je dma' ru song ste/khong nas mi ser dkyus ma'i 'tsho ba rol dgos byung bas mi ser gyi sdug bsngal dang re smon la cha rgyus chen po yod/spyi lo'i sngon gyi 87lo nas 83lo'i bar/ mā len kyis 'go khrid gnang ba'i bran bdag dmangs gtso tshogs khag gis ro ma dbang du bsdus shing /rang lo nyi shur yang ma son pa'i zis zar yang lha khang zhig gi mchod dpon du bskos byung / spyi lo'i sngon gyi 82lor mā len kyi srid dgra ste sku drag tshogs khag gi 'bus mi su'u lā zer ba a h+phe ri ga'i gling nas ro mar phyir log nas/ mā len4 spya rjes 'brang rnams (spyi lo'i sngon gyi 86lor mā len gshegs )dmar

gsod btang ste khrag dri bro ba'i srid dbang sger gcod byas/ dgos mkho'i dbang gis khos thabs brgya jus stong gis zis zar la 'brel lam btsugs te/mi bzang bzang mdog gis zis zar na gzhon sku drag gi 'thus mir bdams pa dang gnyen sgrig mtshams sbyor sogs kyang byas pa la/ ris zar gzhan gyi g.yo 'og tu mi tshud pa'i phyir du rang 'dod kyis su'u lā yi dgra zla'i bu mo zhig chung mar blangs/ gnas tshul de shes 'phral kho kha skyengs rlung langs kyis zis zar la btsan drag dang bcas rang la mgo sgur dgos pa'i bka' phabs/'on kyang zis zar gyis kho la rgol lan bslog ched du bag gsar khrid de 'khyam po'i chas su yul gzhan la bros byol du phebs rung / yun ring ma 'gyangs par 'dzin bzung thebs/ mthar kho'i ma yum gyis blu dngul 'bor chen btang mthar btson grol thob/ lo rjes mar (spyi lo'i sngon gyi 81lor )zis zar dmag la zhugs shing / mi lo brgyad kyi dmag mi'i dka' sdug gi 'tsho ba las kho'i dmag 'thab kyi shes bya dang snying stobs sogs che ru 'phel/ spyi lo'i sngon gyi 73lor zis zar dmag sgar dang bral te phyir ro ma ru log tshe/ su'u lā lo 'ga'i snga rol nas 'das pas ro ma'i dmangs gtso'i las 'gul mtha' dag yang bskyar tsha tsha 'ur 'ur du gyur yod/ chab srid kyi 'dun pa chen po ldan pa'i gzhon nu rnams la mtshon na/ de ni rang nyid kyi blo gros mngon pa'i go skabs mchog tu gyur ba zhig yin phyir/ zis zar yang gang myur sgos dmangs gtso'i las 'gul du zhugs shing / mi ser gyi rgyab skyor la brten nas dmangs gtso phyogs khag gi gtso 'dzin du 'gyur rgyu ni kho'i dmigs 'ben gtso bor gyur/ dmigs 'ben 'di mngon 'gyur byed ched khos dngul sgor 'bor chen bskyis te mi ser la phun sum tshogs pa'i nyin gung gi gsol tshigs dang rig rtsal 'khrab ston rtsa 'dzugs byed pa tsam du ma zad zas sbyin yang btang / da dung go skabs dam 'dzin gyis mi sems spro ba 'phel ba'i /stam

bshad sna tshogs gnang / lo 'ga'i rjes su/ kho'i a ne'i 'das mchod du zis zar gyis mā len dang a ne'i sku par gnyis lhan du bzhags te brtse dung ldan pa'i ngang mā len kyi mdzad rjes la bstod bsngags gnang bar/ mi rnams kyis mā led la bcangs pa'i brtse dung dran gso mdzad pa'i dus mtshungs su zis zar gyi bag chags zab mo thebs/mi ser gyi rgyab skyor 'thob ched dang kho tshor 'brel 'dris byed ched zis zar mchod dpon chen mo'i rtsod 'dems su zhugs rgyu'i sta gon byas/ khong gi 'gran zla ni ming la kha thu'u los zi zhes pa'i sku drag rgan gras shig red/ ngag rgyun du mi des sngar spyi zhing la sger gshol btsugs zhes pa'i dpe ltar/ gzhung gi 'dzugs skrun gyi ma dngul lkog za byas myong ba de zis zar gyi lag char gyur te mthar bde blags ngang mchod dpon chen mo'i go gnas thob/ khong mchod dpon chen mo'i khrir 'dzegs rjes/ go gnas kyi stabs ka bed spyad de gom gang mdun spos gyis rang nyid ni mi ser gyi 'thus mi ru brdzus te/ drag bskyod kyi dmangs gtso'i gtso 'dzin khā thi lin zhes pa srid 'dzin dpon gyi 'dems bsko las pham rjes/ mi des zhing grong gi mi ser la gsang ba'i rtsa 'dzugs kyis zing cha bslangs par/ sku drag tshos btsan drag la brten nas zing cha zhod 'jags su btang zhing khā this lin la srog khrims bcad/ zis zar thengs de'i lkog jus la ma zhugs kyang spyi dmangs tshogs 'du'i steng khos khā this lin la dag sel byed rogs gnang zhing / 'dri gcod ci yang ma brgyud par khā this lin gyi rjes 'brang la srog chad gcod pa ni khrims 'gal yin zhes pa'i rgol gtam btang / 'di ltar yun ring gi 'thab rtsod brgyud mthar zis zar la mi dmangs kyi rgyab skyor dang yid ches thob ste/ dmangs gtso tshogs pa'i gtso 'dzin du gyur cing khong gi sems su ro ma yongs la mnga' da~X mdzad pa'i srid kyi dbang cha thob dgos na/ chab srid kyi mdzad rjes

sdidī 'jog dgos par dgongs te si phen la dmag sna 'dren rgyu'i sta gon la 'go ba gsum gyi mna' 'brel/spyi lo'i sngon gyi 61lor zis zar gyis si phen gyi spyi dpon gyi 'gan bzhes shing / dus yun thung ngu zhig tu khos dmag dpon khag cig rtsa 'dzugs kyis si phen gyi mnga' khongs zhabs 'og tu brdzis te/ si phen yongs kyis ro mar dpya khral mi 'bul thabs med byung / khos sngar las lhag par mi ser spel yul sa khul gyi mi dmangs la smyo ham chen pos bshu gzhog dang ro ma'i rgyalakhab kyi bang mdzod du dngul 'bor chen bskyal ba des/ ro ma'i dbang sgyur gral rim gyi dpung khag khrod du khong gi go gnas mngon gsal gyis mthor 'degs chen po byung zhing / spyi lo'i sngon gyi 6sgyur/ zis zar ro ma ru phyir phebs te sku dngos su srid 'dzin dpon gyi 'dems bsko ru zhugs rgyu'i khyab bsgrags mdzad/spyi lo'i sngon gyi dus rabs gcig par ro ma'i srid stegs su rlung ltar grags pa'i mi sna ni 'byor ldan can khi lā su'u dang dmag 'thab kyi byas rjes 'bur du thon pa'i phung pha'i gnyis po yin/ kho gnyis ni sngon chad su'u lā'i rjes 'brang yin zhing / dmangs gtso'i las 'gul gyi sgul shugs 'og rang nyid la gnod 'tshe mi 'byung ched dmangs gtso'i tshogs khag tu zhugs/ zis zar gyi mtshan snyan nyin bzhin je rgyas su song ba dang bstun/ sngar zis zar si phen du ma phebs pa'i gong rol nas khi lā su'u yis kho'i skyin tshab tu bu lon 'jal ba dang thabs yod rgu bton nas g.yo brid byas/ mthar kho gnyis kyis phan tshun la 'brel thag rjenyer btang zhing phan tshun la bslu brid gtong res byas/ spyi lo'i sngon gyi 63lor phung pha'i yis sa dkyil rgya mtsho chen mo/ snatsho

jag rnams cham la phabs shing /hā le si than(9703 1ba0 ༅777)dngasiri ya(35pa thams/༅)/ a she ya chung ba sogs dbang du bsdus te zhing chen rim pa'i srid 'dzin lam lugs btsugs/ lam lugs des skya dmag gi stobs shugs che ru btang zhing sku drag rgan gras kyi khe phan la gyong gud tshabs chen bzos phyin/ kho tshos phung pha'eyi gros gzhi la chog mchan ma bkod pa la/ khong khros rab tu myos pa'i phung pa'e yang rim gyis zis zar dang nye sar bcar/ 'di ltar rnyog 'dzing gi 'thab 'khrug gang mang brgyud mthar/ zis zar gyis phung pha'i dang khi lā su'u sogs dang lhan du gsang ba'i gros mthun byung ste 'go ba gsum gyi mna' 'brel zhes pa btsugs/ mna' 'brel chings yig tu phung pa'e dang khi lā su'u gnyis kyis zis zar spyi lo'i sngon gyi 59lo'i ro ma'i srid skyong dpon du bsko bar ram 'degs byed rgyu byas/ zis zar gyis srid skyong dpon gyi 'gan bzhes rjes/ khos hāng pa'o yis shar phyogs su lag bstar mdzad myong ba'i srid jus la chog mchan bkod par ma zad/ rgan gras khang la dmag khongs nas phyir log pa'i dmag mi rgan pa dang zhing pa dbul bo khag cig la sa zhing bgo bsha' byed pa'i skor gyi khrims gzhi gsar ba 'ga' bton par/ sku drag rgan gras rnams kyis de ma thag rgol lan sprad na yang phung pha'i dang khi lā su'u/rgya che'i mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi rgyab skyor 'og khrims gzhi gsar ba de dag mtha' mjug tu lag len du bstar thub pa byung / zis zar gyis srid skyong dpon gyi srid 'gan bzhes ring du rang nyid kyi blo gros dang snying stobs la 1rtenā kās chab srid kyi go gnas sra brtan du btang zhing skya dmag gi rgyab skyor na sri/ skyo/ nga dpon gyi 'gan yun lon rjes/ zis zar gyis lo lnga'i ring du go swāhā (pho ran si ba'i snga rabs pa )yi spyi dpon gyi 'gan bzhes/ khong go
