pa sogs bzod par dka' ba'i sdug bsngal mang po myong dgos/pi tis srid 'gan bzhes pa'i sku ring du u ru su'i dpal 'byor gyi 'phel rgyas ha cang mgyogs rung / dmag 'khrug gi rgyun ma chad stabs rgyal khab kyi stobs shugs la zad gron chen po byung / khos rgyal khab kyi yong 'bab khag theg byed ched mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi lag nas btsan gyis khral rigs sna tshogs bsdus mthar/ gang du gnya' gnon yod na/ de ru ngo rgol yod ces pa'i dpe bzhin u ru su'i mi dmangs kyis pi ti'i gnya' gnon la ngo rgol gyi las 'gul rab dang rim pa bslangs/ pi ti'i gsar ba bcos kyis sku drag rnying ba dang chos tshogs kyi khe dbang la phog thug chen po bzos yod stabs/dbang sgyur gral rim nang khul du'ang khong la ngo rgol byed mkhan mi nyung ba zhig byung zhing de dag gi khrod du tha na rgyal sras a le khi zhe yang tshud 'dug kho ni pi ti'i sras gcig pu rang red/ pi tis rang nyid kyi rgyal sras kyang ngo log tshul mthong ste khong khro rab tu langs bzhin rgyal sras a le khi zhe la rdung deg btang nas srog khrims bcad/ 1725lo'i zla 1tshes 28nyin gong ma pi ti sku gshegs shing srid lo 32ring bskyangs/ khong gshegs rjes gong ma'i dbu zhwa mi lag mang du brgyud mthar 'jar man gyi kong jo zhig gi lag tu tshud/ kho mo ni ches gdug rtsub che ba'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi rgyal mo ye kha ce lin na zer ba de yin la/ pi ti'i sras mo yis lis bzi pe yi tsha bo ste pi ti sku phreng gsum pa'i chung ma rang yin no// / /108

gsar brje'i las 'gul du zhugs pa/gye glir sin ni 1743lo'i zla 4pa'i tshes 13nyin wir gye ni ya sa cha'i sku drag tu gyur ba'i 'debs 'dzugs ra ba'i bdag po zhig gi khyim du sku 'khrungs shing / rang lo 16nas bzung yab kyi phyag nas rdo tha'i 'debs 'dzugs ra ba chen po gcig dang rgya che ba'i sa zhing gi ma dngul 'dzin lor bdag gnyer byed 'go tshugs/ rjes su khong gnyen bsgrigs pa'i rkyen gyis chung ma'i sa zhing dbyin mu'u khri 4dang bran g.yog 134de yang khong la dbang stabs stobs 'byor sngar bas che ba byung / 'on kyang rnye glir sin khong nyid byis dus nas bzung zhing ba dbul bo dang rngon pa dag la 'brel 'dris che stabs/ sa rgod slog mkhan rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i dka' sdug dang dbul bo'i nyam thag gi 'tsho sduraskyo snang drag po skyes shing dmangs gtso'i bsam blo yi bag chags zab mo bas/slob ma'i dus skabs kyi gye bar sin ni dmangs gtso'i bsam blo nyin bzhin 'thus tshang du 'gyur ba'i dus skabs yin/ 1760lor rang lo 17du son pa'i gye glir sin khong nyid bis lan mā lis slob gling tu zhugs te chab srid dang bca' khrims/ mtshan nyid/ rtsom rig grangs rig dang rang byung tshan rig gzhan dag la sbyangs pa mi dman pa gnang zhing /gnas de ru khong nyid kyis skom pa chu la dungs bzhin gna' bo'i ke ri se'i ro ma'i rtsom rig dang mtshan nyid rig pa'i bstan bcos sna tshogs/ da dung nye rabs kyi mis ar tun dang zhe khi si phis ar(ya smo18 ba bya'i ji capatshong07874)sogs kyi bcoms chos la gzigs shing lu'o khe dang phe ken/ wu'u su'o sogs 'byor ldan gral rim gyi sngon thon bsam blo ba'i gzhung lugs kyis khong la blo skyed mi da// zlo thob/ slob chen mthar phyin rjes khong khrims rogs pa'i bya bar

zhugs/ 1769lor khong nyid blur gye ni ya'i gros khang gi 'thus mi ru bdams shing gros tshogs su khong gis bton pa'i gros gzhi thog ma'i ni bran g.yog la rang dbang ster dgos pa de red/ skabs der a me ri kha byang ma ni dbyin ji'i dbang sgyur 'og gnas yod la/ mi ser spel yul gyi dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas byung ba dang dbyin ji'i dbang sgyur la shugs snon brgyab pa'i mthus/ mi ser spel yul dang dbyin ji ba'i 'gal ba nyin bzhin dza drag tu gyur cing rang dbang brtson len byed pa'i ngo rgol rgya mtsho'i rlabs ltar 'phyur/ rnye glir sin gyis dngos don la gzigs te hur brtson gyis gsar brje'i las 'gul la zhugs nas rang btsan brtson len byed pa'i a me ri kha byang ma'i mi ser spel yul mi dmangs kyi g.yon ru'i 'go khrid du gyur/ 1774lor gye spir sin gyis 〈dbyin khongs me gling gi khe dbang rags tsam gleng ba 〉zhes par 'char zin btabs te dbyin ji srid gzhung gis a ri'i gling byang ma'i mi ser spel yul khag la btsan gnon gyi srid jus lag bstar byed par rgol gtam btang ste/8 dbyin ji'i rgyal po ni mi dmangs la zhabs zhu mkhan tsam las mi dmangs kyi bdag po ma yin pa ’ dang / mi ser spel yul gyi mi dmangs la tsa mi'i rigs kyi skyes thob kyi khe dbang ldan dgos pa'i lta ba bton/ dgag yig gi nang don zhib cing rgol lan drag pas a ri'i gling byang ma'i mi ser spel yul gyi sa khul dag tu dar khyab chen po byung zhing rkye glir sin gyi mtshan snyan gang sa gang du khyab byung / 1775lo'i zla 6par gye ཿra sin khong nyid zhir rkye ni ya khul gyi 'thus mi'i thob thang gis skabs gnyis pa'i skam sa chen po'i tshogs 'du ru zhugs/ tshogs 'du yis gye ཿra sin dang h+phi ran khi lin/ ya ting zi bcas mi lngas grub pa'i tsho chung gis tshosas 'du'i bsgrags gtam la 'char zin rtsom par gros 'cham byung / rkye glir sin khong nyid smra ba nyung zhing rtsom par mkhas phyir ches thog ma'i bsgrags gtam gyi 'char zin rtsom rgyu de khong gi stu/ tu

babs/ las 'gan legs 'grub yong ched du khong h+phi la rdo ཿsa ya'i(26118601261807)'jim mkhan zhig gi khyim du bzhugs te hur brtson gyis phyag las la brel/ nyin bcu phrag 'ga'i rjes su 'dzam gling la grags snyan 'brug sgra ltar ldir ba'i〈rang btsan bsgrags gtam 〉gzhi nas legs grub byung zhing / bsgrags gtam du khong gis mi ser spel yul mi dmangs la rang btsan thob 'dod kyi 'dun pa drag po mchis pa dang / de ru khong gis mi'i skyes thob kyi rang dbang dang mi dmangs kyi bdag dbang / mi dmangs kyi gsar brje'i dbang cha sogs gleng yod par ma zad/ mi thams cad skyes pa nas bzung 'dra mnyam yin la 'jig rten byed pos thun mong la 'dra mnyam gyi khe dbang sna tshogs bstsal yod de/ de dag gi nang gses su 'tsho sdod kyi dbang cha dang rang dbang / bde skyid 'tshol 'dod kyi dbang cha sogs midamangs kyi rtsa ba'i dbang cha 'di dag la srid gzhung gang rung bas 'gal rkyen bzos tshe/ mi dmangs kyis srid gzhung de bsgyur bkod dam rdul du brlags te rang nyid kyi khe dbang la srung skyob thub pa'i srid gzhung gsar du 'dzugs pa'i dbang cha yod ces bstan/ 1776lo'i zla1tshes 4nyin gyi skam sa chen po'i tshogs 'du'i steng (rang btsan bsgrags gtam 〉la 'thus mi yongs gros 'cham byung zhing a me ri kha rgyal khab dngos su dbu brnyes/ nyin mo de yang rjes su a ri'i rgyal ston dus chen du gtan 'bebs gnang /gye char sin gyis 〈rang btsan bsgrags gtam 〉gyi thog ma'i 'char zin du da dung bran g.yog lam lugs dang bran g.yog nyo tshong dag la rgol lan drag po sprad mod kyang / rjes kyi gros bsdur skabs su don tshan de dag la gros 'cham 'byung ma thub/ 'on kyang bsgrags gtam gyi gsar brje'i rang bzhin la gnod pa ci yang ma thebs te/ des a ri'i gling byang ma'i mi ser spel yul mi da~Xs la mi rigs rang btsan gyi dar cha mthon por bsgrengs su bcug

par ma zad/ rgyal khab gzhan dag gi mi dmangs la'ang skul ma thebs te bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin la ngo rgol byed pa'i 'byor ldan gral rim gyi gsar brje yi dbu tshugs/ h+pha ran si'i 〈rang btsan bsgrags gtam 〉gyi ma dpe lta bu yin la/ gsar brje'i slob dpon mar khe si yis de ni smyo mi'i rigs kyi ches thog ma'i rang btsan bsgrags gtam yin ’ zhes gsungs myong / mi 'gyangs par rkye glir sin h+phi la rdo ཿsa ya dang zhal gyes te cir rmi ni ya khul du phebs/ khong gi thugs dgongs su gsar brje zhes pa ni srid gzhung gi brje spor tsam ma yin par/ spyi tshogs gsar pa dang 'tsho ba gsar pa'i sgrig 'dzugs bcas la yang rmang gzhi 'ding thub pa'i byed las can zhig yin par dgongs/ de'i phyir gye h+phi sin gyis khul srid gzhung du u yon lhan khang zhig btsugs te khul gyi bca' khrims la dag ther byed pa'i gros gzhi bton par ma zad/ sku dngos kyis (shul nor rgyun 'dzin byed srol tshod 'dzin dang med par bzo rgyu'i khrims gzhi 〉dang 〈lir rkye ni ya khul gyi chos dad rang mos kyi khrims gzhi 〉gnyis kyang bstud mar 'char zin bkod/ khrims gzhi dang pos bu che bas shul nor bdag gnyer lam lugs med par bzos te shul nor snyoms bgo byas par brten/ dbyin ji nas me gling du brgyud yong ba'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin ring lugs kyi lhag 'phro'i dpung khag la rdung deg drag po btang / khrims gzhi gcig shos kyis chos tshogs dang rgyal khab kyi dbye mtshams gsal bor phyes nas mi so sos rang nyid kyi 'dod mos bzhin gnam bdag la dad pa byed chog par khyab bsgrags mdzad/6 dbang cha 'dra mnyam dang dmangs dbang rang bdag ’ gi lta tshul spel ba/a me ri kha ru 'byor ldan gral rim gyi dmangs gtso'i chab srid r+shardogs

rgyu ni de 'dra'i las sla mo zhig ga la yin te/ dgra ya'i ngo rgol phar zhog tha na gsar brje'i dpung khag nang khul du'ang rnying zhen gyi stobs shugs che zhing dmangs gtso'i 'phel rgyas la bkag rgya mi nyung ba thebs/ gsar brjer rgyal kha lon rjes gye glir sin gyis dmangs gtso'i lta ba rgyun 'khyongs byed ched du/rnying zhen pa'i rgyal phran mnyam 'brel tang khag dang dus yun ring bo'i 'thab rtsod kyi las la zhugs dgos byung /rang btsan dmag 'khrug bslangs pa des dbyin ji'i mi ser spel ba'i lcags sgrog sil bur gtor cing a ri'i rgyal khab la rang btsan thob/ cher ma 'gyangs par a ri'i rgyal khab kyi nang khul du byung ba'i 'gyur ldog chen po ni/gral rim 'thab rtsod kyi 'gal ba rno ngar can du gyur te 1787lor zhe si'i 'os langs byung / 'byor ldan gral rim gyi rnying zhen phyogs khag gis mnyam 'brel srid gzhung gi dbang cha kha thor yin zhing mi dmangs kyi 'os langs la dus ltar drag gnon byed ma thub tshul mthong ste krung dbyang gis dbang cha gcig sdud gyi srid gzhung zhig 'dzugs rgyu'i jus ngan 'then/ lo de'i zla 5par kho tshos gsang stabs kyis h+phi la rdo ཿsa ya grong khyer du 'dus te rtsa khrims gzhan zhig 'dzugs rgyu'i bsam ngan bcangs/ rgyal phran mnyam 'brel tang khag de yang dus skabs 'dir dbu brnyes pa zhig yin/ kho chos dbyin ji lta bu'i rtsa khrims kyis bcad pa'i rgyal po'i lam lugs 'dzugs rgyu las dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur la ngo rgol byed kyin yod/ skabs der rkye glir sin khong nyid h+pha ran sir bzhugs pa'i spyi khyab gzhung tshab yin rung thengs de'i tshogs 'du'i grags 'gul la lta rtog nan mo gnang yod/ khong gis langs phyogs brtan po'i ngang rang nyid kyis a me ri kha ru rtsa khrims kyis bcad pa'i rgyal po'i lam lugs 'dzugs par ngo rgol byed rgyu yin la/ khul gyi dbang char brtsi 'jog thodi ༵༵ 6 mthun sgril zab mo ldan pa'i 'byor ldan gral rim gyi dmangs

gtso'i rgyal khab cig 'dzugs rgyu'i 'dun pa dang / rtsa khrims gsar ba'i 'char zin du mi dmangs kyi dbang char 'gan len thob pa'i 'gro ba mi'i thob thang gi khrims gzhi'i don tshan de tshud med par thugs shin tu kha ma dgyes pa'i bzhed tshul bstan gnang song /1787lor mnyam 'brel srid gzhung btsugs rjes gye jur sin la wa zhin thun (67760 7461 rtsa ༷sa ༷༅0)nas nan gyis bskul ba'i ngor phyi don blon che chin gyi 'gan bzhes/ dpon po'i nang khul du khong dang nor srid pu'u kung han mir kun bar la dgongs 'gal chen po byung / han mir tun ni ches rnying zhen gyi spyi mthun tang mi zhig yin la tha na cung zad log spyod mkhan zhig kyang red/ mi dmangs kyi lta tshul thad du kho dang rkye glir sin gnyis 'gal ba ltag sprod du gyur/ gye snar sin ni dmangs dbang ring lugs pa zhig yin phyir mi dmangs kyi 'dod blo dang gnam bdag gi dgongs pa ni gcig mtshungs yin par 'dod/ 'on kyang han mir tun gyis mi dmangs la btsan drag che zhing blo sna mang bas phyug po'am mi rgyud can kho nas rgyal khab la do dam bya dgos par snyam/ mthar khong gnyis la nang srid dang phyi 'brel gyi gnad don yod tshad kyi thad la 'gal ba chen po byung zhing khyod shi nga gson gyi 'thab rtsod du zhugs dgos byung / han mir tun gyi nor srid srid jus kyis a ri'i rang btsan dmag 'khrug rjes kyi nyag nyog byung ba'i nor srid la dag ther gyis mnyam 'brel srid gzhung gi khral bsdu tshad je mthor btang zhing / tshong las tshogs pa dang dngul 'dzin mkhan/ ma dngul 'dzin mkhan/ rkang dngul bar tshong pa mkhan sogs la khe spogs 'bor chen thob phyir zhing ba dang lag shes bzo las pa/ phyir log pa'i dmag mi/ tshong bdag chung ba bcas kyi khe phan la gnod pa tshabs chen thebs/ rnye glir sin gyis tan mir tun gyi nor sridasrid jus kyis rgyal khab hril po ru dbul phyug mi snyoms par bzos snar

mtshang 'byin drag po mdzad/ h+pha ran si'i 'byor ldan gral rim gyi gsar brje la rgyal kha blangs pa'i gtam snyan a me ri kha ru slebs rjes/ rgyo char sin gyis h+pha ran si'i gsar brje la gdeng 'jog chen po gnang ste/ h+pha ran si'i mi dmangs la dus dang rnam pa kun tu rgyab skyor bya rgyu'i 'dod tshul bstan/ 'on kyang han mir tun gyis gsar brje 'di la sdang sems drag po bcangs te dbyin ji dang tshong las kyi 'brel bar shugs snon brgyab par gye glir sin gyis kho'i phyi 'brel srid jus la ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu gnang / 1792lor rnye khrir sin gyis dmangs gtso spyi mthun tang gi thog ma'i srol btod cing / dus de nas bzung a me ri ga rim gyis tang khag gnyis kyi lugs su grub (mnyam 'brel tang de rim gyis dmangs gtso'i tang du gyur cing / dmangs gtso'i spyi mthun tang de spyi mthun tang gi thog ma'i rnam par gyur)/ 1793lor rkye glir sin gyis phyi don blon chen gyi las khur dgongs bzhes gnang ste sa gnas so so'i mi dmangs kyi dmangs gtso'i las 'gul la 'go khrid dang phyogs ston mdzad/ 1796lo'i tsung thung 'dems bsko ru mnyam 'brel tang gi sku tshab yo'o han ya ting zi tsung thung dang rkye h+phe sin tsung thung gzhon par bdams thon byung / gye char sin gyis mi dmangs kyi mig mdun nas chab srid la de 'dra'i the gtogs mi gnang khul mdzad rung / don dngos su gom gang mdun spos kyis mi dmangs kyi dmangs gtso'i 'thab rtsod la rtsa 'dzugs byed par brel/ 1793lor ya ting zi srid gzhung gis mi dmangs dmangs gtso'i khe dbang la khyad gsod btang ba'i bka' yig don tshan bzhi khyab bsgrags byas par rgya che ba'i ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi blor mi 'dod pa byung zhing / rnye glir sin sogs kyi mdzub ston 'og byung ba'i mang tshogs rang bzhin gyi ngo rgol las 'gul la snga na med pa'i mtho rlabs 'phyur/ 1793nas 180)lo'i bar gye h+phe sin stugs kyis rgyal yongs su dmangs gtso'i spyi mthun tshogs pa41lhag

btsugs te/ dmangs gtso'i stobs shugs yod tshad la mthun sgril gyis mtha'amajug tu 'thab rtsod kyi rgyal kha blangs/1800lor gye trir sin gyis dbang cha 'dra mnyam dang dmangs dbang rang bdag gi 'bod skul bsgrags te ya ting zi pham par brgyab cing /dmangs yongs kyi rgyab skyor 'og tsung thung gi khrir kod/ 1804lor khong nyid yang bskyar tsung thung du bdams/ rnye glir sin gyis srid 'gan bzhes pa'i mi lo brgyad kyi ring la yar thon gyi srid jus mang du spel cing / sngar ya ting zi'i skabs kyi dmangs dbang la khyad gsod btang ba'i bka' yig don tshan bzhi med par bzos/ han mir tun gyi rgyal nang gi khral yang med par bzos te ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi khral rigs je nyung du btang zhing / sa zhing gi bca' khrims gsar du gtan 'bebs kyis rgyal khab kyis sa zhing btsong tshad dbyin mu'u yo0nas dbyin mu'u 160ru phab/ bran g.yog nyo tshong rtsa med dang dpon rigs kyi rgyu nor dbang cha la tshod 'dzin med par bzos te mi dkar gyi skyes pa'i 'dems dbang che ru btang / khos da dung rang nus ci lcogs kyis srid gzhung gi las khungs so sos sku drag gi spyod stangs la ther 'don gyis sku zhabs kyi mtshan mi bkol ba dang / yod tshad stabs bde dang gron chung byed pa'i bca' khrims lag len du bstar/mi ser gyi tsung thung /thang rgyal rabs kyi gong ma thang tha'e tsung gis legs bshad cig gsungs myong ba ni/ 66rgyal bo ni gru gzings dang mi dmangs ni chu bo yin/chu bos gru gzings 'degs nus la bsnub kyang srid ’ ces pa'i dpe bzhin gye h+pher sin khong gis kyang mi dmangs la gdeng 'jog tshad med gnang yod de/khong gis che nga'i bsam tshul la spyi tshogs gang dang rgyal khab gang zhi/ 1hā mi

dmangs yin yang kho tsho ni rgyal khab de'i dbang cha yod tshad kyi 'byung khungs yin ’ zhes dang / 6 mi dmangs las gzhan pa'i rang dbang dang bde skyid la brtson len byed mkhan ngas gcig kyang mthong ma byung ’ zhes bstan/ khong nyid ni mi dmangs kyi dmangs gtso'i las 'gul gyi 'go khrid pa zhig yin phyin/phyag las la ci 'dra'i brel 'tshub che yang mi dmangs dang 'brel 'dris byed mtshams gtan nas chad ma myong / go thos ltar na khong la goms srol zhig yod pa ni/ pho brang gi phyi ru gzigs skor du phebs tshe rlangs 'khor la bzhugs pa'i dgos pa ma mchis na/ rlangs 'khor du mi bzhugs par rta la bzhon te phebs rgyur mos shing de ni khong gi dga' phyogs shig yin la mi dmangs la stabs bde yong ched du'ang red/ gye bar sin khong nyid ni rgyal sa wa zhin thun nas rgyal sar bzhugs pa'i tsung thung dang bo yin/ skabs der pho brang dkar po legs 'grub ma byung stabs gye glir sin gnas skabs su mgron khang du bzhugs dgos byung zhing / khrir bzhugs pa'i nyin mo der gye glir sin khong nyid mgron khang de nas rgyal tshogs tshoms chen bar rkang thang du phebs par lam gyi 'gram logs gnyis su spro bas myos pa'i mang tshogs dang dmag mis yongs su khyab cing khong la gus 'dud zhus/ pho brang dkar po ru gnas spar rjes khong gis nangs mo re re bzhin pho brang dkar pos mi ser la sne len byed rgyu gtan 'bebs gnang / rgyu mtshan ni mang tshogs kyi bsam 'dun shes rgyu dang dmangs gtso mtshon ched du red/ de'i phyir mi rnams kyis khong la mi ser tsung thung gi mtshan gsol/rkye char sin gyis slob gso yis mi'i gshis rgyud mthor 'degs kyi nus pa bla na med pa mchis par gzhigs te khong gis gsungs rgyur/ mi dmangs ni nam yang blo khel chog sa yin la/ kho tsho la 'os 'tsham gyi slob gso zhig thob rje/ ༵ 8tshos de bas kyang blo khel chog pa yin zhes dang / gal te slob yon ci

yang mi dgos par slob gso myong du 'jug thub tshe/ dbul po rnams kyis kyang mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs la blo yul las 'gongs pa'i byas rjes 'jog nges yin zhes gsungs/ de'i phyir khong gis che 'bring chung gsum gyi rim pa gsum can gyi slob gso'i lam lugs btsugs pa de rjes su a ri'i spyi dmangs slob gso'i dpe gzhi ru gyur/ 1809lor rkye jur sin tsung thung gi las yun thim rjes phyir rang khyim du log rjes/ khong gis rang nyid kyi tshe mjug gi dga' phyogs te wer gye ni ya slob grwa chen mo 'dzugs skrun gyi las la brel/ khong sku dngos kyis sa cha dang 'char gzhi/ bzo skrun gyi lta rtog slob dpon gdan 'dren/ slob gzhi 'dems sgrig bcas la sku ngal ma 'dzems par slob 'go tshugs rag tu gzigs skyong gnang / khong nyid sku gshegs rjes mi rnams kyis khong gis rang nyid la bris pa'i dur byang rnyed byung la/ de'i steng du 'di ni tha'o ma zi gye khrir sin gyi dur sa yin la/ kho ni a ri'i 〈rang btsan bsgrags gtam 〉dang (wer rkye ni ya khul gyi chos dad rang mos khrims srol 〉gyi rtsom pa po/ lir rkye ni ya slob grwa chen mo dbu brnyes mkhan yin zhes bris 'dug 'di las nga tshos mthong thub pa ni blur rkye ni ya slob grwa chen mo de rkye glir sin gyis rang nyid kyi gzi brjid du brtsis yod pa mthong thub/ gye glir sin ni bla na med pa'i 'byor ldan gral rim gyi dmangs gtso'i ring lugs pa zhig yin rung / rang nyid kyi gral rim dang skabs de'i dus skabs kyi bkag rgya yang mi nyung ba zhig thebs yod phyir/ khong gi dmangs gtso'i ring lugs kyang de 'dra'i mthar phyin pa zhig ma yin/ khong gis mi yod tshad 'dra mnyam yin zhes gsungs myong yang de ru yin di'i an mi dang mi nag rnams tshud med/ khong ni mi dkar ring lugs pa zhig yin pas mi nag rnams nang khul du gnas spo ru 'jug pa'am phyir a h+phe ri kha'i gling la skyel rgyu'i 'dod tshul bstan/ de bas kyang blo phangs pa zhig la drag shugs bkol te hin rdu ni an mi rigs theg ༵༵ du

gtong ba'am nyams rgyad du gtong rgyu'i srid jus lag bstar byas/ rgya che ba'i a ri'i bud med rnams kyis kyang khong gi skyes thob kyi dbang cha longs su spyod thub med/ drang por bshad na gye glir sin khong gis gnas lugs zab mo'i sgo nas bud med kyi slob gso'i 'char gzhi la bsam gzhigs btang ma myong / sa gnas kha shas kyis bud med kyi slob gso gleng myong yang de ni bu phrug gi slob gso'i thad kho nar dmigs pa tsam yin pa las bud med srid la zhugs rgyu sogs dang 'brel ba gtan nas med/ kho'i bsam par bud med la rang dbang gi 'dod blo yod mi chog cing kho tsho'i khyo ga'i bsam tshul de rang nyid kyi kun spyod kyi tshad gzhi ru 'dzin dgos par snyam/ngas dga' zhen byed sa ni rang byung tshan rig yin/gye char sin ni khyad du 'phags pa'i chab srid pa kho na zhig ma yin par/rig gzhung sna mang mkhyen pa'i mkhas dbang dang 'dzugs skrun gyi jus 'god mkhan chen po zhig kyang yin/khos grogs po zhig la chab srid ni nga'i las 'gan yin mod/ 'on kyang ngas dga' zhen byed sa ni rang byung tshan rig yin zhes gsungs myong / rnye jur sin gyis skar rtsis dang sa dpyad/ gna' rdzas rig pa/ mi chos rig pa sogs la'ang dga' zhen che bas khong nyid rgyun par ri lung brgal te skye dngos dang srog chags kyi dmar dpe bsdu ba dang / gzugs ris sna tshogs dpe gzhir 'god par dga'/ khong gis srid 'gan bzhes rjes gzhung las la brel 'tshub che yang tshan rig zhib 'jug byed pa la lhod g.yeng phran tsam gnang ma myong / 1797lor rkye glir sin tsung thung gzhon par bdams rjes skabs de'i rgyal sa h+phi la rdo chas ya ru phebs 'go brtsams/ khong gis ko sgam chen po zhi/ snro0 gna' rabs srog chags kyi 'gyur rdo mang bo bcug yod la rgyal sa nas

'gyurardo de dag gis a ri'i mtshan nyid rig pa'i lhan tshogs la rig gzhung snyan zhu zhig 'bul rtsis yod/ khong la mi sger gyi gnam gshis sa tshigs shig yod la nyin rer thengs gnyis su drod grang dang rlung shed/ char chu dang rlon tshad sogs zin thor 'god pa'i goms gshes mi lo 30ring du rgyun 'khyongs gnang / bya ba'i dgos dbang gis yul gzhan du phebs dgos byung tshe khyim mi la bcol gdams gnang ba red/ h+pha ran si ru phyi bzhugs blon chen gyi 'gan bzhes ring du khong gis yo rob gling gi sngon thon lag rtsal la 'bad 'bungs kyis slob gnyer gnang / tshan rig pa zhig gis 'khor mda' gsar bzo gnang ba thos 'phral khong nyid ze nā chu bo ru mchongs te rang dngos kyis tshod lta dang / shugs rig pa'i zhib 'jug dang gsar gtod kyi grub 'bras rnams a rir phar 'dren thub min la mno bsam gang mang btang / khos h+pha ran si ru rgyal khab so so'i thong gshol rigs sna tshogs nyar tshags dang zhib sdur/thong gshol gyi rtse mo sar reg skabs thebs pa'i gnon shugs la dbye zhib mdzad rjes/ thong gshol la tshan rig dang mthun pa'i jus 'god gnang bar h+pha ran si'i dngos mang 'grem ston du gser gyi rtags ma thob/ de las gzhan khong gis rkub stegs 'khor ma can dang so phud 'phrul chas (ma/lkog)/ rkub stegs su bsgyur thub pa'i lag 'khar/ 'khor thub pa'i dbyangs rtags gdang bu/ bskyar dpar 'phrul chas sogs gsar gtod gnang zhing / khong gisagasar gtod 'di dag la ched khe tho 'god ma byas stabs mi rnams kyis rang gi 'dodi mos bzhin bkol chog par stabs bde bskrun/ nges par du gleng dgos pa zhig ni khong gis 'dzugs skrun jus 'god thad du'ang grub 'bras mi dman pa blangs yod/ sngar gleng zin pa'i slob grwa chen mo las gzhan khos da dung rang nyid la grong gseb tu gsang gnas kyi spro khang zhig bskrun yod/spro khang de de'u 'bur zhig gi steng du chags yod la lir rkye ni ya'i ri sbyo/ po

dang kha gtad du langs 'dug de la gna' dpe'i khyad chos phun sum tshogs pa ldan par ma zad thun min gyi rang gshes kyang mngon 'dug khang ba'i yo byad dang bkod sgrig yod tshad khong gi jus 'god nang bzhin yin la tha na rang nyid kyis bzos pa'ang yod/ lo nyis brgya'i rjes kyi deng gi dus su yang nga tshos spro khang de mthong ba na/ de'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bzo bkod kyis mi'i yid sems dbang med du 'gug par gdon mi za/ 1792lor a ri srid gzhung gis rgyal yongs su pho brang dkar po 'dzugs skrun gyi ma dpe bsdus par/skabs der phyi don blon chen gyi 'gan bzhes pa'i rkye glir sin gyis ming rtags bral ba'i jus gzhi'i ri mo zhig phul myong / gsang ba de khong gis mi su la'ang gsungs myong med rung lo sum cu'i rjes su mi rnams kyis khong gi shul rdzas legs sgrig tshags byed skabs/ da gzod khong gi zin bris steng gi ri mo dang sus yin ma nges pa'i pho brang dkar po'i jus gzhi'i ri mo gnyis gcig mtshungs yin pa tshor/ lha snar sin gyis rang byung tshan rig thad du sbyangs pa mi dman pa gnang yod pa de'ang / rang nyid kyi dga' zhen dang skyes thob kyi shes rab las gzhan khong gi brtson 'grus dang lhan skyes kyi yon tan dang mi rang gi rag las te/ go thos ltar na khong gis rang nyid kyi brla thog tu 'dzin chog pa'i dpe sgrog cig kyang gsar gtod mdzad yod la shing rta 'khor lo ru bzhugs skabs phyag rtsom gnang spyad yin pa 'di las/ nga tshos khong gis chu tshod skar cha tsam yang dam 'dzin byas nas chud zos su mi gtong ba shes thub/1826lo'i zla 1tshes 4zhin la dgung grangs 83du son pa'i gye khrir sin tshe las 'das shing / mi rnams kyis khong la 6 dmangs gtso ring lugs mkhan yod tshad las ches rlabs che zhing phul du byung ba'i gtso 'dzin mi zhes bsngags brjod kyi me tog gtor myong / spyir gye char sin khong nyid la gsub thabs bral1 sdus lo rgyus kyi byas rjes rlabs che ba ldan par gdon mi za mod/ khong ni

h+pha ran si'i ma rtsa'ang lugs kyi phul du byungaba'i gsarabarje ba ro rdzori ste mar/ci ya ki ping tshogs pas srid dbang la rme rdzog mnga' brnyes pa nas bzung / mi rnams kyis nam rgyun du dad sems dang gus 'dud dang bcas rgyal dmangs tshogs ne 'du ru mi sems spro ba 'phel ba'i ro bho zi bhe ar gyi gtam bshad dang khong gi gzi brjid mthong thub/ 'on kyang blo yul las 'das pa'i don rkyen zhig byung ba ni/1794lo'i zla 7pa'i tshes 23nyin la (tsha ro bho zi sgye ar/ zla'i tshes 9nyin )mā khi zhis mis lis an ti ro bho zi dhe ar (57511160 66 2066391676 756lo667)sngar bzhin gleng stegs su phebs te gtam bshad 'go rtsom pa'i dus la/ glo bur du zing cha langs shing gtum drag can gyi rgyal po rtsa gtor gtong dgos/ zhes pa'i ku co chu bo'i rlabs bzhin phar langs tshur 'jags kyis grags 'ong zhing ro bho zi bhe ar ci bya gtol med du gyur/ khong gis dgra bos rgyal dmangs tshogs 'du la bsru brid gtong bzhin 'dug ces rgol lan sprad rung / gnam sa g.yo ba'i ngo rgol gyi tsha rlabs khrod du khong ni sdong lo rlung khyer bzhin nyam nga ba'i gnas su sta14/ de dang dus mtshungs su ro bho zi bhe ar gyi gtam bshad la bkag

'gog thebs par ma zad/ rgyal dmangs tshogs 'dus khong dang khong gi rjes 'brang rnams 'dzin bzung bya rgyu'i gros 'cham byung ste khong nyid de ma thag 'dzin bzung byas/ mtshan der khong nyid rgyal srung dmag mis btson khang las bskyabs rung / nyin rjes mar ngo log dmag dpung pha ri si grong khyer gyi gzhungasnrub khang du blugs/ khos rang srog bcad rung 'chi ma thub par nyin gnyis par log spyod pas khrom skor byas te mgo bo bregs shing / lo rgyus steng don rkyen 'di la tsha zla'i srid 'gyur (sa(74)zhes grags so// ro bho zi sgye ar ni phul du byung ba'i ma rtsa ring lugs kyi gsar brje ba zhig yin phyir khos thengs re rer bzhin h+pha ran si'i gsar brje gong nas gong du spel/ tsha zla'i srid 'gyur gyi rjes su h+pha ran si'i gsar brje yi zungs shugs yongs su nyams te yod tshad slar yang nyams rgud du 'gro 'go bcoms so//wu'u su'o yi rjes 'brang ba/ro bho zi bhe ar ni 1758lor h+pha ran si'i byang phyogs kyi a lā zi grong khyer du sku 'khrungs shing / kho'i khyim rgyud de gral rim gsum parayigatogs la chung dus nas bzung slob gso yag po thob myong / snga gzhug tu lu'u dbyi slob grwa dang pha ri si slob chen sogs su slob gnyer gnang zhing rgyugs 'bras phul du byung bas dge slob yongs kyis khong la gdeng 'jog tshad med gnang / khong gshis rgyud drang zhing drang bden bshad rgyur dga' rkyen slob grogs nyam chung la mi gzhan gyis thub tshod dang brnyas bcos byed pa mthong tshe/ khos dus rtag tu mi de dag la rgyab rogs byed par ma zad tha na 'thab 'dzing yang byas myong /dus rabs 18pa'i dus smad du h+pha ran si'i spyi tshogs lam lugs ni bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin yin la gral rim gyi 'gal ba'ang ha cang rnyog 'dzing che ba/gral rim gsum par sbyi tshogs kyi go gnas ci yang med par gzhigadi lhardo spyi

tshogs la bcos bsgyur byed rgyu ni kho tsho'i re ba nyag gcig tu gyur/ skabs der/ lta ba gsar ba'i bcoms chos rnams slob grwa ru dar khyab che bas khong yang brtsams chos de dag gis yid dbang 'phrog ste/ zhib 'jug dang bsam gzhigs zab mo gnang bzhin spyi tshogs bcos bsgyur gyi thabs jus la re 'dun drag po bcangs/ro bho zi bhe ar gyis bkur bsti bla med byed sa'i mkhas dbang ni wu'u su'o (36823805503200333597)yin/ wu'u su'o ni drag bskyod kyi 'byor lda na gral rim chung ba'i dmangs gtso ring lugs pa zhig yin la/ 'byor ldan gral rim gyi spyi mthun rgyal khab 'dzugs rgyu'i lta ba 'don mkhan zhig kyang yin/ro bho zi sgye ar slob chen 'grim pa'i dus skabs su wu'u su'o yi bsti gnas su khong la zhal mjal ba'i skal ba thob myong zer/ 'on kyang lo rgyus pas thengs de'i mjal 'phrad la lta tshul mi mthun pa gnyis bton yod la/ gcig ni wu'u su'o yis ro bho zi sgye ar la sger gyi mjal 'phrad gnang ste gsung gleng yun ring mdzad zer ba dang / gcig shos ni ro bho zi bhe ar gyis khrom skor gyi skabs shig gam yang na mtshan nyid pa khong nyid 'cham 'cham du phebs skabs zhal mjal ba'i go skabs tsam byung snyam mod/ gang ltar kyang khos wu'u su'o yi'i zhal mjal thub pa de khong gi me tshe yi gzi brjid du brtsis yod/ wu'u tshe las 'das rjes khong wu'u su'i 'das mchod du phebs ma thub kyang khong la rjes dran gyi ljags rtsom zhig bcoms myong / de ru khos thengs de'i mjal 'phrad gleng yod par ma zad rang nyid kyi gus 'dud kyang bstan yod de/ khyed nyid kyi slob ston las ngas rang ngo rtogs byung la/ rang nyid kyi la rgya'i rin thang dang da dung spyi tshogs gyi thad la bsam gzhigs gtong ba'i spobs pa yang rnyed byung zhes pa dang / khyed kyi ches mjug mtha'i nyin mo der ngas khyed mjal byung1 2/6rjes dran de dus rtag tu nga'i la rgya dang dga' spro'i 'byung khungs su

'gyur bar nges/ khyed kyi gzab nan gyi zhal ngo de mthong dus/ ngas de ni mi rnams kyi log spyod kyis khyed la nan gyis bzhag pa'i skyo sdug gi rma kha los yin snyam 'ong zhes gsal por brjod 'dug(tshig rjes mas h+pha ran si srid gzhung gis wu'u su'o la mnar gcod drag po btang ste yun ring du yul gyar la ma byon thabs byung ba mtshon yod/ dgung lo 58du da gzod phyir rgyal nang du log pa'i chog mchan thob rung / lo gnyis kyi rjes su h+pha ran si nas sku gshegs ) ro bho zi sgye ar gyis dus dang rnam pa kun tu rang nus ci lcogs kyis wu'u su'o yi dgongs pa lag len du bstar ro//sbyi tshogs su bgrod 'go brtsams pa/slob chen gyi skabs su ro bho zi ste er gyi sbyang bya ni khrims lugs yin la/slob mthar phyin rjes phyir rang yul du log ste khrims rogs pa'i las su zhugs/mi 'gyangs par khong gis sku zhabs bris ze lis zhes pa'i las zhor gyi dngos lugs rig pa ba zhig/la khrims rogs bya dgos byung / nyin zhig khos rang khyim gyi du khung steng du thog cha zhig sprad par grong rdal gyi mi rnams kyis sngar ma thong ma myong ba'i dngos po gsar ba de mthong 'phral ya mtshar skyes pa'i mi mod la 'jigs snang zhig kyang ngang gis skyes/ rgyu mtshan ni thog mda'i ma gzhi ni lhang dbyibs shig yin phyir de 'gad rdzas shig min nam snyam pa dang /yang cig bshad na de'i stong gi rno khab de gnam rgan ma'i thugs dgongs dkrugs pa'i spu gri zhig dang cis mi mtshungs snyam pa'i rmeng tshogs kyis kho la rgol gtam dang 'khon 'dzing byas byung / ches thog mar kho'i gdong du 'bud mkhan ni rang nyid kyi khyim mtshes rnams yin la/ kho tshos skyug bro ba'i dngos po 'di ni bkra mi shis pa'i sna 'dren red ces rgol gtam btang zhing / sa gnas kyi dpon pos kyang thog mdas gnam rgan ma'i thugs dgongs /sbyik+tas

na mang tshogs la gnod 'tshe 'byung bar skrag nas/ bīs ze lis la thog mda' phyir len dgos pa'i bka' phabs/ khos rang sems rnal du phabs te yul dpon dag la thog mda'i byed nus dang spyod sgo/ des gnod 'tshe 'gog thub par ma zad yul mang che bar sngar nas bzung dar khyab byung yod tshul sogs zhib tu brjod rung / nyan mkhan gcig phar zhog mang tshogs dang srid gzhung gi dbang shed 'og khos thog mda' phyir mi len thabs med byung /mthar khos nyan mkhan med pa'i bshad mkhan de 'u thug gi dpe bzhin thog mda'i bkol spyod kyi khe dbang gi ched du khrims khang du gtug bsher byas/gnas de ru ro bho zi bhe ar gyis khong la khrims rogs gnang zhing gyod gzhi la mjug mtha'i rgyal kha'ang blangs/ drang por bshad na de yang ha las dgos pa zhig ma yin te/ ro bho zi sgye ar gyis khrims khang du spyad pa'i lung rigs gnyis ldan gyi ched rtsom gnyis po las/ gcig ni mkhyen rgya yangs pa'i dngos lugs pa dang khrilas rtsod pa sprus za ar gyi bcoms chos shig red/ gang ltar bshad kyang gyod gzhi 'di'i rjes su ro bho zi bhe er gyi snyan grags 'brug ltar grags byung / khos 'dum pa'i gyod don yod tshad legs 'grub 'byung ba'i nges pa ga la yod/ thengs 'gar pham kha myong bar ma zad gyod gzhi'ang bya rkun bye'u rkun tsam gyi rgyad don phal ba'i rigs las ma mchis stabs/ kho'ang rang nyid kyi bya bar rim gyis yid chad chen po byung / ro bho zi sgye ar gyis spyi tshogs dang chab srid kyi gnad don la gzhigs te btsams chos 'ga' spel bar srid gzhung gi bya dga' yang thob myong / de dag las kyang 1788lo'i gsar brje chen mo'i snga rol du khong gis btsams pa'i 〈a tu'u wa na'i jun mi dmangs la phul ba'i 'bod skul zhu yigawa wa.a tos bā na'i rim pa gsum pa'i tshogs 'du la bcos bsgyur bya dgos pa'i gal chen rang bzhin skor gleng ba //sdu pa de ni brjod bya rjod byed gang gi cha nas kyang phul du byung ba zhig

red/ 1788lor h+pha ran si'i srid 'dzin las khungs kyis phu tshul ldan dang bag yod kyi mkhas dbang rnams gdan drangs te/ khrims 'dzin blon chen la rim pa gsum pa'i tshogs 'du'i12 gnas tshul dang las 'gan yar zhu byed du bcug de'i khrod du ro bho zi sgye ar gyi 〈'bod skul zhu yig 〉kyang tshud 'dugabartsams chos de'i khyad chos ni 'go bcoms ma thag nas rnag thog khab gtsags kyis a tos bā na ni ro bho zi sgye ar gyi gnas yul yin la/ sa de ga'i rim pa gsum pa'i tshogs 'du la skyon cha skra ltar gzengs par lhug brjod gnang yod/ khong ni kha bshad gnad la phog pa zhig yin par ma zad mi su zhig yin rung phog thug gtong phod phyir kho'i brtsams chos kyis kyang gzhan gyis tshab byed mi thub pa'i byed nus thon yod/ khong gis dngos yod 'tsho ba'i gnad don rnams mig mthong lag zin gyis dper bkod de rim pa gsum pa'i tshogs 'du'i rul sungs kyi snang tshul mtha' dag ther 'don byas shing /a tu'u bā na'i rim pa gsumā pa'i tshogs 'du ni khe dbang ci yang med pa'i mi ser gyi tshogs pa tsam du zad pas/ dbang cha ngo ma ni mi dmangs kyi lag tu 'jog dgos pa'i lta tshul bton/ 〈'bod skul zhu yig 〉ni bsam blo gsar ba'i lta ba kho na tsam zhig ma yin par/ kho tsho'i bsam blo dang dgongs par brten nas spyi tshogs kyi snang tshul la dbye zhib zab mo gnang ba'i phul du byung ba'i bcoms chos shig yin stabs gral rim gsum pa'i mang tshogs kyi rgyab skyor chen po thob/ brtsams chos de yang ro bho zi ste er khong nyid chab srid kyi thad du kho lag rdzogs pa dang 'tsho ba gsar ba'i lam chen du bskyod pa'i dpang rtags su gyur/ der brten/ a tu'u bā na'i rim pa gsum pa'i tshogs 'dus khong nyid pha ri si ru tshogs pa'i rgyal yongs kyi rim pa gsum pa'i tshogs 'du'i 'thus mi ru bdams shing / pha ri si nas ro bho zi dhe er khong nyid ya ༵ sbyang

tshogs pa (ya ki ping gi sgrub sbyong ra ba nas bya 'gul spel bas na ming de ltar thogs )ru zhugs te khong chab srid du zhugs pa'i mi tshe yi gom kha yang 'di nas spo 'go tshugs/spyi dmangs kyi 'dems bsko'i lta ba 'don mkhan/rgyal yongs kyi rim pa gsum pa'i tshogs 'du (tshogs 'du de zla 5pa'i tshes 5nyin 'tshogs la/ rjes su zla 7pa'i tshes 9nyin de rtsa khrims kyis gtan 'bebs gnang ba'i tshogs 'du'i nyin mo ru bsgyur )'tshogs nas zla ba 2lhag gi rjes su/ 1789lo'i zla 1tshes 14nyin/ h+pha ran si'i 'byor ldan gral rim gyi gsar brje tshogs pa yis mi dbang lam lugs kyi dbang sgyur mtshon pa'i pā hri btson khang rdul du brlags te/ 'byor ldan gral rim gyi tshab byed de rtsa khrims kyis bcad pa'i rgyal po'i lam lugs kyi srid dbang btsugs/ rim pa gsum pa'i tshogs 'du dang rtsa khrims kyis gtan 'bebs gnang ba'i tshogs 'du ci rigs kyi skabs su yang / ro bho zi bhe ar khong nyid khu sim mer mi bzhugs par spobs pa cher bskyed ngang rang nyid kyi 'dod tshul dang lta ba bton myong / khong nyid grong gseb kyi mi zhig yin pa'i cha nas kho'i yul skad dang gzugs gzhi thung ba de chab srid kyi dgra zlas 'phya dmod byed sa'i gnas su gyur rung / khos snang tshul de tsam la yid phyung rgyu phar zhog bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi srid dbang sger 'dzin la ngo rgol gyi 'dun pa de las lhag par sra brtan du gyur cing / kho'i mtshan snyan de'ang ma rtsa ring lugs kyi dpung khag khrod du rim gyis je cher gyur/ 'byor ldan gral rim che khag gis srid dbang bzung ba'i rjes su/ khos sngar bzhin ma rtsa ring lugs kyi thog ma'i bsam blo'i lag char brten nas gsar brje'i las don gong nas gong du spel/17rdo/sbyar h+pha ran si'i rtsa khrims gtan 'bebs gnang zhing / rtsa khrims der

snyan grags rab tu rgyas pa'i 〈mi'i thob thang skor gyi bsgrags gtam 〉gyis gleng gzhi mdzad pa'i 'byor ldan gral rim che na po'i khe dbang mtshon pa zhig yin la/bsgrags gtam de ru 'byor ldan gral rim gyi dmangs gtso'i dbang cha kha shas kyang gtan 'bebs byas yod rung de la dus rabs kyi bkag rgya'ang chen po thebs yod/ dper na/ rtsa khrims 'dis mi dmangs kyi 'byor ba'i chu tshad ltar sngon thon spyi dmangs dang sgyid lug spyi dmangs zhes pa gnyis su bkar te rgyal khab la rang ngos kyis khral 'jal thub pa dang / bran g.yog ma yin par 'gro 'dug rang dbang yod pa'i mi ser la sngon thon spyi dmangs zer zhing kho tshor 'dems bsko'i dbang cha yod/ spyi dmangs phal che bar mtshon na sgyid lug spyi dmangs su gtogs pas 'dems bsko'i dbang cha ci yang med/ sngar rtsa khrims 'di'i gtan 'bebs thad du 'thus mi lngas mtha' gcig tu ngo rgol mdzad myong la de'i nang gi gcig ni ro bho zi sgye ar red/ khos bstan don/phyug po'i rgyu nor la bca' khrims kyis srung skyob bya dgos na dbul bo'i khang khyim dang rang dbang / tshe srog gi bde thang sogs la'ang bca' khrims kyis srung skyob bya dgos/ kho tsho khrims mthun gyi chab srid la zhugs su mi 'jug pa ni mi'i lhan skyes kyi dbang cha 'phrog pa ma red dam zhes dang / mang tshogs kyi khe dbang dang 'brel ba dam zab tu mchis pa'i chab srid kyi dbang cha bcom pa'i tshe ni 〈mi'i thob thang skor gyi bsgrags gtam 〉de shog stong tsam du zad pa'i nyin mo yin zhes gsungs shing / khos da dung mi'i 'byor ba'i chu tshad gzhir bzung nas btsugs pa'i lam lugs ni sku drag gi srid dbang lam lugs dang gcig pa gcig mtshungs yin pas/ de ni 'byor ba'i khyad dbang gral rim gyi srid dbang gis rigs rgyud khyad dbang gral rim gyi srid dbang gi tshab byas pa tsam du gyur ba red ces ther 'don drag po gnang myong phyir/khong ni ches thog ma'i spyi dmangs kyi 'dem bsko'i lta ba 'don mkhan tsa/3 snyi ma

zad/ h+pha ran si'i lo rgyus steng du spyi dmangs kyi 'dem bsko'i lta ba bton pa'i chab srid pa'ang thog mar gyur to//66lu'u dbyi 'chi ran/’ 1792lo'i zla 8tshes 10nyin la h+pha ran si'i mi dmangs kyis yang bskyar 'os langs byas te gsar brje dus rim gnyis pa'i skabs su slebs/ cis lun bī tshogs pa (spyi mthun tang )yis rtsa khrims kyis bcad pa'i rgyal po'i lam lugs kyi tshab kyis spyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes/ rgyal khab tshugs pa'i rjes su ro bho zi sgye ar gyis 'go 'dzin mdzad pa'i ya ki ping tshogs pa dang cis lun bī tshogs pas gong ma'i gnad don ji ltar thag gcod byed rgyu sogs kyi thad du dgongs 'gal chen po byung / rgyal po lu'u dbyi skye phreng bcu drug pa khri las phab rjes/ gsar brje la zhugs pa'i mi dmangs kyis re 'dun drag pos bdud rgan de gsod dgos pa'i re ba bton yang ci lun bī tshogs pas thabs brgya jus stong gis kho rang skyob ched du/ srog khrims ma bcad gong la rnyog 'dzing che ba'i gtug bsher gyi brgyud rim zhig brgyud rgyu'i g.yo thabs bshams/ ro bho zi sgye ar gyis kho tsho'i ngan jus tshor rjes de ni gtug bsher tsam gyi gnad don zhig ga la yin te/ wu dbyi skye phreng bcu drug pa lta bu'i srid dbangasger 'dzin gyi rgyal po zhig rang re'i gsar dar gyi spyi mthun rgyal khab cig la mtshon na/ kho srog thog tu gtong rgyur the tshom ci yang byed dgos don med ces gsungs pa la ci lun bī tshogs pas mtha' gcig tu rgol lan sprad de/gal te gong ma yang rtsa khrims kyis srung skyob byed na khrims thag ma bcad gong du kho la nyes pa ci yang ma mchis la/ tha na khrims gtug kyang bya dgos don med 6 ces pa'i 'chal gtam bsgrags/ ro bho zi bhe ar gyis mi dmangs kyi 'odi ༵༵sa ni dpon ngan la ya lan sprad pa dang / kho'i srid dbang 'phrog pa

ni kho la khrims thag bcad pa yin/ mi dmangs kyi rang dbang las don gyi dgos mkho ni kho'i nag nyes kyi gzhi 'dzin sa yin/ mi dmangs kyi las 'gul de khrims khang dang mi 'dra bar kho tshos glog zhags lta bu'i ngar skad sgrog bzhin gong ma kho rang dmyal khams su brdzang rgyu de red ’ ces gsungs/ 'on kyang ci lun bī tshogs pas kho tsho'i lta ba rgyun 'khyongs byas te don rkyen 'di rgyal po'i tshesrog la rag las pas ha cang gzab nan bya dgos zhes pa la/ ro bho zi dhe ar gyis don rkyen 'di'i gal chen rang bzhin ci yin/ rgyal po kho rang la zer ba e yin/ rang dbang gi las don li mtshon na kho las lhag pa'i tha shal zhig gang na yod/ mi'i rigs la mtshon na'ang kho las lhag pa'i nyes can zhig ma mthong bas lag zung khrag gis sbags pa'i bdud rgan 'di mi dmangs la mtshon na snying bo ci zhig yod ces gsungs/ g.yo sgyu che ba'i ci lun bī tshogs pas gong ma'i gnad don gyi thag gcod thad du mi dmangs kyi 'dod blo mtshon pa'am nyes chad ci 'bab mi dmangs kyis thag gcod byed rgyu sogs la kha g.yar bar/ ro bho zi dhe ar gyis rnag thog khab gtsags kyis gyod don 'di gzhi rim tshogs 'du la sprad de gros zhib byed du 'jug pa'i bsam 'char 'di'i mtha' 'bras ni rgyal khab 'dir nang 'khrug bzo rgyu'i snga ltas red ces bstan/ kho tsho'i bsam don ma grub pa'i rkyen gyis ro bho zi sge ar la ngan smras sna tshogs brjod par ma zad khong gi tshe srog la'ang bar chad gtong rtsis dang /tha na mdzes ma'i 'dzum gyis bsru thabs sogs spyad rung khong nyid g.yo 'og tu tshud ma byung / mi la las ro bho zi ste ar la khyod kyis rgyal por 'di ltar sdang sems 'chang dgos don ci yin zhes dris par/ khos nga rang lu'u dbyi la dga' dgos don med la sdang dgos don yang med/ nga rang zhe spo langs sa ni kho'i ya nga ba'i nag nyes de dag red/ lu'u dbyi 'chi ran/ rgyu mtshan ni spyi mthun rgyal khab 'di 'tsho gnas bya dgos pas red ces gsungs/ lus /byi

'chi ran/ rgyu mtshan ni spyi mthun rgyal khab 'di 'tsho gnas bya dgos pas red ces pa'i gtam de ni skabs de'i h+pha ran si'i gnas bab dang mthun pa'i legs bshad cig red/ mjug mthar ro bho zi bho ar gyi bsam 'dun ltar lu'u dbyi skye phreng bcu drug mgo 'bregs stegs bur bskyal song /ya ki brang chogs pas srid dbang sger 'dzin byas pa/ro bho zi sgye ar gyi drag bskyod kyi gsar brje'i las 'gul dang yang dag pa'i chab srid kyi lta bar rgya che ba'i mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi yid ches dang rgyab skyor thob/ ci lun bī tshogs pas dbang sgyur gyi dus smad du chab srid rul sungs dang / jag rkun sa stong du khyab pas mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba je sdug nas je sdug tu gyur/ h+pha ran sis yo rab gling gi h+pha ran sir rgol ba'i mnyam 'brel dmag dpung las pham kha rab dang rim par nyos te gnas bab ha cang dza drag tu 'gyur bzhin pa'i skabs su/ ro zi bho bhe ar gyis 'go 'dren mdzad pa'i ya ki ping tshogs pas pha ri si'i mi dmangs la skul slong byas te mes rgyal dang gsar brje yi ched du/ 1793lo'i zla 5pa'i tshes 31nyin nas zla 6tshes 2bar drag po'i 'os langs byas mthar ci lun bī tshogs pa'i srid dbang mgo rting bslogs/ji lta bu'i srid dbang zhig 'dzugs rgyu dang ji ltar rgyal khab phyi nang gi dgra bo'i dpung 'jug la rgol lan bslog rgyu de khong rnam pa'i mig mdun du lhags pa'i dka' gnad chen po zhig tu gyur 'dug skabs de'i gtan 'jags min pa'i spyi tshogs kyi gnas bab la gzhigs te/ rgya che ba'i mi dmangs mang tshogs kyis kyang sems 'dun drag po'i sgo nas drag shugs la brten te gsar brje'i ngo log par drag rdung bya dgos pa'i re ba bton/ san / 3/ zi bhe ar khong nyid kyang 'u thug ste 64khrims dpon rnam pa lags/

drag rdung yang nged cag gi gros gzhi ru brtsi rogs zhes pa'i 'bod skul mi sgrog ka med byung / spyir khong nyid kyang bca' khrims la ha cang brtsi mthong byed mkhan zhig yin rung / skabs de'i khyad par ba'i rgyal khab phyi nang gi gnas bab 'og khos kyang drag shugs la brten nas mang tshogs dbang du bsdus spyang gsham gyi khyad par ba'i srid jus 'ga' zhig lag bstar mi byed thabs da byuzlo la/khab myur skyob u yon lhan khang btsugs te ro sgo zi sgye ar sogs 'go 'dzin 'gas thad kur 'go khrid mdzad de rgyal khab kyi nang srid dang phyi 'brel/ dmag don gyi dbang cha yongs rdzogs gcig bsdus byas/ gsar brje'i dmag dpung bsdus te rgyal khab phyi nang gi dgra bor ya lan sprad de gsar brje'i bca' khrims lag len du bstar bar mthun rkyen bskrun pa dang /de las da dung gsar brje'i khrims khang gi nyes chad zhib bsher gyi brgyud rim je nyung du btang ste nyes chad mgyogs myar ngang gcod pa/〈dogs gzhi yod pa'i nyes carno gyi nyes chad sgrig srol 〉lag len du btab ste rgyal khab kyi dogs can byas nyes bsags mkhan rnams 'dzin bzung dang gsar brje'i ngo log par rdung deg drag po gtong ba/rin gong tshod 'dzin gyi bca' khrims gtan 'bebs kyis glags 'tshol mkhan gyi tshong bar nyes chad bcad de mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi rtsa ba'i khe phan la srung skyob gnang ba/1793lo'i lo mjug tu/ srid dbang sger 'dzin gyi byed thabs 'di dag la g.yur du za ba'i grub 'bras blangs/ rgyal nang gi ngo log zing 'khrug zhod 'jags su song bar ma zad/ 1794lo'i zla 6par h+pha ran sir rgol ba'i mnyam 'brel dmag dpung yod tshad mthar skyod btang / mang tshogs kyi rgyab skyor dang ram 'degs 'og ro bho zi bhe ar gyis h+pha ran si'i 'byor ldanā snal

rim gyi gsar brje dar ba'i yang rtser son du bcug pa 'dis/ gsar brje 'di 'byor ldan gral rim gyi gsar brje'i lo rgyus steng du ches rlabs che zhing 'thus tshang ba'i gsar brje thengs shig tu gyur/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi sa zhing gi bdag dbang yod tshad rtsa med du bzos te bros byol du song ba'i sku drag dang grwa btsun gyi sa zhing yod tshad gzhung bzhes gnang zhing dum bur bcad de zhing bar btsongs/ zhing bdag gis bdag 'dzin byas pa'i sa zhing yod tshad zhing par sprad de mi grangs ltar snyoms bgo byas/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi 'os 'gan yod tshad med par bzos te rin gong tshod 'dzin gyi bca' khrims spel ba'i rjes su/ 'byor ldan gral rim gyi rgyu nor gyi dbang char yang gnas skabs su tshod 'dzin thebs yod/btson du tshud de sdug thi thebs pa/ro bho zi bhe ar gtso 'dzin yin pa'i ya ki ping tshogs pas ya nga ba'i drag gnon la brten te h+pha ran si'i rgyal khab phyi nang gi gsar brje ngo log pa'i stobs shugs rtsa med btang zhing / spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi khe phan la srung skyob mdzad de h+pha ran si'i gsar brje la rlabs chen gyi rgyal kha blangs/ 'on kyang ro bho zi bhe ar khong nyid kyang 'byor ldan gral rim gyi gsar brje ba zhig las ma 'das pas/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin la ngo rgol gyi dmag 'khrug dang mi rigs bcings 'grol gyi dmag 'khrug la rgyal kha bsdud mar blangs par bstun/ ro bho zi bhe ar gyi 'byor ldan gral rim gyis mi dmangs la rgol ba'i rang gshis kyang rim gyis phyir mngon byung / khos gral rim ches dma' ba'i mang tshogs de ches nyen kha che ba'i dgra ya ru brtsis nas ya nga ba'i lag thabs spyad de kho tsho'i rtsa 'dzugs la gtor brlags btang bar ma zad/ gtso 'dzin kra rdo3sna'u btson du sdug shi thebs pa'i rkyen gyis ya ki ping dang mi dmangs

mang tshogs kyi 'brel lam yang je sdug tu gyur/ ya ki ping tshogs pa'i nang khul du'ang ro bho zi snye ar gyis rang nyid kyi drag gnon srid jus de rang dang lta ba mi mthun mkhan la drag thung byed spyad kyi lag cha ru bsgyur/ khos snga gzhug tu e nyis byin dang zha'o mis sogs ya ki ping tshogs pa'i g.yas lhung ba rnams la ya nga ba'i mnar gcod btang / de bas kyang khos g.yon lhung mkhan la drag gnon byas pa de mi'i blor shong ba zhig ma yin/ de dang dus mtshungs su/ rgyal khab phyi nang gi khor yug je bzang du song ba dang bstun nas mi rnams kyis ya ki ping tshogs pa'i dmigs bsal gyi dus skabs su spyad pa'i drag bskyod kyi bya thabs la mi 'dod mkhan mang nas mang du 'phel zhing /drag rdung dang rin gong tshod 'dzin gyi srid jus skor la yang gros ma 'cham mthar ro bho zi ste ar khong nyid dpung med khor rkyang gi gnas su lhung / 'di lta bu'i gnas tshul 'og tsha zla'i srid 'gyur byung ste ya ki ping tshogs pa'i srid dbang sger 'dzin rtsa nas bslogs shing / ro bho zi ste ar dang ya ki ping tshogs pa'i gtso 'dzin 'ga' bcas 'dzin bzung thebs te mthar gdug rtsub dang ldan pa'i sgo nas sku bkrongs so// / /137

'khyam ltar gzhan yul 'grim dgos byung ba'i rkyen ci zhig yin zhe na/ gsham /lha 'u cag gis skabs de'i lo rgyus kyi gnas bab la re re bzhin blta bar thu'u lin g.yul 'argyad/nā pho lun rang lo bcu'i steng pha yul dang bral te pha ri si'i nye 'khor gyi dmag mi'i slob grwa zhig tu zhugs/ khong slob sbyong la 'bad 'bungs che zhing dge rgan gyi thugs khur 'og lo lnga'i rjes su pha ri si'i dmag dpon slob grwa ru slob gnyer byed pa'i skal ba thob/ gnas de ru khong grong khyer gyi ltad mo dang zlos gar la rnam g.yeng spu tsam bral bar dmigs pa rtse gcig tu slob sbyong la gtad de sbyangs 'bras g.yur du za ba smin la/ khyad par du grangs rig pa'i rgyugs 'bras de 'dzin grwa yongs kyi yang rtser son/ 1785lor nā pho lun la phyogs mda'i ru dpung zhig tu hra'o we'i dmag thob gnang / khong slob grwar 'grim pa'i tshe na lo rgyus kyi deb ther grags can dang nang sgos su wu'u su'o sogs h+pha ran si'i ma rtsa ring lugs kyi thog ma'i lta ba 'dzin mkhan dag gi sazhung lugs kyi bag chags zab mo thebs te/ zis zar dang a li khi zan ḍi ra(4105thab cang 66 0728 ༅778)lta bu'i byas rjes gling la grags su 'jug rgyu'i 'dun pa bcings/ khong nyid dmag la zhugs rjes kyi lo snga ma 'ga' ru khos ci yang bsgrubs ma nus phyir lo brgyad kyi rjes su da gzod hrang we'i dmag thob tu 'phar/ blo yul las 'das pa zhig la tag tag lo der khong la rang rtsal ngom pa'i skal ba thob / de yang bshad na 1794lor h+pha ran si ru 'byor ldan gral rim gyi gsar brje'i 'os langs byung ste/ lu'u dbyi skye phreng bcu drug pa'i mgo bo bregs nas spyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes rjes/ de la bsam ngan bcangs pa'i sngar gyi rgyal po'i rjes 'brang rnams kyis ༵ /nga

ngan 'brel gyis zing 'khrug bslangs par/ ya ki ping tshogs pas h+pha ran si'i mi dmangs dang lhan du dpa' ngar zhum med kyis g.yul 'gyed byas rung /dgra bo'i lte gnas te lho phyogs kyi dmag gi gru kha thu'u lun zer ba der ci bya gtol med du gyur/ phar rgol gyi skabs su gsar brje'i dmag dpung gis me sbyogs rdzong mkhar dang bar thag cung ring sar 'then te rkang dmag gis thengs 'gar phar rgol byas rung grub 'bras ci yang ma thob pas/ kho tshos yang bskyar me phyogs rnams rdzong mkhar dang nye sar bcar te phyogs mda' char ltar mtshams med du 'phangs rung / mkhar gyi bzo bkod brtan pa dang dbyin ji'i dmag gru'i dpung rogs btsan pas dpon dmag yongs ci bya gtol med du gyur skabs der rang lo 24son pa'i skyogs dmag gi hrang we nā pho lun gong rim gyi bka' ltar thengs de'i g.yul 'gyed kyi phyogs dmag gi bkod 'doms par mngags byung / khong ni mi de 'dra'i ltas mdog can zhig min rung dmag 'thab la ha cang mkhas pas/ khong gnas der 'byor rjes su sa bas dang dgra zla la dbye zhib zab mo gnang rjes/ spyi khyab dmag dpon la/thu'u lun mkhar gyi bzo bkod brtan pas dmag mi rnams hol rgyug byed mi rung ba dang / gal te me phyogs rnams sa mgo cung mtho sar spar te me shugs yod tshad kyis mtsho khar gnas pa'i dbyin ji'i dmag grur rgol rdung byed thub pa byung tshe/ dgra bos rang nyid kyi gzhug lam bcad 'gro snyam ste/ rang nas yod rgyas mkhar rdzong bskyur te dmag grur srung skyob byed nges red ces zer bar/ spyi khyab dmag dpon gyis de ma thag khong gi dmag 'thab la chog mchan bkod/ char rlung drag tu 'jo ba'i mtshan mo zhig la/ nā pho lun gyis char rlung dang mun nag gi go skabs 'dir brten nas sa babs mtho sa zhig btsan gyis tshur 'phrog ste me skyogs btsugs/ yod tshad dus la ran pa na khos ngar skad1 ༵༵ bsgrags pa dang lhan du/ me phyogs mang bos gnam sa bla 'og brje

ba lta bu'i ldir sgras dbyin ji'i dmag gru 'jigs par bzos pa la/ dgra bo rnams tsham tshom ngang dngangs skrag dang bcas spyi mtsho ru bros/ thu'u lun mkhar kyi gsar brje'i ngo log mkhan rnams kyang dpung rogs bral ba'i dpa' bo bzhin yun ring ma theg par gsar brje'i dmag la mgo btegs/thengs 'di'i g.yul 'gyed du nā pho lun gyis rang nyid kyi blo gros dang spobs par brten te byas rjes bla lhag bzhag rkyen dpon dmag yongs kyi bstod bsngags thob/ spyi khyab dmag dpon gyis gong rim la phul ba'i snyan zhu ru dpa' mdzangs ldan pa'i gzhon nu 'di la mthong chen dang bya dga' stsol rogs/ gal te nged cag gis da lta kho la bstod bsngags ma byas kyang / nam zhig gi nyin mor khos rang nyid kyi nus par brten te kun gyi bkur bste thob par gdon mi za zhes gsungs/ thengs de'i g.yul 'gyed du da dung ya ki ping tshogs pa'i srid gzhung gi 'go 'dzin pa gal chen ro bho zi sgye ar gyi nu bo'ang zhugs yod/ khos phu bo la/ gal te khyed la mkhar grong gi dmag 'thab la mkhas pa'i dpa' mdzangs brtul phod kyi mi gsar zhig gam gzhon nu zhig mkho na/ mi de ni nā pho lun las ma 'das so zhes mtshams sbyor gnang rkyen rgyal khab myur skyob u yon lhan khang gis nā pho lun la lu'e krang gi go gnas bstsal/ thu'u lun g.yul 'gyed de nā pho lun gyis 'go khrid mdzad pa'i dmag 'khrug gzhan dag dang bsdur na ha las dgos pa zhig gtan nas ma yin rung /g.yul 'gyed de nā pho lun gyi mi tshe ru byas rjes bla lhag 'jog pa'i gom pa dang g+ni /nga yin stabs don snying ches cher ldan pa'i g.yul 'gyed thengs gcig smugazla'i srid 'gyur/nā pho lun gyis hra'o cang dmag thob kyi 'gan bzhes te lo phyed tsastu sdus

ma lon par rgyal nang du tsha zla'i srid 'gyur byung / ro bho zi sgye ar spun mched dang ya ki ping gi tshogs gtso rnams 'dzin bzung thebs shing gcig rjes gnyis mthud du bkrongs pas/ nā pho lun khong nyid kyang ro sgo zi sgye ar spun mched la 'brel lam zab pa'i rkyen gyis btson du tshud/ 'on kyang kho'i nag nyes ci yang lag tu ma son pas btson grol mi gtong thabs med byung / kho tshos nā pho lun ni phyogs dmag gi las la mkhas rung ham sems che zhing chab srid kyi lag thabs mkhas can zhig red ces khong khyad gsod byas/ btson nas grol rjes ci yang med pa'i khos pha ri si nas nyi ma gtong thabs kyis ngan ngon gyi 'tsho ba mi rol thabs med byung / yin yang khos dbang cha dang mtshan snyan la bcangs pa'i 'dod pa de nyin gcig kyang dor ma myong / 1794lo'i lo mjug nas 1795lo'i lo 'gor khos yang bskyar go skabs thengs gcig rnyed/tsha zla'i srid 'gyur la rgyal kha blangs rjes/ kho tshos skyi g.ya' ba'i drag gnon la brten nas rgyal nang gi mi dmangs la rdung deg drag po btang bar spyi tshogs kyi 'gal ba rnyog 'dzing du gyur/ gong ma'i rjes 'brang rnams kyis glags 'di dang bstun te drag po'i zing 'khrug bslangs/ gsar brje ngo log pa'i drag bskyod stobs shugs kyis 'byor ldan gral rim che khag gi srid dbang 'phrog rgyu'i nyen kha'i 'og kho tshos yang bskyar stogs dmag gi las la nang byan chud pa'i nā pho lun pha ri si'i mkhar srung spyi dpon gyi lag rogs su bskos shing /ngo log zing 'khrug zhod 'jags su gtong dgos pa'i bka' phabs par/ nā pho lun gyis mi'i rigs kyi lo rgyus su mkhar grong gi 'thab 'khrug tu me skyogs bkol ba'i dpe thog ma bstan/ mi 7000tsam las ma mchis pa'i dmag dpung zhig gis mi 3007lhag gi gong ma'i rjes 'brang ba'i srid 'gyur rdul du brlags pa de ni dmag don gyi lo rgyus su'ang blo yul las 'das pa'i rgyal kha rdo12 po zhig red/ thengs de'i g.yul 'gyed du khong gi dpa' mdzangs dang

brtul phod kyis 'byor ldan gral rim che khag la bag chags zab mo bzhag mi 'gyangs par nā pho lun gyis dbyi tha li la dmag sna drangs/ gnas de ru khos dmag 'khrug che chung bsdoms pas 65brgyab myong la pham kha thengs gcig kyang 'khur ma myong bar ma zad/ da dung mnga' khongs bcad bzung dang dgra dmag khri 15tsam gson bzung byas/ khong rgyal kha'i ngang phyir log dus srid gzhung dpon rigs yongs dang grangs las 'das pa'i mi ser gyi bsu ba rgya chen thob/ skye bo kun gyis khong la dgra 'joms dmag dpon zhes mtshan gsol te khong ni h+pha ran si mi dmangs kyi gzi brjid dang la rgya ru brtsis/khong gi bzhugs sgar gnas sa'i srang lam gyi ming yang rgyal kha'i lam zhes btags shing mi kun gyi khas len thob/ 1799lo'i zla 6par nā pho lun gyis e jib tu g.yul 'gyed byed bzhin pa'i skabs su/ khos tshags par zhig las ya mtshar dbos pa'i gsar 'gyur zhig mthong ba ni o si khru ri ya(403 0tha lo lko/1)dang dbyin ji/ u ru su sogs rgyal khab kyis yang bskyar h+pha ran sir rgol ba'i mnyam 'brel dmag bsdus te u ru su'i dmag dpung gis dbyi tha li ru mchis pa'i h+pha dmag pham par brgyab zhing / h+pha ran si'i rgyal nang du'ang sa bshigardo bshig gis srid gzhung thor zhig tu 'gro ba'i nyen khar gyur yod pa mthong 'phral khos de ma thag hrag dmag 500lhag khrid de phyir rgyal nang du logakhong phyir phebs pa'i gtam de grong mi yongs kyis thos 'phral rma byas 'brug sgra thos pa bzhin skye rgu yongs kyis bsu ba mdzad/ 'byor ldan gral rim che khag la ma tshon na yang dgra bor rgol lan sprod thub pa tsam du ma zad/ gzhi rim mang tshogs la'ang drag gnon byed thub pa'i mi brtul phod can zhig mkho bas mi de ni nā pho lun las ma 'das so snyam/ bstud mar gza' 'khor gsum tsam la mi dmangs khrom du 'du sa nas/ nā pho lun mi rnal ma zhig gam chab srid kyi ham sems ci yang med khul gyi phyi tshul tsam ston bzhin lkog nastu spyad

'gyur byed rgyu'i sta gon la brel/ zla 11tshes 9nyin (smug zla'i tshes 18nyin )la nā pho lun gyis rgan gras khang du mchis pa'i sku tshab brgyud de/ bka'i tshul gyis rgan gras khang dang 'thus mi lnga brgya'i las shag(gros khang )gnyis pha ri si'i nye 'dabs kyi grong rdal zhig tu gnas spo ru bcug cing / rang nyid kyis pha ri si dang nye 'khor sa khul gyi bde srung dmag spyi'i 'gan bzhes te srid 'gyur thengs gcig 'di ltar 'go btsams byung / nyin rjes mar nā pho lun dmag dpon rnams kyi phebs rogs 'og grong rdal chung ngu der phebs nas mthong ba tsam gyis spa bkong bar byed pa'i gzi brjid dang gom stabs kyis gon gas khang gi tshogs thog tu phebs te/ khong khro'i me lce dgung du 'phyur bzhin du 'thus mi rnams la/ ngas khyed cag la bskrun pa'i 'od stong 'bar ba'iwo ran si de da lta gang du yod/ ngas khyed cag la zhi bde yi skya rengs bsus rung da lta ba'i mig mdun du lhags pa ni gang sa gang du bem po dang zungs khrag red/ ngas dbyi tha li nas gser dngul mtsho ltar brdol rung da lta nga'i rna lam du 'khor ba ni smre sngags dang mig mdun du snang ba ni dbul phongs red/ ngas khyod tsho la blangs pa'i rgyal kha yod tshad da lta yid skyo ba'i pham kha rkyang rkyang du gyur 'dug khyod tshos ngar rgyus mnga' ba'i h+pha dmag bye ba gcig po gnas gang zhig tu btang byung / kho tsho tshang ma shi tshar ba red dam bsad tshar ba red ces dri ba phreng rdog bzhin bgrang pa la rgan gras rnams kyis a lan tsam yang ster ma nus par gnya' ba sgur sgur du 'dug pa mthong tshe nā pho lun gyis de ma thag rgan gras khang gi dbang cha bkrol/ yang nā pho lun nga rgyal dang bcas 'thus mi lnga brgya'i gros khang du phebs te gtam rnams bskyar du bzlo bar 'dod pa la/ glo bur ba'i don rkyen zhig ni khong nyid gros khang du 'dzul ma thag 'thus mi khag cig khong khro dang bcas rje ngan la ngo rgol dang srid1 ༵༵nga sger 'dzin la ngo rgol gyi kha g.yang mthon por sgrog bzhin khong la kha

rub lag rub byas pa na/ khong yang dngangs 'tshab dang bcas ga byed 'di byed ma nges par yud tsam 'gor rjes/ da gzod dmag shog ces bka' bsgos te mthar 'thus mi rnams kyang mtshon cha'i mdun du ci bya gtol med du gyur nas dbang cha slar 'bul rgyur pos mthun byung / rgan gas khang dang 'thus mi lnga brgya'i gros khang gnyis ming gi lhag ma tsam du btang rjes/ srid dbang yod tshad mi gzhan gnyis dang nā pho lun gsum gyi lag tu tshud cing mtshan mo der kho tshos srid dbang bdag gar bzhes pa'i mdzad sgo bsdus/ mi de gsum las kyang nā pho lun ni dbang 'dzin pa dang po yin zhing spyi 'gan bzhes yod la/ mi gzhan gnyis po la bsam 'char 'don pa'i dbang cha tsam las ci yang med/ dus skabs 'di ni nā pho lun gyis dmag don sger 'dzin gyi rkang tshugs sa'ang yin no//nā pho lun gyi mi tshe ru ches 'od stong 'bar ba'i dus rim/nā pho lun ni dmag don la nang byan chud par ma zad da dung phul du byung ba'i chab srid pa zhig kyang red/ khong chab srid kyi lag thabs la mkhas pa de bod kyi pho gsar rta rtsal gyis phyug pa dang mtshungs la/ khong gis srid dbangs brtan du gtong ched sa gnas kyi rang skyong med par bzos te krung dbyang gis dbang cha gcig sdud mdzad pa dang chabs cig dmag dbang dam 'dzinakhyas shing dgra bor dogs zon nan mo byas/ nyin zhig gi mtshan mor khong zlos gar khang du phebs pa'i lam bar du 'gad rdzas shig bkad pa'i mthus/ spyir kho'i tshe srog la gnod 'tshe ci yang ma thebs rung ya ki ping gi mis nga rang lkog gsod byed 'dod pa red ces ma nyes kha g.yogs kyis 'go khrid pa 130lhag 'dzin bzung byas shing / nub rgya mtsho chen mo'i phar ga'i a ri'i gling dkyil ma ru mthar skrod btang / khos yang bskyar don rkyen ༵ spyang

ma'i rjes 'brang rnams kyi ngan jus yin par bsnyad btags te mi bcu phrag kha shas btson 'jug dang gtso 'dzin mi gnyis tsam la srog khrims bcad/ nā pho lun gyis srid dbang sra brtan du gtong ba'i thabs shes gzhan zhig ni khrims lugs 'dzugs skrun yin te/ 1804lor khos (dmangs don skor gyi khrims gzhung 〉(yang na 〈nā pho lun gyi khrims gzhung 〉du'ang 'bod )gtan la phab te ma rtsa ring lugs dang zhing pa chung ngur dbang ba'i lam lugs srung skyob mdzad pa'i dus mtshungs su bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin dang gral rim lam lugs med par bzos nas tshong las rang dbang can dang bzo bar bshu gzhog mi byed par khag theg mdzad cing / phyi rgyal du bros byol du song ba'i mi la h+pha ran si'i thob thang med par btang ste bca' khrims kyi bdag skyong ci yang med par bzos/ khong gis bstud mar 〈nyes chad kyi khrims gzhung nyidang 〈tshong las kyi khrims gzhung 〉sogs kyang khyab bsgrags mdzad/ nā pho lun gyis da dung ro ma'i gnam bdag dang gan rgya bzhag ste/ srid gzhung gis gnam bdag chos lugs ni h+pha ran si'i spyi dmangs phal mo ches dad pa byed pa'i chos lugs yin par khas len pa'i dus mnyam du/ chos tshogs yod tshad rgyal khab la gtogs par gtan 'bebs gnang / mtho rim gyi chos lugs mi sna yod tshad srid gzhung gis bsko bzhag mdzad rgyu dang / gnam bdag gi bka' yig dang bsgrags gtam/ bslab bya yod do cog srid gzhung gi chog mchan ma thob par gang 'dod du spel mi chog par bzos phyin/ gnam bdag chos lugs de nā pho lun gyi dbang 'og tu yongs su tshud par gyur ba de ni sngar byung ma myong ba'i snang tshul zhig red/ nā pho lun ni 'byor ldan gral rim che khag gi 'thus tshab yin pa'i cha nas khong srid khrir bzhugs ma thag sgo khral la srung skyob/bya dngos gsar gtod la bya dga' dang skul ma gnang ste mi rigs kyi dpal 'ardidī 6gong 'phel dang 'dzugs skrun la 'bad 'bungs lhod med gnang /

1800lor nā pho lun gyis dmag mi nyis khri lhag khrid de dbyi tha li dang g.yul sprad cing / kho tsho'i byang phyogs kyi mnga' khongs yang bskyar h+pha dmag gis bcad bzung byas te/ btsan shed kyis o si khru ri ya la dbyi tha li sogs yo rob gling gi mnga' khongs h+pha ran si la dbang bar khas len du bcug par ma zad/ thengs gnyis par h+pha ran sir rgol ba'i mnyam 'brel dmag dpung ming gi lhag ma tsam du btang / 1802lo'i zla 2par rgan gras khang gis nā pho lun gyi thugs dgongs bzhin khong nyid h+pha ran si spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi tshe dpon du bskos shing / 1804lor nā pho lun h+pha ran si'i rus rgyud kyi gong mar bsko bzhag mdzad de/ tshe tshe rabs rabs su nā pho lun khyim rgyud kyis srid 'gan bzhes chog par gtan 'bebs gnang ba des smug zla'i srid 'gyur (tsha(74)gyi rjes su/ 1792lor dbu brnyes pa'i spyi mthun rgyal khab de ming don gnyis ka med par gyur/ khrir bzhugs pa'i mdzad sgo de yang gzi brjid ldan zhing kun gyi yid dbang 'phrog ched ro ma'i gnam bdag pha ri si ru gdan drangs/ gnam bdag h+pha ran si ru 'byor ba'i nyin mo der nā pho lun rngon pa'i chas su zhugs shing shwa khyi gsum dang bcas ri dwags rngon du 'gro khul gyis lam bar du gnam bdag dang mjal 'phrad gnang / khos kyang de 'dra'i yid la mi 'jags pa'i tshul gyis khams bde tsam dris rjes nā pho lun dang gnam bdag gnyis dus mnyam du shing rta ru bzhugs pas su sngon dang su gzhugagi mtho dman sogs kyi rnyog dra ci yang bzo ma dgos/ 1804lo'i zla 12tshes 2nyin la/ gnam bdag gis 'phags ma dge sgrub gling 'du khang chen mo (cha (74)ru nā pho lun khrir bzhugs kyi mdzad sgo bsdus/ nyin der nā pho lun gyis h+pha sgor khri 100lhag btang ba'i na bza' dang gdugs kyis brgyan pa'i dbu rgyan sku la gsol te/ rdo rje pha lam gyis phra btab pa'i glo gri las 'od mdangs rnam par 'tsher bas skye bo kun gyi yid dbang1 〉phrog

'grib kyi dus kyang los yod/ kho'i chung ma'i ming la ye zi h+phin zer zhing thu'u lin g.yul 'gyed skabs su khong gnyis ngo 'phrad cing rjes su gnyen bsgrigs/khong gnyis phan tshun la brtse ba zab kyang sras sras mo gcig kyang btsa' ma thub pa de kho'i sems sdug cig tu gyur 'dug mthar nyin mo zhig la nā pho lun gyis kho mo dang gza' tshang 'thor rgyu'i bsam tshul bstan/ rgyu mtshan ni rang gi bu rabs tsha rgyud kyis tshe tshe rabs rabs su h+pha ran si'i dbang 'dzin pa byed ched du red/ kho mos glo bur ba'i gtam ngan de thos 'phral sa ru 'gyel brgyal ba na/ nā pho lun gyis nga'i snying nye ba'i dga' ma lags/ ngas khyod la bcangs pa'i brtse dung de su yis kyang bsnyon du med rung / brtse dung gis chabasrid kyi tshab byed ga la rung zhes bza' thor byed rgyu'i sems thag bcad zin pas/ ci bya gtol med kyi ye zi h+phin gyis kyang mthar mos mthun mi byed thabs med byung / 'o na su zhig rang gi chung mar bsu rgyu yin nam/ ches thog mar nā pho lun gyis u ru su'i hra hong gong ma la rang lo 16can gyi sring mo zhig yod pa bslangs par/ hra hong gis kho mo da dung nar ma pon par kha g.yar te nā pho lun la kha ya ma byas stabs khong nyid khong khro tshad med langs/ yang khros o si khru ri ya'i gong mar gnyen slong pa'i bsam tshul bstan pa na gong ma dga' mgu dang bcas zhal gyis bzhes/ rgyu mtshan ni h+pha ran si'i do zlar mi yong bar ma zad nā pho lun gyis gnyen bslangs pa de kho tsho'i rgyal khab la mtshon na bla na med pa'i gnang sbyin zhig tu mthong / nā pho lun rang ngos nas bshad kyang / khong nyid khrir bzhugs rjes yo rob gling gi mi la las rang nyid glags 'tshol mkhan gyi jag rkun zhig gi sar bzhag yod par ha cang blor mi 'dod pa byung yod/ da lta o si khru ri ya'i sras mo mā lis lo'u ye zi bag mar bsus pa de lo rgyus ches ring ba'i yo rob gling gi hwa pu'u zi pa'o rgyal rabs13la gnyen bslangs pas de'ang kho'i gzi brjid du brtsis yod/ nā pho lunā snas

o si khru ri yar gnyen btsugs pa des hra hong gi thugs dgongs ches cher dkrugs shing / sngar nā pho lun gyis dbyin ji kher rkyang du gtong ba'i srid jus lag tu bstar te/ yo rob gling gi rgyal khab khag gis dbyin jir tshong 'brel byed mi chog par bzos par rgyal khab 'di dag gi khe phan la gnod 'tshe tshabs chen thebs shing nā pho lun la rgol lan sprad myong / da lta hra hong gong mas h+pha ran si la gcig mtshungs kyi thabs spyad de sgo khral lam lugs gsar du bzos nas/ dbyin ji'i tshong rdzas 'bor chen u ru sur nang 'dren byas te de nas slar yo rab gling gi rgyal khab so sor phyir gtong byas/ nā pho lun gyis sha 'khon rtsod ched du gang myur sgos phu'u lu'u hri dang o si khru ri yar mnyam 'brel gyis 1812lor mi khri 50can gyi dpung chen gyis u ru su'i phyogs su dpung 'jug byas te/ khong gi bsam par u ru su pham par ma brgyab na h+pha ran si nam yang yo rob gling gi btsan rgyal du 'gyur mi srid snyam/ yin yang u ru su'i sa khyon che zhing gnam gshes btsog pas dbang du bsdu thub min la mi kha shas kyis g.yul sprod mi rung ba'i re ba phul kyang khos nga rgyal chen po dang bcas lo gsum gyi rjes su ngas 'dzam gling hril po dbang du bsdu rgyu yin zhes bshad/ 'on kyang nā pho lun gyi rmi lam du'ang 'char mi srid pa'i don rkyen zhig ni u ru sus khong nyid pham par brgyab par ma zad/ khri bcu phrag 'ga'i h+pha dmag gcig kyang slar yang rang yul du ldog tu med par gyur/ dmag 'khrug 'di'i rjes su yo rob gling gi rgyal khab khag gis spobs pa cher bskyed kyis h+pha ran si la rgol lan gcig mur gnyis mthun de bslogs/ 1813lor u ru su dang dbyin ji/ phu'u lu'u hri/ o si khru ri ya/ su'e ten (57070balkosko)bcas rgyal khab drug gis thengs drug pa'i h+pha ran sir rgol ba'i mnyam 'brel dmag dpung rtsa 'dzugs kyis le pi zhi'i g.yul 'gyed du h+pha ran si yong11 ༵ pham par brgyab/ te dbyi kri'i rgyal phran so sor bcings 'grol thob

par ma zad/ dbyin dmag gis si phan gyi mnga' khongs yongs su bdag 'dzin byas/ lo rjes ma'i lo 'gor/ mnyam 'brel dmag dpung gis dmag mi ru bzhi la bgos te phyogs yongs nas h+pha ran sir dpung 'jug byas shing zla 3tshes 31nyin pha ri si grong khyer du blugs/ mnyam 'brel dmag gi btsan drag 'og h+pha ran si'i rgan gras khang dang khrims 'dzugs las khungs kyis nā pho lun gyi srid dbang mgo rting bslogs par khas len phul cing / zla 4pa'i zla 'gor nā pho lun gyis kyang rang nyid yul mthar smyugs pa'i bka' shog steng ming rtags bkod/ nā pho lun go gnas las phyungs rjes mnyam 'brel dmag dpung gis khong nyid or pā gling phran du rgyang phud btang / gling phran de sa dkyil rgya mtsho chen mo'i byang phyogs su mchis la kho'i pha yul kho zhi ca dang spyi le 50tsam las med/ gling phran der grong khyer chung ngu gsum dang grong mi stong phrag 'ga' las mi 'dug pas/ nā pho lun sku srung 'ga' dang dmag mi stong phrag gcig tsam gnas de ru gtan sdod byed dgos byung / dbyin ji dang yo rob gling gi rgyal khab gzhan dag gis nā pho lun da lta gzhi nas pham par brgyab pa red snyam rung / khong dang rgyal nang du lus pa'i rjes 'brang bar gyi gsang 'phrin nam yang chad ma myong / h+pha ran si'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi rgyal rabs te po pa rgyal rabs kyis bskyar du srid dbang bzung rjes/ thabs brgya jus stong gis sku drag rnying ba'i go gnas slar gso dang gsar brje'i grub 'bras snang med du bzhag cing / sku drag las khungs slar gso byas te mi dmangs kyi 'dems bsko'i dbang char bshu gzhog byas par ma zad/ dmag grangs je nyung du btang ste dmag phogs mi ster ba dang / khral bcu cha'i gcig(4/khe7)dang gsar brje'i rjes su zhing par thob pa'i sa zhing gzhung bzhes byed par 'ud sgrogs chen po byas pa la zhing pa dang dmag mi/ da dung 'byor ldan gral rim mang po'ang khong khro tshad med langs dgos byung / ngan sdu/ ma

'phrad na bzang po mi dran zhes pa'i dpe ltar kho tshos yang bskyar nā pho lun gyi mdzad rjes dran byung la/ kho'i 'khrungs skar dus chen la mi dmangs kyis k+ṣe tsho ri'i —— ci'i rugang 4 — dzha la/ sa ji ra sha ga sa gu ci ri ——— — ci sna ri/ sgyuX nga — h+pha ran si'i skam sar bud rjes pa'o gang rgyal rabs kyi dmag mi rnams ngo log nas bsu ba byed pa'i tshul/ dga' ston byed pa dang dmag sgar du'ang dmag mis nam rgyun du dus nam zhig la gong mar slar mjal thub pa'i gleng mol byed bzhin yod/ yo rob gling gi rgyal khab so sos rgyal kha'i lag yong gi bgo bsha'i thad du wi en na (71 0bas7)ru khyod shi nga gson gyis 'khon 'dzing gi las la brel ba'i skabs su/ nā pho lun gyis go skabs 'di dam 'dzin byas te gling phran de ru grags med tshor med du 'dug ma bzod par phyir h+pha ran si la dmag dpung 'dren rgyu byas/ 1815lo'i zla 2tshes 26nyin yod tshad dus su babs pa na/ nā pho lun gyis dmag dpon gsum dang gzhan dmag mi stong gcig lhag bcas gru gzings 'gar bsdad de mtshan mo'i chu tshod 7gyi steng du ir pā gling phran nas ladi k+to 2chas/ nyin zhag gsum gyi rjes su kho tsho bde blags ngang h+pha ran si'i

mtsho ngogs su 'byor/nā pho lun phyir log skabs pa'o pang srid gzhung gis 'tshab 'tshub ngang g.yul bshams par/ dmag mi rnams dpung dang dpung byas nas srid gzhung la lo log stabs nā pho lun gyis mde'u gcig gi zad gron med par mi tshogs kyi sa 'tshang skor dmag dpung pha ri si grong khyer du 'dzul du bcug par ma zad/ dga' ba 'bum gyis myos pa'i mang tshogs kyis khong nyid gong ma'i pho brang du gdan drangs te khrir mnga' gsol/ gong ma lu'u dbyi skye phreng bco brgyad pa nā pho lun grong khyer du ma 'byor gong nas gar song cha med du gyur/khos yang bskyar rtsa khrims gsar du gtan 'bebs dang dmag dpung rgya skyed/chos tshogs kyi dbang char tshod 'dzin mdzad pa sogs srid jus mang du spel bar wi en na ru tshogs 'dur zhugs yod pa'i yo rab gling gi rgyal khab khag rnams ya mtshar dgos pa byung / kho tshos gang myur sgos h+pha ran sir rgol ba'i mnyam 'brel dmag dpung sgrig 'dzugs kyis nā pho lun mi dmangs kyi spyi dgra chags pa'i bka' yig bsgrags/ mnyam 'brel dmag mi khri brgya brgal ba de h+pha ran si'i phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas sprin nag 'khrigs pa ltar sa gzhi sgib zil yong ba'i shugs kyis/ nā pho lun la dmag khri nyi shu tsam las med pa dang mtshon cha yang ha cang rjes lus yin phyir dgra bo'i mdun du sgo nga brag la brdabs pa tsam las ma 'das par/ 1815lo'i zla 6par nā pho lun yang bskyar khri las phabs te hreng hi na'i gling phran la rgyang phud du btang / mthar gling phran de ru mtshan snyan rlung ltar grags pa'i skyes chen des ngag thog nas rang nyid kyi lo rgyus mi la bshad pa dang dpe char gzigs pa/ me tog 'debs pa/ mda' rtsal sbyong ba tsam gyis dus 'das te 1821lor tshe las 'das shing dgung grangs 52tsam las ma bzhugs so// / /153

66ches shes rab༅ltan pa'i mi mi ste sngo nya ma'o rna ma yis/a'o zi man thur khe rgyal khab chen mo14ni mnga' khongs yo rob gling dang a she ya/ a h+phe ri kha'i gling bcas gling chen gsum du khyab pa'i stobs ldan pa'i rgyal khab chen lo zhig yin rung / dus rabs 18pa nas bzung yo rob glingagi gsar dar ma rtsa ring lugs kyi 'phel rgyas dang bstun nas rgyal khab rim gyis nyams 'go tshugs/ 'on kyang btsan rgyal 'di'i mnga' khongs su da dung gson stobs rgyas bzhin pa'i sa khul gcig ('di gcig po tsam)yod de de ni e cib rgyal khab red/(e cib ni 1512lor a'o zi man thur khe rgyal khab kyi zhing chen zhig tu gyur/)de ni skabs de'i e cib kyi spyi dpon ā+o ha ma'o di ya lis kyi blo thag rbad chod kyi gsar brje dang 'brel ba dam zab tu yod de/gsar brje des e cib kyi rang btsan dang bdag dbang la srung skyob mdzad cing mthar ma rtsa ring lugs kyis e cib la btsan 'dzul gyi dus tshod 'gor 'gyangs su btang / yang cig bshad na khos rgyal khab de ru ma rtsa ring lugs kyi 'phel rgyas la rmang gzhi chen po btings/ 'byor med gral rim gyi slob dpon mar khe sis kyang a lis ni 6 mgo bkris kyi rgyan la mi zhen par mgo bo zlo sna spyod mkhan mi spyang grung 'dzoms pa zhig red ’ ces bstod bsngags phul sbyi dpon gyi khri la mnga' gsol ba/ke ri se'i byang shar phyogs su khā pa lā zer ba'i grong khyer zhig yod la e chin ༵༵ yi 'gram ngogs su chags pa'i yul ljongs rnam par mdzes pa'i

tsā sariri ri gna' bo'i gru kha zhig red/ 1769lor a ( ba'i lis gnas der sku 'khrungs shing kho'i yab gshi chen ni ar pa ni ya'i mi zhig dang khā pa rig lha'i dmag dpon chung gras shig kyang yin/4 snang ga bsdudamarachung ma 'ga' blangs stabs kho — da tshang la bu phrug bco brgyad yod la 'tsho bar 07 95)ha cang khag po byung / rang lo lnga drug tsam ༄23du yum chen tshe las 'das shing rang lo bcu — bzhir son tshe yab kyang tshe las 'das te — — — ——mthar khong nyid dwa phyug tu gyur/ 'on kyang ma'o ha ma'o rdi sa lis/ dga' 'os pa zhig la kho'i che zhing rgyags pa'i gzugs gzhi dang phra zhing myur ba'i rnam dpyod sa de'i dmag spyi yi thugs su babs te/ khong rang bu skal du blangs shing 'tsho gos tsam du ma zad rta rgyug mda' 'phen sogs pho rtsal sna dgu la nang byan chud par mdzad/ a lis nar son rjes drag zing zhod 'jags dang 'bru khral bsdu sa par ma zad/ dpon chung sogs kyi 'gan yang bzhes myong stabs dmag don dang dmag 'thab kyi thad du nyams myong phun sum tshogs/ rang lo bco brgyad du a lis gnyen bsgrigs shing chung ma ni sdod dmag gi dmag spyi'i gnyen nye zhig red/ gnyen sgrig gi rjes su khos smad phyogs nas gong sla mo'i rdo tha tshur nyos shing slar khā pa lā nas yo rob kyi tshong bar btsongs te tshong ha cang brin pa byung / 'di ltar lo 'ga'i rjes su a lis khong yang khā pa lā'i rgyu stobs che ba'i mi chen zhig tu gyur/1801lor a lis rang lo so gnyis yin/ lo 'di ni kho'i mi tshe yi ches gnad 'gag gi lo gcig yin la gtam rgyud de'ang h+pha ran sis e cib la btsan 'dzul byas pa nas gleng dgos/ 155

dus rabs 18pa'i dus mjug tu dbyin h+pha rgyal khab gnyis kyis a she ya'i mi ser spel yul 'phrog rtsod kyi 'gal ba nyin bzhin dmar rjen du gyur bar brten/ e cib ni rgyal khab 'di gnyis la mtshon na 'byor phyug ldan pa tsam du ma zad da dung dmag 'thab kyi go gnas ha cang gal che stabs/1798lo'i zla 7par nā pho lun gyi sne khrid 'og h+pha dmag 35000e cib la dpung 'jug byas/ thur khe srid gzhung gis rgol lan ba slog ched de ma thag sa gnas so so nas dpon dmag 'tshol bsdu mdzad de e cib tu dmag rogs su btang / de dag gi khrod du dpa' 'dzing brtul phod kyi ar pa ni ya'i skya dmag gi ru dpung cig yod la kho tsho'i dmag spyi ni a lis rang red/1801lo'i zla 6tshes 9mtshan mor a lis kyis zhis nā phyed gling gi dgra bor 'jab rgol byas te rmi lam gyi zhing khams na bde bar gzims pa'i h+pha dmag gi 'thab ra sil bur gtor cing dgra sde yongs cham la phabs par/ thur khe'i tsung tu'u ho'u zi los khong la bya dga'i tshul gyis dmag mi 4000can gyi ar pa ni ya'i skya dmag gi dmag spyi ru dngos su bsko bzhag bstsal/ 'di ltar h+pha dmag gis e cib nas pham kha gang mang myangs mthar 1801lo'i zla 8tshes 31nyin la dmag dpung phyir 'then mi byed thabs med byung / h+pha dmag mthar skrod btang rjes thur khe srid gzhung gis a lis kyi dmag dpung yang e cib nas phyir 'then byed pa'i bka' babs rung / a lis kyis da ni rang skyes kyi rang mdog ston ran red dgongs te dmag dpon phyir 'then byed rgyu phar zhog spyi dpon gyi srid khri 'phrog rtsod kyi 'thab rtsod du zhugs so//skabs der a'o zi man thur khe rgyal khab chen mo ru e cib la dmigs bsal gyi rang skyong dbang cha cung tsam mchis pa gtso cher mā mo'u li'u khu15 yi lag tu tshud yod na yang / thur khe gong ma'i stobs shugs ni sngar mus bzhin su/ ཿ/ 'gran zla bral ba yin/ nā pho lun pham par brgyab rjes/ e cib kyi

bdag dbang la 'gan srung byed ched a lis dang mā mo'u li'u khu gnyis tur ki srid gzhung la rgol lan slog pa'i mna' 'brel btsugs/ ar pa ni ya'i dmag mir thur khe srid gzhung nas thob pa'i dmag phogs ha cang nyung phyir a lis yi ma rangs par srid gzhung la ngo log byas/ zing 'khrug langs ma thag mā mo'u li'u khu yi rgyab skyor thob ste thur khe ki'i dmag dpung rdul du brlags shing dmag spyi ho'u zi lo gson bzung mdzad/ ngo log zing 'khrug zhod 'jags su gtong phyir thur khe srid gzhung gis gang myur sgos hā zha gsar ba zhig khrir bskos kyang / ar pa nis ya'i dpon dmag yongs kyis blo sems 'gyur med kyis rgol lan sprad mthar/ pā zha16 kho yang 'dzin bzung thebs shing gsar brje dmag mis rkang lag thag pas bsdams te gson por sa dkyil rgya mtsho chen mo ru 'phangs te gsar brje yi chod sems bstan/ e cib tu thur khe srid gzhung gi stobs shugs nyams rgud du gyur ba dang bstun/ spyang ki gsos rung sgo khyi mi nyan gyi dpe bzhin a lis kyis mdung kha mā mo'u lig khu la gtad de kho tsho'i nang khul gyi 'gal ba bed spyod kyis phan tshun la dmar gsod dang / skabs 'gar thur khe srid gzhung dang lag 'brel gyis mā mo'u li'u khu la g.yul bshams te pham nyes chen po bzos/ khos rang nyid gcig pu'i stobs shugs kyis mā mo'u li'u khu'i do zla mi longs pa tshor te yis zi lan gyi chos dpon dang tshong ba rnams la rgyab rogs zhus/ 1805lo'i zla 5 bar phyogs yongs kyi ram 'degs dang rgyab skyor 'og a lis e cib tsung tu'u yi khri la mnga' gsol/ ci bya gtol med du gyur ba'i tur ki gong mas kyang kho la khas len mi byed bya thabs bral/ nyin de nas bzung khos mi lo 44ring gi chab srid kyi las 'gan 'khur du bzhes/mā mu'u li'u khu dang rgyal pham gyi dbye ba 'byed pa/a lis spyi dpon gyi khrir bzhugs te cher ma lon par/ dbyin ji stulha e

cib la btsan 'dzul byas par a lis kyis blo thag rbad chod kyis dbyin ji'i jag dmag mthar skyod gtong thub pa byung na yang / kho tsho la nyen kha sngar bzhin gnas yod de/ dper na dbyin jis sha 'khon rtsod ched du dmag dpung nam yong cha med yin pa dang / thur khe srid gzhung gis kyang rang nyid kyi mnga' khongs phyir 'phrog dgos snyam pa'i ham sems bcangs/ da dung mā mo'u lig khus kyang gnas skabs kyi pham kha myangs te e cib kyi stod phyogs su bros na yang tshur rgol nam byed cha med yin phyin a lis kyis da lta ci zhig bya dgos sam/ 'di lta bu'i gnas bab 'og a lis kyis thur khe srid gzhung la blo sems dkar khul gyis khral rigs dus ltar 'jal zhing ci gsungs bka' bzhin sgrub pa/ mig sngar gyi gnad don ni mā mo'u li'u khu rtsa med btang ste e cib gcig gyur dang rgyal khab stobs ldan du btang nas rang khyim rang bdag byed rgyu rang gal che bar dgongs/ 'o na ji ltar mā mu'u li'u khu la dpung 'jug byed rgyu yin nam zhe na/ de yang sla mo zhig ma yin stabs khos mā mo'u lizhukhu'i gral rim mtho khag gi rjes 'brang rnams khe dzā((8170)ru gdan drangs shing kho tshor 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen gya nom pa gnang ste gtan 'dug byed par skul ma gnang / 1811lo'i zla 3pa'i tshes 1nyin la a lis kyis rang gi sras chung ba thu'u sung ā ra dhe'i gling phran gyi dmag spyi chen mo ru bskos pa'i mdzad sgo bsdus par/ a lis kyis khe rī ru gnas bcas pa'i mā mu'u le'u khu'i mtho rim sku drag 460lhag la kho tsho'i sku srung dmag dang zhabs 'brang dang bcas gdan drangs shing bsu ba rgya chen gnang / ston mo mjug sgril la nye tshe kho tshos 'charagazhi nang bzhin khrom skor mdzad/ khrom skor gyi ches mdun du a lis dang thur khe'i dmag dpung / ar pa ni ya'i dmag dpung bcas phebs shing /de nas mā mo'u lig khu sku 'khor dang bcas pa/ de dag gi rjes su rkang dmag dang1 snro8 dmag kyang ched du bkod sgrig gnang yod stabs ha cang brjid nyams
