gyi gtan tshigs dang 'gal ba'i nang don la bsgyur bcos dang kha snon gyis tshig sbyor dang gzhung lugs sogs bam po dang po dang gnyis pa ma mchis pa zhiga.e yong snyam pa'i mthus/ 1885lo'i zla 7par 〈ma rtsa'i rnam bshad 〉kyi bam po gnyis pa de en ke si'i 'char gzhi ltar 'grem spel gnang / 'on kyang thog ma'i ma zin tsam las ma mchis pa'i bam po gsum pa'i sgrig sgyur de en ke sir mtshon na/ mar khe si rang nyid kyi skad chas mtshon pa'i gzhung lugs kyi 'bras bu g.yur du za ba zhig byed rgyu de'ang las sla bo zhig ga la yin/mar khe si'i 'char zin la gzhigs te 1885lo'i zla 11par/ en ke sis bam po gsum pa'i grub cha de sngar gyi le'u bdun po nas le'u chen po bdun dang sa bcad 52su gtan 'bebs gnang / yang bskyar le'u re re bzhin dag bcos dang kha snon mdzad par ma zad gsar rtsom yang mang du mdzad byung / rgyu mtshan ni khong gi lag tu son pa'i 'char zin yang legs sgrig ci yang mdzad med pa'i zin bris dang dpyad brjod/ rtsom btus sna tshogs kho na rang red/ dper na le'u bzhi ba'i 〈ma rtsa'i 'khor skyod kyis skyed kur thebs pa'i shugs rkyen 〉zhes par kha byang dang 'char gzhi tsam las med pa dang / le'u lnga ba ste 〈khe spogs zhes pa ni skyed ka dang khe las kyi yong 'bab gtso bo/ ma rtsa'i 'khor skyod bcas las grub 〉ces pa'i sa bcad so so rtsom skabs kyang dka' ngal mang por 'phrad myong / 1895lo'i zla 3par en ke si sku gshegs pa'i zla 'ga'i snga rol du/ 〈ma rtsa'i rnam bshad 〉kyi bam po gsum pa da gzod dngos su 'grem spel byed thub pa byung / en ke sis mi lo 12tsam spyad de 〈ma rtsa'i rnam bshad 〉kyi bam po gnyis pa dang gsum pa yongs su legs 'grub byung ba des/ rgyal khab so so'i 'byor med gral rim dang gung khran ring lugs kyi las don la rlabs che ba'i byas rjes bzhag yod par ma zad/da dung rang nyid kyi mdza' grogs la dus rtag tu bsgrubs par mi srid pa~X /na

gso'i rdo ring zhig bslangs shing / rang nyid kyi mtshan yang rdo ring du brkos te bskal brgya'i bar mdza' brtse rtag brtan gyi dpang bo ru gyur/1895lo'i zla 8pa'i tshes 5nyin mar khe si'i ring lugs kyi srol gtod mkhan zhig dang 'byor med gral rim gyi rlabs che ba'i slob dpon chen mo/rang nyid kyi mi tshe yang gung khran ring lugs kyi las don du phul ba'i en ke si tshe las 'das shing / khong gi ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad rjes dang dgongs don de kho'i mdza' grogs mar khe si dang 'dra bar mi rnams kyi sems khong du gnas shing / 'byor med gral rim gyis mu mthud du 'thab rtsod byed pa'i snying stobs kyi 'byung khungs su gyur yod do// / /

gsar gtod kyilam chen 'di ru nga tsho mdun nas mdun dugaskyod dgos/wa waming kri gsar bsgyur gyi mdzad rjes can blon chen tā ci'u pa'o li thung /dus rabs 19pa'i dkyil tsam du 'jar pan yang krung go dang 'dra bar rjes lha rte lus kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin lam lugs ri kyi rgyal khab cig yin/ dga' 'os pa zhig la krung go ltar rim gyis bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin dang mi ser spel yul phyed tsam gyi rgyal khab cig tu 'gyur ma dgos/ rgyu mtshan ci phyir du red snyam na/ 1830 — 1878lo'i —— — — —— — — — ————— — bar du lang tsho dang shes rab kyis phyug pa'i tā ci'u pa'o li thung / skyes chen gang mang gis ming kri gsar bsgyur la rang nyid kyi tshe srog phul ba'i rkyen gyis so/1868lor 'jar pan 'byor ldan gral rim bcos bsgyur gyi las 'gul te ming kri gsar bsgyur byung ba'i sgul shugs kyis 'jar pan yang ma rtsa ring lugs kyi lam chen du bskyod 'go tshugs/ thengs de'i gsar bsgyur du ches ming du grags pa ni tā ci'u pa'o li thung dang zhi zhang lung hreng / (1828 —1877lo'i bar) / mu'u hu'u zho yun (1833 — 1877lo'i bar )zhes pa'i gsar bsgyur mkhan mi gsum du grags pa de yin no// 257

'jar pan bcos bsgyur gyi phugs bsam bcangs pa/cang hu'u dmag shed can20(1603 — 1867lo'i bar )gyi dbang sgyur dus rim du/ 'jar pan ma rtsa ring lugs kyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i lag shes bzo las ra ba gsar du thon zhing / ma rtsa ring lugs kyis spyi tshogs kyi thon skyed tsam du ma zad mi'i bsam pa'i 'du shes la'ang shugs rkyen zab mo thebs/dus rabs 18pa'i dus dkyil nas bzung 'jar pan du ho lan gyi skad kyis brtsams pa'i gso rig dang rdzas 'gyur/ dngos lugs/ lo rgyus/ sa rgyus/gna' rdzas rig pa sogs sgyur rtsom mang du 'phel ba der ho lan rig pa dang de la zhib 'jug gnang mkhan gyi gzur gnas mkhas dbang la ho lan rig pa ba zhes 'bod/ tā ci'u pa'o li thung gi spo bo ni gso byed sman pa zhig yin la skabs der snyan grags rgyal yongs su khyab pa'i ho lan rig pa ba zhig kyang yin/tā ci'u po'i li thung byis pa'i dus nas bzung khong dang lhan du 'tsho ba rol stabs kho'i bsam blo'i bag chags dang 'tshar longs phyogs su ha cang sman pa byung / tā ci'u pa'o li thung gi yab chen ni sā ma'o phun (deng sang sha ba'i gling phran zer ba'i rdzong de red )gyi dpa' rtul zhig yin/ phun de ru gsar brje pa dang rnying zhen pa zhes chab srid kyi phyogs khag gnyis su gyes yod la/ khong gi yab chen ni gsar brje tshogs pa'i tshogs mi yin/ 1849lor tā ci'u pa'o li thung rang lo 19yi steng du gsar brje tshogs khag gis srid 'gyur slong rgyu'i gsang don phyir shor bas gsar brje slong rgyu par zhog gsar brje'i tshogs khag la ya nga ba'i drag gnon thebs/ tā ci'u pa'o li thung gi yab gsang gros su zhugs pa'i rkyen gyis yul mthar sprugs shing / tā pa'o li thung gis srid gzhung du gnyer ba'i drung yig gi las gnas kyang med par btang / ma yum da~X mo gsum sogs khyim tshang gi 'tsho bcas kyi khur po yod tshad khong gi

phrag steng du babs pas/ khong gis ngal brgya dang du blangs te khyim thabs la mi gzhol thabs med byung / 'tsho bar dka' sdug dang sun snang che na yang khong gis chab srid la bcangs pa'i 'dun pa skad cig kyang ma btang bar/ zhi zhang lung hreng sogs phugs bsam dang snying stobs kyis phyug pa'i gzhon nu rnams dang lhan du rgyal khab kyi srid don gleng bar spro zhing / dus tshod kyi 'gros dang bstun tshogs mi je mang dang snyan grags che ru 'phel bar bstun ming du lhag bsam tshad med tshogs pa zhes pa'i chab srid kyi rtsa 'dzugs shig tshugs shing / rjes su dmag shed can pham par rgyag pa'i las 'gul du med du mi rung ba'i bla med kyi stobs shugs shig tu gyur/1851lor gsar bcos tshogs khag la sā ma'o phun gyi srid 'dzin dbang cha thob rjes tā ci'u pa'o li thung la go gnas cher ma gnang yang gser sa 'og tu sbas rung 'od nam mkhar 'phro zer ba'i dpe bzhin rim gyis khong nyid rdzong dpon gyi thugs la babs te dpon gnas mthor 'degs dang dbang cha che ru gnang ba des ma 'ongs gsar bsgyur gyi las 'gul la mthun rkyen bzang po zhig bskrun byung /dmag shed can pham par brgyab pa/gral rim dang mi rigs kyi 'gal ba nyin bzhin dza drag tu gyur bas 'jar pan gyi spyi tshogs nyen kha'i gnas su lhung / nges par du bcos bsgyur bya dgos/ bcos bsgyur ni mig mdun du lhags pa'i thabs lam gcig pu las ma 'das snyam/ 'o na ji ltar bcos bsgyur bya dgos/ skabs der khong la gsar bsgyur gyi 'dun pa drag rung bsam blo da dung 'thus tshang ma yin te/khong gi thugs ngor snang ba ni rang gzhan 'bud kyi bsam blo zhig yin/ rang gzhan 'bud ces pa ni zhi ba'i thabs kyis rgyal nang gi dmag shed canā /da

gzhung la bcos bsgyur dang / blo thag rbad chod kyis btsan 'dzul mkhan yod tshad la rgol lan drag po sprod dgos pa de red/ 'on kyang skabs de'i rgyal nang gi gnas bab la gzhigs na de ni stong bsam kho na las ma 'das/gsar brje'i ched du sngar khong gis dpung chen btegs te drag po'i zil shugs la brten nas gong mas dmag shed can srid gzhung bcos bsgyur byed par mos mthun mi byed thabs med byung / dmag shed can srid gzhung gi tshab tu srid gros lam lugs gsar 'dzugs dang phun khag so so'i 'jon thang can gyi skyes chen mi chen thun mong nas rgyal srid skyong dgos pa'i bka' yig bsgrags rung spyi tshogs la phan nus ci yang thon ma byung / rgyu mtshan ni srid gzhung dang rdzong dpon so so gros kha mi 'cham pa dang sger sems kyis 'khyer zhing dmag shed can gyis rang nyid kyi srid dbang mi 'chor ba'i phyir du/ mi rigs kyi khe phan rgyang du dor te ma rtsa ring lugs kyi rgyal khab gzhan dag la mgo 'dogs zhu bzhin yod/ pha bla ma/ bu bla ma/ bong bu sus 'ded ces pa'i dpe bzhin yod tshad rang rang sar nas gros kha ma 'cham par gsar brje'i las 'gul yang re zhig stong bar lus/ 'u thug pa'i zhing pa dang grong mi dbul po'i 'os langs kyi tsha rlabs gcig rjes gnyis mthud du langs shing /'os langs 'di'i sgul shugs la brten nas ta ci'u pa'o li thung sogs kyis kyang dmag shed can pham par rgyag dgos pa'i kha g.yang bsgrags te/ log spyod spya spyi spragardzu su drag po'i zing 'khrug ni gsar brje bcos kyi sngon 'gro yin par sdo ma/ she/ /can pham par rgyag dgos na mthun sgril yong dgos/mthun sgril ni snying stobs yin la mthun sgril ni rgyal kha'ang yin/ khrang kro'u phan (deng gi ya ma ngu chi rdzong )gyi gsar bcos tshogs par mthun sgril byed rgyu de ༵༵ba gal 'gangs che ba'i gnas su mthong / khrang kro'u phan yang sa ma'o

phan dang 'dra bar gsar brje'i stobs shugs ha cang che la 1863lo'i zla 2par sa ma'o dang khrang kro'u rdzong gnyis kyis dmag srid shag pham par rgyag pa'i dmag don mna' 'brel gyi gsang chings bzhag lo de'i zla 6par dmag shed can srid gzhung gis khrang kro'u la dpung 'jug byed skabs sa ma'o phan gyis dmag rogs byed dgos pa'i bka' phab rung / ta ci'u pa'o li thung gis thengs de'i g.yul 'gyed de dmag shed can dang khrang kro'u bar gyi sger don yin par kha g.yar te dmag mi gcig kyang mngags gtong gnang ma byung / ma rtsa ring lugs rgyal khab so so'i stobs shugs rim gyis 'jar pan nas rkang tshugs pa dang bstun/ sngar kho tshos dmag shed can la rgyab skyor byas shong yid ches ldan rung da lta bcos bsgyur tshogs pa'i stobs shugs yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel bzhin pa'i sgang yin stabs/ 'jar pan du gnas pa'i rang nyid kyi khe phan la dmigs te dmag shed can srid gzhung la ngo rgol dang tha na 'os langs la drag chas mkho 'don byed pa sogs bya ba mang du bsgrubs/ mthar khrang kro'u phan gyis sa ma'o phan dang rgyal yongs kyi gral rim so so'i mi dmangs kyi rgyab skyor 'og thengs de'i dmag 'khrug las rnam par rgyal/ dmag 'khrug des pān khag gzhan dag la'ang skul ma thebs te 1867lo'i zla 10bar ta ci'u pa'o li thung dang sa gnas so so'i gsar brje tshogs khag gi gtso 'dzin gyis rgyal sa ru gsang gros bsdus shing dmag shed can theg med du gtong thabs skor la gros chod byung / skabs der ming kri gong ma khrir bzhugs ma thag pa'i lo 14can gyi byis pa zhig yin phyir/ ta ci'u pa'o li thung gis blo gros kyi rtsal sna tshogs la brten te (dmag shed can la 'dul 'joms bka' yig 〉lag tu son/ ta ci'u pa'o li thung gis sngar gyi dka' sdug gi lo zla gang mang dang gsar brje yi ched du mi dmangs kyi tshe srog dang zungs khrag mang du shor zhing /yab chen dang snying nye ba'i spun zla tsho dran thengs rer mchi ma dbang shātā tu

'khor bzhin/ da ni 'jar pan bcos bsgyur gyi dmigs 'ben 'grub la nye ba'i dga' tshor dpag med skyes/dmag shed can gyi mkhar rdzong gi mtha' 'khor kun tu gsar brje'i dmag dpung gis bskor rjes/ dmag srid shag gyi dmag dpon bsam par gal te rnam pa'i steng nas srid dbang gong mar sprad na/ gsar brje'i dmag dpung mu mthun du dpung 'jug byed par lugs srol dang 'gal bar ma zad/rang nyid kyis sngar mus ba'in 'jar pan yongs la srid kyi kha lo bsgyur thub snyam pa'i ngan jus de ta ci'u pa'o li thung gis mkhyen te rgyal srid slar gso (dmag shed can rtsa med bzos te srid gzhung gsar du 'dzugs pa )zhes pa'i gros gzhi bton zhing / 1868lo'i zla 1por gong ma ming kris rgyal srid slar gso'i bka' lung bstsal te srid gzhung gsar 'dzugs gnang / dmag shed can gyis rang nyid kyi dbang cha yod rgu slar 'phrog par snying gis ma bzod par gong mar ngo log zing 'khrug bslangs par ta ci'u pa'o li thun gyis yang bskyar dmag dpung la 'go khrid mdzad de nya'o lus dang h+phu can sogs kyi g.yul 'gyed brgyud nas dmag shed can pham par brgyab cing / lo rjes mar kho'i dpung gi lhag ma gcig kyang ma lus par rtsa med du btang / 1868lo'i lo stod du rang lo 14las ma 'das pa'i gong ma ming kris ta ci'u pa'o li thung sogs kyis bton pa'i rgyal srid slar gso'i 'char gzhi ltar/ dmag shed can rtsa med du gtong ba sogs 'dus pa'i (bka' lung chen mo 〉khyab bsgrags mdzad de dpon sa'i lam lugs dang srid gzhung gsar pa'i lam lugs gtan 'bebs gnang / dmag shed can gyi dbang sgyur yongs su mjug rdzogs pa de 'jar pan gyi lo rgyus su byung ba'i don chen zhig yin la/ sa bdag 'byor ldan gral rim gi khe phan mtshon pa'i gong ma'i srid gzhung gis sriX ༵gan dngos su bzhes shing 'jar pan yongs ma rtsa ring lugs kyi spyi

tshogs la 'phel rgyas su phyin pa'i rtags mtshan du'ang snang ngo spyophyogs yongs nas bcos bsgyur mdzad pa/ming kri srid lo dang por ta ci'u pa'o li thung gis bcos bsgyur tshogs pa gzhan dag dang lhan du rnying zhen pa'i ngo rgol la ma 'dzem par/ phun de rdzong gi lam lugs su bsgyur ba sogs lam lugs gsar du gtan 'bebs kyi 'thab rtsod la byas rjes dang khyon yongs dang gting zab mo'i sgos spyi tshogs kyi bcos bsgyur la nus pa yod rgu phul/sngar 1862lor sa ma'o phan gyis dbyin jir 'gog rgol byed pa'i dmag 'khrug tu kho tsho'i do zla ma nus par dbyin sgor 25033dmag 'khrug gi skyin tshab sprod dgos byung / thengs de'i ya nga ba'i dmag 'khrug gis ta ci'u pa'o li thung la mi gnyom na kun gyis thub chod dang / rta bsrun na kun gyi bzhon pa zer ba'i dpe de dmar khrid thengs shig byas byung bas khong gi thugs su da ni nyi ma 'da' thabs byed pa'i dus ma yin par dgongs te dbyin ji nas dmag gru nyo bar chog mchan bkod pa dang / phun gyi dpa' rtul rnams la gsar dar gyi me mda' dang me phyogs sogs 'dra bzo bya dgos pa'i bka' bstsal/gzhon nu 15tsam dbyin ji ru slob gnyer du brdzangs pa sogs rgyal phyug dmag btsan gyi srid jus sogs gtan 'bebs gnang bar ma zad/ 1871lor ta ci'u pa'o li thung gis tshogs gtso gzhon pa'i 'gan bzhes pa'i 'jar pan 'thus tshab tshogs pa chen mo zhig ma rtsa ring lugs kyi sngon thon rgyal khab khag la gzigs skor du'ang phebs myong / thengs de'i gzigs skor la dus yun lo gcig dang phyed tsam 'das shing a me ri kha dang dbyin ji/ h+pha ran si/ u ru su/ per krem/ ho lan/ 'jar man/ dbyi tha li/ o si khru ri ya/ ten mag su'e tser sogs rgyal khab 12su bskyod de rgyal khab de dag gi lhaXspyar

phyug ldan pa'i grong khyer dang 'phrul chas kyi 'ur sgra lhang nying du grags pa'i bzo grwa/ me 'khor/ gru gzings sogs mthong ba des khong gis nges par du bcos bsgyur bya dgos pa'i 'dun pa je brtan du gyur/ phyir rgyal nang du log rjes khong gis ming kri srid gzhung la mi dmangs kyi dbul phyug de rgyal khab cig gi stobs shugs la rag las shing de'ang dngos po'i thon skyed la rag las/dngos po'i thon skyed phun sum tshogs min de mi dmangs kyis bzo las la rgyab skyor byed min la rag las phyir/ rgyal khab stobs ldan du 'gro rgyu de mthar thug na srid gzhung gis thon skyed la skul ma gnang rgyu de red ces pa'i legs bshad gnang / lo 'ga'i rjes su 'jar pan gyis nang srid las khungs btsugs shing ta ci'u pa'o li thung gtso 'dzin du bsko bzhag mdzad/ spyi tshogs kyi thon skyed dang phyogs yongs nas bzo las dar khyab tu gtong ched khong gis kha tsha dgos gtug gi srid jus sna tshogs gtan 'bebs gnang /nang srid blon chen gyi 'gan bzhes ring du khong gis da dung ming kri srid gzhung gi srid 'dzin rtsa 'dzugs bskyar sgrig gnang ste phyi 'brel dang nang srid/skam dmag mtsho dmag rig gnas/ slob gso/ bzo las/ khrims 'dzin sogs las khungs bcu'i bdag nyid can gyi krung dbyang gi srid 'dzin las shag btsugs shing / mi rnams dpon sar bsko ba'i tshe yang ta ci'u pa'o li thung ni kho tsho'i tshogs khag dang khyim rgyud kyi skye khungs gang la yang kha ya mi byed par kho'i yon tan dang nus pa gtsigs su 'dzin mkhan zhig yin/dper na/ ta ci'u pa'o li thung khong gi 'khrungs yul ni sha ba'i gling phran yin mod/ 'on kyang nang srid las khungs su kho'i yul mi gcig kyang dpon sar bskos med/ mi zhig gis khong la de'i rgyu rkyen dris par khong gis ku re'i tshul du/ nga'i yul mi rnams drag po'i g.yul 'gyed la mkhas pa bston du med rung chaX // skyong mi shes zhes lan btab/

ta ci'u pa'o li thung gis 'jar pan gyi srid 'byor rig gsum sogs phyogs gang ci'i thad nas yo rab gling la lad zlos byed 'dod kyis ma rtsa ring lugs kyi lam lugs dang nye rabs kyi tshan rig lag rtsal tsam du ma zad/ tha na 'tsho ba'i goms srol gyi thad du'ang phyi gling ba'i kha zas za ba dang lu ring khu yug gi mjug ma can gyon pa/ skra thung ngu 'jog pa/ mthun 'dris zhabs bro 'khrab pa/ phyi gling ba'i thog khang 'bubs pa sogs ni sngar yod ma myong ba'i lta ba dang cha lugs sha stag red/ sngar song gi lo rgyus su 'jar pan pa rnams kyis kyang skra'i lan bu ring du 'jog pa'i lugs srol mchis/ khong gis rang dpe gzhan ston mdzad phyir du ral ba bregs te gong mar mjal du phebs par dpon blon kun ha las hon thor du gyur cing / kho tsho'i sems su de la mdzes pa'i cha tsam brjod rgyu phar zhog da dung yid sems gdon gyis brlams par gor ma chag snyam/ nyin bcu 'ga'i rjes su gong mas kyang ta ci'u pa'o li thung mig dper bzung ste ral ba bregs par bstun srid gzhung gi dpon blon yongs kyis ral ba cig gyur du bregs byung / ta ci'u pa'o li thung gis bcos bsgyur 'di dag lag len du bstar ba'i brgyud rim du'ang skur 'debs dang dka' ngal mang du 'phrad na yang khong gis gsungs pa nang bzhin du/ gsar gtod kyi lam chen du nor 'khrul ni su yis kyang g.yol thabs bral na yo bsrang gi las 'gan de rjes rabs kyi chab srid par zhogs dang / mig sngar gyi las ༵ /ji / trī shā pa/rno gtod kyi lam chen du mdun nas mdun du bskyod dgos phyi ru rgya skyed dang nang srid sger 'dzin gyi lam du bskyod pa/sngar ma rtsa ring lugs kyi rgyal khab khag tu gzigs skor la phebs sdus tshe

khong dpon blon yongs kyi thugs su ma rtsa ring lugs kyi shes rig gi rjes su snyeg pa de bong bus rta yi do zla bzhin 'jar pan gyis nam yang yong ba'i dpe mi srid snyam/ 'on kyang 'jar man du 'byor rjes dbu bzhugs blon chen lhas zi ma khi yis rang nyid kyi phu'u lu'u hri'i rgyal khab kyang ji ltar nyam chung zhig nas stobs ldan du bsgyur ba'i lo rgyus kyi nyams myong smras par ta ci'u pa'o li thung sogs la blo skyed chen po thebs shing / kho tsho'i thugs su'ang rgyal khab gnyis kyi spyi tshogs kyi gnas bab ha cang cha 'dra bar dgongs/ mthar mi dmangs yongs kyi thun mong gi shes rab dang blo gros la brten nas 'jar pan gyi dpal 'byor nyin bzhin 'phel rgyas su song ba dang bstun phyi phyogs su rgya skyed pa'i gom 'gros kyang je mgyogs su phyin/1873lor mi la las kho ri ya rgyal khab dbang du bsdu dgos pa'i gros gzhi bton par ta ci'u pa'o li thung mos mthun gtan nas mi yong ba'i bsam tshul bstan/ khong ni zhi bde ring lugs pa zhig red dam snyam na nga tsho gtan nas nor song ba yin te/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ khong gi thugs su 'jar pan da dung gnyom lag rgyas mi 'dug par 'dod/ mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa na khong yang btsan 'dzul gyi go skabs gcig tsam yang chud zos su gtong mkhan rang ma yin no/ / 1874lo'i zla 4pa ste kho ri ya rgyal khab la btsan 'dzul byed par rgol lan drag po sprad pa'i lo rjes mar/ the wan gyi ga'o hran rigs kyis li'u chi'u sa cha'i nya ba bsad par kha g.yar te ta ci'u pa'o li thung gis the wan la btsan 'dzul byas shing / dbang cha yod tshad mnga' ba'i tshab byed mkhan gyi thob thang gis pe cin du phebs te btsan drag dang bcas ching srid gzhung gis dngulasrang khri 50dmag 'khrug gi skyin tshab tu sprod dgos byung / 1875lor ta ci'u pa'o li thung gis yang bskyar byang kho ri ya'i cang hwa gling phran la skyogs che/ ༵༵ngas te gnam sa rdul gyis bkang bar byas/ 'di ltar ta ci'u pa'o

lin thung gis rang nyid kyi sku tshe hril po ru 'jar pan du ma rtsa ring lugs gsar gtod dang 'phel rgyas la rlabs che ba'i mdzad rjes bzhag yod pa bden mod/ 'on kyang khong gi tshe smad du srid dbang sger 'dzin gyis rang la ngo rgol byed mkhan la rdung rdeg dang khrims gcod nan mo byas myong / zhi zhang lung hreng du 'bod pas khong dang dpung ba mnyam gshib kyis ming kri gsar bsgyur la rang nyid kyi yod tshad phul myong yang / kho ri ya lho ma ru dmag 'dren pa'i thad du ta ci'u pa'o li thung dang lta ba ma mthun stabs khong srid gzhung nas phyir bskud/ sa khul so sos gcig rjes gnyis mthud du srid 'gyur bslangs pa yang drag po'i zil shugs kyis re re bzhin zhod 'jags su btang zhing / ngo log mkhan rnams 'dzin bzung thebs ma thag tu dmar gsod btang / mi dmangs kyis kyang rim gyis kho'i skyi g.ya' ba'i srid jus la yid chad de srid dbang sger 'dzin pa'am dmu rgod can zhes skur 'debs dang mtshang 'byin bya dgos byung /1878lo'i zla 5pa'i nyin mo zhig la ta ci'u pa'o li thung tha'e krin pho brang du phebs pa'i lam khar zhi zhang gi rjes 'brang mkhan two than dbyi lang sogs mi drug gis dus mnyam du gris bsnun te bkums shing rang lo 49las son med/khong gi tshe smad du lta ba mkhregs 'dzin dang nor 'khrul mang du bzos kyang rang nyid kyi sku tshe hril bo ru 'jar pan de srol rgyun gyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi spyi tshogs shig nas nye rabs kyi tshan rig lag rtsal che ru dar ba'i ma rtsa ring lugs kyi spyi tshogs su bgrod par khong gi mdzad rjes ni su yis kyang bston du med la bsgyur du'ab med do// / /267

ji tho bsi'i gong ma sīn nyi yis khi sku rabs gnyis pa/— — rtor lin tshogs 'du'i21 rjes su —— 3— tsho sgo btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis h+phe gling — sgyu ci ci snyoms bgo byed pa'i btsan 'dzul las tsho / ci smo drol 'gul gyi mtho rlabs drag tu 'phyur la ri —— cing / dus rabs 20stod tsam du ri tsho thu ri ci ༷ri( slebs tshe yangs pa'i a h+phe ri kha'i gling lko lha dzo du da dung rang btsan yin pa'i rgyal —— — — —— — — —— khabal li pi ya (67skya lko)7༅)dang sdin nyi lis khi gnyis pa/ ithotha ya (2 61091 ṣ+ṭha tsho6khur+sā)gnyis las gcig kyang lhag ma byung / 'o na mi ser spel ba'i ring lugs kyi 'dur rgyug rgod pa'i lo rabs su nub gling ba'i dmag sde gcig kyang sa khul 'di dag tu ma 'byor ba red dam snyam na de yang ma yin te/ dbyin ji dang dbyi tha li sogs kyis snga gzhug tu i tho phi yar btsan 'dzul byas myong bar ma zad yo rob rgyal khab gzhan dag gis kyang 'jigs skul dang tam sems bcangs myong / 'on kyang dus nam zhig gi tshe yang e tsi o phi ya'i mi dmangs kyis mes rgyal dang rang nyid kyi bdag dbang gi phyir du mi ser ring lugs pa dang khyod shi nga gson gyis 'thab rtsod mthil phyin pa byas par brten btsan 'ardokā /khan su zhig gis kyang dus yun ring bor dbang du bsdu thub pa byung

med/ de yang e tsi o phi ya'i mi rigs rang btsan dang mi ser spel ba'i ring lugs kyi btsan 'dzul la rgol lan slog pa'i 'thab rtsod kyi khrod du mi zhig gis brjed du med pa'i lo rgyus kyi mdzad chen bzhag yod de/ khong gi mtshan la go~X ma sīn nyi lis khi sku phreng gnyis pa (1844 — 1913lo'i bar )zhes 'a da/dus rabs 19pa'i dus dkyil nas bzung ste sngar gcig gyur gyi e tsi o phi ya'i mnga' khongs yang bskyar sil bur thor zhing hra'o a dang thi ke li/ a mu'u ha la sogs gung rim gyi rgyal phran mang du gyes/ 1865lor sbrin nyi lis khi yis hra'o a'i srid khrir mnga' brnyes rjes/ dka' spyad 'bad brtson dang bcos bsgyur gting zab tu spel ba'i mthus rgyal khab kyi stobs shugs mgyogs myur ngang 'phel rgyas chen po byung / 1889lor phrin nyi lis khis rang nyid kyi spobs pa dang stobs shugs la brten te sngar 'thor zhig tu gyur ba'i e tsi o phi ya'i mnga' khongs yongs yang bskyar gser yig gcig gi zhabs 'og tu bsdus shing / 1895lor dbyi tha li btsan 'dzul mkhan las rnam par rgyal te rgyal khab kyi srid 'byor rig gsum yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel thub byung /gzhan sder dpe bltas nas rang rigs rgyas la brtson/sngar song gi spyi tshogs 'phel ba'i lo rgyus las nga tshos mthong thub pa ni bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin spyi tshogs kyi gong ma zhig yin tshe rnying zhen dang bag 'khum can mang du snang mod/ de dag dang bsdur na phrin nyi lis khi ni dus /bas kyi 'os 'gan dang ma 'ongs par mig rgyang ldan pa'i gong ma bla med cig da/ nyin zhig ljongs rgyu mkhan zhig gis sbag sbag cig khong gi gzigs mor phul ba la/ gong ma nīn nyis lis khi dga' ba 'bum gyis brtas bzhin 2༷/ra

lo gnyis can gyi lcags kyi rta pho de la mtshar snang skyes/ 'o na rta pho 'di ji ltar bgrod pa yin nam snyam pa'i skabs der ljongs rgyu mkhan des snum sgor drag kyis mnan pa dang lhan du ldir ldir gyi sgra chen zhig grags shing / du ba sngo lhog lhog tu 'byur bzhin skad cig gi mod la rgyang ring du bzhud 'gro ba mthong tshe tshe srog bral ba'i rta pho 'di ji ltar bgrod pa yin nam snyam pa'i ya mtshar chen po skyes/ spyir gsar byung dngos po mtha' dag la thugs mos che stabs mi 'gyangasaso par khong gis kyang lcags kyi rta pho de'i kha lo gang mos su bsgyur thub pa byung ya/ the/ngas shig chos 'chad mkhan zhig gis yo rob gling nas gong ma sīn nyi lis khi la legs skyes kyi tshul du 'tshem 'khor zhig nyos shing stabs bde yong ched du 'tshem 'khor gyi lhu lag rnams gtor te sgam du bcug ye tsi o phi ya ru 'byor rjes/ chos 'chad mkhan des gong ma'i mdun sa nas lhu lag rnams yang bskyar sgrig 'dod kyis thengs 'gar tshon lta byas rung mthar 'u thug pa'i nyams kyis gong mar dgongs pa ma tshom zhes zhus te logs gcig tu 'dug rgyu las thabs ma rnyed/ smyun nyi lis khis ngas cig lta'o snyam pa'i blos lhu lag so sor zhib tu gzigs rjes mtshan hril bor gnyid kyang ma khug par sgrig sbyor gnang ba'i mthar/ nyin gnyis pa'i 'char ku'i mtshams su 'tshem 'khor de gzhi nas 'khor thub pa byung / sbag sbag dang 'tshem 'khor sogs don chung ngu re las ma 'das rung / 'di dag las zur bstan leb mthong gi dpe bzhin gong ma sīn nyi lis khi'i gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa'i shes rab dang gsar byung dngos po la bcangs pa'i dga' zhen mthong thub/ 'phrul chas 'di dag las gzhan phrin nyi lis khis da dung rang 'gul sog le dang rdo 'thag 'phrul 'khor/ rdo snam 'dren chas sogs kyi 'phrul chas kyang mang du nadī ltasan mdzad/ khong nyid gsar byung dngos po la thugs mos che stabs

sīn nyi lis khi yo rob gling gi bzo las kyi 'grem ston du zhugs myong bar ma zad h+pha ran si'i gnam rig mthun tshogs kyi srol gtod mkhan zhig kyang red/ming la ti khā si thi la'o zhes pa'i dbyi tha li yi pho nya zhig gis kyang phrin nyi li khi'igasar gtod kyi blo gros la bstod bsngags mdzad myong ste/ gal te stong bsam mkhan zhig gis bar snang stong ba'i khams su sa'i go la dang zla ba gnyis gzhi gcig tu sbrel thub pa'i rang 'gul them skas shig bzo ba'i 'dun pa tsam mchis pa dang / 'char gzhi de legs 'grub kyi yid ches ldan na phrin nyi lis khis de la mgrin pa gzengs su btegs nas rgyab skyor byed nges yin zhes gsung|/na nyi lis khis nye rabs kyi sngon thon tshan rig la 'di ltar dga' zhen che ba yang spro snang kho na tsam zhig gtan nas ma yin te/ e tsi o phi yar dus dang rnam pa kun tu btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis mi ser spel yul rgya skyed kyi nyen khar gnas pa dang / mes rgyal gyi rang btsan brtan srung bya dgos na nges par du ma rtsa ring lugs rgyal khab khag gi sngon thon tshan rig lag rtsal nang 'dren bya rgyu las thabs med snyam/ h+pha ran si'i tsung thung ki li wis kyis sngar e tsi o phi yar pho nya btang ste legs skyes su me skyogs rnying ba gcig dang rang grags rol chas gcig tsam phul ba la/ sīn li nyis khis rang nyid la brnyas bcos byas song snyam ste thugs dgongs che ru khros bzhin pho nya de la/khyod tsho'i tsung thung la sku drin zhu rgyu ma brjed cig nga'ang spo bo zhig yin pa'i cha nas khos nga'i tsha bo dang tsha mo rnams la rtsed chas bstsal bar thugs rje che zhes gsungs rjes/ pho nya de rang gi drag chas mdzod khang du 'khrid de gsar dar gyi me phyogs dang la'e rmu me mda' gral du bsgrigs 'dug par mdzub mos bstan te/ 'di dag da gzod nga yi rtsed chas yin zhes gsungs pa la pho nya de dgun gyi khu byug ltar tshig gcig kyang smra ba'i spobs pa bral/ me ma~X de

dag kyang gzhan gyi btsan 'dzul 'gog ched du phrin nyi lis khi yis mngags nyo gnang ba sha stag ste/ yo rob gling du h+pha sgor bdun brgyad tsam gyi la'o spu me mda' gcig de e tsi o phi ya ru h+pha sgor 40tsam du brje thub pas sa khul 'di dag tu khyab rgya che ba'i drag chas nyo tshong mgyogs myur ngang 'phel rgyas byung /1882— 1887lo'i bar du sīn nyi lis khi srid gzhung gis la'e h+phu'u me mda' 258tsam mngags nyo gnang zhing mngags nyo'i thad du h+pha ran si dang dbyi tha li srid gzhung gis kyang khong la rgyab skyor chen po gnang / rgyu mtshan ni dbyin rdo srid /zhung la do zla dang e tsi o phi ya bgo bsha' rgyag par sngog 'gog byed da du me byed/'a sna tshogs nang 'dren byed pa'i dus mtshungs su sīn nyi lis khi yis rang gi lag zung gis me mda' bzo e thub snyam pa'i rang stobs rang spel gyi thad du bsam gzhigs gtong bzhin yod/ sngar su'e tser gyi tshong ba zhig la sīn nyi lis khis rdzas dpyad mkhas can zhig e tsi o phi ya ru gdan 'dren par mngags bcol gnang ba bzhin/ tshong dpon gyis ched mkhas gsum e tsi o phi ya ru gdan drangs shing gong ma'i blo 'don pa'i 'gan bzhes/ mi de dag gi khrod du ming la yir khi zer ba zhig mchis shing khong gis mi lo 20lhag gi ring du sīn nyi lis khi la zhabs zhu bsgrubs myong / yir khi khong nyid rgyal khab 'di ru 'byor ma thag gong mas khong la la'i h+phu me mda' bzo dgos pa'i bka' phab/ yir khis rang nyid kyis bzos pa'i me mda'i 'gro gron de nang 'dren las kyang rin gong che ba tsam du ma zad dngos po'i spus ga'ang gzhan dang bsdur thabs bral zhes me mda' rang gis bzo bar khe spogs ci yang mi 'dug ces zhus pa na/ 'gro gron la khyod kyis sems 'khur bya dgos don med de/ches gtso bo ni nga tshos rang rgyal gyi thon khungs bed spyad de la'e h+phu me mda' brdo ltozlo min de red ces gong mas gsungs pa na/ khong gis gong ma'i thugs

dgongs bzhin e tsi o phi ya ru le h+phu'u me mda' thon skyed mdzad/ 'di ltar lo 'ga'i 'thab rtsod byas pa brgyud mthar rgyal khab 'di'i dmag dpung la a h+phe ri kha'i gling phran du gang rung bas kyang 'gran zla bral ba'i drag chas ldan par gyur/1886lor phrin nyi lis khi yis yang bskyar yir khi la a wa hri gtsang bor lcags zam 'dzugs dgos pa'i bka' phab/ las 'gan de ni su yis kyang sgrub 'dod med pa'i dka' tshegs kyi bya gzhag chen po zhig yin phyir/ bzo skrun legs 'grub byung rjes yir khis 'di ltar gsungs myong ste/la me las tsha ba'i nyi 'od dang glo bur du byung ba'i bgegs rkyen sogs su yis kyang tshod dpag byed thabs bral ba'i 'og zam chen gyi nyer mkho'i rgyu cha rnams spyi le 15yi mtshams su mi shugs la brten nas skyel 'dren bya dgos shing zam mgo'i 'dzugs skrun gyi lcags 'dzer dang gcus gzer/ sbrel byed gcus gzer sogs rang dngos kyis bsreg rdung bya dgos par ma zad drag char dang des bslangs pa'i bshal nad/ mig gis mi zin pa'i 'tshub ma glo bur du lding zhing kha zas dang sbra gur sogs kyang bar snang du spur ba/ mtshan mor wa spyang gis sngas 'bol yang 'khur e 'gro snyam pa'i dngangs skrag dang ri bong sogs sems can chung ngu rnams kyis thab tshang stong sing nger btang ste/ bkres skom gyi dka' sdug myong dgos pa sogs 'das zin pa'i don rkyen de la phyir 'dang re brgyab na ngas hri ti nying (dbang rtsa ngar slong bar bed spyad kyi sman rigs shig )zhig mi 'thung ka med red ces gsungs/ yir khi dang lag rtsal mkhas can gzhan dag thun mong nas da dung e tsi o phi ya ru gzhung lam dang lcags lam sogs gsar skrun mang du gnang ba des rgyal khab 'di'i rjes lus kyi 'grim 'grul rnam pa yongs su dor/dus rabs 19pa'i dus mjug tu phrin nyi lis khis sngar hra'o ya~X snang

khyer lte ba ste e ti si a pa pa (4661346lo ༅7lo༅༅༅)ru rgyal sa spos/rgyal sa yin pa'i cha nas grong khyer 'di'ang mgyogs myur ngang 'phel rgyas byung zhing 'byor phyug ldan pa'i grong khyer gzhan dag dang 'dra bar a pis zhi nyis ya dngul khang dang phrin nyi lis khi skye phreng gnyis pa'i slob gling / da dung sīn nyi lis khi skye phreng gnyis pa'i sman khang dang e ti ke mgron khang (rgyal khab 'di'i ches thog ma'i gsar dar gyi mgron khang ste zhim mngar can gyi kha zas rnams nges par du sgor gyis nyo dgos)/ dpar skrun khang sogs nye rabs kyi thon skyed dang dpal 'byor mtshon pa'i 'dzugs skrun sna tshogs dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas pa byung / sīn nyi lis khis gom gang mdun spos kyis spyi tshogs la bcos bsgyur mdzad phyir du/ dpya khral de khral 'jal mkhan gyi nus pa dang sdur tshad dngos ma yin dgos pa'i rtsa don ltar khral 'jal lam lugs gsar du bzos/ches thog ma'i e tsi o phi ya'i dngul sgor bkrams te sger gyi tshong las stabs bdedang 'phel rgyas su 'gro bar mthun rkyen bskrun/ nye rabs kyi sbrag srid lam lugs nang 'dren dang sbrag khang btsugs te rgyal yongs su sbrag rtags 'grem spel gyis tha na rang gi rgyal khab du'ang yo rob gling gi srid lugs 'dzugs 'dod kyi kun slong gis tshe smad du khong gis nang srid las khungs btsugs shing srid gzhung gi ma lag so so gsar 'dzugs gnang / shes yon canagaso skyong byed ched du rgyal nang nas nye rabs kyi slob gso'i las khungs btsugs par ma zad thengs dang por su'e tser ru mi gsum dang thengs gnyis par mi bdun tsam u ru su la slob gnyer du mngags gtong gnang zhing mthun rkyen gzhung nas sbyar/(wu'u khra lis chings yig 〉las byung ba'i rtsod gleng /27snan nyi lis khis e tsi o phe ya'i mi dmangs la 'go khrid mdzad de dbyi

tha li btsan 'dzul mkhan rnams pham par brgyabs pa de khong gi mi tshe yi ches bla na med pa'i mdzad rjes rang red/ smyun nyi lis khis srid 'gan ma bzhes pa'i yar sngon nas bzung dbyi tha li yis kho tshor btsan 'dzul byed 'go tshugs shing mnga' khongs gang mang zhabs 'og tu brdzis/ 'on kyang rgyal khab gnyis bar gyi mngon lkog bral ba'i dmar 'dzing de khong nyid gong mar bzhugs rjes su byung zhing gyod don gyi 'byung khungs ni 〈lu'u khra lis chings yig 〉tu gyur/1889lo'i zla 5bar sīn nyi lis khis srid 'gan ma bzhes pa'i zla 'ga'i snga rol tu/ e tsi o phi ya dang dbyi tha li'i bar tu (wu'u khra lis chings yig 〉bzhag chings yig de la 〈gtan du zhi bde dang mdza' mthun gyi chings yig 〉ces kyang 'bod/ chings yig las bstan don/ sīn nyi lis khi yis dbyi tha li la e tsi o phi ya ru sa khul gyi bdag dbang yod par khas len byed rgyu dang /de'i skyin tshab tu dbyi tha lis smyun nyi lis khi ni e tsi o phi ya'i gnam gyi 'ogs yi steng gi gong ma gcig pu rang yin par khas len byed rgyu byas/ spyir phyogs gnyis kur khe phan cung tsam mchis pa'i chings yig de mthar gyod kyi sna 'dren du gyur/ chings yig gi don tshan 17pa ste/ e tsi o phi ya'i gnam gyi 'og sa yi steng gi gong ma chen pos rgyal khab dag dang 'brel gtug byed skabs dbyi tha li srid gzhung gi ming g.yar chog ces pa'i don tshan de/ dbyi tha li srid gzhung gis bzo bcos brgyab ste nges par du zhes pa'i cha rkyen zhig gsar du bsnan zhing / lo de'i zla 10pa'i tshes 11la e tsi o phi ya rang nyid kyi srung skyob rgyal khab cig yin par 'dzam gling la khyab bsgrags byas/ gtam de thos 'phral rang nyid gzhan gyi g.yo 'og tu tshud song snyam pa'i sīn nyi lis khi khong khros rab tu myos bzhin dbyi tha li'i gong ma blun bas tha'o sku rabs dang por 'phrin springs te/ ngas sngar nas kyang bshad myong ba bzhin nga tsho'i bar gyi mdza' brtse la gzhigs te rang re'i rgyal khab de yo rob rgyal khab gzhanā /ga

dang 'brel gtug byed skabs dbyi tha li dang gong ma chen po'i rogs skyor 'og sgrub rgyu yin zhes bshad mod/ 'on kyang mig sngar la slebs rag tu ngas nges par du de ltar bya dgos pa'i chings yig gcig kyang bzhag ma myong / rgyu mtshan ni nga ni gzhan gyi bka' drin la brten nas rang nyid kyi las don sgrub mkhan zhig ma yin pa gong ma khyed la gsal cha yod nges red ces springs/ de dang dus mtshungs su khong gis da dung dbyin ji dang h+pha ran si/ 'jar man/u ru su bcas kyi 'go gtso so sor 'phrin springs te rgyal khab kyi bdag dbang dngasanga' khongs 'thus tshang gi ched du 'chi dgos kyang go med tshor med du 'dug mi bzod ces rang nyid kyi chod sems bstan/e tsi o phi yas sngar dbyi tha li nas dngul bun g.yar yod stabs da lta rgyalatab gnyis kyi 'brel ba je sdug tu gyur bar bstun phrin nyi lis khi yis/dbyi tha li nas mu mthun du dngul bun g.yar mtshams bcad de gang nus sgos dngul bun yod tshad mgyogs myur ngang 'jal dgos pa'i sems thag bcad/tshogs 'du zhig gi steng du dbyi tha li'i pho nya ste po rim gyi mtshan thob can an tung no lis kyis r+sān nyi lis khi la/ ru dbyi tha li srid gzhung gis dbyi tha li'i skad kyis brtsams pa'i wu'u khra li chings yig gi don tshan brgyad pa de nor 'khrul bzos song zhes rgyal khab gzhan dag la gsal bshad byed 'dod med/rgyu mtshan ni nga tsho'i rgyal khab kyi la rgya'i ched du yin zhes bshad pa la sīn nyi lis khis kyang the tshom spu tsam med par nga tshos kyang rang skad du don tshan de 'dzam gling du bsgrags byung / gal te yo bsrang bya dgos snyam na nga tsho yang khyod tsho dang 'dra bar rang nyid kyi la rgya'i ched du yin zhing / e tsi o phi ya de dbyi tha li yis bskyang bya'i rgyal khab cig tu 'gyur 'gro snyam pa de khyod tsho'i rmi lam rang yin zhes gsungs/ 1893lo'i zla 2par phrin nyi lis khi yis 18༷/sbya'i zla 2pa nas bzung wu'u khra lis chings yig rtsis med dang e tsi o phi

ya la gnam bdag las gzhan pa'i mgon skyabs gcig kyang mkho don med ces yo rob gling gi rgyal khab so sor bskyar bsgrags mdzad/rgyal srung dmag 'khrug langs pa/1894lo'i zla 7par dbyi tha lis thi gi li yis zhing chen la btsan 'dzul byas te a zi mā dang a tu'u wa sa khul sogs dbang du bsdus/ da lta gzhi nas btsan 'dzul dmag 'khrug dus la babs pa red snyam pa'i dbyi tha li srid gzhung gis phrin nyi lis khi la mjug mtha'i tha tshig bsgrags shing / lo rjes ma'i zla dang por dmag 'khrug phyogs yongs nas 'go brtsams byung / dmag 'khrug gi thog ma'i dus rim du btsan 'dzul mkhan rnams 'gag nas shor ba'i chu klung chen po bzhin ma khā les dang a mo'u pa/ a la chis/ ti ki la bī sogs gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis khyur mid btang / lo mjug tu slebs dus phrin nyi lis khi sku dngos kyis dpung chen btegs nas byang phyogs su phar rgol byas/ zla 12pa nas 1896lo'i lo mgo ru thon dus phrin nyi lis khi yi dmag dpung gis gong gi sa khul so so nas rgyal kha rim par blangs te btsan 'dzul mkhan rnams a to'u wa ru phyir 'then bya dgos byung / bstun mar gza' 'khor 'ga'i ring du rdul ma 'tshub par rang rang sar gnas ring du smyun nyi lis khi yis zhi 'dum yong ba'i bsam pa bstan par/ dbyi tha li srid gzhungagis kha ya tsam mi byed par ma zad e tsi o phi ya rkang 'og tu brdzi ba'i stong bsam bcangs/1896lo'i zla 3pa'i tshes 1nyin gyi nangs mor rgyal pham gyi dbye ba 'byed pa'i 'thab 'khrug ste a to'u wa g.yul 'gyed kyi 'go brtsams/ i to'i wa sa khul gyi mi dmangs kyis kyang dmag 'khrug 'go btsams pa nas bzung rgyal gcesakyi lhag bsam drag po la brten nas sīn nyi lis khir phyogs stonā spyang

dgra bo'i gnas tshul gyi snyan zhu 'bul mkhan mang du byung / dbyi tha li btsan 'dzul mkhan tshor mtshon na sa gnas mi dmangs kyi 'khon sems che bar ma zad/ tshad ldan gyi g.yul 'gyed sa khra zhig kyang med par long bas ri dwags la mda' 'phen gyi dpe bzhin rang nyid la gdeng tshod bral ba'i skabs der/e tsi o phe yar lo bcu lhag gi gra sgrig dang sbyong brdar gyis dmag grangs dang me mda' sogs mthong ba tsam gyis dgra bo hon 'thor 'gro ba lta bu'i brjid nyams ldan zhing / dmag dpung gi gras su mdung 'dzin mkhan las gzhan deng rabs kyi la'e h+phu me mda' thogs mkhan mi khri 11lhag brgal ba de/dmag mi 17000tsam las mi 'dug pa'i dbyi tha li'i dmag dpung gis thos pa tsam gyis dpa' zhum par mi 'gyur ci la srid/ da dung kho tsho'i khrod du 407tsam gyi dmag mi ni btsan gyis dmag tu skul ba'i a h+phe ri kha'i gling ba sha stag tu snang / zhi mi dang stag gi la rgya rtsod pa lta bu'i g.yul 'gyed de'ang chu tshod 3tsam las ma dgos par mthar btsan 'dzul mkhan mi grangs 7560tsam shi rmas btang ba de dgra dmag yongs kyi 436zin 'dug da dung me stogs 56dang la'e rmu me mda' khri gcig lhag tsam bor gtor byung ste 1896lo'i zla 5bar phrin nyi lis khis rlabs che ba'i g.yul 'gyed kyi rgyal kha blangs/ zla 10pa'i tshes 26la dbyi tha li yis e ti si ya pa pa chings yig tu ming rtags mi 'god thabs med byung zhing e tsi o phi ya srid gzhung la rdo lir khri 200skyin tshab 'jal dgos byung / chings yig der ming rtags bkod rjes kyi zla 'ga'i nang du dbyin ji dang h+pha ran si srid gzhung gis sku tshab tshogs pa ched mngags kyis e tsi o phi ya ru 'byor te mdza' mthun chings yig bzhag pa dang / su'u tan (166557 bzos)gyi mā hi ti dang a'o zi man btsan rgyal gyi su'u tan (rgyal po)/ u ru su'i hra hong gi 'bus tshab tshogs pa sogs kyang snga gzhug tu swā shā o phi ya ru 'byor/ der brten rgyal khab 'di'i snang brnyan 'dzam

gling dang rgyal spyir khyab pa'i mthus phyi rgyal gyi blo 'don pa dang pho nya ba/gsang myul ba sogs sprin tshogs 'du ba bzhin gnas der 'dus shing rgyal sa e ti si ya pa pa yang kun gyis khas len pa'i a h+phe ri kha'i gling gi phyi 'brel gyi lte bar gyur byung /ma rtsa ring lugs mgyogs myur ngang 'phel rgyas su phyin pa'i yo rab gling gi rgyal khab gzhan dag dang bsdur na e tsi o phi ya sngar bzhin ha cang nyam chung du snang yang / sīn nyi lis khi yis thabs dang shes rab la brten nas btsan rgyal dang mnyam du slob sbyong dang sngon thon lag rtsal nang 'dren byed pa'i dus mtshungs su/ rang khyim rang bdag gi phyi 'brel srid jus lag len du bstar/ khos rgyal khab bar gyi 'gal ba legs par bed spyod byas pa des rang nyid kyi las don yod tshad legs 'grub 'byung bar mthun rkyen bzang po bskrun/ dbyin ji'i ming la hā lin tun zhes pa'i pho nya zhig gis yo rob tu gnas pa'i rang gi las grogs la springs pa'i 'phrin yig tu tsa nga tshos e tsi o phi ya la ci zhig gi shugs rkyen thebs yod pa ci yang mthong mi thub la/ smin nyi lis khis rang nyid kyi 'dod smon dang 'gal ba'i bya ba phra mo gcig kyang bsgrubs tu 'jug ma thub ces dbyin ji btsan 'dzul ba'i 'dur rgyug ci 'dra'i rgod rung / sīn nyi lis khi'i rang btsan rang bdag gi srid jus la shugs rkyen ci yang thebs ma thub/1906lor sīn nyi lis khi la tshabs che ba'i 'dar nad kyis bzung zhing lo gnyis kyi rjes su sku gzugs po yongs su grib skyon shor bar ma zad/ rig pa rdab rdib du gyur te srid 'gan bzhes thabs bral/ mthar 1913lor kung ༵sa nas dgung lo 69son pa'i phrin nyi lis khi mi yul dang gtan du zhal gyes 279

de ni khong gis rgya gar gyi rang btsan dang mi rigs kyi bcings 'grol las 'gul la rlabs che ba'i byas rjes bzhag pa'i rkyen gyis red/ sha chang dang 'dod sred la mi chags pa'i dam bcas pa/snyan dis rang lo 7gyi steng du slob grwar phebs shing dgung lo 11steng slob 'bring du zhugs/ skabs der rgya gar ni dbyin ji'i mi ser spel yul gyi sa khul yin phyir slob grwa'i 'khrid bya yod tshad dbyin yig red/ 'on kyang snyan dis dbyin yig gi rmang gzhi zhan zhing slob gnyer skabs su dka' ngal mang du 'phrad kyang khong ni slob la brtson 'grus dang kun spyod gtsang ba/ drang bor smra ba'i byis pa ya rabs shig yin/ thengs shig dbyin ji'i slob gso'i sde khag gi lta zhib pa zhig snyan dis kyi 'dzin grwa ru slebs te slob ma'i slob sbyong gi gnas tshul ga 'dra red snyam bzhin/ tha snyad lnga rim par bton te su zhig gis 'bri thub min la gzigs par ghan rdis kyis ha ci yang ma go bas yi ge rdog gcig kyang bris mi 'dug der bzhugs pa'i slob gtsos lta zhib pa'i bsngags brjod thob phyir du lkog tu khong la 'dug grogs kyi 'bri deb las brkus 'bri byos shig ces mig brda sprad rung / khong gis sngar bzhin yig 'bru gcig kyang bris ma byung / lta zhib pa phyir log rjes slob gtsos khong la gshe gshe drag po btang ba na khong gi sems su brkus 'bri ni tshul min gyi bya spyod cig ma yin nam snyasnan/ rdis slob 'bring las mthar phyin la nye dus khong gi sbyangs 'bras kyang yar thon chen po yong yod/ yab chen snga mo nas gshegs stabs khong gi grogs po zhig gis snyan dis dbyin ji ru bca' khrims slob gnyer du btang na/ma 'ongs par spyi tshogs kyi go gnas mtho zhing yong 'bab bzang bar ma zad/ghan rdis kyang bca' khrims sbyangs 'dod kyi 'dun pa ha chang che zhes ma sdu/ la

re ba phul/ rgya gar chos lugs la mi phyed pa'i dad pa ldan pa'i ma yum zhig la mtshon na rang gi gces pa'i bu phrug de phyi rol ba'i rgyal khams su 'grim du 'jug pa'i re ba gtan nas med/ ghan dis kyis ma yum gyi sems khral mkhyen te btsun pa zhig rang khyim du gdan drangs shing / btsun pa dang yum chen gnyis kyi mdun sar phyi rgyal du sha chang mi bzhes shing 'dod yon la mi chags pa'i dam bca' phul/ mthar bu'i chod sems kyis sems 'gul thebs pa'i ma yum gyis bu la phreng skor gcig gnang ste rang nyid rgya gar chos lugs pa zhig yin pa sems nas ma brjed cig ces zhal ta yang yang gnang /rgyagar gyi gzhon nu rnams dbyin ji ru slob gnyer du 'gro mi mang bas snyan dis la pha yul gyi grogs po mang du byung / nyin zhig khong grogs po 'ga' dang lhan du zlos gar khang la spro 'khyam du phebs pa'i lam bar nas kho tshos dgongazas gsol bar za khang du zhim mngar ldan pa'i zas sna mang du mchis kyang dkar zas ci yang med/ khong gis zas kham gang yang ma bzhes par bzhugs bsdad pa la grogs po rnams kyis yar lung nas bsdad na yar lha sham po dang / mar lung nas bsdad na khyim mtshes rgan mor bstun dgos zhes pa'i dpe bzhin dam bca' re zhig ma brtsis rung ci skyon zhes ngan skul byas par/khong gis grogs po tsho'i thugs dgongs dang 'gal dgos rung rang nyid kyi dam tshig 'dor mi nyan snyam ste mtshan der zhal zas ci yang bzhes ma byung /'di ltar dbyin ji ru bzhugs pa'i lo ngo bzhi'i ring du rang nyid kyi dam tshig dpral ba'i mig ltar gces shing ma yum gyis gnang ba'i phyag phreng de yang phreng thag chad rag tu phyag la bsnams myong bar grags/lkosgyuti ya ki lā hā 284891lor snyan rdis dgung lo 22stong bde blag ngang khrims rogs pa'i

thob thang blangs te phyir rgyal nang du log dus ma yum yang tshe las 'das zin/khong gis min me nas lo gnyis tsam la khrims rogs pa'i phyag las gnang zhing /1893lor rgya gar gyi 'byor ldan can zhig gi gdan zhus ltar a h+phe ri kha lho mar phebs/ khong gi las 'gan ni bu lon gyi gyod don rnams thag gcod gnang rgyu de red/ dus tshod kyi 'gros dang bstun gnas de ru snyan rdis kyi mtshan snyan 'brug ltar ldir ba byung / rgyu mtshan ci'i phyir du red snyam na de yang khong gis rgya gar gyi gnas spos yul mis dbyin ji bar ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab rtsod du mi dmangs la 'go khrid mdzad myong ba'i stabs kyis red/a h+phe ri kha lho ma yang rgya gar dang 'dra bar dbyin ji'i mi ser spel ba'i sa khul yin phyin gnas de ru rgya gar gyi gnas spos yul mi'i bzo ba bgrang las 'das/ bzo ba rnams kyi las 'gan lci zhing gla phogs nyung bas ma tshad/da dung dus rgyun gzhan gyi brnyas bcos sna tshogs bzod bsran byed dgos/snyan dis gnas der thog mar 'byor ba'i tshe rgya gar gyi gnas spos yul mi tshos mi rigs khyad gsod la 'thab rtsod byed bzhin pa'i sgang yin phyir/ khong yang thengs de'i 'thab rtsod du zhugs shing mi dmangs la 'go 'dzin mdzad/ rgya gar gyi gnas spos yul mi'i tshab tu re 'dun zhu yig phul bar ma zad kho tsho'i chab srid kyi tshogs khag thog ma ste nā thar gyi rgya gar tshogs chen la rtsa 'dzugs dang / 〈rgya gar gleng stegs 〉zhes pa'i gza' re'i dus deb kyang 'grem spel gnang / 1906lor a h+phe ri kha lho ma'i mi ser spel ba'i srid gzhung gis rgya gar nas a h+phe ri kha lho ma ru gnas yul spo mi chog pa'i khrims gzhung gtan 'bebs dang / byis pa lo brgyad yan gyi rgya gar gyi gnas spos yul mi tshor nges par du tho deb dgos shing khrims dang 'gal tshe nyes chad gcod pa'am rgyal khab kyi mnga' khongs nas mthar skyod gtong rgyu byas/ a h+phe ri kha lho ma ru mchis pa'i rgya gar mi dmangs kyi khe dbang srung skyob byed ched du/ ghanā /sa

kyis thengs gnyis la rgya gar gyi gnas spos yul mir 'go 'dzin mdzad de khrom skor (snyan rdis kyis zhi bde ru dpung 'jug ces 'bod )dang bzo bas las mtshams 'jog pa/ da dung mi dmangs kyi stobs shugs sna tshogs bed spyad de srid gzhung la mtshang 'byin dang gshe gshe drag tu btang / khong gis snga gzhug tu ma dngul btang ste rgya bya'i grong dang thor zi the zhing ra zhes pa'i zhing ra chen po gnyis gnyer nas las shor bzo ba dang kho tsho'i bza' mi rnams la 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen sbyar/ a h+phe ri kha lho ma ru bzhugs yun tu snyan gis ni mi dmangs kyi mgrin tshab pa dang gtso 'dzin gyi cha nas ngan ngon gyi 'tsho ba tsam las 'tsho ba bag med mi byed pa ni khong gi rlabs chen gyi spyod bzang zhig red/ snyan dis thengs 'gar 'dzin bzung thebs te nyes chad 'khur myong mod/ khos blo sems 'gyur med kyis log spyod mkhan dang 'thab rtsod lhod med mdzad pa'i mthus mi rigs khyad gsod kyi 'thab rtsod la grub 'bras nges can blangs par mazad/ 1913lor a h+phe ri kha lho ma'i mi ser spel ba'i srid gzhung gis rgya gar nas a h+phe ri kha lho ma ru gnas yul spo mi chog pa'i khrims gzhi rtsa med du mi bzo thabs med byung /snyan dis kyis a h+phe ri kha'i gling lho mar 'go khrid mdzad myong ba'i rigs rgyud ring lugs la khyad gsod la rgol ba'i 'thab rtsod la sā ti ya ki lā hā ste bden don mtha' 'khyol zhes 'bod/ 'thab rtsod de la khyad du 'phags pa'i don snying chen po gnyis ldan te/ gcig ni dmigs 'ben mngon 'gyur byed rag tu mu mthud du 'thab rtsod dang / gcig shos ni ji ltar rgod rung drag shugs gtan nas mi spyod pa ste/ khong gis 'thab rtsod du zhugs pa'i mi dmangs la rang srog 'dor dgos kyang dgra bor drag shugs gtan nas spyod mi rung zhes pa'i zhal ta gnang / 'di la nga tshos snyan rdis kyi 6 drag shugs mi spyotā ༵༵ ring lugs zhes 'bod/ a h+phe ri kha lho ma ru bzhugs pa'i mi lo nyi

shu de khong gi drag shugs mi spyod pa'i dgongs pa de med pa nas yod pa dang yod pa nas lag len du bstar ba'i dus rim yin zhing / las 'gul de la rgya gar gyi 'byor ldan gral rim dang mang tshogs phal mo che'i rgyab skyor dang bsngags brjod kyang chen po thob myong / ghan dis a h+phe ri kha'i gling lho ma nas phyir rgya gar du slebs tshe khong la gsar brje mkhan zhes mi dmangs kyi khrod du kun gyis gleng bzhin mchis/ cher ma 'gyangs par khong nyid rgyal dmangs tshogs chen tang23 gi gtso 'dzin du bskos shing mi dmangs la 'go khrid mdzad de dbyin ji'i mi ser spel ba'i dbang sgyur la ngo rgol byed 'go tshugs shing /1915— 1919lo'i bar snyan dis kyis thengs lnga la mang tshogs rtsa 'dzugs kyis bden don mtha' 'khyol gyi 'thab rtsod gnang ste/ mi ser spel ba'i srid gzhung gis sgo khral rtsa med dang rgya gar gyi bzo ba phyi rgyal du btsong mi chog pa/zhing par bshu gzhog drag po byed mkhan gyi dbyin ji'i 'debs 'dzugs ra ba'i bdag por nyes chad gcod pa/ bzo bar gang 'dod du sdug gcod gtong ba'i dbyin ji'i bzo grwa'i bdag po la rdung rdeg gtong ba sogs rgya gar mi dmangs kyi mi lus rang dbang dang rgyal khab kyi bdag dbang la 'gan srung byed pa'i re ba sogs la mthar khas len mi byed bya thabs bral/mnyam las mi byed pa'i las 'gul/'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po'i rjes su dbyin ji bas mi ser spel ba'i dbang sgyur gyi tshad je mgyogs su btang zhing btsan gnon gyi srid jus kyi tshab la 'jam 'gug gi srid jus spyad nas 〈la'o lā thi'i khrims gzhi 〉zhes pa khyab bsgrags kyis nyen rtog pas gang 'dod du dogs gnad yod pa'i mi 'dzin bzung byed chog par ma zad khrims khang ma brgyud par yun ring du btson 'jug byed chog par gtan 'bebs byas shing / 1919lo'i zla 4bsdu snas

mtshams bzhag pa'i mang tshogs kyi ngo rgol la khrag dri bro ba'i drag gnon gyis 'dzam gling yongs ha las pa'i a mu'u li tsi'i dmar gsod ces pa'i don rkyen byung / 'di lta bu'i gnas bab la gzhigs te snyan rdis kyis rgyal dmangs tshogs chen tang la dbyin ji srid gzhung dang mnyam las mi byed pa'i lta ba gsar du bton/ sngon chad las 'gul gang gi skabs su yang tha na bden don mtha' 'khyol las 'gul gyi skabs su'ang dbyin ji ba dang mnyam las byed bzhin yod de/ dper na dbyin pu'u dmag 'khrug skabs su/ dbyin jir dmag rogs byed ched du dbyin ji bas rgya gar gyi zhing pa'i dang blangs dmag bsdu bar ram 'degs byas myong / da lta snyan rdis kyis bton pa'i lta ba gsar ba de ni drag shugs mi spyod pa'i ring lugs go rim gsar ba zhig tu 'phel rgyas su phyin pa'i rtags mtshan tu mngon/lo rjes ma'i zla 9bar snyan dis kyis rgyal yongs mi dmangs la dbyin ji'i srid gzhung du las don mi gnyer ba dang mtshan gnas mi len pa/ dbyin skad mi bshad pa/ dbyin ji ba'i slob grwar mi 'gro ba/ mi ser spel ba'i srid gzhung gi khrims ra ru khrims gtug mi byed pa/ dbyin ji'i tshong rdzas mi nyo ba/dbyin ji'i dngul khang du bsags dngul mi 'jog pa/ dbyin ji'i spyi bun mi nyo ba bcas kyi skul ma gnang bar rgya gar mi dmangs kyis kyang khong la yid ches dang rgyab skyor gnang ste mi rigs kyi slob grwa dang tshong khang gsar bskrun/dbyin ji'i dar ras yod tshad mer bsregs te lag skor 'khel 'khor 200gsar du bzos nas yul ras 'khel 'thag dang bzo ba khri 500yis las mtshams bzhag mnyam las ma byed pa'i las 'gul de gnon par mi bzod pa'i rba rlabs drag po bzhin tsha tsha 'ur 'ur du mgyogs myur ngang rgya gar gyi sa gnas so so ru khyab cing dbyin ji bar 'jigs dngangs chen po bslangs/19༷༵༵'i zla 2tshes 22nyin cho lis cho la sa khul gyi zhing pa rnams kyis khrom

skor byas par nyen rtog pa dang dmar 'dzing gi don rkyen byung / thengs de'i las 'gul de drag shugs mi spyod pa'i khyab khongs las brgal zin pas khong gis de ma thag mnyam las mi byed pa'i las 'gul mtshams 'jog dgos pa'i khyab bsgrags mdzad/ zla 3tshes 20nyin snyan rdis 'dzin bzung thebs shing lo drug gi nyes chad bcad/ mthar lo gnyis kyi rjes su snyung gzhi lci ba'i stabs kyis khag theg byas te glod grol btang / lo 'ga'i rjes te 1930lor khong gis yang bskyar drag shugs mi spyod cing mnyam las mi byed pa'i las 'gul te tshwa ru dpung 'jug ces pa'i las 'gul la 'go khrid mdzad/ rgya gar mi dmangs kyi rngul khrag bshu gzhog byed ched du mi ser spel ba'i srid gzhung gis (tshwa yi bca' khrims 〉zhes pa gtan 'bebs byas te rgya gar gyi tshwa gter yod tshad sger sdem gyis tshwa khral bsdu bar ma zad/ rgya gar gyi yul mis tshwa bzo ba'am skyel 'dren byed mi chog ces gtan 'bebs byas yod/ zla 3tshes 12nyin snyan rdis kyis rgyal yongs nas bdams thon byung ba'i dad ldan pa 78dang lhan du mtsho 'gram du tshwa bzo bar rgyang skyod byed 'go brtsams shing / mi ser spel ba'isrid gzhung gis (tshwa yi bca' khrims 〉rtsa med gtong rag tu mtsho 'gram dngas mi 'bral zhes pa'i dam tshig phul te lam du bzhud/ kho tsho nyin rer dbyin le 20tsam bskyod de mtshan mor zhing sde ru ngal gsos shing sde dmangs la tshwa sger sdem gyi srid jus la ngo rgol bya dgos pa'i bslab bya gnang / khong nyid gnas gang zhig tu 'byor rung sa de ga'i mang tshogs kyi yid sems spro ba'i dga' bsu thob cing tshwa ru dpung 'jug byed pa'i dpung khag kyang je che nas je cher phyin/ mthar snyan dis dang khong gi rjes 'brang rnams mtsho 'gram du 'byor rjes tan tiḥ/ zhes pa'i sar gnas bcas shing tshwa las snon byed pa'i 'go tshugs/ ghan dis kyi tshwa la dpung 'jug ces pa'i brda 'phrin de mgyogs myur ngang rgyal yongs su khyab rjes/ sa khul so so'i mi dmangs kyis stu| gi

lad zlos byas te dpung khag re re bzhin mtsho 'gram du bzhud cing tha na tshwa dri cung tsam ldan pa'i chu bo'i 'gram su'ang tshwa bzo mkhan rnams sprin ltar 'dus par gyur/ tshwa ru dpung 'jug ces pa de rim gyis khyab rgya che ba'i ngo rgol las 'gul du gyur cing / mthar drag shugs mi spyod pa'i bkag rgya las 'das te dbyin ji bar rgol rdung drag po btang / zla 5pa'i tshes 5nyin tan ti nas snyan rdis dang khong gi rjes 'brang rnams 'dzin bzung thebs shing lo rjes ma'i zla dang por yang bskyar btson grol btang / zla 3pa'i tshes 4nyin snyan rdis kyis rgyal dmangs tshogs chen tang gi 'thus tshab kyis rgya gar gyi tsung tu'u o'u bin dang lhan du 〈rdi le'i gros chod 〉la ming rtags bkod cing / rgyal dmangs tshogs chen tang gis mnyam las mi byed pa'i las 'gul mtshams 'jog pa dang mtsho 'gram sa khul gyi mi dmangs kyis tshwa bzo chog pa/ drag shugs ma spyad pa'i chab srid nyes can yod tshad de ma thag btson grol gtong ba bcas la mos mthun byung / gros chod der ming rtags bkod rjes cher ma lon par dbyinaji mi ser spel ba'i srid gzhung gis yang bskyar rgya gar mi dmangs kyi 'gro 'dug la dag ther nan mo byed pa'i dmigs bsal gyi bka' khrims gsum khyab bsgrags byas rkyen/ 1934lor thug gi ring mnyam las mi byed rdzuX ༵ ༵ ḍi gul de snyan dis kyi 'go khrid 'og skad cig tsam yang btang lhod spyi tshogs bcos bsgyur la nus shugs yod rgya brtan/1934lo nas bzung snyan dis rgyal dmangs tshogs chen tang las phyir 'bud dang / khong gis mi dmangs la lag shes 'khel 'thag dang rang gis tshwa bzo bar skul slong mdzad pa ni mi ser spel ba'i dbang sgyur la ngo rgol byed cheX hāḥ yin pa las/ rgya gar gyi spyi tshogs de rang mkho rang 'dang gi rang byung

dpal 'byor gyi spyi tshogs su phyi bsnur byed pa ga la yin/ khong gis da dung dus dang rnam pa kun tu rgya gar ni rang sgo dam por brgyab pa'i rgyal khab cig byed mi rung bar/ de las ldog ste sgo dang sge'u khung yangs por phyes te phyi rol yul gyi mkha' dbugs gsar ba rang dbang du rgyu thub pa bya rgyu ni gal 'gangs ha cang che zhes gsungs/ ghan rdis kyis rgya gar nges par du rang btsan bya dgos par ma zad/ dmangs gtso'i lam lugs lag len du bstar ba'i rgyal khab cig tu 'dzugs skrun bya dgos par dgongs/ rgya gar mi dmangs kyis rang nyid kyi 'dod mos bzhin chos lugs dad mos byed pa'i rang dbang dang /bud med la dma' 'bebs dang bran bkol mi byed pa/ pho mchog mo dman gyi bsam blo 'dor rgyu sogs yong ba'i re ba nan du bstan/ snyan dis kyis slob gso bcos bsgyur gyi thad du'ang bsam gzhigs yang yang gnang myong ste dbyin ji bas btsugs pa'i slob gling so so ni mi ser spel ba'i dbang sgyur la mi sna gso skyong byed pa tsam las ma 'das pas/ mi ser spel ba'i dbang sgyur gyi lcags sgrog sil bur gtor ba'i mi rigs rang rkya thub pa zhig tu 'gyur dgos na/ rgya gar mi dmangs kyis rang nyid kyi slob grwa chen mo 'dzugs dgos shing zhing las dang sgyu rtsal/ bzo bkod rig pa sogs bkol spyod kyi rin thang che ba dang mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba dngos dang 'brel ba dam zab tu mchis pa'i rig gzhung khag gsar gtod dang slob ma'i lus shugs ngal rtsol/ kun spyod gtsang ba/ rang mgo thon pa rang byed rgyu bcas ha cang dgos gal che bar gsungardzu /tshogs la rnam pa gsar ba'i gson shugs rgyas dgos na lugs srol rnying ba rnams 'dor dgos/ rgya gar ni rigs rus kyi dbye ba che ba'i rgyal khab cig yin phyir de'ang spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba'i 'gog rkyen chen po ru gyur yod/ snyan dis kyis thabs sna tshogs sgos lam lugs 'di la ༵ spyal

dang nang sgos su gdol rigs kyi spyi tshogs go gnas mthor 'degs gtong ched du phyag las rgya chen po gnang myong ste/ khong sku dngos kyis 〈gdol rigs 〉zhes pa'i gza' re'i dus deb cig 'grems myong la dmangs rigs kyi bu mo zhig kyang gnyor skyong gnang myong / thengs shig la khong gis skra bzhar mkhan zhig la dbu skra gtan nas bzhar du bcug ma byung / rgyu mtshan ni mi desagadol rigs shig yin tshe skra gtan nas mi bzhar ba de red/ a zi lā mu'u ru bzhugs ring du khong gis rang la 'di lta bu'i don tshan zhig gtan 'bebasaganang yod de/ khyo shug zung las cig shos gdol rigs yin na ma gtogs gnyen ston gang la'ang gtan nas zhugs rgyu min zhes pa de'o/rgya gar gyi dus yun ring po'i spyi tshogs 'phel ba'i lo rgyus kyi brgyud rim khrod du rgya gar chos lugs dang dbyi si lan chos lugs bar gyi 'gal ba ni khyi dang ra ltar du snang / mi dmangs yongs zhi bde mnyam gnas yong rgyu ni snyan gis kyi bsam 'dun drag po yin phyir khong gis rang nyid kyi sku tshe hril po ru 'bad 'bungs lhod med gnang myong yod/ snyan dis ni rgya gar chos lugs pa zhig yin yang dbyi si lan dang chos lugs gzhan dag la sdang sems 'chang mkhan zhig gtan nas ma yin te/ 1924lor dbyi si lan gyi rjes 'jug pas bslangs pa'i hā li h+pha las 'gul 'go rtsom pa'i skabs su/ snyan dis kyis chos lugasadang grub mtha'i phyogs ris rgyang du dor te dbyi si lan mang tshogs la rgyab skyor gnang bar kho tshos snying khong rus pa'i steng nas yid ches dang dga' bsu thob/ zla 8tshes 15nyin rgya gar rang btsan thob ste skye rgu yongs spro bas khengs pa'i nyin mo ru/ snyan rdis kyis chos lugs phyogs khag gnyis kyi 'gal zlar thugs sems skyo dgos byung / khong gis snga gzhug tu thengs gnyis la zas bcad de phyogs khag gnyis ku'i 'go khrid kyis deng phyin zhi bde mnyam gnas yoX sdu/ khag theg mdzad rjes da gzod zas bcad kyi mtshams bzhag pa red/

'tsho bar dka' spyad dang mang chogs la 'brel lam zab pa/snyan dis la rgya gar mi dmangs kyis yun ring du bkur bste bla med byed pa de yang khong ni rgya gar gyi mi rigs bcings 'grol las 'gul gyi gtso 'dzin yin pa las gzhan/ khong gis 'tsho bar dka' spyad dang mang tshogs la 'brel lam 'dzugs pa'i rlabs chen gyi kun spyod kyang rgyu rkyen gtso bo zhig yin te/snyan gis kyi sku tshe hril po ru ras pa bzhin dmar zas mi bzhes shing gyon pa'i yag btsog mi 'dems par gnas mjal la mang du phebs shing / phebs pa'i tshe yang dbu la ras rkyang dkar po zhig dkris shing sku la ras dkyil ma'i gyon gos mnabs pa/ zhabs gnyis rjen par bud de mtshan mor pang gcal du gzims pa dang / tsha gdug rab tu che ba'i dbyar dus su tsha ba 'gog phyir du khong gis srin khung la 'dam bag sbyar te gnas yul nges med du 'grims myong /khong gis 'phrin yig gi lam nas rgya che ba'i rgya gar gyi gral rim so so'i mi dmangs la 'brel 'dris gnang zhing / tha na ches spyir btang ba'i mi ser gyis kyang khong gi 'phrin yig klog thub/ de'i phyir snyan dis kyis nyin rer 'phrin yig ha cang mang bo 'bri dgos par gzhigs te grogs po zhig gis rang nyid kyi rtsa che ba'i chu tshod chud zos su mi gtong phyir/ drung yig cig la rang nyid kyis gsungs pa nang bzhin 'phrin yig 'bri ru bcug na mi bzang ngam zhes zhus par khong gis yud tsam la bsam gzhigs gnang rjes 'o na de ltar bya'o zhes gsungs/ 'on kyang cher ma lon par ghan dis kyis yang bskyar sku dngos kyis 'phrin yig 'bri 'go tshugs/ de ci zhig gi ched du red snyam na khong gis 'di ltar gsungs myong ste/ ngas mi dmangs la mjal 'phrad gnang ste kho tsho dang lhan du gleng sol byed mi thub pa de nga'i phangs sems su gyur yod pa shes bzhin du/ 'phrin yig tsam yang nga rang dngos kyis 'bri ma thuX 9rdo kho

tshoyi chad chen po skye nges red ces mi dmangs kyi gtso 'dzin zhig gis mi dmangs la bcangs pa'i lhag bsam mtshon yod/ 1945lo'i nyin mo zhig la snyan dis khong gi rjes 'brang 'ga' dang lhan du me 'khor la bzhugs te bhang ga la ru spyi don du phebs/ thengs de'i las don gyi bkod sgrig byed mkhan gyis snyan sa la ched du cha rkyen cung bzang ba'i khang mig nang 'brel can gnyis bkod bsgrigs byas yod par/ khong gis 'tshang kha rgyag pa'i mi ser la gzigs bzhin nga tsho bhang ga lar 'gro ba ni bkres ltogs kyis mnar ba'i dbul bo rnams kyi phyir du yin pa las spro 'khyam du 'gro ba ma yin no zhes gsung bzhin/ khang mig gcig u tshugs kyis 'grul bzhud par gnang ste rang nyid kho'i rjes 'brang rnams dang lhan du zhag bzhugs gnang bar grags/gongagi gtam rgyud 'di dag ni snyan dis sku gshegs rjes khong gi rjes 'brang rnams kyi ngag las thos pa sha stag yin pas/ zhud brjod mang du mdzad par gdon mi za yang yod tshad rlom du med pa zhig gtan nas ma yin te/ 'di lta bu'i bya ba phran tshegs las nga tshos zhi bde dang snying rje/ mdza' brtse yi thugs rgyud phyug pa'i skyes chen zhig gi rlabs chen gyi mi tshe mthong thub pa ma yin nam/snyan gis kyis rang nus yod rgu bton te rgya gar chos lugs dang dbyi si lan chos lugs dbar gyi 'gal ba dang 'khon 'dzing zhod 'jags su gtong bar phyag las mang du gnang rung / skye 'gro yongs blo pham pa zhig la 1948lo'i zla 1tshes 30nyin snyan dis mchod mjal du phebs pa'i lam bar du/yid sems gdon gyis brlams pa'i rgya gar chos lugs pa zhig gis khong nyid me mdas sku bkrongs shing dgung grangs 79son/ mdor na khong gi sku tshe hril bo ru mi rigs kyi bcings grol la 'go khrid dang / drag shugs mi spyod pa dang mnyam las mi byed pa'i las 'gul 'go bslangs te dbyin btsan rgyal ring lu/sdu snar rgol lan bag tsha ba sprad pa bden yang drag shugs mi spyod pa dang
mnyam las mi byed pa'i las 'gul gyis mi dmangs kyi ga 'gul la tshod 'dzin thebs shing phyogs yongs nas rgya gar gyi stas su gtong bar mngon gsal dod po'i phan nas 'don

leyoyin dus rtag tu ben cag gi sems khong dugasonalan/1924lo'i zla 1pa'i tshes 22nyin gyi nangs mor/ skyo sems kyis mnar ba'i gdung dbyangs drag po zhig gis le nyin sku gshegs song zhes tang krung dbyangagi 'das brda btang ba de gnam lcag bzhin su'u len gyi bzo pa dang zhing pa/ dmag mi/ slob ma bcas rgyal yongs mi dmangs kun rmongs gnyid las dkrogs shing mig zung mchi mas brlan bzhin smre sngags dang 'o dod kyi sgra yis rgyal khams kun skad cig nyid la gdung bas rab tu mnar/ rgyus lā ci mis ar ye lis chi me nyin gyi sku gdung bzo ba'i tshogs khang chen mo ru bzhugs te rgyal khab kyi sa khul so so nas 'byor ba'i mi tshogs mtsho mo'i rlabs phreng 'byur ba bzhin/ gcig rjes gnyis mthud du nyin mtshan bcu'i ring du gsar brje'i gtso 'dzin khong la ches mjug mtha'i gyes phyag phul/ zla 1tshes 27nyin ni nam mkha' sngo dwangs shing sa gzhi 'khyag pas bsdams pa'i nyin mo zhig yin la/ le nyin gye gdung sgrom de gdung dbyangs kyi khrod du dal ba dal bur thang chen dmar po ru gdan drangs shing phyi dro'i chu tshod 4steng gnam sa g.yo ba'i rten 'brel gyi me skyogs grags pa dang lhan du/ mo si kho dang rgyal yongs sa khul so so'i bzo grwa dang me 'khor gyi rlangs dung yod tshad cig car du bsgrags te khong la mya ngan phul/le nyin nga tsho dang gtan du zhal gyes pa bden mod/ 'on kyang khong da dung gzhung drang gi bzo pa re re dang dbul phongs kyi zhing pa re re'i sems khoX sta4 gson yod par ma zad/ bgrang las 'das pa'i mi ser spel yul sa

khul gyi bran g.yog gi khrod du gson yod ces pa bzhin le nyin sngar mus bzhin mi dmangs kyi sems khong du gnas yod/ khong gi brtsams chos kyang yig rigs mang du bsgyur te 'dzam gling du bkrams pa yis rgyal khab so so'i 'byor med gral rim gyi gsar brje la mdzub ston mdzad cing / khong gi gtam rgyud sna tshogs kyang rgyal khab so so'i mi dmangs kyi khrod du khyab ste gzhon nu rnams la mdun skyod kyi spobs pa bstsal byung /༷ 1 ———/ — dmirigatsho rke di dzeng kyi ri 7655 sna — lha'i — rdzo snangasna ‘gzhon nu'i dus skabs kyi le nyin/ngas sha 'khon rtsod rgyu yin/1870lo'i zla 4tshes 22nyin u ru su'i spur ca chu bo'i 'gram ngogs kyi zhin pi ar si khi (deng sang wu'u li yang na'o thus si khi zer )ru le nyin sku bltams shing / yab ni dmangs gtso ring lugs kyi bsam blo ldan pa'i rgyal dmangs slob gso mkhan zhig dang / yum ni mkhyen rgya yangs shing dbul 295

phongs myong bzhin pa'i ngal rtsol mi dmangs la byams brtse che ba'i sman pa zhig gi bu mo red/ le nyin la phu bo gcig dang a ce gcig nu bo gcig dang sring mo gcig bcas mchis shing nar pon rjes spun sring tshang ma gsar brje'i las don du zhugs/ le nyin byis dus nas bzung blo sems 'gyur med kyis gsar brje'i lam chen du bskyod pa de yang / hra hong gi log spyod dang mi dmangs kyi dka' sdug kho nas yid 'gul thebs pa tsam ma yin par/ da dung khong gi phu bos kyang bag chags zab mo thebs pa'i rkyen gyis red/phu bo'i mtshan la yā li hran ta zer zhing snying stobs che la sgam brling ldan pa'i gzhon nu zhig yin la/ khong slob chen 'grim pa'i dus nas bzung dmangs kyang tshogs pa'i25 tshogs mi yin/ skabs de'i u ru su ru rgya che ba'i bzo pa dang zhing pa rnams kyis byol song las sdug pa'i 'tsho ba rol bzhin yod stabs/ 'di lta bu'i srid gzhung la rgol lan bslog ched du dmangs rkyang tshogs pas lo rgyus kyi 'os 'gan phrag tu bzhes nas hra hong lkog gsod bya rgyu'i gsang gros bsdus par le nyin gyi phu bo'ang zhugs myong / blo pham pa zhig la nyin dkar rkun mas ma brku/ ri mgo thams cad mig yin/ nub mo phag lab ma rgyag rtsig srubs thams cad rna yin zer ba'i dpe ltar gsar brje'i tang mi yod tshad 'dzin bzung thebs shing zla gnyis lhag gi rjes su hra hong srid gzhung gis yā li hran ta 'gegs gsod byas te mi dmangs la 'jigs skul byas/ lo der slob 'bring mthar phyin ma thag pa'i le nyin rang lo 17du son yod/ log spyod pas phu bo bgag gsod byas pa'i 'phrin ngan de 'byor rjes bza' mi yongs kyi mig las mchi ma phyung zhing ngu skad shub shub byed pa'i skabs der le nyin gcig pus mchi ma bton ma byung / khong khu sem mer khang ba'i gru logs shig tu langs te ngas ngu 'bod byed mi nyan/ ngu 'bod kyis ci phan/de ༵༵du ngas phu bor dgra sha len rgyu yin zhes chig lab rgyag bzhin mchis/ 'o

na ji ltar dgra sha len rgyu yin/ phu bo'i 'das grongs las khong la 'di lta bu'i bslab bya zhig thob byung zer na/ phu bo ni dpa' 'dzum drug rgyas pa stag dang mtshungs kyang spyang grung 'dzoms pa'i dmag mi zhig gtan nas ma yin te/gsar brje'i las don la mtshon na dmangs rkyang phyogs khag gis phan 'dogs rgyu las da dung gnod skyel nges yin pa dang / hra hong gi dbang sgyur las dka' sdug myong bzhin pa'i mi dmangs rnams yang dag par bcings grol gtong dgos na/ nges par du rgya che ba'i ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi brtson sems dang spobs par skul ma mdzad de mi dmangs yongs dpung ba mnyam gshib kyis drag po'i gsar brje la brten nas hra hong srid gzhung rdul du brlag dgos snyam/1887lo'i ston kur le nyin kha hran slob chen gyi bca' khrims sde khag la rgyugs 'phrod cing gsar brje'i bsam blo mnga' ba'i slob grogs dang lhan du/slob ma'i las 'gul sna tshogs la zhugs stabs lo de'i zla 12par le nyin slob grwa las phyir bskrad par ma zad/ srid gzhung gi 'dzin bzung thebs shing mthar rgyang phud btang / nyen rtog pa zhig gi khong la/ 64gzhon nu/ ngo log byas na phan thogs ci zhig yod/ de ni 'gram sha lag pas 'then na rang sha dang mgo bos brag la bsnun na rang sdug ma yin nam zhes zer bar le nyin gyis 6 red lags/ dngos gnas de 'dra rang red/ 'on kyang khyod kyis ltos dang de ni zhig ral tu gyur ba'i gyang chag cig yin phyir bsnun pa tsam gyis log 'gro nges red ces gsungs/ lo gcig gi rjes su le nyin phyir log cing mar khe si'i 〈ma rtsa'i rnam bshad 〉la zhib 'jug gnang 'go tshugs shing sa khul de'i mar khe si'i ring lugs kyi tsho chung tu'ang zhugs/ 1891lor le nyin gyis slob phyi'i slob ma zhig gi thob thang gis pi ti pa'o slob chen gyi bca' khrims sde khag gi mthar phyin dpang yig blangs shing khrims rogs pa~X |ga

rogs su tho 'god byas/ lo rjes mar le nyin gyis rmur ca chu bo'i bzhur rgyud nas mar khe si'i ring lugs kyi tsho chung gsar 'dzugs mang du gnang ste mar khe si'i ring lugs khyab bsgrags mdzad/ khong gis phyogs yongs nas mar khe si'i ring lugs kyi mdzad rtsom sna tshogs la zhib 'jug gnang zhing 〈gung khran tang gi bsgrags gtam 〉de 'jar man skad nas u ru su'i skad du bsgyur pa'i dus mtshungs su/ bzo zhing mang tshogs kyi khrod du phebs nas spyi tshogs la rgyus lon dang / u ru su'i lo rgyus dang dpal 'byor/ gral rim 'thab rtsod sogs la zhib 'jug gnang ste gzhung lugs dang lag len gnyis ji ltar zung 'brel byed rgyur bsam gzhigs nan gyis btang /btson khang nang dang yul mthar sprugs pa'i dus skabs/1893lo'i lo stod du le nyin u ru su'i chab srid 'tsho ba dang bzo ba'i las 'gul gyi lte gnas pis ti pa'o ru phebs shing / lo gnyis kyi rjes su khong gis grong khyer de'i mar khe si'i ring lugs kyi tsho chung yod tshad gcig gyur gyi chab srid rtsa 'dzugs shig ste bzo pa'i gral rim bcings 'grol gyi 'thab rtsod lhan tshogs zhes pa dbu brnyes shing / de ni u ru su'i 'byor med gral rim gyi srid tang dbu brnyes pa'i thog ma yin/ le nyin gyi gsar brje'i las 'gul la hra hong srid gzhung blor ma bab par 1895lo'i lo mjug tu khong dang blo mthun rnams gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis 'dzin bzung byas shing / btson khang du khong la rang dbang phran tsam bral yang gsar brje'i las don la mtshams chad myong med de/ btson mas kyang dpe gzigs gnang chog phyir khong gis dpal 'byor thad kyi bcoms chos rnams skom pas chu la dungs bzhin slob gnyer dang 'tshol bsdu mdzad pa'i mthus/ ma 'ongs pa'i tshe na khong gis phyag rtsom ga~X zlor phan 'bras bla na med pa thon/ le nyin gyis da dung phyi rol gyi blo

mthun rnams la 'phrin yig springs te gsang ba'i bsgrags yig mang du bkrams shing / tha na tang gi ches thog ma'i rtsa 'dzin gyi 'char zin dang 〈las mtshams 'jog pa gleng ba 〉zhes pa'i deb chung zhig kyang brtsams myong /btson khang du btson mas phyag rtsom gnang chog gam zhe na gtan nas mi chog ste/'o na le nyin ji ltar dgra bo'i mig 'og las thar ba red ce na de yang ha cang nyan spro ba'i gtam rgyud cig yod de/le nyin gyi ma yum gyis bu chung dran che bas nyin bzhin bya thabs sna tshogs spyad de khong la 'o ma cung tsam re bskur te lus phung la gces skyong bzang po bya rgyu gal che snyam/ 'o mas lus kyi zungs stobs bskyed thub pa bden mod/'on kyang khos 'o ma de 'thung mi spobs par spyod sgo gzhan zhig mchis te de ni snag tsha'i tshab tu springs yig dang rtsom yig 'bri spyad du bkol kyin yod/ 'o mas bris pa'i yi ge rnams ji ltar klog thub pa de yang kho tshor thabs shes shig mchis te/ le nyin gyi bskur yig dang zin bris blo mthun rnams kyi phyag tu 'byor rjes me ru cung tsam bsros tshe phyag bris de ma thag gsal snying nger shar yong / snag tsha gsog 'jog byed ched du khong gis skam zhing sra ba'i go re'i phyi lkogs su snag tsha blugs shing btson gnyer ba glo bur du thon tshe khos snag bum gang myur sgos kha nang du sba dgos/ sngar khong gis 'thab grogs la springs pa'i zhar byung du'ang 66de ring ngas snag bum drug bzas byung zhes dgod gtam gyi tshul du'ang gsungs 'dug dka' sdug dang nyen kha ci 'dra che yang khong gis dpa' ngar zhum med kyis phyag rtsom la gzhol ba'i snying stobs dang gsar brje la bcangs pa'i lhag bsam gyis btson grogs dang / tha na phyi rol gyi blo mthun yongs la brjod du med pa'i sgul shugs chen po zhig thebs byung /1897lo'i zla 2par le nyin zhi po li ya'i shar khul gyi ye nyi ze chu bo'i 'gram ngogs kyi hros hrin si khi sde chung du rgyang phud btang / le dbar stozlozlo ga

brgal ba'i tshang tshing gi nags tshal gyis le nyin dang gsar brje'i blo mthun rnams kyi 'brel lam bcad rung / khos sngar bzhin u ru su dang rgyal khab gzhan dag gi gsar brje'i las 'gul la thugs 'khur mdzad par ma zad/'tsho bar dka' sdug che yang gzhung lugs zhib 'jug gi brtson pa ma btang bar gnas der bzhugs yun du gsung rtsom 20lhag tsam gsar rtsom gnang /rgyang phud kyi lo grangs 'dang rjes khong mu mthud du phyi rgyal khag la yul gyar du phebs shing / gyong gud dang phangs sems kyi mdun du zhum pa spu tsam med par sngar mus bzhin 'byor med gral rim bcings 'grol gyi las don la gzhol/ skabs de'i gsar brje'i las 'gul du zhugs myong ba'i mi zhig gis 'di ltar brjod myong ste le nyin gyis mi dmangs dang 'tsho bar dga' zhen byed par ma zad 'tsho ba'i brod pa la'ang dga' zhen byed pa yin/ de bas kyang khong la mtshon na ches brod pa 'phel ba ni 'thab rtsod dang gsar brje la rgyal kha len rgyu de red ces zer/ tang gi 'dzugs skrun dang gsar brje'i gzhung lugs gsar du btod/hra hong gi lam lugs rtsa med du bzo dgos na 'byor med gral rim gyi srid tang 'dzugs rgyu ni kha tsha dgos gtug gi bya gzhag chen po zhig yin par dmigs te/ 1898lo'i zla 3par u ru su'i rgyal yongs kyi sa gnas so so'i 'thab rtsod lhan tshogs kyi 'thus mi rnams gcig 'dus kyis spyi tshogs dmangs gtso'i bzo ba'i tangazhes pa dbu brnyes/ 'on kyang thengs de'i tshogs chen gyis tang gi rtsa 'dzin gtan 'bebs byed ma thub cing gsar du dbu brnyes ba'i krung dbyang u yon lhan khang yang mi 'gyangs par gtor bswākā thebs/ de'i phyir skabs der ming don mtshungs pa'i tang khag cig da

dung 'dzugs thub pa byung med/ thengs de'i pham kha las le nyin gyis 'byor med gral rim gyi tang khag cig 'dzugs dgos na bsam blo gcig gyur bya dgos shing / de'ang mar khe si'i ring lugs kyi dgongs pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng rtsa 'dzugs bya dgos par snyam pyodang rgyal yongs rang bzhin gyi chab srid tshags par zhig 'grem spel bya rgyu ni mar khe si'i ring lugs khyab bsgrags byed pa'i thabs mchog tu dgongs te/ 190)lor rgyang phud kyi yun tshad lon rjes bya gzhag chen po 'dir 'go 'dzin gyis zla 12tshes 11nyin u ru su'i spyi tshogs dmangs gtso'i bzo ba'i tang gi ches thog ma'i (me stag tshags par 〉zhes pa 'jar man gyi la'e pi zhi ru 'grem spel gnang / thog ma'i lo gsum tsam gyi ring du le nyin gyis 〈me stag tshags par 〉du mar khe si'i ring lugs khyab bsgrags dang bzo ba'i gral rim go rtogs sad yong ba'i ljags rtsom 57tsam spel cing / sa gnas so so'i mar khe si'i ring lugs kyi tsho chung rnams la mthun sgril byas nas tshags par de mar khe si'i ring lugs khyab bsgrags dang gong 'phel du gtong ba'i srog shing du bsgyur/1902lor le nyin gyis 〈ci zhig bya 〉zer ba'i ljags rtsom zhig spel te bzo ba'i gral rim gyi rang 'phel rang bzhin la rmongs bkur dang chab srid 'thab rtsod rtsis med gtong ba'i go skabs ring lugs par mtha' dpyod gnang ste/ mar khe si'i ring lugs kyi tang srid gsar pa zhig 'dzugs par bsam blo'i rmang gzhi brtan por bting / 〈me stag tshags par 〉gyi rtsom sgrig khang gis kyang le nyin gyi 'go khrid 'og dza drag gi 'thab rtsod dang 'bad brtson lhod med brgyud nas tang gi rtsa 'dzin gyi 'char zin gtan 'bebs gnang thub pa byung / lo rjes ma'i zla 1tshes 30nyin u ru su'i spyi tshogs dmangs gtso'i bzo ba'i tang gis thengs gnyis pa'i 'thus mi tshogs chen bsdus shing tang gi rtsa 'dzin la 'thus mi yongs nas gros 'cham byung bas/ dus ༵ /sa

bzung 'byor med gral rim gyi srid tang zhig dngos su dbu brnyes pa red/'on kyang kho tsho'i mig mdun du snang ba'i lam phran ni de 'dra'i bde zhing snyoms pa zhig ga la yin/ tshogs thog tu tang mi rnams tang gi rtsa 'dzugs sheg la nges par du zhugs dgos min thad du rtsod gleng chen po byung / le nyin gyis tang mi zhig yin phyin tang gi rtsa 'dzugs shig la nges par du zhugs dgos pa dang / mar tho spru sogs kyis tang gi lta rtog dang 'go khrid 'og las don la brtson mkhan zhig yin tshe tang mi ru bsdu chog pa'i bsam tshul bstan/ thengs de'i rtsod gleng de don dngos su tang ni bzo ba'i gral rim gyi rtsa 'dzugs ldan pa'igadong len ru khag cig yin min gyi rtsa ba'i gnad don la rag las pas de ni ha cang gal che ba'i gnad don zhig red/ krung dbyang u yon lhan khang gi 'dems bsko byed skabs le nyin gyis 'go khrid mdzad pa'i pur hri we khe (mi grangs mang ba'i shog kha )dang mār tho sgos kyis 'go khrid pa'i meng hri we khe (mi grangs nyung ba'i shog kha )zhes phyogs khag gnyis su gyes shing / dus de nas bzung pur hri we khe'i bsam blo'i ma lag la pur hri we khe'i ring lugs zhes 'bod pa dang de yang le nyin ring lugs dbu brnyes pa'i rtags mtshan du snang /rjes su dus yun ring bor nang khul gyi 'thab rtsod byas pa brgyud le nyin gyis 'go khrid mdzad pa'i pur hri we khe de mtha' mar rang rkya thub pa'i tang khag cig tu gyur cing / mar khe si'i ring lugs dril bsgrags dang mi dmangs gsar brje'i las 'gul gyi rtsa 'dzugs sogs la gzhan gyis tshab byed mi nus pa'i byed nus gal chen bton pa red/'byor med gral rim gyis mi'i rigs hril po bcings 'grol btang na mgatogs ji srid bar du rang nyid bcings 'grol gtong mi thub/ le nyisagyis u ru su'i 'byor med gral rim gyi las 'gul la thugs khur gnang bar ma za) rnyisam gling hril po'i 'byor med gral rim gyi gsar brje dang mi dmangs

kyi gsar brjer yang thugs khur gnang bzhin yod/ le nyin rgyal spyi gnyis pa'i 'thus mi tshogs chen dang rgyal spyi'i cud kyi tshogs 'du la thengs mang du phebasanas rgyal khab so so'i sbyi tshogs tang nang khul gyi g.yon phyogs pa dang mnyam 'brel gyis/ g.yas phyogs pa dang bar sdod phyogs khag gi 'go gtso rnams dang 'thab rtsod byas te dmag rgyal ring lugs la ngo rgol byed rgyu dang de min mi rigs mi ser spel yul sa khul/ tang gi thabs jus rtsa don kyi gnad don bcas kyi thad du cung drang bden yin pa'i gros chod dang bsgrags gtam gros 'cham 'byung du bcug1914lor 'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po 'go brtsams pa dang bstun dmag 'khrug tu zhugs pa'i rgyal khab so so'i spyi tshogs dmangs gtso'i tang khag phal mo che yis hra wun ring lugs kyi langs phyogs bzung ste/ rang gi rgyal khab kyi thabs srid gzhung gis smyo tam chen pos btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi dmag 'khrug rgyag par rgyab skyor gyis 'byor med gral rim gyi rgyal spyi'i ring lugs kyi rtsa don dang rgyab 'gal byas/ 'di 'dra'i gnas bab 'og le nyin gang myur sgos rgyal spyi gnyis pa'i go skabs ring lugs kyi ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab rtsod du zhugs te/ 6 btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi dmag 'khrug de rgyal nang dmag 'khrug tu bsgyur dgos pa mi dang 6 rang gi rgyal khab kyi srid gzhung de btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi dmag 'khrug khrod pham du 'jug dgos pa'i 'bod skul bton/ mi rnams la btsan rgyal ring lugs ni ji lta bu zhig yin pa ngos 'dzin yang dag yong ba byed ched du 1916lor le nyin gyis 〈btsan rgyal ring lugs ni ma rtsa ring lugs kyi ches mtho'i dus rim yin 〉zhes pa'i gsung rtsom grags can zhig btsams te/ 〈ma rtsa'i rnam bshad 〉par du bskrun rjes kyi mi lo lnga bcu'i ring gi ma rtsa ring lugs kyi 'phel rgyas la phyogs bsdoms mdzad cing phyogs yongs nas btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi ngo ༵ pyeng

dpal 'byor gyi khyad chos/ rtsa ba'i chos nyid la dbye zhib mdzad de btsan rgyal ringalugs kyi byung 'phel dang mthar nyams rgyad du 'gro ba'i phyi rol yul gyi chos nyid la 'grel bshad gnang / btsan rgyal ring lugs ni ma rtsa ring lugs kyi ches mtho'i dus rim dang ma rtsa sger sdem gyi dbang sgyur ni btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi ches rtsa bar gyur pa'i khyad chos yin no zhes pa'i bsdoms tshig bkod/'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang bo'i skabs su/ le nyin gyis da dung btsams chos gzhan dag kyang mang du spel myong ste spyi tshogs ring lugs la rgyal khab gcig gam du ma ru thog mar rgyal kha thob nus shing / btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi dus rabs su mi rigs kyang gnya' gnon byed mkhan dang myong mkhan gnyis su dbye yod stabs rgyal spyi'i 'byor med gral rim gyis nges par gnya' gnon myong mkhan gyi mi rigs dang mnyam 'brel gyis 'thab rtsod byed 'go sogs gal che ba'i bzhed dgongs bton/ dgongs don 'di dag nibatsan rgyal ring lugs dang 'byor med gral rim gyi gsar brje'i dus skabs kyi mar khe si'i ring lugs kyi rtsa ba'i rigs pa ste/ le nyin gyis 'byor med gral rim gyi gsar brje dang 'byor med gral rim gyis srid dbang sger 'dzin byed pa'i gzhung lugs la bzhag pa'i mdzad rjes rlabs po che de'o//zla ba bcu ba'i gsar brje la mjug mtha'i rgyal kha thob pa/1917lo'i zla 1por le nyin gyis 6 nga tshos yo rob kyi grags 'gul ci yang med pa'i mig snga'i spyi tshogs kyi snang tshul la yi mug bya dgos don med de/gnam sa'i bla 'og brje ba'i gsar brje zhig yo rob gling du 'byung la nye zhes lung bstan gnang ba bzhin de nas ma 'gyangs par u ru su'i zla gnyis pa'i gdī~X ༵rje langs nas/ mi lo 370tsam la mi dmangs kyi gnya' nas mnan
