yod tshad yin pas/ dmag dbang mi la sprad pa ni rang sems gdon gyis bzung ba ma yin nam/ thur khe mi dmangs kyis rang nyid kyi bya gzhag yod tshad rang nyid kyis bsgrub dgos pa las/ 'jar man pa rnams gdan drangs yong ba de nga tsho'i mi rigs 'di'i ngo tsha ma yin nam zhes 'jar man gyi rjes su 'brangs te dmag 'khrug tu zhugs pa ni nor 'khrul zhig yin par bstan/ ci mar gyis nyal 'dang lag pa brang thog dang langs 'dang lag pa mgo thog gi dpe bzhin rgyal khab dang mi rigs kyi mdun lam la thugs khral gnang drags pas nyin dkar gyi zas ma zhim/ dgong mo'i gnyid ma skyid par zla 'ga'i ring lus po yongs su skam rin du gyur cing gong rim gyi las bgos bka' yig da dung ci yang ma 'byor stabs/ 1915lo'i zla 2par khos rang 'gul gyis drag rtsal dpon gyi go gnas bskyur te 'dun pa brtan pos g.yul sa ru chas/ci mar gyis dpa' mdzangs brtul phod kyis g.yul du dpa' rtags mang du bzhag pa'i mthus snga gzhug tu hrī krang dang cun krang / shog sgrig dpung tshogs kyi dmag spyi sogs kyi 'gan bzhes te gros chings bzhag pa'i rgyal khab kyi dpung 'jug thengs du mar pham par brgyab/ 1915lor ta ta nyir mtsho 'gag gi g.yul 'gyed du'ang ci mar gyis gros chings bzhag pa'i rgyal khab kyi dmag dpung thengs gnyis su rdul du brlags shing rgyal sa'i bde 'jags kyi nyen kha sel bar/ khong la e zin than stor gyi mgon skyab ces pa'i rlabs chen gyi mtshan snyan gsol/ 1916lo'i zla 8par ci mar gyis u ru su'i dpung tshogs mthar skyod btang zhing mnga' khongs khag cig yang bskyar thur khe'i chab 'og tu bsdu thub pa byung / u ru su dang gros chings bzhag pa'i rgyal khab gang zhig yin rung thur khe'i dmag dpung la 'jigs pa spu tsam bral na yang /ci mar zhes brjod pa'i tshe khong la bstod pa'i mtheb mo mi bsgreng mkhan gcig kyang yod ma gyur/355

mi rigs kyi gsar brje'i las 'gul du zhugs pa/'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po de mna' 'brel rgyal khab khag gros chings bzhag pa'i rgyal khab las yongs su pham stabs/ thur khe srid gzhung gis kyang rgyal khab dang mi rigs kyi bla btsongs pa'i 〈mo te lu'o si'i dmag mtshams 'jog pa'i gros chings 〉zhes pa bzhag cing / gzhon nu'i thur khe tang gi dbang 'dzin mkhan rnams tsham tshom ngang phyi rgyal du bros/ gros chings bzhag pa'i rgyal khab khag gis thur khe rgyal nang du rang snang gang shar gyis log spyod sna tshogs spel ba dang mi dmangs la mnar gcod drag po btang rung /thur khe dbang 'dzin pa rgyal po dang blon 'khor rnams ci bya gtol med du gyur/mi rigs kyi 'tsho gnas nyen kha'i gnas su lhung ba'i skabs der rgyal sar bzhugs pa'i mtho rim mi sna'i khrod du/ dbyin ji'am a rir mgo 'dogs bya dgos snyam pa'i lta ba mi mthun pa gnyis byung / 'on kyang gnad don gyi ngo bo'i cha nas bshad na bsam tshul 'di gnyis po gang zhig yin rung nyam chung dang sgyid lug gi bsam blo zhig yin phyir/ ci mar gyis drag po'i 'os langs la brten te btsan 'dzul mkhan rnams mthar skyod dang rul sungs su gyur ba'i srid dbang mgo rting bslogs nas/ mi dmangs kyi 'dod blo dang 'tsham pa'isbyi mthun rgyal khab cig 'dzugs rgyu ni da gzod mig mdun du snang ba'i thabs mchog yin par bzhed/1919lo'i zla 5par ci mar rgyal sa nas zhal gyes te shar khul gyi an na tho lī ya zhes pa'i sa char phebs shing / gnas de ru khong gis mes rgyal gyi bdag dbang dang mi rigs kyi rang btsan la sngar yod ma myong ba'i chags 'jig thebs kyin yod pas/ mi rigs la bcangs pa'i dung sems dang snying stor+shaswā /sa da gzod mi rigs shig skyob thub ces gsang ba'i bsgrags yig

gang sar bkrams shing / khong gi mdzub ston 'og rgyal yongs rang bzhin gyi tur ki mi rigs kyi bcings 'grol las 'gul gzhi nas 'go brtsams byung /ci mar gyis srid gzhung la blo ba log par rgyal po'i srid gzhung dang btsan rgyal ring lugs khag la khong khro dang dngangs skrag che ru bslangs/ kho tshos brel 'tshub ngang ci mar la gang myur sgos e zi than sgor du log dgos pa'i glog 'phrin btang ba'i lan du/ mes rgyal la rang btsan thob rag tu nga rang an na tho lī ya dang gom gang yang kha 'bral rgyu min zhes gsungs shing / sngar srid gzhung gis gnang ba'i dpon gnas yod tshad phangs pa spu tsam med par rgyab tu dor te blo gcig sems gcig gis thur khe bcings 'grol las 'gul la dbu khrid mdzad/cis mar la mkhal ma'i snyung gzhi phogs shing nam rgyun gnyan tshad rgyas tshe mi snying dum bur gcod pa lta bu'i zug gzer che yang / khong gis skad cig tsam yang phyi bshol dang bag 'khum bral bar zhin mtshan dus drug tu gros bsdur dang snyan zhu/ yig char gzigs pa/ bka' yig stsol ba sogs kyi phyag las la gzhol dgos shing a thang chad drags tshe tha mag zhu'e ca re'am kha h+phe khamagang re bzhes te ngal gso phran tsam gnang srol mchis/ gsar brje la nyen kha dang dka' sdug ci 'dra'i che yang khong nam yang rgyal khar yid ches kyis khengs yod de/ sngar a ri'i dmag spyi chen mo zhig gis ci mar la/ gal te mi rigs ring lugs kyi las 'gul la pham kha nyos byung na khyed kyis ci zhig bya 'dod yod ces dris par/ the tshom spu tsam med pa'i ci mar gyis khong gis nam rgyun du gsung bshad dang bka' yig tu bsgrags pa'i gtam ste/ 'tsho gnas dang rang btsan gyi ched du zungs khrag dang tshe srog 'dor ba'i mi rigs shig yin tshe de ni nam yang pham par rgyag mi srid ces gsungs/ci mar gyi gsar brje'i las 'gul la rgyal yongs kyi gral rim so sdus mi

dmangs kyi rgyab skyor thob cing / sa gnas so so'i rgyal khab myur skyob tshogs pa yongs kyi ram 'degs 'og rgyal yongs su gcig gyur gyi an na tho lī ya dang lo'u me lī ya'i dbang cha 'gan srung byed pa'i lhan tshogs zhes pa dbu brnyes/ 1920lo'i zla 1por a'o si man rgyal khab chen mo'i rgyal tshogs kyi 'thus mi mang che shos kyis ci mar la rgyab skyor mdzad par ma zad/ khong gi lta ba khas len thob pa'i 〈rgyal dmangs kyi spyi chings 〉zhes pa gtan 'bebs gnang zhing de yang mi dmangs byings nas nges par du brtsi srung bya dgos pa'i thun mong gi rtsa 'dzin du gyur/ 1920lo'i zla 4tshes 23la an khā lā ru ci mar gyis thebs dang po'i rgyal dmangs tshogs 'du bsdus shing rang nyid kyis 'go khrid mdzad pa'i gnas skabs srid gzhung btsugs/ de dang dus mtshungs su gros chings bzhag pa'i rgyal khab khag gis thur kher btsan 'dzul dang bgo bsha' rgyag pa'i gom stabs je mgyogs su btang ste/ zla 8tshes 10la rgyal po'i srid gzhung gis 〈zi byor chings yig 〉tu ming rtags mi 'god thabs med byung / chings yig ltar na thur khe srid gzhung la rgyal sa e zi than stor dang nye 'khor gyi sa khul chung ngu tsam las mnga' khongs yongs gzhan la shor/ ya nga ba'i rgyal nang gi gnas bab la gzhigs te ci mar gyis gsungs rgyur/ kho tsho yo rob pas nges par du shes dgos pa zhig ni nga tsho yang kho tsho dang 'dra 'dra yin pa las/ kho tsho las glen zhing lkugs pa zhig gtan nas min/ nga tshor mjug mtha'i rgyal kha thob rag tu nga tsho'i mi dmangs dang rgyal khab kyis kho tshor mgo bo gtan nas sgur mi srid ces mi dmangs yongs la skul lcag mdzad de pho mo bgres gzhon med par khong gi rjes su 'brangs/ skyes pa yin tshe g.yul du chas shing bud med yod tshad khyim du 'dus nas mda' dang mde'u skyel ba'am dmag lwa bzo ba/ rmas mar gzigs skyong gnang ba sogs mi sems yod tshad gardi/ slo phyogs te dgra bor drag rdung btang ba'i mthus/ dmag 'khrug la

dka' tshegs dang shi rmas che yang 1922lo'i zla 8par thur khe mi dmangs la mjug mtha'i rlabs chen gyi rgyal kha thob cing / gros chings bzhag pa'i rgyal khab khag gis kyang ci mar dang lhan du 〈lu'o sang chings yig 〉bzhag ste thur khe rang btsan dang sngar gyi 〈se spror chings yig 〉sogs kyang rtsa med du bzos/deng rabs can du brtson pa/rang btsan dmag 'khrug la rgyal kha blangs rjes ci mar gyis rang re'i rgyal khab 'di deng rabs rig gnas can gyi rgyal khab cig tu bsgyur dgos/'u cag la mtshon na de ni mi rigs 'di'i 'tsho gnas kyi gnad don gal chen rang red ces pa'i bka' slob gnang / 'o na mi rigs 'di'i ma dun du lhags pa'i bkag rgya gtso bo ni ci zhig red dam snyam na bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi lha dbang lam lugs yin te/ rgyal khab 'dir su'u tan ni mnga' 'bangs yongs kyi rgyal po tsam du ma zad/ 'dzam gling yongs kyi dngos brgyud mu'u si lam chos lugs kyi gtso 'dzin te hā li h+pha zhes pa'ang red/ su'u tan hā li h+pha lam lugs zhes pa ni thur khe bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi lha dbang lam lugs kyi rtsa ba'i snang tshul rang yin stabs/ 1922 — 1923lor ci mar gyis snga gzhug tu chab srid kyi lam lugs la bcos bsgyur mdzad de su'u tan hā li h+pha rtsa mi dgos pa bzos shing / spyi mthun rgyal khab gsar du dbu brnyes pa dang rang khong yang ches thog ma'i tsung thung du 'dems bsko byas song /gsar brje'i lam chen du bskyod par khong gis mi dmangs kyi rnying zhen dang rmongs dad kyi bsam blor bcos bsgyur mang du gnang myong bar grags te/dper na/ thur khe mi rnams kyis ཿsa tsi zer ba'i phying pa dmar po'am smug pos bzos pa'i klad snyoms shing dbyibs zlum pa/ mtha' rgyan ci yang med pa'i zhwa mo zhig gyon pa'i goms srol mchis la phyi rol ba dang khyad par 3༷/da

phyir du dus rabs 19pa'i smad du bzung mu'u si lam sa khul du dar khyab byung ba zhig yin/ ci mar gyis zhwa mo 'di rigs ni rmongs dad dang gti mugarnying zhen gyi rtags mtshan rang yin par snyam ste mi rigs kyi bsam blor bcings grol gtong dgos na glis tsi zhwa mo rtsa med du gtong dgos par dgongs/ 'on kyang goms srol tsam yang de 'dra'i bsgyur sla ba zhig ga la yin/de bas ci mar khong nyid hol rgyug ma mdzad par thog mar srung dmag rnams la mtha' rgyan med pa'i zhwa mo gsar ba zhig gyon pa'i bka' phabs par mi dmangs kyis ngo rgol ci yang byas ma byung / der brten khong gis zhwa mo de rim gyis dmag dpung hril por khyab brdal btang / ci mar gyis rgyal yongs su zhwa mo gsar ba 'di khyab brdal du gtong phyir mtsho nag po'i 'gram ngogs nas bzung 'grul bzhud thengs gcig bya dgos byung / kha si tha mo no'u ru 'byor rjes ci mar gyis dbu la pa na ma'i rtswa zhwa zhig gsol te mi dmangs kyi tshogs rar phebs/ khong gis skad gseng mthon pos mi dmangs la gal te nga tsho'i mi rigs 'di'ang shes rig ldan pa'i mi rigs shig yin tshe/ nga tshos nges par du rgyal spyi'i 'gros dang mthun pa'i chas su zhugs dgos te/ ཿsa tsi zhwa mo ni rmongs dad kyi rtags mtshan rang yin pas nga tshos rmongs dad la gyes phyag 'bul ran red ces 'bod skul btang zhing / khong bskud mar sa khul mang du phebs te kha tsha dgos gtug gi gsung bshad mang du gnang rung / rnying zhen gyi bsam blo dang rjes lus kyi goms srol de mi rnams kyi blo ngo nas gyon pa brje ba ltar de 'dra'i las sla po zhig ga la yin/ khong gi zhwa mo gsar bsgyur gyi las 'gul la grub 'bras lon rgyu phar zhog spyi tshogs kyi gral rim so sos gshe gshe drag po btang zhing ngo rgol gyi mtho rlabs 'phyur bar zhwa gsar gyon pa'i mi tshogs nyung shas kyis yang bskyar ཿsa tsi zhwa mo mi gyon thabs med byung / 'di lta ༵ mug pa'i gnas bab la gzhigs te ci mar gyi 'dun pa ma lhod par

gros tshogs brgyud nas ཿsa tsi zhwa mo gyon pa khrims 'gal yin la/ de gyon mkhan gyi mi la khrims ltar nyes chad gcod rgyu yin zhes pa'i bka' yig bkrams/ nyin gnyis kyi rjes su/ nyen rtog pas zhing grong yongs kyi ཿsa tsi zhwa mo gzhung bzhes gnang zhing de la ngo rgol dang phog thug gtong mkhan gcig kyang ma lus par btson 'jug byas par brten las 'gul de bde blags ngang legs 'grub chen po byung / las 'gul 'di'i sgul shugs 'og ci mar gyis bcos bsgyur gyi mdung rtse chos lugs la gtad de/ mi'i rigs kyis skyo gar yod tshad chos lugs bag med du spyad pas lan par ma zad/ nyam chung gi mi la da gzod chos lugs mkho ba yin zhes gsungs shing / rtsa khrims las dbyi si lan chos ni thur khe rgyal khab kyi chos lugs yin zhes pa'i don tshan de med par bzo rgyu byas/ rgyu mtshan ni chos lugs zer ba de mi sger gyi rang don yin pas spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi spyi dmangs so sor rang mos kyis chos lugs la dad mos byed pa'i rang dbang yod ces bstan/rang btsan dmag 'khrug la rgyal kha blangs rjes thur khe rgyal nang du gnam bdag chos lugs pa'i stobs shugs sngar ltar rgya che bar ma zad/ kho tsho da dung ci mar gyi bcos bsgyur la ngo rgol byed mkhan zing 'khrug slong mkhan dpung rtsa gnon mkhan du gyur pa red/ ci mar gyis gros tshogs kyis gros 'cham byung ba'i bca' khrims ltar dgon pa'i rtsa 'dzugs med par btang ste kho tsho'i rgyu nor yod tshad gzhung bzhes dang / chos pa rnams grong mi dkyus ma ru phab ste rang nyid kyi lag zung gis rang kha gso dgos pa'i bka' phab/khong gis da dung mi rigs 'di'i la rgya dang gzi brjid kyi ched du nyams pa slar gso dang ma nyams gong spel gyis rig gnas gsar ba slob par skul lcag nan du gnang / khong gis yo rab kyi mkhas dbang rnams gdan drangs shing sngon thon gyi yo rob rig gnas te 'jar man gyi tshong las bca' khrimastu spyang

dbyi tha li yi nyes khrims/ su'e tser gyi dmangs don bca' khrims bcas lag len tu bstar/ nang sgos su'e tser gyi dmangs don bca' khrims khyab gdal du btang bar sngar skyes pa gcig la chung ma 'ga' len pa'i lam lugs med par bzos shing bud med kyi go gnas mgyogs myur ngang mthor 'degs chen po byung / dus de nas bzung chung ma ni skyes pa'i rgyu nor lta bu ma yin par bcings 'grol dang rang dbang yang dag thob pa'i spyi dmangs su gyur/gzhan gyi rig gnas nang 'dren dang slob sbyong byed pa'i dus mtshungs su rang nyid kyi srol rgyun rig gnas dang mi rigs kyi khyad chos nam yang 'dor mi rung bar dgongs te/ ci mar gyis tur ki ni thur khe mi yi rgyal khab yin zhes pa'i bka' gsung ltar mi rigs rang ngos kyi 'dzugs skrun la'ang thugs 'dang mang du gnang myong / gsham nas nga tshos dpe nyung tsam 'dir bkod na/thur khe skad char gzhan skad kyi shan shugs thebs drags pa'i rkyen gyis khong gis mi la bka' bsgos te tā tan skad kyi rmang gzhi'i steng thur khe skad kyi khyad chos gzhir bzung nas rang skad gtan la phab cing / 〈khu ran gsung rab 〉dang 〈dam pa'i gsung rab 〉sogs kyang lo tsā bas thur khe skad du bsgyur bar ma zad/ 'du khang du gsol 'debs byed skabs thur khe skad las skad rigs gzhan dag ci yang spyod mi chog pa'i gtan 'bebs gnang / phyi 'brel tshogs pa las gzhan phyi rgyal bas slob grwar bdag gnyer byed mi chog cing thur kheḥs pa rnams kyang rang mi'i slob grwa nas dma' rim slob gso myong dgos/sman pa dang khrims rtsod pa sogs kyi bya bar tur ki ba las gzhan rigs su'ang zhugs mi chog par mdzad/ da dung mi rigs dpal 'byor gyi srid jus la 'phel rgyas dang srung skyob byed ched du tshong zog nang 'dren je nyung dang phyi tshong je mgyogs su btang ste/ sgo khral dang tshong zog nang 'dren la tshod 'dzin byas nadi ༵ dmangs la rgyal nang gi tshong zog dang yul ras nyo ba las phyi rgyal gyi

rasami nyo ba dang / lug mig me tog gi lo ma sa phyi rgyal gyi ja'i tshab sogs rgyal nang gi tshong zog gis phyi rgyal gyi tshong zog gi tshab bya dgos pa'i 'bod skulabatang / phyi 'brel gyi cha nas bshad na/ ci mar gyis dus dang rnam pa kun tu rang khyim rang bdag gi mi rigs kyi phyi 'brel lam lugs gzhir bzung nas mi rigs kyi rang btsan dang rgyal khab kyi bdag dbang la 'gan srung byed pa'i dus mtshungs su/ 'dzam gling mi rigs khag dang 'brel lam je dam du btang / lo rabs 30pa'i rjes nas bzung 'dzam gling hril po'i h+pha shi si'i btsan 'dzul mkhan rnams smyo ham che ru langs bzhin par gzigs te/ ci mar gyis rgyal khab su zhig gis tur gir btsan 'dzul byed 'dod snyam pa de lugagu tshe zad spyang ki'i dung khar thon zer ba'i dpe ltar rang nyid 'joms pa'i rgyu ru 'gyur rgyu las gzhan med ces nyen brda yang yang btang /'di lta bu'i skyes chen zhig gis thur khe mi rigs kyi rang btsan dang 'phel rgyas kyi phyir du zungs khrag dang rngul chu bton yod par ma zad/ skye dgu yongs kyis mngon par bstod pa'i rlabs chen gyi mdzad rjes yang mang du bzhag yod pa bden mod/ 'on kyang khong nyid ni 'byor ldan gral rim gyi gsar brje ba zhig yin phyir khong gis 'thab rtsod dang brtson len byed pa'ang 'byor ldan gral rim gyi khe phan rang yin pa las rgya che'i ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi khe phan ga la yin/ kho tsho'i khe phan rtag tu snang med du 'jog gtan nas mi rung bar ma zad/ bzo zhing mang tshogs kyis 'u thug pa'i gnas bab 'og rtsa 'dzugs byas pa'i gyen log la'ang sdang sems ston pa dang tha na khrag dri bro ba'i drag gnon bya dgos pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan/ mthar 1938lo'i zla 11tshes 10la snyung gzhi drag pos mnar ba'i ci mar dgung lo 57par kho'i gzi brjid ldan pa'i thur khe rgyal khab dang mi dmangs la dus rtag tu zhal gyes so// / /363

rkub stegs 'khor 'o rugazhugs pa'i ma'a'i tsung thung ro si 'o khri/a me ri kha'i ta khi tha khul lho ma'i rtse mo dgung la bsnyegs 'dra'i ri rab chen po zhig gi steng du srid na 'gran zla bral ba'i a ri'i tsung thung rnam bzhi'i gzugs brnyan 'bur brkos mdzad yod de/ khong tsho ni a ri'i rang btsan dmag 'khrug gi gtso 'dzin dang skabs dang po'i a ri'i tsung thung wa zhin thun/a ri'i 'byor ldan gral rim gyi dmangs gtso'i rmang gzhi 'ding mkhan dang 〈rang btsan bsgrags gtam 〉gyi rtsom pa po gye khrir sin/ a ri'i bran g.yog lam lugs rmeg med du bzos shing lho byang dmag 'khrug gi mthar thug rgyal kha len mkhan lin khun/ rkub stegs 'khor lo ru bzhugs pa'i a ri'i tsung thung h+phu ran khi lin tin lan na'o ro si yo khri bcas yin/ro si wo khri (164701224440(777)ni a ri'i lo rgyus su bstud mar thengs bzhi ru tsung thung du bdams pa'i skyes bu gcig pu rang yin la/a ri'i 'byor ldan gral rim gyi rtsa ba'i khe phan la srung skyob gang legs kyis 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa'i rjes su/ a ri bde blags ngang 'dzam gling gi stobs ldan rgyal khab cig tu 'pho 'gyur byung bar rmang gzhi sra brtan du bting zhing mig rgyang ring zhing blo gros kyis phyug pa'i phul du byung ba'i gtso 'dzin zhig kyang red/ si ta lin gyis kyang ro si wo khri ni deng rabs ma rtsa ring lugs kyi gtso 'dzin khrod du ches 'jon thang dang snying stobs ldan pa'i chab sriX 34 zhig red ces gsungs myong / 'on kyang khong lta bu'i skyes chen zhig de

rang nyid kyi zhabs zung la brten nas bgrod mi thub par rkub stegs 'khor lo ru bzhugs yod stabs/ khong gi mi tshe la'ang kyag kyog dang bkrag mdangs gzhan las lhag pa byung yod/snying stobs can zhig bya rgyu'i phugs 'dun bcangs/1882lor nyi'u yog gi mthong ba tsam gyis nyams dga' ba'i khang mig cig tu ro si wo khri sku 'khrungs shing / yab kyis phyi 'brel dpon rigs shig dang tshong chen gyi las 'dzin pa'i 'gan sogs bzhes myong stabs khyim tshang ha cang 'byor phyug ldan/ khong la byis dus nas bzung slob gso gang legs thob cing dgung lo 18steng a ri'i ches ming grags che ba'i slob gling ste har bir slob chen (ṣ+ṭha lkolha)du rgyugs 'phrod cing chab srid dang lo rgyus/ gsar 'gyur bcas kyi rig gzhung khag la slob gnyer gnang / slob sbyong gi thad du khong la gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa'i rtags mtshan ci yang ma mchis shing rgyugs 'bras kyang te skar 60—70tsam las med/ 'on kyang spyi tshogs kyi 'brel 'dris la mkhas phyir lo rim gsum pa'i skabs su khong gis har bir slob grwa'i dus deb kyi rtsom sgrig pa'i 'gan bzhes/ slob mthar phyin rjes khong gis bstud mar kho lim nyis ya'i (677༅)bca' khrims slob gling du rgyugs sprad/ blo phangs pa zhig la bca' khrims la khong gis dga' zhen spu tsam mi byed par ma zad tha na rgyugs mi 'phrod pa'i snang tshul yang byung myong / gang ltar mthar slob mthar phyin pa'i tshe na bde blags ngang khrims rogs pa'i thob thang blangs te nyi'u yog grong khyer gyi spyi tshogs kyi gral rim mtho ba'i bca' khrims las gnyer khang zhig tu phyag las gnang / 1901—1909lo'i bar srid 'gan bzhes pa'i a ri'i tsung thung gis o ti ro si wo khri (ro si wo khri rgan pa )ni kho'i a khu yin zhing ro si wo khri'i 'tshar longs la shugs rkyen ༵༵ mo

thebs/gzugs po'i ring tshad la rmi 1 87mchis shing skyes pa'i gzi nyams dang ldan pa/ dus nam gyi char yang zhal la 'dzum gyis khengs pa'i ro si wo khri khong nyid rang lo 22kyi steng gnyen bsgrigs/ chung ma yang mi gzhan ma yin par tag tag ro si wo khri rgan pa'i tsha mo ste ming la e lis na'o zhes zer/ e lis na'o lo na gzhon pa'i dus su yab yum zung tshe ma 'khyol bar kho mo dwa phrug tu gyur bar mthong ste ro si wo khri rgan pas bdag skyong gnang / de'i phyir khong gnyis kyi gnyen ston mdzad sgo ru tsung thung sku dngos su phebs pa des ston mo la gzi brjid lhag tu che ba byung / de dang dus mtshungs su ro si wo khris kyang der 'du ba'i sku mgron gang mang ni khong gi gnyen ston gyi mdzad sgo ru phebs pa gtan nas ma yin par/ tsung thung gi gzi brjid kho nar mjal phyag dang gus 'dud zhu ched du phebs pa sha stag tu mthong bas/ yod tshad kyis tsung thungagar phebs kyi rjes su bsnyegs shing khong bza' mi gnyis la a lan ster mkhan tsam yang ma byung stabs/ khong gi sems su dga' skyo 'dres ma'i snang ba zhigangang gis 'khrungs shing dus de nas bzung rang nyid kyang a ri'i pho brang dkar po ru dpung 'jug bya dgos snyam pa'i 'dun pa skyes/ 1909lor ro si wo khris sngar gyi khrims rogs pa'i bya bar las khur dgongs zhu gnang zhing /dmangs gtso'i tang mi zhig gi thob thang gis nyi'u yog khul gyi gros khang gi gros mir 'dems bsko ru zhugs par mthar bsam don lhun gyis grub/1912lo'i tsung thung gi 'dems bsko ru khong gis ci nus sgos dmangs gtso'i tang gi 'thus mi wer zhun la rgyab skyor mdzad pa'i mthus/ wer zhun gyis srid 'gan bzhes rjes ro si wo khri la drin lan zhu chen du mtsho dmag gi dmag spyi gzhon pa'i go gnas bstsal/ 1920lor rang lo 38las ma son pa'i ro si yo khri ༵༵ngas gtso'i tang gi 'thus tshab kyis tsung thung gzhon pa'i 'dems bsko

ru zhugs par/ spyi mthun tang las rgyal ma thub rung khong la sbyong brdar thob cing snyan grags a ri'i rgyal yongs su khyab pa'i chab srid pa chen po zhig tu gyur byu/ da/ pe la'ang gnam sngon po dwangs re 'thibs re/ sa dog mo skya re sngo re zhes pa'i dpe ltar skyid sdug gi 'khor lo res mos su 'khor bzhin pa'i 'jig rten du/ ro si wo khri khong nyid kyang zhogs pa'i sprin gseb las thon pa'i nyi zlum bzhin snyan grags kyi zer brgya ser lam mer 'phro ba'i skabs su yid pham dgos pa'i don rkyen zhig byung ba ste/ 1921lo'i zla 8par ro si wo khri bza' mi yongs dbyar gyi bzhugs sgar du spro gseng la phebs/ nyin zhig khong dang sku sras rnams gru gzings chung ngu zhig tu bzhugs te nyams dga' ba'i phyi rol yul gyi mdzes ljongs la gzigs mor g.yeng ba'i tshe/ gling phran de'i nags tshal chung ngu zhig mes 'tshig bzhin pa gzigs 'phral bza' mi yongs de ma thag nags tshal myur skyob kyi las su zhugs/ mthar me lce yongs su bsad cing a thang chad pa'i lus po rngul chus yongs su brlan zhing bkres skom dang tsha gdug gis gzir ba'i yab sras rnams kyis chu bo bzhur bzhin pa mthong tshe/ dga' ba 'bum gyis brtas pa'i ngang mo bzhin the tshom spu tsam med par chu gzhung du mchongs pa na ya nga ba'i gsham gsal gyi don rkyen de byung song / me las tsha ba'i lus po de grang zhing bsil ba'i mtsho chu dang 'phrad tshe drod grang ma snyoms stabs ro si wo khri de ma thag brgyal zhing byis pa'i rtsa sbyin kyi snyung gzhi phogs/ snyung gzhi 'di'i rtags su zhabs gnyis mkhregs por gyur cing sha gnad 'khum pa/ lus smad yongs su zha 'khum du gyur/ sngar gyi rgyug na gyi lang rta yang zin/ 'thab na byang kha'i 'brong yang thub pa'i lang tsho dar la babs pa'i gzhon nu stag dang 'dra ba zhig da lta skad cig tu dbang bo skyon can du gyur te phebs bzhugs kyang sdug las mang du myong dgos par ma~X tshe

gnyen nye dang grogs po su yin yang sems su bzod glags bral ba'i gdung ba chen pos gzir/ gnyen nye dang yul mi rnams la sems gso'i tshul du ro si yokhris mgrin pa gzengs su btegs te 6 'di lta bu'i byis nad cig gis nga rang 'jom 'gro khyod tshos smreng mi dgos zhes gsungs/ thog mar mal khri'i steng du zhabs la sbyong brdar dang rjes su byis pa bzhin sa ru gog 'gros brgyab ste zhabs kyi mnyen 'gug la sbyong brdar yun du gnang / khong gis da dung rang nyid la snying stobs skyed phyir du bza' mi 'khor g.yog dang bcas pa mdun du bkugs te rang nyid dang btsas nas cher ma lon pa'i sku sras chung ba gnyis kyi gog 'gros 'gran sdur la gzigs par bskul/ khong da dung skub stegs 'khor lo ru bzhugs nas lus rtsal sbyong brdar gyi goms srol mchis pa de yang khong gi sku lus la ha cang sman pa byung / tso kri ya khul du rang byung chu khol zhig mchis pa de khong gi snyung gzhi de rigs la phan par gsan rjes/ ro si wo khris rgyu nor 'bor chen btang ste sa khul de nyos shing de ru khrus gsol dang chu rkyal sogs mdzad par gzugs po'i bde thang la mngon gsal dod po'i phan thogs byung /1924lo'i dbyar khar ro su wo khri bsnyungs rjes kyi ches thog mar dmangs gtso'i tang gi 'thus mi'i tshogs chen du zhal mngon/ phyag yas 'khar ba dang phyag ya nas sku sras kyi ram 'degs 'og 'chad stegs su phebs shing 'khar ba sar 'phangs te phyag zung gis 'chad stegs la brten nas gsung bshad gnang 'go tshugs/ lus po'i ljid shugs yod tshad phyag zung la brten yod stabs rtsa 'khum thengs mang du byung zhing rngul thigs zhogs pa'i bsil ba bzhin gdong yongs su khebs rung / khong gis gtam bshad mtshams 'jog rgyu phar zhog skad gseng mtho nas mtho ru btegs pa la der brdi/sdu kyi mi rnams khong gi gzi brjid dang snying stobs la yid 'gul thebs

shing dga' ba'i thal mo bar med du brdabs/ lo gnyis kyi rjes su khong gis yang bskyar srid stegs su zhabs zung 'god phyir du nyi'u yog khul dpon gyi 'dems bsko ru zhugs rgyu'i gros thag bcad/ a ri'i tshags par khang so sos kyang 6 'theng bos khul dpon rtsod 'dems bya rgyu red zer zhes pa'i dma' 'bebs dang skur 'debs kyi gsar 'gyur mang du bsgrags shing / dmangs gtso'i tang nang khul du'ang khong gi gzugs po'i cha rkyen gyis phyag las 'di bsgrub thub bam snyam pa'i the tshom za mkhan mang du byung ba na/ dmangs gtso'i tang gi gtso 'dzin rgan pa si mis zi yis khul dpon du 'dems pa ni lus rtsal 'gran tshogs su zhugs pa rang ma yin pas/ gzugs po'i cha rkyen gyis ci zhig mi longs zhes mtha' gcig tu rgyab skyor dang mi mthun phyogs dgag lan drag tu sprad/ ro si wo khri yis kyang phugs bsam dang gson nyams ldan pa'i 'thus mi zhig gi snang brnyan gsar bzhengs byed ched du gza' 'khor bzhi lhag gi dza drag che ba'i 'dems bsko'i bya 'gul du zhugs/ nyin rer dbyin le 200tsam bskyod cing gtam bshad thengs 12la gnang dgos rung khong nyid gdong la 'dzum kyis khengs shing gzi brjid dang ldan pa'i ngang yul mi rnams la lag 'ju dang bgro gleng / kho tsho'i khang khyim dang phyugs ra ru phebs te mnyam du gsol ja bzhes pa dang tha mag re gsol te lta tshul brje res gnang /mi dmangs kyi rgyab skyor dang yid ches la brten nas mthar khong nyid bde blags ngang khul dpon du bdams thon byung /tsung thung gi srid 'gan bzhes pa/1929lo'i zla 10pa'i smad tsam du a ri'i rgyal yongs su nyam nga ba'i dpal 'byor gyi nyen kha byung / tshes 29la nyi'u yog gi ma rkang 'dzin shog tshong ra yongs su 'thor zhig tu gyur cing / sngar gyi ma rkang rer a sgor 48/ 6) de

da lta rdo lir 1re tsam las mi ri ba zhig tu gyur pas/ 1929lo'i mjug gi dus tshigs gcig pu ru ma rkang 'dzin shog a sgor dung phyur 400tsam gyi khe gyong chen po bzos/ der bstun dngul khang so so'i rkub rdibs shing bzo grwa dang tshong khang / zhing las thon rdzas sogs kyi yong 'bab mar chag ste a ri'i spyi tshogs yongs su spyang tshogs lug khyur shor ba bzhin zang zing 'ur 'ur tu gyur/ skabs de'i tsung thung gi mtshan la — hos wir (/khri/sto)zhu zhing a ri'i spyi tshogs — rkekyi gnas bab la khong yang ci bya gtol med du gyur yod stabs/ grong khyer chen po'i nye 'gram gyi thang stong du gnas yul nges med 'grim pa'i sprang tshogs rnams lcags leb byi( ༵ kyis baspya/ ༵༵/ spyiX shā saru snrodu ṭā dgos byung zhing me ser rnams r+shang khro dang bcas de la hos khrir gyi spro gseng gling 1932lo'i tsung thung gi 'dems ga'am hos lir sde ba zhes 'bod cing / tha bsko'i skabs kyi ro miyo khri na kho tsho'i lag tu thogs pa'i slong khug ral (g.yas )dang hos lir/bo de'ang hos wir khug ma dang ri mgo ru mchong lding byed pa'i ri bong la yabahos blur phag ces 'bod tshul byung / 'di lta bu'i dus su spyi mthun tang la mi dmangs kyi yid ches dang re ltos ci yang ma mchis pas/ skyes bu su zhig spobs pa cher skyed kyis hos slur dang spyi mthun tang gi mdun du mchong tshe de ni mi 'gyangs par a ri'i tsung thung du 'gyur bar dus rabs kyi mthun rkyenabadīt+ta ༵ bskrun yod do/

ro si wi khri khong nyid kyis khul dpon gyi 'gan bzhes rjes bcos bsgyur gyi byed thabs sna tshogs lag len du bstar bar/ tshad nges can gyi steng nas dpal 'byor nyams rgud du 'gro bar sngon 'gog dang mdzad rjes che bas mi dmangs kyi dga' bsu thob/ dka' ba'i las ma myangs na zhim pa'i zas mi reg ces pa'i kha dpe ltar khong gis dka' spyad 'bad brtson byas pa brgyud/mthar dmangs gtso'i tang gi 'thus tshab kyis tsung thung gi 'dems bsko ru zhugs pa'i chog mchan thob/ ro si wo khri sems khams rig par mkhas stabs lo bzhi'i ring bkres ltogs dang dka' sdug myangs zin pa'i a ri'i mi dmangs la mtshon na/ 'tsho ba'i chu tshad mthor 'degs gtong rgyu ni kho tsho'i kha tsha dgos gtug gi re ba nyag gcig po yin pas/ ro si wo khris 6 a ri'i mi dmangs kyi ched du srid gsar spel rgyu yin mi zhes kha g.yang bsgrags par mi dmangs yongs kyi rgyab skyor thob cing / tha na spyi mthun tang(〈mi nag bran g.yog bcings grol btang ba'i bsgrags gtam 〉lag len du bstar mkhan linakhun ni spyi mthun tang mi yin)la brtse dung zab pa'i mi nag rnams kyis kyang khong la 'dems shog 'phangs/ mthar khong gnyis kyi 'dems shog de 8 1bsdur tshad kyis hos wir yongs su pham/ 1933lo'i zla 3tshes 4la a ri'i mkha' dbyings su sprin nag 'khrigs shing drag char shag shag tu 'jo ba'i rlung 'tshub khrod/ ro si wo khri khong nyid sku dngos su a ri'i srid khri la mnga' brnyes/che srid gsar mi lag len du bstar ba/skabs der ro si wo khri khong gi thugs dgongs su rgyal khab kyis las rigs mtha' dag la the gtogs byed tshad shugs snon rgyag dgos snyam pa'i bsam tshul tsam las srid gsar gyi 'char gzhi ci yang med/ 'on kyang khong gi sku mdun du blos khel chog pa'i khrims rtsod pa dang dpal 'byor gyi mi 3/sdus

shig mchis la/ bcos bsgyur gyi snying stobs ldan pa'i gzhon gsar gang mang yang srid gzhung gi las shag so sor las bgos gnang yod pa de/ khong gi brtsis na bgrang du med cing bkol na zad du med pa'i 'byor ba chen po zhig yin/ zla 3tshes minas zla 6tshes 16bar du rgyal tshogs kyis tsung thung gi bka' gsung ltar dmigs bsal gyi tshogs 'du bsdus te/ ha cang gal 'gangs che ba'ikhrims gzhi khag cig ste (dngul khang gi 'phral spyod bca' khrims 〉dang (rgyal phran mnyam 'brel gyi 'phral spyod myur skyob bca' khrims〉/ (zhing las snyoms sgrig gi bca' khrims〉/ 〈bzo las skyar dar gyi bca' khrims 〉bcas nyin brgya'i ring du bstud mar lag len du bstar par lo rgyus pa rnams kyis de la 6 nyin brgya'i srid gsar zhes 'bod kyin yod/ro si wo khri'i srid gsar de yang dum rim gnyis su brgyud yod de/ dus rim dang po ni 1933lor 'go brtsams shing 1935lor yongs su mjug sgril/gtso cher gsham gyi phyogs lnga yi nang don 'du ste/dang po/ dngul khang legs bsgrigs/ ro si wo khris srid 'gan bzhes rjes kyi nyin dgu bar rgyal yongs kyi dngul khang so sos las mtshams bzhag ste legs sgrig bya dgos pa'i bka' phab/ nyin 'ga'i rjes su skyin tshab sprod nus yod pa'i dngul khang che khag rnams kyis thog mar las gnyer chog pa'i bka' rgya gnang zhing / bsags dngul nyen 'gog kung zi btsugs nas rgyal khab kyis bsags dngul la 'gan srung byed par khas len byas par ma zad/ da dung nor srid las khungs kyis rdo lir dung phyur bcu phrag 'ga' btang ste dngul khang so so dang yid rton dngul bun las khungs so sor dngul rogs mdzad/ yang dag pa'i srid jus dang rgyal nang gi gnas bab je legs su song bar bstun lo gcig dang phyed ga'i dus yun du/ rgyal yongs kyi dngul khang phaX ༵ 2che yis yang bskyar las gnyer thub pa byung zhing rgyal khab kyi lta skul

'og dngul khang gi mtshan snyan slar gso yag po byung /gnyis pa/ dngul lor srid jus bsgyur bcos/ ro si wo khri yis gser nag phyir btsong dang mi sger gyis gser nag gsog 'jog dang shog sgor du brje ba/ gser rtsis gzhir byas pa'i rtsis lugs sogs yod tshad rtsa med du bzos shing shog sgor gyi dpar grangs je mang du btang ste a sgor gyi rin gong mar chag pa sogs kyi nor srid srid jus la brten nas/ rgyal nang gi dngos po'i rin gong je mthor dang phyi tshong gi nus par shugs snon brgyab/gsum pa/ zhing las thon skyed tshod 'dzin/ zhing las thon skyed kyi 'khor rgyug dman zhing rin gong nyin bzhin mar chag pa'i gnas bab la gzhigs te/ rgyal khab kyis 'char gzhi ltar thon khungs je nyung dang zhing pa'i gyong gun srid gzhung gis gun gsab sprod par khag theg gnang /bzhi ba/ bzo las la the gtogs byed pa/ ro si wo khri sku dngos kyis ma rtsa can rnams kyi 'gal bar bar 'dum mdzad de/ las rigs yongs kyis 'dra mnyam sgos 'gran rtsod bya rgyu'i lam lugs gtan 'bebs gnang dgos pa'i re ba bton/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas ngal rtsol mkhan dang ma rtsa can la bar 'dum gyis bzo ba'i gla phogs dang ngal rtsol byed yun/ byis pa'i bzo ba mi bsdu ba/ bzo pas ma rtsa can dang gan rgya'i skor gros mol gyi dbang cha ldan par khag theg mdzad pa des ngal rtsol mkhan rnams slar yang bzo grwar log ste bzo las kyi 'phel rgyas la skul 'ded kyi nus pa chen po thon/lnga ba/ bzo par las zhugs kyi go skabs bskrun pa/ las ka shor ba'i bzo pa rnams rtsa 'dzugs byas te rgyal khab kyi dngul bun spyad pa'i gzhung gi 'dzugs skrun te gzhung lam dang chu ben/ nags 'dzugs/ slob grwa/ sman khang sogs kyi bzo skrun mang du spel ba'i mthus ngal rtsol gyi go skabs (lo 'ga'i ring a ri ru lo 18—25bar gyi las shor bzo ba khri 250—3chisam

mchis par yod tshad las kur zhugs thub pa byung /)thob par ma zad/ spyi tshogs kyi 'dzugs skrun la'ang phan 'bras chen po thob/gong gi don tshan lnga bo las gzhan khong gi thengs gnyis pa'i srid gsar gyi dus rim ni 1935lo nas dbu tshugs pa yin/ spyi tshogs kyi gong 'phel dang dpal 'byor gyi slar gso bde blags ngang byung stabs ma rtsa can rnams kyis srid gzhung gis thon skyed la tshod 'dzin byed par yi ma rangs te/ kho tshos ches mtho'i khrims khang la gtug bsher brgyud nas 1935dang 1936lor 〈bzo las bskyar dar gyi bca' khrims snyadang 〈zhing las snyoms sgrig gi bca' khrims 〉sogs bca' khrims 'gangs chen khag cig rtsa med du bzos/ spyi tshogs bde 'jags dang rtsa 'dzugs ldan pa'i bzo ba'i rgyab skyor thob phyir du khong gis gros tshogs la gros gzhi bton te bca' khrims gsar ba khag cig ste/bzo tshogs kyis ma rtsa can dang gla phogs thad kyi gros mol dbang cha sngar bzhin sor bzhag gnang ba'i 〈rgyal yongs kyi bzo ba'i bca' khrims 〉dang / 〈spyi tshogs kyi nyen 'gog bca' khrims 〉zhes pa srid gzhung nas las shor ngal rtsol ba dang bgres po rnams la gzigs skyong gnang rgyu'i skor gyi bca' khrims gtan 'bebs gnang / da dung 〈ngal rtsol 'dra mnyam gyi tshad gzhi'i bca' khrims 〉zhes pas ches dma' ba'i gla phogs dang ches ring ba'i ngal rtsol gyi dus yun sogs kyi tshad gzhi la gsar du gtan 'khel gnang / ro si wo khri'i dpal 'byor slar gso'i byed thabs 'di dag gis gral rim bar gyi 'gal ba zhi 'jags su btang bar ma zad/ a ri'i thon skyed nus shugs la sngar yod ma myong ba'i mthor 'degs byung / khong gi srid gsar de ma rtsa ring lugs spyi tshogasakyi 'phel 'gros dang mthun zhing rgya che ba'i ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi khe phan dang yang yongs su mthun/374

kher rkyang ring lugs dang 'thab rtsod rgyun 'khyongs mdzad/ro si wo khris ngal brgya dang du blangs te bcos bsgyur gyi thabs jus sna tshogs spel bar brten rgyal nang la dga' 'os pa'i 'gyur ldog byung ba bden yang / 'dzam gling gi rgyal spyi'i gnas bab nyin bzhin dza drag tu 'gro bzhin mchis/ 1939lo nas bzung khong gis dmigs pa yongs su rgyal spyi'i las don gyi thad du gtod dgos byung / 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa phyogs yongs nas rlung 'tshub bzhin langs yong ba'i skabs su/ h+pha shi sir rgol 'dzing drag po gtong bzhin pa'i dbyin ji dang rgyal khab gzhan dag la skyid sdug mnyam myong dang rogs skyor gnang ched du/ ro si wo khris rgyal nang gi kher rkyang ring lugs pa dang dka' chegs che ba'i 'thab rtsod kyi dus rim ring bo zhig brgyud yod par snang /a ri'i skabs dang po'i tsung thung wa zhin thun gyis yun thim skabs phul ba'i gtam bshad de 〈gyes kha'i gtam bshad 〉ces pa ru/ nga tsho'i phyi 'brel gyi rtsa don ni tshong las kyi 'brel lam je zab tu gtong ba'i dus mtshungs su/gzhan sde dang chab srid kyi 'brel ba ci yang mi 'dzugs pa de yin zhes bka' slob gnang ba'i rkyen gyis/ kher rkyang ring lugs de a ri'i srol rgyun gyi stobs shugs chen po zhig yin zhing dus dang rnam pa kun tu a ri'i phyi 'brel gyi srid jus la bkod 'doms byed bzhin yod/ 1935 — 1937lor 'jar man dang dbyi tha li/ 'jar pan bcas h+pha shi si rgyal khab khag gis yo rob gling dang e sha ya'i shar rgyud kyi rgyal khab khag la smyo ham chen pos btsan 'dzul byed pa'i tshe na a ri srid gzhung gis kha kha rog bsdad na kha mchu med/ mgo lag pas bskyor na rgyag ni med ces pa'i dpe ltar tsung thung la dzodabu ma'i khrimasagazhi 〉lag len du bstar bar bskul cing g.yul 'gyed rgyal kha~X /ga

la me mda' dang dngul bun bskyi mi chog par byas/ khrims gzhi de zhags thag cig dang 'dra bar khong gi rgyal spyi'i h+pha shi sir rgol ba'i las don la bkag rgya chen po bzos par/ khong gi thugs su me dpung 'byur ba bzhin skad cig tsam yang sdod mi tshugs par gyur/ 1937lo'i zla 10tshes 5la sku nyid kher rkyang ring lugs pa'i lte gnas zhi kha sgo (0610820lhame'i )ru phebs te kun la rlung ltar grags pa'i gtam bshad thengs gcig spel/ da lta nged cag 'tsho gnas byed sa'i go la zlum po 'di ru mi la zhed sha langs dgos pa'i nad yams su sheg rgyun 'byams 'gro bzhin 'dug 'o na nga tshos ci zhig bya dgos zhe na/ nad yams phog pa'i mi tshogs gang myur sgos sger sdem bya rgyu las ma 'das zhes dgos gal la thug tshe dmag 'khrug tu zhugs rgyu yin pa'i shugs bstan gnang bar/ gros tshogs su zhugs pa'i kher rkyang ring lugs pa'i 'thus mi'i blor ma babs shing tha na tsung thung ro si wo khri gnas dbyung gtong dgos pa'i 'jigs skul chen po bzos/gna' mi'i kha dpe la la re thur re ma brgyud na/ bde mo'i thang la mi thon zhes pa bzhin khong la 'gog rkyen mang du 'phrad pa bden mod/ 'on kyang sku zhabs kyis gom gang yang phyir bsnur med par gsang ba'i sgo nas dbyin h+pha rgyal khab khag gis me mda' sogs drag chas nyo bar rogs skyor dang stabs bder bzos shing / da dung gros tshogs la snyan zhu phul te a sgor dung phyur 10tsam btang nas mtsho dmag rgya skyed gtong dgos pa'i re bar yun ring gi rtsod gleng brgyud mthar khong gi re ba don thog tu 'khyol byung / 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa des 'dzam gling hril po yongs su nam mkha' du bas bkang / sa gzhi rdul gyis khyab ste skam sa lag mthil tsam yang bde 'jags ngang gnas pa'i bskal ba tsam yang med pa mthong bzhin du/ a ri'i kher rkyang rir+sha sta/sa pas mig dang rna ba spar mos bkab te 'chal gtam sna tshogs dang

〈dbu ma'i khrims gzhi 〉bsgyur bcos mdzad pa la gnod 'tshe btang bar/khong dang kher rkyang ring lugs pa'i dbar du bag tsha ba'i rtsod gleng chen po langs/ gros tshogs su khong gis nya nyog tshig gi lo mas ma bsgribs par rnag thog gtsag khel gyis dbyin jir rogs ram mdzad pa de mthar gtugs na nga tsho'i rang don yin la/ dmag spyod dngos rdzas nub rgya mcho chen mo'i pha mthar skyel ba des bgrang gis mi langs pa'i a ri'i mi dmangs la las bgo byed thub pas mi tshad/ a ri'i rang stong gi rgyal srung 'dzugs skrun la'ang phan thogs che ba'i mda' mo gcig gis gla bo gnyis sod pa'i dpe dang cis mi mtshungs zhes bstan/ khong gi gtam bshad kyis 'thus mi rnams kyi yid sems bkugs shingasngar gyi dbu ma'i khrims gzhi las mtshon cha phyir btsong mi chog pa'i don tshan med par bzos shing / nyo mkhan rang gis skyel 'dren dang ma dngul dus ltar sprod dgos pa'i don tshan tsam sor bzhag byas/dmag 'khrug gi dus yun ring zhing zad gron che stabs dbyin ji'i mdzod khang gi gser nag dang phyi rgyal gyi dngul lor yongs su zad pas/ a ri srid gzhung la ma dngul dus su sprod mi thub pa dang 'jar man gyi chur 'dzul dmag gru yang nub rgya mtsho chen mo'i steng 'gro 'ong byed bzhin yod stabs/ skyel 'dren la nyen kha chen po ldan pas da lta ci zhig bya dgos sam/ro si wo khris gnas bab la gzhigs te nyo mi thub tshe bogs g.yar byas chog ces pa'i lta tshul gsar du bton/ khong gis a ri'i mi dmangs la 'gal 'dzol mi yong ba dang skur 'debs mi byed phyir du lhad med kyi lhag bsam dang bcas kho'i snying nye ba'i yul mi rnam par/ gal te khyim mtshes la me skyon byung tshe nga tshos ci zhig bya dgos sam/ ngas bya dgos pa ni rang nyid kyi chu 'dren sbug ring kho la g.yar te me dgra gsod rgyu yin pa las/ grogs po lags/nga'i chu 'dren sbug ring 'di'i rin gong ni a sgor 15yin pas/ me ma 37)da

gong du nga la sgor mo de sprod rogs zer rgyu ma yin par snyam/ rgyu mtshan ni me skyon 'di'i rjes su nga la thob pa ni a sgor 15dang chu 'dren sbug ring tsam ma yin par gus 'dud dang yid ches/ tha na ri bo'i gtos dang mnyam pa'i longs spyod thob rgyu de red ces gsungs pa dang / gros mi rnams la 'bod skul dang rgyab rogs su bskul ba'i mthus 1941lo'i zla 3tshes ཿla 〈bogs mar gtong phyogs skor gyi khrims gzhi 〉la khas len gyi gros chod byung / 'o na ji ltar lag bstar bya rgyu yin/ ro si wo khris yang bskyar gros tshogs la dras chas skyel 'dren gyi gru gzings dang a ri'i gru gzings mtha' dag g.yul 'gyed sa khul dang gru kha ru bskyod mi chog pa'i gtan 'bebs rtsa med du gtong bar gros gzhi bton/ spyir bogs g.yar khrims gzhi lag tu bstar bar dbyin jis 'jar man la 'gog rgol byed pa'i g.yul 'gyed la bston du med pa'i byas rjes bzhag yod par ma zad/ su'u len dang krung go sogs 'dus pa'i h+pha shi sir rgol ba'i rgyal khab khag la'ang byas rjes bla lhag tu thon/'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa'i skabs su a ri srid gzhung gis su'u len gcig pur skyel 'dren byas pa'i dmag chas a sgor dung phyur 10)pas brgal stabs/ 1945lo'i zla 6tshes 13nyin si ta gyi mag—84 lin gyis bogs g.yar khrims gzhi'i spyi tshogs kyi gcing —ruphan 'bras la gdeng 'jog tshad med gnang zhing / ro si wo khris 'jar pan dang gros chod gzhir bzung nas a ri srid gzhung gis g.yul 'gyed pa'i bsgragasayigayo rob g.yul 'gyed du bogs g.yar gyi rnam pas la chog mchan 'god bzhin pa/ su'u len la me mda' dang g.yul 'thab dngos rdzas/ 'bru rigs sogs kyi 378

rogs skyor gnang ba des mi'i rigs thun mong gi dgra bo ste shi the li las rnam par rgyal bar bston du med pa'i mdzad rjes bzhag yod ces gsungs/1941lo'i zla 8par ro si wo khri dang chir khyi'o rnam gnyis kyis nyi'u h+phin lan du (nub kyi rgya mtsho chen mo'i rtsa khrims 〉la ming rtags bkod de/ rgyal spyi'i mnyam las dang thun mong gis h+pha shi sir rgol ba'i chod sems bstan/ lo de'i zla 12tshes 7la 'jar pan pas mu tig gru khar 'jab rgol byas rkyen gyis zhi bde rgya mtsho chen mo'i g.yul 'gyed gzhi nas 'go bcoms shing / a ri srid gzhung yang da lta gzhi nas mig gis zhar rdzu dang rna bas 'on rdzu ltar 'dug dbang gzhan gyis ma byin par phyogs yongs nas 'jar pan dang 'jar man gnyis la rgol lan sprod rgyu'i khyab bsgrags mdzad/ 1942lo'i lo gsar la ro si wo khris skul slong 'og a ri dang dbyin ji/ su'u len/ krung go sogs 'dus pa'i rgyal khab 26gi sku tshab kyis wa zhin thun nas 〈mnyam 'brel rgyal khab kyi bsgrags gtam 〉la chog mchan bkod cing / rgyal spyi'i h+pha shi sir rgol ba'i mnyam 'brel yang dag par dbu brnyes/ de'i rjes kyi lo du ma'i ring du tsung thung ro si wo khri khong nyid thengs gang mang la rgya mtsho'i pha rol du phebs gnang ste/ sku dngos su mna' 'brel rgyal khab khag gi gtso 'dzin kyi zhal 'dzoms gros tshogs su zhugs shing nus pa bla med bton/ blo phangs pa zhig la 1945lo'i zla 4pa'i tshes 12nyin mi rnams h+pha shi si las rnam par rgyal la nye ba'i nangs mo zhig la/ ro si wo khri khong nyid tso kri ya rang byung chu khol du klad khrag shor rkyen gyis tshe las 'das shing dgung grangs 63du son/ khong gi sku tshe hril po ru dbang bo skyon can zhig gi rkub stegs 'khor lo de sa pu'u lan khā dang khe rmā/ te te lan/ yar thā sogs su phebs myong zhing zhabs rjes a me ri kha'i gling dang a h+phe ri kha'i gling / e sha ya'i gling / yo rab gling sogs gling chen bzhi ru phebs shing chab srid dang phyi 'brel gyi phyag las phun sum tsho/sdu po

gnang ste mna' 'brel rgyal khab khag dang gom pa mnyam bgrod kyis mdun du bskyod pa/ 'dzam gling gi h+pha shi si jag rkun las rnam par rgyal bar rin thang gzhal du med pa'i mdzad rjes bzhag khong gi mdzad chen yang 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa'i skyo gar ltar mi'i rigs kyi lo rgyus su bkod de bskal ba ma stong ring du mi rnams kyis klog cing rjes su yi rangs bya nges yin no// / /

6 drug pa'i bcobargyad kyi don rkyen :gyi dpa' rgod ta'e zha'o lo/1940lo'i zla 5tshes 14la 'jar man h+pha shi sis phyogs yongs nas h+pha ran sir btsan 'dzul byas shing zla gcig gi rjes su btsan 'dzul dmag h+pha ran si'i rgyal sar slebs/ zla 6tshes 17la mgo 'dogs ring lugs mkhan gyi dmag spyi chen mo pe ting tsung li ru bskos shing btsan 'dzul par mgo btags/ sha gseng na rus dkar zhing rus gseng na rkang snum pa'i mi rigs dang rgyal khab la brtse dung che ba'i mi rnams rang nyid kyi mes rgyal la skyo ba'i mchi ma 'byin zhor ma zhal gyes dgos byung / sngar li nu'o srid ge cha gzhung gi rgyal srung dang skam dmag gi ta'e ga'o lo/ dmag spyi gzhon pa zhar ta'e ga'o lo ( (687123 4bzung /3395 58716 6367550zapo sa lko)yang 'khon sems drag po skye bzhin dbyin ji ru yul byar du phebs/ zla 6tshes 18nyin gyi mtshan mor dbyin ji'i226rgyang bsgrags brgyud nas khong gis 〈phe ran si'i mi dmangs la phul ba'i gtam 〉zhes pa'i rang dbang h+pha ran si dngos su dbu brnyes par khyab bsgrags mdzad ༵ /sa

ta'e ga'o lo la zhe drug pa'i bco brgyad kyi dpa' rgod ces mtshan snyan 'khor/da lta yod tshad yongs su mjug bsgril ba red dam zhe na gtan nas ma yin te/nga tsho la re ba ci yang med dam zhe na de yang gtan nas min/ phangs sems dang dka' khag ci zhig dang 'phrad rung h+pha ran si'i mi dmangs kyis nyams pa med pa'i chod sems dang bcas 'jigs pa spu tsam yang med par mdun nas mdun du bskyod rgyu yin ’ zhes gsungs pa dang /skyes thob kyi shes rab ldan pa'i dmag don pa zhig1890lo'i zla 11tshes 22la h+pha ran si'i li er zhes pa'i sa cha'i khyim tshang zhig tu ta'e ku'o lo sku 'khrungs shing / spo bo ni lo rgyus smra ba dang rmo bo ni rtsom rig pa zhig yab kyis chos tshogs kyi slob grwa'i mtshan nyid rig pa dang rtsom rig slob dpon gyi 'gan bzhes yod/ ta'e ga'o lo sku na phra dus nas bzung shes bya spyi dang nang sgos su lo rgyus dang rtsom rig gi shes byar thugs gsan mi dman pa gnang yod/ dgung lo 15steng 〈skyo sdug gi mjal 'phrad 〉ces pa'i 'khyam po nyam chung zhig gi rgyu nor yod tshad gzhan gyis bslus pa'i ya nga ba'i don brjod zlos gar zhig brtsams par rtsom rig dus deb tu'ang bkod myong / 'on kyang ta'e ga'o lo khong nyid la mtshon na lo rgyus dang rtsom rig las kyang dmag don gyi rol rtsed sna tshogs la dga' zhen che ste tha na kha zas kyang brjed 'gro ba'i dus sogs mang du byung / 1909lor rang lo 19son pa'i ta'e ku'o los hreng zhir dmag pon slob grwa ru rgyugs 'phrod cing lo gsum gyi rjes su slob mthar phyin/ 'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po ru rmas phogs stabs dgra dmag gis 'dzin bzung thebs shing 'jar man gyis mgo btags rjes btson grol thob/ da dung pho lan du phebs nas su'u len la bshāspya 2'dzul byed pa'i dmag 'khrug tu'ang zhugs myong / 1921lor khong

phyir h+pha ran sir log rjes hreng zhir dmag dpon slob grwa ru dmag 'khrug gi lo rgyus dang 'thab rtsod rig pa'i 'chad khrid slob dpon gyi 'gan bzhes te/ lo rdepa mar h+pha ran si'i dmag don slob gling du zab sbyong gnang ba'i skal ba yag bta/ 'e ku'o lo 'thab jus dang 'thab rtsal sogs kyi dmag don gzhung lugs la gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyus lon dang nyams myong phun sum tshogs pas/ dmag don slob gling du zhugs ma thag nas bzung slob gtso mu'u wa lang hrang zha'o dang 'gal ba chen po byung / rgyu mtshan ni slob gtsos 'gog srung ni ma 'ongs dmag 'khrug gi las 'gan gtso bo rang yin par rlom pa la/te ko los ma 'ongs dmag 'khrug ni than khe'i dmag 'khrug dang skor skyod dmag 'khrug yin pa las 'gog srung tsam ma yin zhes bstan te phan tshun la dgongs 'gal chen po byung / mthar phyin la nye ba'i tshod lta'i dmag 'khrug cig gi skabs su slob gtso'i lta ba gzhi nas nor 'khrul yin pa'i bden dpang byung par ma zad/ slob grogs yongs 'dzoms pa'i mdun du slob gtso snang med du bzhag ste kho'i dri bar lan gcig kyang btab ma byung stabs/ slob gtso'i ngo tsha de khong khro ru gyur cing gu yangs gtan nas gtong rgyu min snyam/sku nyid kyi mthar phyin rgyugs 'bras thad du slob gso'i u yon lhan khang nas rtsod gleng byung rkyen mthar cung bzang ba'i rgyugs 'bras las thob ma thub/slob gtsos khong la bkod pa'i bsdoms tshig ni 66slob ma 'di shes rab rno zhing mkhyen rgya yangs/ yon tan khyad du 'phags shing 'jon thang ldan pa'i dmag mi zhig yin pa bden mod/ blo phangs pa zhig la rang rlom che zhing gzhan rigs khyad du gsod mkhan zhig yin par ma zad/ kho'i kun spyod de yul gyar ba'i rgyal po zhig dang gnyis su ma mchis pas gong gi yon tan mtha' dag kyang gleng pa'i dgos pa cher ma mthong ’ zhes brjod pa mthong tshe/ khong zhe snazlo snang

bcas khu tshur mtho ru 'phyar te 8 dmag don slob gling gi khyi rkun de dag khyod tshos ltos dang / nga rang slob gtso ru 'dug ma thub tshe shi yang phyir mi log ces gsungs/ gal te rgyugs 'bras cung bzang ba'i dbang du btang tshe/ te ko lis yun ring thugs su nyar ba'i gros 'don pu'u yi 'char gzhi las khungs su phebs te rang nyid kyi dmag 'thab bsam blo lag len du bltar ba'i skal ba ldan mod/ da lta cung bzang po'i rgyugs 'bras las ma thob phyir skyel 'dren mkho 'don las khungs kyi do dam pa tsam las phyag las ci yang gnyer ma thub/dga' 'os pa zhig la lo gcig gi rjes su/ skabs der h+pha ran si'i dmag yongs kyi lta skul ba chen mo'i 'gan bzhes pa'i pe ting gi thugs la babs te/1931lor ches mtho'i rgyal srung u yon lhan khang gi drung yig las shag tu las gnas spos shing dmag don gzhung lugs la ched du zhib 'jug gnang bar bskul/1924— 1938lo'i bar te ko los snga gzhug tu 〈dgra bo'i 'thab ra nas phan tshun phyir 'bud 〉dang 〈ral gri〉/ 〈ma 'ongs pa'i dmag 'khruganyi/〈las gnyer dmag dpung gi 'dzugs skrun〉/ (pho ran si dang de'i dmag dpung 〉sogs dmag don gzhung lugs kyi brtsams chos mang du gsar rtsom gnang ste/ 'phrul chas can gyi skor skyod dmag 'khrug gi gal chen rang bzhin gling zhing dmag don thad kyi sgyid lug dang phyi bshol gyi bsam blor mtshang 'byin drag po mdzad de/ shi the li'i dmag don gyi nyen khar dogs zon nan mo bya dgos pa'i dran skul mang du gnang / rnying zhen dang bag 'khum gyi mi rigs shig la mtshon na/ ta'i ga'o lo'i bsam blo ni smyo ham dang khengs dregs che ba'i bsam blo zhig yin par snyam ste rmongs gnyid du yur ba'i mi dmangs kyis khong la mthong chen gnang ma byung / 1937lor slebs tshe da gzod hrang zhaswā byi4 go gnas bstsal cing mus zi ru than khe'i mda' shog 507pa'i mda'

dpon du bsko bzhag gnang / 1939lo'i zla 9par po lan la 'jar man gyi btsan 'dzul thebs rjes dbyin h+pha rgyal khab gnyis kyang dmag 'khrug tu mi zhugs thabs med byung / 1940lo'i zla 1par te ko lis srid gzhung gi 'go khrid cig la dran tho phul te/ dmag mi ci 'dra'i dpa' rung mtshon cha dang bral na lag rdum brag la 'dzegs pa bzhin nga tsho pham pa'i rgyu las mi 'dug pas/ 'phrul chas can gyi dmag dpung gis 'phrul chas can gyi dgra bor g.yul sprad na nga tsho yang dgra las rgyal ba'i re ba ha cang che zhes gsungs par/dpon mi gang mang gi yid ches dang rgyab skyor thob cing de dag khrod du mi 'gyangs par tsung li ru bskos pa'i li nu'o yang tshud yod/ 1940lo'i zla 5tshes 10la 'jar man gyi dpung chen dbu mi'i rgyal khab (lharwarji)ho lan dang per krom/ lu dzem pog bcas kyi phyogs su bskyod par h+pha ran si la 'jigs nyen chen po bzos/ nyin rjes mar ta'e ku'o lo gsar du sgrig 'dzugs gnang ba'i khrab ldan dmag dpung hrī shog bzhi ba'i dmag spyi ru bskos te/ tshes 14nyin than khe'i dmag dpung gis thengs gnyis la dgra bo'i gzhug lam bcad de 'jab rgol gnang bar rlabs chen gyi rgyal kha thob cing srid gzhung gis khong la gzengs bstod kyi bya dga' bstsal/ zla 6tshes 4la tsung li li nu'o yis nang srid las khungs bskyar bsgrigs mdzad de sku nyid rgyal srung dang skam dmag pu'u yi 'go gtso gzhon par bskos/ 'on kyang rgyal khab dang mi rigs kyi chags 'jig de mi gcig gis lan pa ma yin la mi gcig gis bsgyur du yod pa zhig kyang ma yin pa nang bzhin h+pha ran si'i rgyal nang du mgo 'dogs ring lugs pa'i dbang stobs kyis 'khyer ba'i mthus/ gsar brje yi bzhud lam ha cang nyag phra bar dgongs te zla 6tshes 4yi nangs mor/ta'e ku'o lo khong nyid dbyin ji'i dmag spyi ga ge mo zhig phyir rgyal nang du phebs pa'i skabs dang bstun/ gsar brje dang 'thab rtsod kyi phyir du 3tā/na

ji ru phebs pa'i 'dun pa bcangs/rang dbang h+pha ran si'i las 'gul la dbu khrid gnang /〈pho ran si'i mi dmangs la phul ba'i gtam 〉zhes pa'i gsung bshad du te ko lis rang dbang h+pha ran si zhes pa'i kha g.yang dang / 'thab rtsod kyi dmigs 'ben ni 'jar 'gog rgyal skyob yin par khyab bsgrags mdzad kyang dmigs 'ben 'di mngon 'gyur bya rgyu'ang de 'dra'i las sla po zhig ga la yin/rgyal nang du ta'i ku'o lo la chab srid kyi go gnas mngon gsal mi ldan pa dang dbyin ji ru'ang shugs rkyen ci yang thebs med pa/ khong la da lta dmag dpon las rogs 'ga' las rjes 'brang ci yang ma mchis pas khong gi phrag stong gi las 'gan de gnam las lci yang / dus nam zhig gi tshe yang khong gis rang nyid kyis sgrub bzhin pa'i bya gzhag ni rlabs chen gyi las 'gan zhig yin par yid ches ldan par ma zad/ mes rgyal la blo sems dkar bas las 'gan 'di bde blags ngang 'grub par spobs sems kyis khengs 'duga'o na ji ltar don thog tu 'khyol rgyu yin zhe na/ khong gis h+pha ran si'i mi ser spel yul gyi spyi dpon dang phyi sdod drag dpung gi dmag spyi rnam par glog 'phrin dang 'phrin yig springs te rgyab skyor yong re zhus par/ kho tsho'i khrod kyi mi mang po zhig khong gi dgongs par mos mthun yod rung gral rim gyi bsam blo dang / pe ting srid gzhung khas len min gyi rkyen sna tshogs kyi dbang gis khong la kha ya byas ma byung / 'on kyang khong gis sems shugs ma nyams par dmag mi 'tshol bsdu'i thad du phyag las 'bor chen gnang bar brten/ zla 7pa'i zla mjug tu slebs dus dbyin ji'i gru khar bros byol du thon pa'i h+pha ran si'i chu ba dang rmas skyon phog pa'i h+pha dmag da dung phyi rgyal gyi dmag mi bcas 'dus pa/ ༵ grangs 767can gyi dmag dpung zhig 'dzugs thub pa byung / khong

gis da dung mi ched mngags kyis a h+phe ri kha'i gling gi mi ser spel yul sa khul khag gis h+pha ran si'i mgo 'dogs srid gzhung la ngo rgol byed pa'i las 'gul la dbu khrid dang / zla 9par rang dbang h+pha ran si'i rgyal yongs u yon lhan khang dbu brnyes/ skabs der h+pha ran si'i rgyal nang du'ang mang tshogs kyis rang 'gul sgos bslangs pa'i 'gog rgol thar thor du gcig 'jags gnyis langs kyis byung bar brten/ te ko lis rang dbang h+pha ran si'i khongs gtogs kyi gsang 'phrin dang dmag don las khungs brgyud de rtsa 'dzugs 'di dag dang 'brel lam btsugs shing khong gi rang dbang h+pha ran si'i dgongs pa kun gyi khas len thob/ 1942lo'i zla 7par 6 rang dbang h+pha ran si de 66'thab 'dzing gi h+pha ran si ru mtshan bsgyur cing / kho tsho'i 'thab rtsod kyi dmigs 'ben ni 'jar man gyi sdug 'og tu tshud pa'i h+pha ran si yongs su bcings 'grol gtong rgyu de red/ 1943lo'i zla 5bar h+pha ran si'i rgyal nang du dbu brnyes pa'i 66rgyal yongs kyi ngo rgol u yon lhan khang gis 6 ta'e ku'o lo ni h+pha ran si'i ngo rgol las 'gul gyi gtso 'dzin gcig pu rang yin par khas len mdzad pa des/ khong gi rgyal spyi'i thog gi chab srid kyi go gnas mthor 'degs chen po byung /1943lo'i zla 6tshes 3la sku nyid kyis h+pha ran si'i 'jar 'gog las 'gul gyi gtso 'dzin gzhan zhig ste ci lu'o dang gros mol mdzad de/ h+pha ran si mi rigs bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang dbu brnyes rgyu dang khong rnam gnyis kyis dus gcig tu kru'u zhi'i 'gan bzhes rgyur mos mthun byung / u yon lhan khang 'di dbu brnyes ma thag a ri dang dbyin ji/ su'u len sogs gtsorabyas pa'i 'dzam gling gi h+pha shi sir rgol ba'i mnyam 'brel gyi khas len thob phyir de'ang don dngos su h+pha ran si'i gnas skabs srid gzhung du gyur/a mchod mang na 'don pa 'khrug ces pa'i dpe bzhin srid skyong ba la 3tāzlong

'dzin pa mang mi rung bar snyam ste chab srid kyi lag thabs sna tshogs la brten nas ci lu'o yi dbang cha tshur 'phrog cing rang nyid gcig pus srid 'gan yongs su bzhes/ 1944lor 6 h+pha ran si mi rigs kyi bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang de gnas skabs srid gzhung du gtan 'bebs gnang bar 'dzam gling gi rgyal khab che khag gi khas len thob/ dus de la slebs tsa na te ko lis dbu khrid mdzad pa'i h+pha dmag kyang 'thab mo ba khri 23dang rang srung drag chas spras mkhan mi khri 15/ tun 32dang mtsho dmag khri 5can gyi dmag gru/ tun khri 120can gyi tshong 'grul gru tshogs/ da dung mkha' dmag khri 3dang gnam gru 500bcas ldan par rgya che ba'i mnyam 'brel dmag dpung dang 'jar man gyi dmag dpung la bsdur thabs bral rung gleng du med pa tsam zhig gtan nas ma yin no/ / mnyam 'brel dmag dpung h+pha ran si'i nu'o man ti nas skam sar bud rjes/ te ko lis rgyal nang gi dmag mi khri 50tsam rtsa 'dzugs mdzad de mnyam 'brel dmag dpung dang lhan du pha ri si bcings 'grol gyi g.yul 'gyed du zhugs shing / rang rgyal gyi dmag dpung la brten nas mes rgyal bcings 'grol gtong ba'i lo rgyus kyi las 'gan bde blags ngang 'grub par mdzad chen bzhagah+pha ran si'i rgyal spyi'i go gnas mthor 'degs la brtson pa/ta'e ku'o lo dbyin ji ru 'byor te rang dbang h+pha ran si'i las 'gul la 'go khrid mdzad pa'i skabs su/ mi gang mang gi sems su khos dbyin ji la mgo btags zin pas 'jar man las rgyal rung h+pha ran si nam yang rang btsan thob mi srid snyam/ 'on kyang lo rgyus kyis nga tsho la de ni nor 'khrul gyi bsam blo zhig yin par bden dpang byas/383dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa'i skabs su/ te ko lis dbyin ji dang

a ri'i rgyab skyor brtson len gnang pa'i dus mtshungs su kho tshos h+pha ran sir bsgyur bkod byed 'dod kyi ngan jus dang 'thab rtsod bya dgos byung / ta'e ku'o lo dbyin ji ru phebs pa'i nyin mo nas bzung rang nyid kyis h+pha ran si mtshon pa dang / h+pha ran si'i khe phan la srung skyob dang brtson len bya rgyu ni rang nyid kyi bsgyur tu med pa'i lo rgyus kyi 'os 'gan yin par snyam/ 1944lo'i dpyid kur dbyin ji dang a ri'i mnyam 'brel dmag dpung gis h+pha ran si ru mnyam 'brel dmag mi'i srid gzhung 'dzugs rgyu'i gros gzhi bton par/ te ko lis a ri'i tsung thung la mtha' gcig tu rgol lan sprad/ khong gi mtshan snyan dang mdzad rjes la gzhigs te 'jar man gyi mgo 'dogs byed sgo ru zhugs pa'i dbang cha dang 'jar man gyi mnga' khongs khag cig bcad bzung bya chog pa/ mnyam 'brel rgyal khab kyi rgyun bzhugs las 'dzin rgyal khab kyi thob thang bcas thob byung / 'on kyang gong gi lag yong 'di tsam gyi steng nas nga tshos h+pha ran si'i rgyal spyi'i go gnas mthor 'degs byung song snyam na/ de yang ma lags te/ 1945lo'i po tshi than tshogs 'du ru ta'e ga'o lo gdan ma drangs pa de a ri dang dbyin ji'i 'dra mnyam min pa'i srid jus kyi dpe mtshon zhig red/ 1958lor khong nyid bskyar du srid khrir mnga' gsol rjes/ h+pha ran si'i rgyal spyi'i go gnas mthor 'degs gtong rgyu de khong gi las 'gan yod tshad kyi gtsigs su bzhes/1958lo'i zla 9tshes 17la te ko lis a ri'i tsung thung e sin ho bir dang dbyin ji'i dbu bzhugs blon chen me khi mis lun rnam gnyis la dran tho zhig phul te/ dbyin ji dang a ri'i 'go khrid mdzad pa'i nub rgya mtsho chen mo byang ma'i spyi chings rtsa 'dzugs kyis dus rabs gsar ba'i bde 'jags kyi rtsa ba'i dgos mkho dang re ba yongs su skong mi thub pas/ 'dzam gling gi gal 'gangs che ba'i chab srid dang dmag 'khrug thad kyi gnad don mtha' dag a ༵ /nga

dbyin ji/ h+pha ran si bcas rgyal khab gsum gyis grub pa'i rtsa 'dzugs gsar ba zhig gis bdag gnyer bya dgos pa'i gros gzhi bton par/ a ri dang dbyin jis kha ya ma byas stabs ta'i ga'o lo thugs khro gting nas langs bzhin nub rgya mtsho chen mo byang ma'i rtsa 'dzugs las rim gyis phyir 'bud bya rgyu'i thag gcod gnang / 1953lo'i zla 3par te ko li'i bka' ltar sa dkyil rgya mtsho chen mo ru gnas pa'i h+pha ran si'i dmag gru dang / 1963lo'i zla 6par nub rgya mtsho chen mo ru gnas pa'i h+pha ran si'i dmag gru yod tshad phyir 'then mdzad cing / 1966lo'i zla 3par nub rgya mtsho chen mo byang ma'i rtsa 'dzugs las phyir 'bud bya rgyu'i khyab bsgrags mdzad/1958lor a ri dang dbyin jis nub rgya mtsho chen mo'i rtsa 'dzugs su/h+pha ran sir 'gan dbang cung tsam yang med pa'i rgyu mtshan ni h+pha ran sir rdul phran mtshon cha med pa'i rkyen gyis red/ skabs de'i 'dzam gling gi 'phel rgyas la mtshon na rdul phran mtshon cha yod med de rgyal khab cig gi stobs shugs kyi mtshon rtags su gyur bas/ te ko lis kyang mi stobs dang rgyu stobs yod tshad bton te rdul phran mtshon cha gsar gtod byed par skul ma gnang ste/1960lor h+pha ran si'i ches thog ma'i rdul phran mtshon cha legs 'grub byung /1963lo'i a ri dang su'u len gyis rang nyid kyi khe phan srung skyob byed ched du rdul phran mtshon cha tshod lta khag cig bkag 'gog byed pa'i chings yig zer ba zhig gtan 'bebs byas te/ ta'e ku'o lo la chings yig tu ming rtags 'god pa'i re ba bstan/ te ko lis gsungs don 'dzam gling yongs kyis rdul phran mtshon cha gcig kyang ma lus par rmeg med du gtong ba'i nyin mo der/ nga tsho yang dga' mgu dang bcas las 'gul 'di la zhugs par gdon mi za na yang /da lta dus de ma ran pas su yis kyang nga tsho mdun du bskyod par bkag 'gog byed thabs bral zhes gsungs/390

'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa'i rjes su a sgor gyis 'dzam gling dngul sgor khrod brgya kha gcig gcod kyi go gnas bzung yod stabs/1965lo'i zla 2par te ko lis gser gzhir byas pa'i rtsis lugs gsar ba 'di khas mi len par ma zad/ h+pha ran si'i dngul khang la a sgor mang che ba gser nag tu brje dgos pa'i mdzub ston gnang / te ko lis a ri'i srid gzhung la rgyab 'gal bzo ba'i dus mtshungs su h+pha ran sis yo rab gling dang nang sgos su yo rob nub ma'i 'go khrid kyi go gnas la brtson pa lhur len mdzad/ khong gis yo rob gling ni yo rob mi dmangs kyi pha sa pha yul yin pa las nub rgya mtsho chen mo'i yo rob gling ma yin no zhes bstan te/ yo rob kyi rgyal khab gzhan dag dang lhan du a rir ngo rgol dang a ris yo rab kyi nang srid la the gtogs byed par ya lan sprad/ da dung h+pha ran si dang 'jar man gyis 'go khrid mdzad pa'i yo rob mnyam 'brel btsugs nas/ a ri dang su'u len la do zla thub pa'i stobs shugs shig tu 'gyur ba'i re ba'ang bcangs myong /a ri'i rdul phran mtshon cha'i srung skyob kyi tshab tu 1963lo'i zla 1tshes 22la/h+pha ran si dang 'jar man rgyal khab gnyis kyis mnyam las byed pa'i chings yig bzhag ste/ phyi 'brel gyi gnad don gal chen ci rigs la rgyal khab gnyis kyis gros bsdur byed par mos mthun byung zhing rgyal khab gnyis kyi 'brel ba'ang mgyogs myur ngang gong 'phel chen po byung / te ko lis da dung gtam bshad mang du gnang ste h+pha ran sis yo rob sa khul las gzhan e sha ya dang h+phe gling / la ting me gling sogs su'ang byed nus 'don dgos pa'i bsam tshul bstan/ 194lo'i zla 1tshes 27la h+pha ran sis dngos su krung go dang phyi 'brel 'brel ba btsugs shing / krung go ma tshud pa'i e sha yar ni don chen gang yang bsgrub mi pa'i bzhed tshul bstan/ 1965lo'i zla 2par sku nyid kyis hu'u kri ming la 'phrin springs nas a ris we the nam (710 sa 7 76)gyi nang spyad la

the gtogs dang dmag 'khrug rgya skyed btang bar kha gshe drag po btang /che smad/dmag 'khrug gi rjes nas rtsa khrims la gros bsdur mdzad pa'i skabs shig tu tang srid so so kha ma 'cham zhing / khong gis bton pa'i tang srid dang gros tshogs gang gis kyang tsung thung gi dbang char the gtogs mi byed pa'i tsung thung lam lugs dbu brnyes dgos pa'i snyan zhu la/ tang srid so sos dgag gis ngo rgol byas pas khong khong khro dang bcas srid khri las bab ste grong gseb tu dben bzhugs gnang / 1958lor h+pha ran si'i dbang sgyur gral rim nang khul du 'gal ba chen po byung stabs/ ta'e ku'o lo yang bskyar gdan 'dren zhu bar tang srid khag ma gros gcig mthun byung / sngar dang mi 'dra ba ni khong la 'gog rkyen ci yang ma 'phrad par rtsa khrims gtan 'bebs dang tsung thung gis thad kur tsung li bsko bzhag dang gros khang bskyar sgrig gnas tshul dza drag can khyab bsgrags/ gros khang gi chog mchan ma thob rung dmigs bsal dbang cha spyod par gtan 'bebs gnang zhing / h+pha ran si de 'byor ldan gral rim gyi gros khang gi lam lugs nas tsung thung lam lugs kyi rgyal khab cig tu 'gyur ldog byung / mi rnams dga' 'os pa zhig la khong gi dbang cha dgung dang mnyam yang srid dbang sger gcod kyi nor 'khrul ci yang bzos ma byung /lo rabs 60pa'i mjug tsam nas khong gis rgyal nang gi gnad don la thugs dgongs cher gtod ma thub phyir/ 1969lo'i zla 4tshes 27la khong gis bton pa'i bcos bsgyur gyi gros gzhi gnyis por spyi dmangs kyi chog mchan thob ma thub/ nyin rjes mar khong gis srid 'gan dgongs zhu gnang ste pha yul du log nas thengs gnyis par srid 'gan bzhes pa'i brgyud rim brjod pa'i 〈re ba'i dra/ /lha 〉zhes pa bcoms nas/ rtsom yon tsam la brten nas 'tsho ba ngan ngon

rol 'go tshugs/ srid gzhung gis khong la cha rkyen gya nom pa gnang rung khong gis ci yang zhal gyis bzhes ma byung /1970lo'i zla 11tshes 9la ta'i ku'o lo'i snying nad glo bur du 'phar te sku gshegs shing dgung grangs 80son/ nyin rjes mar a'e li hri pho brang nas khong gi zhal chems mi dmangs kun la khyab bsgrags mdzad/6 khe lung pi chos khang du nga'i 'das mchod spel ba'i re ba yod/ dur sani nga'i bu mo an nā dur 'jug byed sa'i gnasa'osashing / ma 'ongs par nga'i lcam mo'ang gnas de ru dur 'jug bya rgyu/ dur byang du zhar ta'e ku'o lo (1874)lasaci yang 'bri mi dgos/ nga'i bu dang bu mo/ mna' ma bcas kyis nga'i sger gyi lasagrogs rnams kyi rogasaram 'og stabasabade'i 'das mchod kyi mdzad sgo zhig bsdu rgyu lasargyal khab kyisa'adas mchod cho ga bsgrub mi dgos/ drag chas dmag dpung nyung ngu tsam las gdung dbyangasadang rol cha ci yang mi dkrol cing / tsung thung dang srid gzhung gi dpon mi/gros tshogs kyi 'thusatshab tshogs pa/ thun mong gi tshogs pa'i 'thus mi gcig kyang zhugasami dgos/ chos khang dang saganasagang zhig tu'ang rjesadran dang mya ngan ci yang zhu mi dgos/ ngas gsal bor brjod 'dod pa zhig la rgyal nang dang phyi rgyal gyi mtshan snyan dang rtagasam/ che brjod yang na bya dga' gcig kyang gsol rgyu min/ gal te nga lamatshan gnas gang rung zhig gnang na de ni nga'i ches mjug mtha'i re ba dang rgyab 'gal byas pa yin 7zhesagasungs/1970lo'i zla 11pa'i tshes 12la te ko li'i zhal chems bzhin khe lung pi sde ba'i mchod khang du dur mchod kyi mdzad sgo bsdus/ pha ri si'i chos gos dmar po gsol ba'i chos dpon gyis yum chen gyi mchod khang chen mo ru khong la khrus gsol gyi cho ga gzab rgyas ngang bsgrubs shing / tsung thung dang srid gzhung gi dpon rigs mtha' dag dbyin ji'i rgyal mo i lis zi ste sku rabs gnyis pa dang su'u len gyi kru'u zhi po te ker ni/ a ri'i tsung thung ne khi sin (sa150batham7)/ e rin gyi rgyal po/ e tsi o phi ya'i gong ma sogs lhan du dīrdosnas

shing mi grangs sa ya las lhag pa'i pha ri si'i grong mi rnams char chen dang rlung dmar la ma 'dzem par rnam rgyal sgo chen gyi mdun du lhags nas dus gcig tu khong la ches mjug mtha'i gyes phyag phul/ nyin rjes mar pha ri si grong khyer gyi gros tshogs kyis khong la dran gso zhu ched du/ rnam rgyal sgo chen mdun gyi skar ma'i dbyibs kyi thang chen la zhar te ko li'i thang chen zhes mtshan gsol/rnyog 'dzing che ba'i lo rgyus dus skabs su nga'i 'os 'gan ni h+pha ran si dang len byed rgyu de yin zhes pa ni khong zhal bzhugs skabs gsungs pa'i legs bshad cig yin/ 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis par khong gis h+pha ran si mi dmangs la 'go khrid mdzad de/ blo thag rbad chod kyis 'jar man h+pha shi sir ngo rgol mdzad pa'i lo rgyus kyi mdzad chen bzhag te ko lis rang nyid kyi yod tshad de tha na tshe srog dang phugs bsam yang h+pha ran si'i mi dmangs la phul stabs/ khong nyid nam yang mi dmangs kyi sems khong du nyar te ma 'ongs par mdun skyod dang gsar gtod kyi spobs pa zhig tu gyur yod do// / /394

snying stobs ngar55gas55sa mkhregs pa'i tsung thunga'abe thu'o/yu sgo si la wi ya (103031871chi mo'ilko)mi dmangs kyi rlabs chen gtso 'dzin ye si ko'u phu'u la'o tsi thi'e thu'o (11 ༷ ṣ+ṭha7)gling ba'i tshe/khong gi 'jigs pa bral ba'i snying stobs dang zhum pa med pa'i spobs par bstod bsngags mi byed mkhan gcig kyang ma mchis la/ de yang drang por brjod na khong ni 'dun pa ngar lcags las sra ba'i gsar brje pa zhig yin pa'i rkyen gyis red/4 ci gzhon nu'i dus skabs su/ khong nyid btson du thengs mang la tshud de lus sems la dzonā mnar gcod tshad med thebs rung log spyod sto bar dgongs dag gtan nas zhus ma myong la ༷ ༷ ci mgo 'dogs de bas kyang ma mdzad par ngo sna rgol mtha' 'khyongs byas/ 'dzam gling 'khrug cha chen gnyis par khong gis mi dmangs la 'go chi smra khrid kyis h+pha shi si'i btsan 'dzul mkhan pham chi rdo par brgyabs te mes rgyal bcings 'grol thi'e thu'o/ btang / zhi bde'i 'dzugs skrun gyi skabs su'ang khong gis rgyal spyi'i dza drag gi gnas bab 'og rgyal khab sger btsan dang dpal 'byor rang bdag la srung skyob dang 395

sra brtan du btang bar ma zad/ mna' 'brel mi byed pa'i las 'gul la skul 'ded kyis rgyal spyi'i las don khrod bla med kyi byas rjes rlabs chen bzhagakhrims gtug byed sa ru/thi'e thu'o ni 1892lo'i zla 5pa'i tshes 7la khu re she ya'i (༅77༅)zhing pa dbul bo zhig gi khyim du sku 'khrungs shing / dgung lo 15steng 'tsho gnas kyi phyir du yul phyogs gzhan du phebs te za khang gi g.yog po dang sgo zwa bzo grwa'i bzo ba sogs byas myong / 'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po'i skabs khong lta bu'i mi ser yod tshad gong ma'i bka' ltar a'o zhung rgyal khab chen mo'i dmag dpung du zhugs/ 1915lo'i g.yul 'gyed cig tu rmas phogs te dgra lag tu tshud stabs zhi pa'o li ya ru bran g.yog bzhin sdug las mang du myong dgos byung / u ru su'i zla ba bcu pa'i gsar brje la rgyal kha blangs rjes/khong lta bu'i btson ma yongs la rang dbang thob cing su'u we chad dmar dmag gi rgyal spyi'i tsung tu'e ru khag tu dmag mir bsdus/ gnas de ru le nyin gyis 'go khrid mdzad pa'i gsar brje las don gyi skul ma thebs te blo sems 'gyur med kyi spyi tshogs ring lugs pa'i 'thab mo ba zhig tu gyur/ 1920lor khong nyid phyir mes rgyal du log rjes gung khran tang du zhugs/ rul sungs kyi srid gzhung la ngo rgol gyi las 'gul sna tshogs spel ba'i rkyen gyis thengs gang mang la log spyod pa'i 'dzin bzung thebs/1928lo'i zla 8tshes 4yi mtshan mo'i chu tshod 12stong khong nyid gzim la nye ba na/ ci yin ma nges par nyen rtog pa rnams spyang ki gzan la 'dur ba bzhin kho'i rgyab phyogs nas mchongs yong ste phyag zung dam por bsdams/khong gi gzim shag tu 〈gung khran tang gi bsgrags gtam 〉dang 〈khur mar khe se〉3/93ga 'bom bzhi bcas rnyed par khong nyid yang bskyar btson du tshud/

zla 11pa'i tshes 7ni khrims thag gcod pa'i nyin mo yin stabs/ nangs snga mo nas bzung 'dri gcod la sems khur chen po byed bzhin pa'i na gzhon bzo ba dang slob ma rnams chu bo brdol ba bzhin khrims ra ru 'dus shing chu tshod 11par 'dri gcod kyi 'go bcoms/ khrims dpon gyis khyod kyis rang nyid la nyes pa yod par khas len bya rgyu yin nam zhes dris par/ thi'e thu'o yis gtug yig ltar na nga ni nyes can yin pa bden mod kyang drang por bshad na nga la nyes pa ci yang med ces gsungs/ gtam de thos ma thag khrims dpon yi ma rangs par khyod kyis nges par du rang skyon khas len byed dgos zhes zer ba la/ khong zhum pa med par nga ni nan si la spru'i gung khran tang mi zhig yin par ma zad/ da dung gung khran ring lugs khyab bsgrags dang 'byor med gral rim gyi 'dra mnyam min pa'i spyi tshogs kyi snang tshul la ngo rgol yang byas myong /'on kyang ngas rang nyid kyi tang la khas len byed pa las/ khyod tsho lta bu'i 'byor ldan gral rim gyi khrims ra zhig la khas len gtan nas bya rgyu min zhes gsungs/ khrims dpon gyis yang bskyar khyod kyis rgyal khab kyi nyen 'gog bca' khrims zer ba zhig thos e myong / bca' khrims 'di ltar na gung khran tangagi bsgrags gtam sna tshogs spel ba ni khrims 'gal gyi bya spyod yin zhes bshad ma thag thi'e thu'o yis de ngas go myong / 'on kyang de ni mi dmangs la gnya' gnon byed pa'i bca' khrims shig yin phyir/ brtsi srung bya dgos don ci yang med ces 'dri gcod kyi go skabs dam 'dzin gyis kha dpe la/ bshad sa bu mo dang nyan sa mna' ma'i dpe bzhin der bzhugs pa'i gzhon rabs rnams la gsar brje'i rig gzhung dril bsgrags dang / rang dbang dang 'dra mnyam brtson len byed pa ni mi zhig gi mi tshe don ldan du byed pa'i gnad dam pa yin par bstan/ ches mjug mtha'i rtsod gleng gi gtam bshad skabs su khong gis khrims rogs pa'i tshab tu rang nyid byis dus nas bzung dka~X stag

mang po myangs te/ mthar ji ltar gung khran ring lugs pa zhig tu gyur tshul sogs gsungs pa la bzod bsran bral ba'i khrims dpon gyis 'dri gcod mtshams bcad/ nyen rtog pas thi'e thu'o phyogs gnyis su lug chung glag gis khur ba bzhin 'khyer 'gro ba la khong gis skad gseng mthon pos/ kho tshos bya spyod 'di dag las 'di ni nyen rtog pa'i rgyal khab cig yin par ra sprod byung ba red ces dang / yu sgo si la li ya'i gung khran tang khri lo brtan par shog ces pa'i kha g.yang bsgrags/btson du bzhugs ring /'di ltar drag bskyod kyi mi rigs ring lugs pa zhig dang mar le ring lugs kyi 'thab mo ba zhig ni/ skabs de'i log spyod dang mun nag gi yu sgo si la wi yar mtshon na nyen kha chen po zhig tu brtsis te btson 'jug byas/dmyal khams dang gnyis su ma mchis pa'i mun nag dang brlan bsher gyis khengs pa'i btson khang du rtswa 'bol ral bo zhig dang mal gos srab mo zhig las malagadan dang sngas 'bol sogs ci yang med/ nam rgyun gyi kha zas la'ang nas phye lta bu'i kha zas ngan ngon dang skyur zhing bsher ba'i la phug gi khu ba/gza' 'khor gcig la shog nyeb las kyang srab pa'i sha leb mo gnyis las ci yang med/ 'on kyang 'tsho ba'i dka' sdug dang khor yug gi 'gyur ldog tsam gyis khong lta bu'i mi'i rigs bcings 'grol gyi dpa' rgod cig gis rang nyid kyi 'dun pa gtong ba'i gnas su ga la 'gyur/ kho tshos kha zas gcod pa sogasakyi lag thabs la brten nas cha rkyen je legs dang btson khang du slob gnyer gnang chog pa'i dbang char brtson len byas/ khong gis btson du tshud pa'i gung khran tang mi dang tang la brtse sems bcangs mkhan gyi sdug grogs rnaswākā pya rtsa 'dzugs mdzad de/ 'dzin grwar khag bgos te gung khran ring

lugs kyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs dang yu sgo si la wi ya'i lo rgyus la slob gnyer gnang du bcug khong gis da dung phyi rol du gnas pa'i tang gi rtsa 'dzugs dang mdza' grogs rnams la 'brel gtug mdzad de dpe tshogs dang slob chas gang mkho phyag tu son par byas/ btson khang du gsar brje'i dpe tshogs gtan nas klog mi chog stabs thi'e thu'o dang khong gi sdug grogs rnams kyis mar khe si'i ring lugs kyi brtsams chos yod tshad kyi mdun shog dang mdun shog nang ma mer bsregs te/ dpe deb gzhan gyi rgyab shog tshab tu bkol dgos byung rung gsar brje yi blo sems nam yang 'gyur ma myong /thengs shig khong nyid ra bar du 'cham 'cham la phebs te 〈tu'u lin gyi lta ba'i mtha' dpyod 〉la gzigs pa'i tshe/ btson srung zhig rngon pas shwa rjes 'ded pa bzhin shar mar kho'i gam du thon pa na/ khong gis 'jigs pa spu tsam med khul gyis 〈a rab kyi sgrung gtam 〉zhes pa'i yig 'bru bzhi bo gsal nying nger 'dug pa'i dpe cha de kho la bstan tsa na mi de ci bya gtol med du gyur byung /khongagis da dung rang dpe gzhan ston gyis mtshan gung la slebs rag tu dpe gzigs gnang rgyu rgyun 'khyongs mdzad (lā sgron la tshod 'dzin med)/ gnas de ru khong gis mar khe si'i ring lugs kyi brtsams chos grags can dang mtshan nyid/ sems khams/ lo rgyus/ rang byung tshan rig sogs kyi shes byar dbyer med du gzigs shing dbyin yig sogs kyang rang sbyong gnang / rjes su khong gis btson khang gi 'tsho bar phyir dran mdzad pa'i skabs su mi mang bo zhig la mtshon na de ni slob chen ngo ma zhig yin te/ ngas kyang gnas de nas rang nyid spyu /zlo // sagar+shas ༷kās sgos bed spyod thub pa byung bas nga la blo skyed chen po sto dmag 'khrug gi lo rabs/mi lo lnga'i rjes su khong btson grol thob/ 'on kyang log spyod pasdusgra /nga

gis ngo log byed par skrag ste pha yul dang kha 'bral mi chog pa'i bka' phab/'di lta bu'i rtogs sad mkhan zhig rgyu 'bras dang drang bden bral ba'i sbyi tshogs su khu sim mer 'dug dgos zer na/ de ni dper srid pa zhig red dam/ khong gis skra mdog bsgyur cing smra ra bzhag dngos ming brjes nas gsar brje'i las don gyi phyir du gnas yul nges med 'grim pa'i 'go tshugs/1934— 1936lor khong gis yu gung (tshe༅)zhing chen gyi u yon dang krung dbyang chab srid cus kyi u yon/ krung dbyang rtsa 'dzugs las khungs kyi hru'u ci bcas kyi 'gan bzhes/ skabs de'i yu sgo si la wi gung khran tang nang khul du gling ba thams cad kha shar la 'khor rung / a khu khro thung kha nub la 'khor ba'i dpe bzhin bsam blo dang spyod pa a khu khro thung lta bu mang du byung /1938lor khong gis yu sgo si la wi ya'i tang krung dbyang gi hru'u ci'i 'gan bzhes rjes/ krung dbyang gi las khungs so so legs sgrig dang tang gi sgrig khrims gsar du gtan 'bebs gnang ba'i mthus/ rtsa 'dzugs 'di gzhi nas yar ngo'i zla ltar yang dag pa'i lam du bskyod thub byung / 1941lo'i zla 4tshes 6la 'jar man dang dbyi tha li'i btsan 'dzul dmag dpung gis yu sgo si la wi yar tshur rgol byas shing / nyin bcu'i rjes su mang sna nyung gis ma brtan par dgra bor mgo 'dzul rkyen/ rgyal khab dang mi rigs myur skyob kyi tsholas 'gan de yang dag par thi'e thu'o yis 'go khrid mdzad bzhin pa'i yu gung gi phrag steng du babs/khong gis kyang lo rgyus kyi las 'gan chen mo'i mdun du dpa' ma zhum par dgra bo'i gdong bsu chen du zla 6tshes 27la/ yu sgo si la wi gung krung dbyang gis yu sgo si la wi ya mi dmangs kyi nges med rgol rdung dmag khang dbu brnyes shing thi'i thu'o yis sku dngos su dmag spyi'i 'gan bzhes/ zla 7par khodwa gus mi dmangs la 'go khrid mdzad de drag po'i 'os langs bslangs te e

sar wi ya'i nub rgyud kyi ri khul du ches thog ma'i bcings 'grol khul btsugs/zla 9zla 'gor khong gi mdzub ston 'og sa gnas so so'i mi dmangs kyi bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang char shul gyi sha mo bzhin mang du 'phel/ rgyal nang gi gsar brje'i gnas bab la gzhigs te tshes 26nyin sngar gyi dmag khang de mi dmangs bcings grol nges med rgol rdung ru khag gi spyi khyab las khungs su bsgyur cing / lo mjug tu drag chas spras pa'i 'thab mo ba'i dngos gzhi'i ru dpung ste 'byor med gral rim lu'i (7)dang po yongs su dbu brnyes/ khong gis 'go khrid mdzad bzhin pa'i mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag (nges med gol rdung ru khag dang dngos gzhi'i drag dpung )la dmag mi khri brgyad du 'phar zhing / rgyal yongs nas btsan 'dzul par rgol lan sprod pa'i nus pa mthor 'degs chen po byung / 'on kyang sgyid lug dang bag 'khum/ mun nagarnying zhen gyi mi rigs su zhig yin rung rang dbang dang 'dra mnyam brtson len byed pa'i brgyud rim du blo 'gyod dang pham kha los yod/ dper na thi'e thu'o yis rang srog 'ben ltar btsugs te dmangs dmag dang lhan du btsan 'dzul bar g.yul sprod pa'i skabs su/ srid gzhung rnying ba'i dmag dpung gis khong la rgyab skyor byed rgyu phar zhog da dung khong gi gzhug nas 'jab rgol gyis gsar brje'i dmag la shi rmas tshabs chen bzos pa dang / rgyal spyi'i steng dang mo si kho sogs kyis kyang sku nyid kyis 'go khrid mdzad pa'i nan gung khas len gtan nas ma byas stabs/ mi zhig yin tshe rang nyid kyi zhabs zung la brten nas mi tshe yi lam chen zhig gtod dgos pa las gzhan ngo 'tsho rgyu rang ma yin par dgongs nas/ bcings 'grol khul so so ru dgra bos bskyur ba'i dmag chas bzo grwa slar yang bkol spyod dang / tang mi rnams la krung go'i dmar dmag rgyang skyod kyi nyams myong ngo sprod mdzad de chod sems dang yid ches ni rgyal kha yin pa'i skul lcag gnang / 401

'dzam gling yongs su dmag 'khrug gi rdul 'tshub 'phyur bzhin pa'i lo rabs su thi'e thu'o nas sku dngos kyis g.yul 'gyed chen po bdun la blo 'don mdzad cing / khong ni snga ma gsum gyi sngon ma/ nam mkha'i sprin gyi thog ma zer ba'i dpe bzhin dus nam zhig gi tshe yang dmag dpung gi mdun du rgyug pa'i bu rgya stag 'dra ba zhig red/ 1943lo'i zla 6par 'jar man jag dmag gis kho tsho'i dmag sgar gyi mtha' bskor ba la khos dpon dmag yongs gang myur sgos phyir 'then bya dgos pa'i bka' phab/ tshes 6la 'thab mo ba rnams tshang tshing gi nags tshal gyis khebs pa'i ri sgang zhig brgyud bzhin pa'i tshe na/ dgra bo'i gnam gru'i tshur rgol thebs par shi rmas tshabs chen byung zhing tha na khong nyid kyi mchan khung g.yon par yang rmas ljid mo phog rung / khong gis rang nyid kyi 'chi gson la snang dogs spu tsam ma gnang bar na zug drag po myong bzhin mu mthud du dpon dmag yongs la lam ston mdzad de dgra bo'i zhags thag las shor/ don rkyen 'di'i dbang gis dmag 'khrug gi rjes su yu sgo si la wi ya mi dmangs kyis nga rgyal dang bcas thi'e thu'o ni 'khrug chen gnyis pa'i skabs su g.yul sa nas rmas phog pa'i dmag spyi chen mo gcig pu red ces bstod bsngags phul/ thi'e thu'o yis 'go khrid mdzad pa'i yu sgo si la wi ya mi dmangs kyis nyin mtshan bar med du g.yul 'thab dang dka' ngal yod tshad khyad du bsad de gsar brje'i las don la bsdud mar rgyal kha blangs/1942lo'i zla 11par h+pha shi sir rgol ba'i mi dmangs bcings grol u yon lhan khang dngos su dbu brnyes shing / lo gcig gi rjes su u yon lhan khang gi thengs gnyis pa'i tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs su sku nyid kyis rgyal khab chen mo kha shas kyi ngo rgol snang med du bzhag ste/ mi dmangs bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang de yu sgo si la slu ya'i gnas skabs srid gzhung du khyab bsgrags mdzad/gdi/ 2'gyur de te ho lan tshogs 'dur zhugs pa'i su'u len dang a ri/
