dbyin ji'i gtso 'dzin rnam pa'i khas len thob cing / dbyin jis thi'e thu'o la mna' 'brel rgyal khab khag gi rogs skyor dmag chas kyi gnang sbyin mdzad par ma zad/ su'u len gyis kyang sngar gyi lta tshul bsgyur te dngos su yu sgo si la slu yar dmag don blo 'don pa mngags nas mi dmangs kyi gsar brjer mdzub ston gnang / 194lo'i zla 2par 'dzam gling gi gnas bab dang mi dmangs kyi rgyab skyor thob rkyen mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag 'bum brgyad du 'phar snon byung yod la/ lo de'i zla 10par thi'e thu'o yis 'go khrid mdzad pa'i mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi ram 'degs 'og rgyal sa per ke le ti'i phyogs su dpung 'jug byas te rgyal sa'i mi dmangs yongs bcings 'grol btang / lo rjes ma'i zla 3par mnyam 'brel dmag dpung per lin gyi nye 'gram du 'byor ba'i 'phrin bzang thos 'phral khong gis dmag dpung la ches mjug mtha'i shi gson gyi g.yul 'gyed thengs shig bya dgos pa'i bka' phab/ zla 5pa'i tshes 15la yu sgo si la wi ya'i mnga' khongs yongs bcings 'grol btang ster h+pha shi sir rgol ba'i 'thab rtsod la rlabs chen gyi rgyal kha blangs/ khong gi mdzad rjes la bstod bsngags dang mi dmangs kyi lhag bsam mtshonaphyir du khong la dmag spyi chen mo dang mi dmangs kyi dpa' bo'i mtshan snyan gnang / zla 11tshes 29la yu sgo si la wi ya'i rgyal phran mnyam 'brel gyi mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes shing khong gis rgyal khab kyi kru'u zhi dang ཿdhi /bye ༵ ༵ snazlo / drag dpung gi dmag spyi chen mo sogs kyi 'gan gcig 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa'i rjes su/ston pa'i chos kyi 'go dka'/ 'jig rten 'khor ba'i mtha' dka' zhes pa'i dpe ltar rgyal khab cig dbu brnyes rgyu de las sla mo zhig ma shā/ la/

rgyal khab sra brtan dang 'phel rgyas su gtong rgyu ni de bas kyang las sla mo zhig ga la yin/ 'dzam gling gi 'gyur ldog ston ku'i gnam ngo bzhin su yis kyang tshod dpag bya thabs bral te/ 1948lor yo rlob gung khran tang dang bzo pa'i gsang 'phrin las khungs kyis yu sgo si la wi ya tang rtsa 'dzugs las phyir bskud pa dang / cher ma lon par yu sgo si la wi dang su'u len bar gyi 'brel bar sel zhugs stabs khong gis mi dmangs la blo sems pham dgos don ci yang med pa'i bslab bya gnang / spyi tshogs ring lugs gcig las ma mchis pa bden mod/ 'on kyang der bgrod pa'i lam sna gcig gis ga la tshad ces gsungs te/1952lor tang gi skabs drug pa'i tshogs chen du bzo pa rang skyong zhes pa'i dpal 'byor lam lugs la bcos bsgyur mdzad/ khong gis bstan don/ spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi bzo pa rang skyong srid jus lag len du bstar ba ni spyi tshogs kyi dpal 'byor dang chab srid kyi dgos mkho dang 'tsham par ma zad/ngal rtsol pa'i rang dbang dang rtsa ba'i khe dbang la gdeng 'jog thob pa mtshon thub la/ kho tsho phyogs yongs nas rang dbang can dang shes yon can/ gsar gtod can gyi ngal rtsol mkhan du 'gyur bar brtsi 'jog thob pa yin zhes gsungs/ 'di ltar ngal rtsol pa'i rin thang dang rang dbang la mthong chen gnang rkyen 1947— 1978lo'i bar bzo las kyi lo re'i cha snyoms 'phel tshad 97ru slebs/ 1979lor slebs tshe mi sger gyi yong 'bab sngar las ldab 3gyis 'phar snon byung zhing / 'dzam gling gi dpal 'byor 'phel tshad ches mgyogs pa'i rgyal khab cig tu gyur/thi'e thu'o ni rgyal nang 'dzugs skrun dang phyi 'brel don gcod gang gi thad du'ang rang nyid kyi bzhed tshul ltar phyag las gnang mkhan zhig yin te/sngar su'u len gyi ched mkhas rnams yu sgo si la wi ya nas phyir 'then byas rjes a / sdu/nga dbyin ji sogs nub phyogs rgyal khab kyis rogs skyor byed 'dod kyi

bsam tshul bstan pa la/ mig sngar mi dmangs kyi lto ba 'grang rgyu ni kha tsha dgos gtug gi don chen yin par dgongs te dga' mgu dang bcas zhal gyis bzhes/ 'on kyang rogs skyor dang sbrags pa'i chab srid kyi cha rkyen ci yang 'don mi chog par ma zad rogs skyor gyi ma dngul yang rgyal dmangs yong 'bab kyi 4phrolas brgal mi chog pa'i re ba bstan/ sku nyid kyis da dung ghi ri si dang thur khe'i srid gzhung la 〈par gan chings yig 〉bzhag cing o si khru ri ya dang dbyi tha li'i 'brel lam legs bcos gnang / a ri dang dbyin ji sogs nub phyogs rgyal khab khag la phyi 'brel 'gro 'ong gi lam lugs btsugs shing 1960lor a rir 'tshams 'drir phebs te mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs su gtam bshad gnang / 1961lo'i zla 9par thi'e thu'o yis mi lo gang mang la 'tshol zhib dang brtson 'grus kyi grub 'bras te/ skabs dang po'i mna' 'brel mi byed pa'i rgyal khab dang gtso 'dzin gyi tshogs 'du rgyal sa per ke la'o te nas 'tshogs shing / 'thus mi yongs kyis sngar song gi lo rgyus dang da lta'i gnas bab gang zhig la gzigs rung spyi tshogs kyi lam lugs sna tshogs 'dzam gling 'dir mnyam gnas byed thub pa bden mod/ 'on kyang rang btsan dang drang bden de btsan rgyal ring lugs sam mi ser spel ba'i ring lugs dang mnyam gnas byed thabs bral bar mos mthun byung / de'i rjes kyi tshogs 'du ci rigs kyi steng du khong gis lta ba 'di rgyun 'khyongs mdzad/ 1979lor ha wa na ru skabs drug pa'i gros tshogs bsdus par dgung grangs 87du son pa'i thi'e bu'o yis sku ngal dang nyen kha la ma 'dzems par tshogs 'dur phebs shing rang nyid gyi bzhed tshul bton/ sngar gyi rgyal khab 25tsam gyi rtsa 'dzugs de thengs de'i tshogs 'du ru rgyal khab 95dang rgyal khab 27tsam gyi lta zhib pa tshogs 'dur zur zhugs gnang / mna' 'brel mi byed pa'i las 'gul gyis 'phel rgyas su 'gro bzhin pa'i rgyal khab khag gi khe phan la srung skyob gang legasdu /ba

rkyen gyis/ 1977lo'i zla 8tshes 9la dgung grangs 85son pa'i thi'e thu'o krung gor 'tshams 'dri phebs shing krung go'i mi dmangs kyi gsar brje'i las don la thugs khur chen po gnang ste dpung ba mnyam gshib kyis mdun du bskyod pa'i re ba bstan/ thi'e thu'o yi sku tshe hril po ru mi'i rigs kyi las don la mdzad rjes bla med bzhag yod stabs kyis khong la snga gzhug tu rgyal khab 59tsam gyis gzengs bstod rtags ma 98dang rgyal khab gang mang gis 'dzam gling gi spyi dmangs zhes bla na med pa'i mtshan snyan gnang / yu sgo si la blu ya mi dmangs kyis kyang 1963lo'i zla 4tshes 7la 〈yu sgo si la wi ya rgyal phran mnyam 'brel spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi rtsa khrims 〉kyis khong nyid tshe dpon dang /1974lor yu sgo si la wi ya'i gung khran ring lugs kyi mnyam 'brel mthun tshogs kyis khong nyid sku tshe hril bo'i kru'u zhi ru bsko bzhag gnang /mi dmangs kyi bu drugaspyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes rjes thi'e thu'o ni dus dang rnam pa kun tu tang srid dmag gsum gyi 'go gtso gcig pu yin rung / dbang cha dang rgyu nor la rmongs mgo cung tsam yang ma 'thoms par mi dmangs la gnod pa'i bya ngan ci yang bsgrubs ma myong /khong nyid nam rgyun du mi ser gyi chas su zhugs pa'i sku bcar srung dmag re gnyis dang lhan du dmangs khrod du mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba dang thon skyed la rgyus lon byed du phebs myong / 1954lor khong nyid mtsho 'gram sa khul du lta zhib la phebs pa'i lam bar du/ sde ba chung chung zhig tu mdzes shing lta na sdug pa'i khang khyim zhig mchis la sgo 'gram du na so ha cang bgres pa'i rgan mo zhig bsdad 'dug pa mthong ma thag khong rlangs 'khor las babs te rgan por khadisdu sade min dris rjes 'tsho ba'i gnas tshul rgyus lon gnang bar/ kho mo

yid mgu tshad med skye bzhin thi'e thu'o rang khyim du gdan drangs te rgyan chang dmar pos khong la sne len gzab rgyas zhus/ khong gi sku 'khor dpon mi zhig yi ma rangs par kru'u zhi lags/ khyed nyid kho tshang lta bu zhig la phebs don ci yin/ kho mo tshang ni sa khul 'di'i chos lugs la dad mos ches che ba'i mi khyim zhig red ya ces zhus par/ thi'e thu'o yis nga ni yu sgo si la li ya mi dmangs kyi tsung thung yin pa las gung khran ring lugs pa tsam gyi tsung thung ma yin no zhes gsungs/ yang thengs shig sku nyid sa gnas kyi las byed pa zhig dang sku bcar srung dmag gcig bcas lhan du glog shugs mo tra ( sto)du bud/ kho tsho tshang ma mi ser gyi chas su zhugs yod stabs mi gcig gis kyang kho tsho ngos ma zin/thi'e thu'o yis sgor stong gcig can gyi tis nā ar zhig sprad de smyo blo mthun lags/ nga la 'dzin shog gsum btsong rogs ’ zhes gsungs pa la 'dzin shog btsong mkhan des tis nā ar stong gcig yin pa mthong ma thag khong khro dang bcas nga la 'di 'dra'i sgor mo mang po med ces lan btabs/ 8 khyed rang dgongs pa ma tshom/ nga la'ang 'di las mi 'dug ces nan gyis gsungs par/ 'dzin shog btsong mkhan de mgo bo dgye tsam yang mi byed par/'o na nga la yang 'dzin shog btsong rgyu med ces kha ya byas ma byung / dus der glog shugs mo tra 'dus pa'i mang tshogs kyis thi'e thu'o yin pa shes rjes 'dzin shog btsong mkhan la gshe gshe drag tu btang / kho mos mgo bo dgyes te bltas tsa na rang nyid kyi mdun du langs 'dug pa ni kru'u zhi yin pa shes 'phral dngangs 'tshab dang bcas yar langs nas dmag spyi chen mo lags/khyed kyis 'dzin shog nyo mi dgos zhes zhus pa na/ thi'e thu'o yis rgyu mtshan ci'i phyir du ngas 'dzin shog nyo mi dgos/ nga ni 'grul bzhud pa ma yin nam zhes gsungs te 'dzin shog nan gyis nyos/ khong gis rang nyid kyi bza' mi rnams kyis kyang dmigs bsal gyi dbang cha spyod par mos mthun gtanā /sa

med/ rang nyid kyi mi tshe rang nyid kyi zhabs 'og tu mchis la/ rang nyid kyi 'byor ba rang nyid kyi lag zung gis bskrun dgos pa'i zhal ta rgyun du gnang /thengs shig a ri'i 〈nyi'u yog tshags par 〉gyi gsar 'god pas khong la mi zhig 'jig rten tu ji ltar gson dgos pa dang / mi ji lta bu zhig da gzod rjes rabs pa'i sems khong du gson thub ces zhus par/ khong gis yu sgo si la wi ya'i snyan ngag pa chen mo ye ki hri'i 8 'jig rten 'tsho ba don ldan gyis/mdzad rjes mi zhig brag la 'debs ’ zhes pa'i gtam gyis lung drangs te mi zhig gis mi dmangs la phan pa'i bya ba phran bu tsam bsgrubs kyang / mi dmangasakyis mi de nam yang brjed mi srid par ma zad kho'ang 'jig rten du gson par bde skyid dang ldan pa yin zhes gsungs/ mthar 1980lo'i zla 5tshes tshul pu'u lor ya na grong khyer du thi'e thu'o sku gshegs shing dgung grangs 88du son yod do// //408

mar den ḍi na'i 'o rgyas kyi mi snaspags cana' rong /la ting me gling gi lo rgyus su srid 'gyur la brten nas rgyal srid mnga' brnyes shing yang bskyar srid 'gyur gyi khrod nas srid dbang shor ba'i gtso 'dzin bgrang gis mi langs rung / hu'u ad pe rong lta bu'i lo ngo bcu'i rjes su slar yang tsung thung gi khrir bzhugs pa nyin mo'i skar ma bzhin dkon par snang / 1943lor pe rong srid la zhugs pa nas bzung 1946 — 1955lo'i bar skabs gnyis la tsung thung dang / 1955lo nas mi lo bco brgyad ring phyi phyogs su bros byol du phebs dgos byung zhing / 1973lor thengs gsum par tsung thung du bdams la 1974lor sku gshegs/ pe rong gis srid 'gan bzhes ring du srid jus dang bcos bsgyur gal chen mang du mdzad phyir ar jen ḍi na'i lo rgyus kyi 'phel rgyas la shugs rkyen zab mo thebs shing / deng rabs la ting gling gi lo rgyus su byon pa'i 'byor ldan gral rim gyi chab srid pa chen po ru gyur/srid 'gyur bslangs pa/1895lor ar jen ḍi na'i phan phu zi rtswa thang gi 'brog khyim zhig tu pe rong (chungaX glo )sku bltams shing slob 'bring mthar phyin rjes dmag don slob gling nas slob gnyer gnang / rjes su dmag dpon slob grwa ru zab sbyong du'ang phebs myong / sku na gzhon dus nas bzung byis pa pra tshags shig yin te rta rgyug dang / dar shud/ mchong rgyug sogs la dga' zhen che zhing dmag yongs kyi gri rtsal 'gran bsdur du gser gyi rtags ma thob myong / khong gi sku tshe hril po ru dmag don tshan rig la zhib 'jug gting zab tu gnang bar ༵ byed

chab srid dang dpal 'byor/ lo rgyus/ spyi tshogs rig pa sogs kyi shes bya la'ang dbyer med du slob gnyer gnang zhing dbyi tha li'i skad dang dbyin skad/h+pha ran si'i skad sogs la sbyangs pa dpyis phyin par mdzad/ dmag dpon slob grwa nas thon rjes khong gis snga gzhug tu dmag don slob gling gi dmag don lo rgyus kyi slob dpon dang sde khag gi kru'u ren/ chi li dang dbyi tha li ru bzhugs pa'i drag rtsal dpon gyi 'gan sogs bzhes myong / 1941lo'i lo mjug ste rang lo 46stong da gzod hrang zha'o yi mtshan gnas thob/ 'on kyang lo ngo de dag tu khong gis bstud mar (1914lo'i 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gyi shar phyogs 'thab phyogs dang g.yul 'thab la dpyad pa 〉dang (dmag don lo rgyus kyi dran tho〉(bam bzhi ma)/ (1870lo'i dmag don dpung 'jug 〉ces pa'i mdzad rtsom mang du spel bar ar jen ḍi na'i dmag dpung khrod du khong gi snyan grags bla na med pa byung /1941lor pe rong dang rtogs sad kyi dmag dpon khag gcig gis dmag dpon gcig gyur gyi mda' shog ces pa gsar du dbu brnyes par/ mi rigs ring lugs kyi khyad chos mngon par ldan pa'i chab srid kyi tshogs pa 'di la dmag yongs kyi 75chadamag dpon gyi rgyab skyor thob/ 1943lo ni tsung thung 'dems pa'i lo zhig yin stabs skabs de'i rnying zhen dang log spyod tshogs khag gi gte bo ste/ tsung thung kha si ti lu'o yis rang gis blo 'gel chog pa'i nang mi zhig tsung thung du bsko ba'i lkog g.yo ngan jus bshams/ zla 6tshes 4la dmag dpon gcig gyur gyi mda' shog gis kha si ti lu'o yi srid dbang gi mgo rting brjes par/ pe rong gis gsang jus spyod pa dang srid 'gyur bsgrags gtam gyi 'char zin bcoms pa sogs byas rjes bla med bzhag yod/srid 'gyur la rgyal kha lon rjes sngar gyi skam dmag gi dmag spyi la smis li si sgog/sdu /bas kyi tsung thung du bdams shing pe rong gis ngal rtsol las bzo pa'i

pu'u yi pu'u krang gi 'gan bzhes/ mi su yis kyang mthong chen mi bya ba'i go gnasade ni khong gis rang 'gul sgos re ba zhus pa yin/ rgyu mtshan ni las don ci zhig bsgrub rung rgya che'i ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi rgyab skyor dang 'bral thabs med par gzhigs te/ las gnas dam 'dzin gyis bzo tshogs las 'gul khrod rang nyid kyi stobs shugs che ru gtong bar nus shugs yod rgu bton/ a ri'i srid gzhung gis ar jen ḍi na'i rgyal nang du srid 'gyur bslangs par blo sems ma bde ba dang / nang sgos su pe rong gi stobs shugs sngar bas rgya cher gyur bar zhed snang skyes te/ la smi li si la btsan gyis pe rong gi dbang shugs nyams dmas su gtong dgos pa'i re ba bton/ wa mo las snying chung ba'i sdar ma lā mis lis zis dmag dpon gcig gyur gyi mda' shog de khrims 'gal gyi rtsa 'dzugs shig dang pe rong gi dbang cha med par bzos pa na/ nyin gnyis pa ste 1944lo'i zla 2tshes 24la pe rong gis 'go khrid mdzad pa'i skam dmag ru dpung gis tsung thung gi rgya se'i me tog pho brang gi mtha' bskor cing tsung thung khri nas phabs/ gcig gyur drag dpung gi gtso 'gan bzhes pa'i 'og srid gzhung gsar du btsugs shing / kho tsho'i nang mi h+pha lis ar zer ba tsung thung dang pe rong skam dmag pu'u yi pu'u krang / zla 'ga'i rjes su bde blags ngang tsung thung gzhon par bdams thon byung /a'e wa dang gnyen bsgrigs pa/dmag dpon gcig gyur mda' shog ni pe rong gi chab srid las dbang la bsgyur bkod byed pa'i rgyu gtso bor gyur ba las gzhan/ chung ma a'e was kyang khong gi bsam blo'i shugs rkyen zab mo thebs yod/ 1943lo'i srid 'gyur rjes kyi nyin mo zhig la pe rong rgyang bsgrags las khungs kyis gnyer ba'i khrom tshogs su ltar mor phebs shing / ltad mo mjug rdzogs pa na ladī 1rdo zla

ltar rgyas pa'i gzhon nu ma zhig gis khong la gus 'dud dang bcas hrang zha'o pe rong lags/ khyed kyis nga tsho'i le tshan du rang re'i rgyal khab kyi 'tsho ba'i gnas bab thad du lta tshul zhig brjod na ci 'dra red ces khu byug lta bu'i gsung skad de thos pa na/ kho mo ni su zhig yin nam snyam/ kho mo ni thengs de'i khrom tshogs kyi rgyang bsgrags pa bud med a'e wa yin zhing / a'e wa ni zhing sde nas thon pa'i dwa phrug cig yin la slob gso yang legs po thob myong med/'on kyang kho mos rang nyid kyi brtson 'grus la brten nas deb mang po bklags myong bar ma zad/ rang nyid kyi skyes gzugs dang blo gros la brten nas gar la mkhas pa zhig kyang byed thub pa byung / gar ma zhig la mtshon na spyi tshogs kyi gral rim so sor 'brel 'dris kyi go skabs ldan phyir/ kho mo nam rgyun du dbul bo dang bzo pa'i gral rim gyi khrod du phebs nas brnyan 'phrin brgyud de mi dmangs kyi dka' sdug la dpyad brjod sna tshogs spel bar le tshan de la chab srid mi sna dang mi ser yongs kyi mig dbang gtod pa byung / 1936lor pe rong gi lcam sku zhabs grongs rjes/ khong gis sems shugs yod tshad rgyal nang gi 'thab rtsod dang bcoms chos rtsom par spyad cing rang nyid kyi 'tsho bas thugs 'dang gnang rgyu cher ma byung / thengs 'dir mkhyen rgya yangs shing lang tsho dar la babs pa'i gzhon nu ma 'di lta bu zhig la 'phrad pa de gnam gong mas gnang sbyin mdzad pa ltar snyam te kho mo'i yon tan dang lang tsho la yid kyi brtan pa dbang med du shor/ mi 'gyangs par a'e wa khong gi mi sger gyi drung yig dang lo gnyis kyi rjes su gcig sems gcig la brten bzhin lhan du mi tshe yi lam chen du bskyod 'go tshugs/ a'e wa ni drag bskyod kyi dmangs gtso'i ring lugs pa zhig yin phyir/ kho mos go skabs phran tsam yang chud zos su ma btang bar pe rong gis spyi tshogs kyi gnad don thag gcod dang / ngal rtsol padī /2 bab mthor 'degs gtong bar skul lcag rgyun du gnang / kho mo'i

shugs rkyen 'og pe rong gis dpal 'byor bcos bsgyur gyi ma lag cha tshang zhig bton cing / kho mo dang lhan du rgya che'i mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi 'tsho bar gzigs skyong dang lta zhib gnang du bskyod pas khong gi chab srid kyi go gnas sra brtan du gtong bar phan 'bras chen po thon/ 1945lo'i zla 10bar byung ba'i don rkyen de ni a'e wa'i 'jon thang mngon par dpe mtshon rang bzhin ldan pa'i don rkyen zhig red/rgya che'i mi dmangs dang dmag dpon chung 'bring rnams kyi rgyab skyor thob ched pe rong gis ngal rtsol pa'i zla phogs dang las khyur ngal gso'i ma dngul/ gyong gsab ma dngul/ spyi tshogs kyi phan bde'i ma dngul sogs je mang du btang zhing / na gzhon dmag dpon khag cig la hrang zha'o yi dmag thob bstsal te sngar gyi gcig gyur drag dpung gi stobs shugs je zhan du btang bar/ 'byor ldan gral rim che khag dang dmag dpon mtho khag gis khong la ya lan sprad/ 1945lo'i zla 10bar pe rong gi srid ya'am dbang chen bzung mkhan gyi tshab byed pa ste dmag spyi a wa lu'o sis ngo log zing 'khrug bslangs shing / pe rong gis dmag srid dbang cha yongs rdzogs phyir sprod dgos pa'i bsam 'char bton/ tshes 12la drag chas spras pa'i dmag dpon khag cig gis khong nyid khyim nas 'dzin bzung byas shing / skabs der a'e was log spyod mkhan de dag la gshe gshe drag po gtong bzhin rang nyid kyi lus pos pe rong la ji ltar 'gebs srung byas rung / ra ros myos pa lta bu'i dmag dpon de dag gis khong nyid btsan du rlangs 'khor la bcug ste btson rar bskyal/pe rong btsan gyis khrid pa mthong rjes kho mo skyes ma gzhan dag dang 'dra bar mchi ma shal ler ma bsdad par/ bzo tshogs kyi gtso 'dzin rnam par skyabs bcol te pe rong myur skyob kyi thabs jus la brel/ tshes 17nyin gyi nangs mor phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas thon pa'i bzo pa rnams rgya mtsho'i rba 4/zlos

'khrug pa bzhin/ rgya se'i pho brang mdun gyi zla lnga ba'i thang chen du zhogs yong nas 66pe rong phyir sprod cig pe rong phyir sprod cig ces pa'i 'bod sgras gnam sa g.yo ba lta bu'i 'jigs snang chen po zhig bzos pa la/ dngangs 'tshab langs pa'i tsung thung h+pha lir gyis mtsho dmag gi btson khang du bkag nyarabyas yod pa'i pe rong de ma thag btson grol gtong rgyu dang dpon gnasaslar gso dgos pa'i bka' phabs/ mtshan mo der tsung thung pho brang gi nyi g.yab steng du pe rong gis mi grangs sum 'bum tsam la spro sems rab tu 'khol ba'i gsung bshad gnang / nga rang dus dang rnam pa kun tu rgyal khab kyi 'dzugs skrun la rngul khrag 'don bzhin pa'i mi dmangs dang lhan du mchis zhes glog rlabs brgyud nas rgyal yongs su khyab bsgrags mdzad/ zla bcu ba'i don rkyen gyi rjes nas mi dmangs kyi sems su pe rong dpa' bor gyur cing 1946lo'i zla 6tshes 24la dmangs yongs kyis mgrin gcig tu gsol ba'i ngor tsung thung gi khrir bzhugs/lo bcu la srid 'gan bzhes pa/pe rong gi dbang sgyur la rtsa ba'i khyad chos gnyis ldan te gcig ni mi rigs kyi dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas dang / gcig shos ni ngal rtsol ba dang 'byor ldan pa'i bar gyi 'gal ba 'dum rgyu de red/ ngag rgyun la'ang mi gsar la a gsar che zer ba'i dpe bzhin/ pe rong gis kyang srid 'gan bzhes ma thag rlabs chen gyi bya gzhag 'ga' zhig gi 'go brtsams myong ste/dang po/ ar jin ḍi na rang btsan thob pa nas bzung dus yun ring po'i lo rgyus su dbyin ji'i tshong las kyi mi ser spel yul du gyur cing / 'khrug chen gnyis pa'i rjes su'ang a ri'i ma rtsas btsan 'dzul thebs par brten/akā rdo/ ḍi na'i mi rigs dpal 'byor gyi 'phel rgyas la bkag 'gog tshabs

chen bzos yod par mthong ste/ pe rong gis phyi rgyal ba'i lag tu tshud pa'i dngul khang dang lcags lam/ kha par gyi dra ba sogs ma dngul 'bor chen btang ste slar nyos shing mi rigs dpal 'byor gyi 'phel rgyas dang rang khyim rang bdag la mthun rkyen bzang po bskrun/gnyis pa/ zhing las ni rgyal khab 'di'i rgyal dmangs dpal 'byor gyi rtsa ba yin par dmigs te bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi sa zhing lam lugs med par bzos nas/ zhing pa yongs la sa zhing snyoms bgo thub pa byung na zhing las kyi thon skyed nus shugs gong 'phel du gtong bar byed nus chen po 'don thub par snyam mod/ blo phangs pa zhig la sa zhing bcos bsgyur de rnam pa tsam las sngar yod kyi zhing bdag chen po dag la gnod skyon ci yang thebs ma byung /gsum pa/ lo lnga'i 'char gzhi bton te rgyal khab bzo las can du bskyod par skul ma mdzad/ khong gis snga gzhug tu rdo snum gter kha'i do dam las khungs dang mtsho 'grul kung zi/ mkha' 'grul kung zi sogs rgyal gnyer khe las mang du btsugs shing / mu mthud du yang ba'i bzo las 'phel rgyas su gtong ba'i dus mtshungs su ngar lcags dang rlangs 'khor/ rdzas bzo/ glog rdul 'phrul chas sogs kyi bzo las la'ang rgyab skyor mdzad pa'i mthar pe rong gi skabs dang po'i tsung thung gi 'gan 'khur yun mjug rdzogs pa na/ar jen ḍi na'i thon skyed las rigs yongs 1946lo las 84 77gyis 'phar snon byung zhing / gang sa gang du 'phel rgyas kyi rnam pas khengs 'dug1945— 1955lo'i lo 10tsam gyi dus yun du bzo pa'i zla phogs50nya'aphar snon byung zhing / srid gzhung dang gros khang du'ang bzo ba dbul por 'thus mi'i thob thang gnang bar ma zad/ dmigs bsal gyi sbyong brdar thob pa'i bzo ba kha shas la phyi rgyal du mngag gtong gis gzhung tshab khang gi tshan tsan gyi las 'gan yang gnang myong / srid dbang sra brtan du gtong ched 191/sbyar

khong gis gsar brje tang gcig pu (rjes su pe rong ring lugs pa'i tang dang drang bden tang sogs su ming bsgyur )zhes pa gsar 'dzugs gnang bar/rgya che'i ngal rtsol mi dmangs dang 'byor ldan pa'i mthun sgril la phan cung tsam thogs kyang ngo bo'i steng nas 'gyur ldog cher ma byung /rgyal spyi'i las don gyi thad du pe rong yang gtso 'dzin gzhan dag dang 'dra bar rang rgyal gyi khe phan srung skyob byed mkhan zhig yin te/ 'dzam gling gi rgyal khab su yis kyang rang rgyal gyi nang srid la the gtogs bya mi chog cing /rang dbang gi rgyal khab cig gi ngos nas rgyal spyi'i las don gyi khrod du nga tshos rang nyid kyi khe phan dang 'tsham pa'i lam bu zhig 'ded nges yin zhes 1946lor su'u len dang phyi 'brel 'brel ba btsugs shing / a ri lta bu'i 'dre lag bsrings mkhan rnams la ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu mdzad/ 1951lor khong nyid yang bskyar tsung thung du bdams thon byung / 'on kyang rgyal spyi'i gnas bab la dza drag che zhing pe rong gis dpal 'byor gyi srid jus kha shas la nor 'khrul byung pa/ a ri'i sger sdem rtsa 'dzugs kyi gnon shugs drag po'i 'og lo rabs 50pa nas bzung / ar jen ḍi na'i rgyal spyi'i tshong ra nyin bzhin je chung dang dpal 'byor gyi rnam pa je sdug tsong rdzas kyi rin gong je mtho nas je mtho ru 'phar ba'i rkyen gyis mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba'i chu tshad je dman du gyur cing / ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyis srid gzhung la mi 'dod pa'i rnam pa nyin bzhin je sdug tu gyur/ khong gi snying sdug gi chung ma a'e wa yang mi yul dang gtan du zhal gyes stabs khong la bzod glags bral ba'i sdug bsngal chen po zhig ngang gis skye dgos byung / ar jen ḍi na'i mi dmangs kyis gnam bdag chos lugs la dad stabs chos tshogs la bla na med pa'i stobasashugs ldan/ a'e wa tshe las 'das rjes gnam bdag chos tshogs kyis bzo padī kār cha mthon por bsgrengs te pe rong srid gzhung la ya lan sprad/

1955lor bya thabs bral ba'i pe rong gis zing cha slong mkhan gyi chos dpon gnyis mthar skyod btang bar/ h+phan ting snyang gis pe rong phyi rol bar brtsis te chos khongs las phyir bskud par khyab bsgrags byas pa des mi dmangs yongs ha las dgos pa byung zhing pe rong srid gzhung la yang g.yo 'gul thebs 'go tshugs/ pe rong srid gzhung la rgol lan sprod mkhan gyi gte bo ni chos tshogs las gzhan da dung dmag dpon khrod kyi g.yon lhung tshogs khag kyang yin te/ 1955lo'i zla 6tshes 6la mtsho dmag gis srid 'gyur bslangs shing /tsung thung gi pho brang la gnam grus 'bar mdel dbyugs kyang khong la gsang bsgron pa'i stabs kyis da gzod 'chi ma dgos pa tsam byung / srid 'gyur gyi rjes su khong gis nag nyes can re 'ga' las khrims chad gcod ma thub pa'i mthus zla gsum gyi mtshams su/ skam dmag dang mtsho dmag mkha' dmag bcasakyi dmag dpung yod tshad kyis mdung kha khong gcig pu la gtad pa na/pe rong gis srid dbang slar sprad de yul gzhan du 'khyam dgos byung / dus de nas bzung ar jen ḍi na'i srid dbang de gzhi nas dmag srid kho nas dbang sgyur gyi dus rim du tshud/yul grur ba'i 'tsho ba/1955lo'i zla 9nyin mo zhig la pe rong mi ser gyi chas su zhugs te gru gzings chung ngu zhig gi gcal 'og tu 'dzul nas/ pa ra ge'i (༅ṣ+ṭha༅)rgyal sa ya sung sin du phebs te mi lo bcu'i ring gi yul gyar ba'i 'tsho ba rol dgos byung / lo ngo de dag gi ring du khong nyid sdong lo rlung 'khyer bzhin pa ra ge nas ni kha ra kwa (khu717lo)/ ni kha ra kwa nas pa na ma/ we ba ne tsu'o la/to smi ni khan (lkosko775)sogs rgyal khab tu gnas yul nges med du 'grims/1956lor pa na ma ru pe rong ming la dbyis zi per zer ba'i gar ma zhi~X /nga

rmeng 'phrad cing / lo lnga'i rjes su pe rong gis /rtag ca ca gnyen thengs gsum par bsgrigs/sa 1961lor pe rong si phen du 'byor ba nas tsho rang tsho bzung 1972la slebs rag tu rgyal khab ri / 'di nas 'tsho ba dang phyag las gnang /7 sngar mi dmangs sems khong gi dpa' bo dang rgyal khab kyi gtso 'dzin zhig da lta khyi bzhin du gzhan sgo 'grim dgos pa ha cang blo phangs dgos pa zhig yin yang / khong phe ngapero yid ma pham par da dung sngar mus bzhin yul rgyar du bas pa' nga / rgyal khab la thugs khur chen po gnang ste nam nyin zhig la mes rgyal du log pa'i re 'dun drag po bcangs yod/drang por bshad na pe rong srid gzhung gi mgo rting bslogs rjes pe rong ring lugs pa'i las 'gul mtha' dag la tshod 'dzin thebs/ 'on kyang gsar brje dang mi rigs shig gi re ba'i me stag de tsam gyis sod pa zhig ga la yin/ pe rong ni sngar bzhin rgyal nang gi pe rong ring lugs pa'i gtso 'dzin gcig pu dang khong gi gsung bshad dang mdzub ston sna tshogs kyang sgrar phabs te/ ar rjen ḍi na'i pe rong ring lugs pa'i khrod du dar khyab chen po byung /phyi yi rgyal kha mi lon par nang gi sgye kha gzhags zer ba'i dpe bzhin thengs shig la kho tsho'i nang khul du 'thab rtsod byung bar/ pe rong gis lcam sku zhabs dbyis zi per ar jen ḍi na ru ched mngags kyis 'dum 'grig gi las la 'bad du bcug nga tsho su yis kyang shes gsal ltar nang khul gyi mthun sgril ni rgyal kha'i rtsa ba yin/ khong gzhan yul 'grims pa'i mi lo bco brgyad du rgyal nadī/ 8rnam pa yang de 'dra'i dga' 'os pa zhig gtan nas ma yin te/ kho

chos snga gzhug tu tsung thung brgyad brjes kyang dpal 'byor gyi rnam par 'gyur ldog phran tsam yang 'byung ma thub/ lo rabs 40ba'i mjug nas 50pa'i stod tsam du ar jen ḍi na ni lā tin a me ri kha'i ches 'byor phyug ldan pa'i rgyal khab cig yin/ pe rong khri las phabs rjes par tsir (kham)dang mo zhi kho ma zad/ chi li dang kho lom pi ya/ phe ru sogs kyang ar jen ḍi na las brgal te 'phel rgyas chen po byung / 1972lor rgyal nang gi thon skyed 'phel tshad de gling yongs kyi ches mjug mtha'i ang rim gsum pa ste lo der dngul lor 'grem thal shor tshad 867tu zin yod/ pe rong gi skabs su za khang nas kha zas thengs gcig za bar (sha dang khu ba/ zhog khog mngar zas chang kha gles sogs yod )a sgor gcig tsam las mi dgos rung da lta a sgor gsum du 'phar yod/ mi ser gyi 'tsho ba nyin bzhin thabs chag tu gyur cing ma 'ongs par re thag chad pa'i tshe na/ kho tshos yang bskyar lus la dmag chas spras pa'i pe rong dang dkar mdog gi lwa ring mnabs pa'i a'e wa'i 'dra par phyir bton te/ khong tshor gus 'dud zhus shing re sgug gi bsam 'dun nyin bzhin je drag tu gyur/ sngar pe rong gis slob gso dang rig rtsal la tshod 'dzin gyi srid jus lag len du bltar bar rgya che'i shes ldan mi snar dgongs 'gal chen po bzos/ da lta phyir 'dang re brgyab tshe khong yang blo 'gyod drag po skyes byung /khos rang nyid kyi nor 'khrul khas len dang lhag bsam mtshon ched du cwa gis ya zer ba'i mkhas dbang zhig mā ti li ru gdan drangs/ cwa zhis ya zhu ba ni ar jen ḍi na'i gnam gshes rig pa ba zhig yin la slob chen gyi slob gtso'i 'gan yang bzhes myong / sngar pe rong gi nor 'khrul srid jus la rgol gtam drag tu btang zhing ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byed mkhan zhig yin/ de bas kyang sdug pa la dmag mis srid dbang bzung rjes spyi tshogs kyi 'phel rgyas dang mi ser gyi 'tsho ba je sdug tu gyur cing mi rnams gson pa las shi na dga' snya/1 sna'i

gnas su gyur/ thengs 'dir cwa zhis ya dang zhal 'dzoms par khos rang nyid kyi sngar song gi nor 'khrul la nongs 'gyod chen po skyes tshul dang / rang nyid kyis ji ltar mi rigs dang rgyal khab rjes lus kyi 'dam rdzab las skyob rgyu'i thad dugasung gleng yun du mdzad par/ cwa zhis ya sems 'gul thebs shing rgyal nang du'ang gsar brje zhig med du mi rung bar dgongs te shes ldan mi sna'i dpung khag gis khong gi nor 'khrul gu yangs ster bar rang nus yod rgu 'don pa'i bsam tshul bstan/ pe rong gis khong la yid ches dang thugs rje zhu ched du cwa zhis yas 'go khrid mdzad pa'i rig gnas dang ched mkhas khag cig gis ma 'ongs pa'i pe rong srid gzhung la srid 'dzin rtsa don rtsom dgos pa'i zhu ba phul/ 1972lor pe rong gis pha ra ku'e dang phe ru/ mo zhi kho ko sogs kyi rgyab skyor thob ched rgyal khab 'di dag la 'tshams 'drir phebs shing go skabs 'di dang bstun nas phyir rgyal nang du log ste chab srid kyi gtso 'dzin gzhan dag dang mna' 'brel gyis rang nyid la blo sems dkar pa'i khen po lha tsung thung gi sku tshab dang mtshams sbyor gnang / khan po lā tsung thung du bdams rjes khos pe rong gi bka' gsung ltar gang myur sgos mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba dang 'brel ba dam zab tu mchis pa'i dngul lor 'grem thal shor ba'i gnad don thag gcod gnang zhing / zla 6pa'i zla mjug tu slebs tshe mi ser gyi 'tsho ba'i gron dngul 2 97tsam mar babs shing srid jus la mngon gsal dod po'i grub 'bras blangs/srid 'gan slar bzhes pa/1973lo'i zla 6tshes 20la khan po lha'i phebs rogs 'og pe rong phyir rgyal nang du log par/ rgyal spyi'i gnam gru thang gi rtswa thang du khong la mi da~X sa ya 'gas skye bo'i blo las 'gongs pa'i dgyes ston bshams/

dga' spros myos pa'i mi ser gyis pe rong la bstod glu len pa dang kha dog sna lnga'i dar cha nags ltar 'dzing ba/ pe rong gi gzugs ris phab pa'i shog bya mkha' dbyings su lding skor rgyag pa/ phug ron 1800(phug ron 1rtsiyis pe rong yul gyar du phebs pa'i lo gcig mtshon )dus gcig tu 'phur te pe rong khri lo brtan par shog ces pa'i kha g.yang dang ki bsro bar med du bsgrags/zla 1tshes 13la khan po lhas srid dbang slar phul te pe rong tsung thung du 'dems par mthun rkyen bskrun/ zla gnyis kyi mtshams su pe rong bde blags ngang tsung thung dang dbyis zi per tsung thung gzhon par bdams/ rgyal spyi'i las don gyi thad la pe rong dus rtag tu 'phel rgyas su 'gro bzhin pa'i rgyal khab khag dang lhan du btsan rgyal ring lugs dang mi ser spel ba'i ring lugs/sger sdom ring lugs la ngo rgol mdzad pa dang thengs mang por pe rong gis a ri dang su'u len gyi dbang rtsod la skyon brjod dang la ting a me ri kha'i mi dmangs kyis mthun sgril byed dgos pa'i gal chen rang bzhin bstan/ khong gi bsam par nga tsho lā ting a me ri kha'i mi dmangs kyis gang myur sgos mthun sgril ma byas tshe/ spyi lo 2000du slobs dus nga tsho gzhan 'og tu tshud par gdon mi za zhes bstan/ 1973 — 1974lo'i bar khong gis mgyogs myur ngang 'phel rgyas su 'gro bzhin pa'i rgyal khab 23lhag la phyi 'brel 'brel ba btsugs shing / lā ting a me ri kha'i rgyal khab khag gis gter kha srung skyob dang rgyal nang gi khe phan srung skyob la'ang byed nus gal chen bton/ mi dmangs kyi 'tsho bar legs bcos dang spyi tshogs gong 'phel du gtong phyir khong gis srid 'gan bzhes ma thag lo gsum gyi 'char gzhi gtan 'bebs gnang zhing pe rong ring lugs pa'i rgyab skyor la brten nas tang khag sna tshogs dang dmag yongs/ rgyal khab phyi nang gi mi 'jon thang can dang mthun sgril gnang ba'i mthus rgyal khab 'di la cung mthun sgril dang bde 'jags ༵ sas

shig mngon byung /lo gsum gyi 'char gzhis grub 'bras nges can zhig blangs pa bden mod kyang / 'di lta bu'i log spyod dang rjes lus kyi rgyal khab cig la mtshon na des kyang phan nus cher 'don ma thub par ma zad/ pe rong ring lugs pa'i nang khul gyi 'thab rtsod nyin bzhin rnyog 'dzing dang 'jigs skul mi snas spyi tshogs la zing cha mang du bslangs/ 1974lo'i zla 1tshes 1la ar jen ḍi na'i nye rabs kyi lo rgyus su nyi zla ltar gsal snying nger 'dug pa'i skyes chen pe rong stabs ma legs par sku gshegs shing dgung grangs 79son/ pe rong sku gshegs rjes khong gi zhal chems bzhin dbyis zi per tsung thung du bsko bzhag bstsal/ 'on kyang kho mo ni 'jon thang bral ba'i bud med nyam chung zhig yin phyir rgyal khab 'phel rgyas su gtong rgyu phar zhog rgyal nang gi gnas tshul sngar bas thabs chag tu gyur/ 1976lo'i zla 3par dmag mis srid 'gyur bslangs shing dbyis zi per gyi srid dbang 'phrog lo 'di nas bzung pe rong ring lugs kyi las 'gul mtha' dag la srid gzhung gi chod 'dzin thebs kyang /ar jen ḍi na'i srid stegs su kho tsho ni sngar bzhin chab srid kyi tshogs khag gal chen zhig ste/ 1983lor pe rong ring lugs pas tang khag gzhan dag dang mthun sgril gyis dmag mi'i srid gzhung la rgol lan sprad de/ kho tsho'i chab srid kyi las 'gul la bkag rgya med par bzo rgyu dang lo mjug tu srid dbang slar sprod pa'i khas len byed du bcug 1983lo'i 'dems bsko ru nang mi phan tshun dgrar langs rkyen gyis pe rong ring lugs par mi dmangs kyi 397yi rgyab skyor las ma thob rung / kho tsho sngar ltar rgyal khab 'di'i tang khag gal chen zhig yin par ma zad/ ar rjen ḍi na'i mi dmangs mdun skyod dang 'phel rgyas kyi bgrod lam du bag chags zab mo 'jog pa'i chab srid kyi rtsa 'ardo/sdu shig yin par gdon mi za'o// / /

lagayogasagasasbyong thung gi khrir 'dzegs pa'i sa ta'/1981lo'i zla 10tshes 6la e cib kyi rgyal sa khe rlo'i nye 'gram du dmag dpung gzigs zhib kyi mdzad sgo bsdus par/ lus su dmag chas spras pa'i ma'o hwa ma'o rdi yan bā ar sa ta thi srid gzhung gi dpon blon rnams dang lhan du zangs nag gis bskrun pa'i gzigs zhib stegs bu ru bzhengs te/gdong la blo tshim pa'i mdangs shig mngon bzhin drag chas dmag dpung la gzigs 'dugachu tshod 12dang skar 55steng mdzad sgo mjug bsdu la nye ba'i tshe na/ me skyogs riri 'khor lo zhig las dmag mi bzhi gang — myur sgos phyir mchong ste khong gi phyogs su shar mar brgyug song ba la/ mi rnams kyi sems su tsung thung la gus 'dud zhu ba'i mo lasa'aganazhigalosayodasnyam satazikhong nyid kyang mdun du gom chen zhig tsung thung sa ta thi/spos nas gus 'dud byed par rtsom pa na dmag mi gcig gis glo bur du lag 'bom zhig kho'i gam du 'phangs pa dang bstun/ gnam rdibs pa lta bu'i ldir sgra zhig grags shing rang 'gul me mda' bzhi bos dus gcig tu ngar skad sgrog pa'i g.yu 'brug bzhin khong la gtad de 'phangs par/ sa ta thi'i ༵༵ su

mde'u mang du phogs te zungs khrag gis gzigs shab sdings cha'ang dmar por btang / sku srung dmag dpung gis gang myur sgos sman khang du bskyal rung rngo cher ma thogs par tsung thung sku gshegs shing dgung grangs 63du pon yod/mi mi kha med na shi ni yin/ rtswa bsil ba med na skam ni yin zer ba'i dpe ltar khong lta bu'i chab srid pa chen po zhig la mtshon na khong nyid sku gshegs pa'i 'phrin gsar de 'dzam gling gi yul gru so so ru gleng gzhi chen po zhig tu gyur/mi la las mi'i rigs kyi skyes chen zhig nga tsho dang gtan du zhal gyes song snyam pa dang / yang mi la las bdud rgan zhig tshar bcad song snyam pa'i dga' spro tshad med skyes/ 'o na sa ta thi dngos gnas ji lta bu'i skyes bu zhig red snyam na nga tshos khong gi rma med kyi mdzad rjes la phyir dran zhig byed de/rgyal gces kyi gzhon nu/1918lor nā ye 'o chu bo'i zur gsum sa khul gyi sde chung zhig tu sa ta thi sku 'khrungs/ 1882lo nas bzung mi'i rigs rig gnas kyi 'byung khungs e cib de dbyin rgyal khab chen mo'i mnga' khongs su tshud yod la/ 1922lor ming thog nas rang btsan thob rung don dngos su sngar bzhin dbyin ji'i mi ser spel yul du gyur yod/ byis dus kyi sa ta thi rmo bo'i gtam rgyud la nyan rgyur spro zhing gtam rgyud de dag las kyang khong la skul shugs chen po thob myong /dper na gtam rgyud cig tu sde dmangs skor zhig gis sngar gdug rtsub dang ci byed la gnas med pa'i dbyin ji'i dmag mi zhig dmar gsod btang bar/log spyod pas sde mi rnams 'dzin bzung byas te lcag gis bsnun pa dang gnam la dpyangs pa sogs mnar gcod tshad med btang bar ma zad/ kho tsho'i gtso 'dzin la ya nga ba'i srog khrims nan mo bcad/ yang yang nyan mthar khong gis gta / /da 'di shar mar blo nas kyang skyor thub/

slob 'bring nas bzung khong slob grogs tsho dang lhan du khrom skor sna tshogs su zhugs myong / 1932lor 'phags mchog snyan dis kyis e cib la 'tshams 'drir phebs shing khong gis rgyal nang mi dmangs la 'go khrid mdzad de mnyam las mi byed pa'i las 'gul spel bzhin pa'i sgang yin stabs/dbyin ji'i tshong zog mi bkol ba'i phyir du khong gis rang nyid kyis 'thag pa'i srol rgyun gyi btso ras srab mo zhig las sku la ci yang mnabs med pa dang /khong gi gtam rgyud kyis na gzhon gyi sa ta thi la skul ma chen po thebs te snyan dis la lad zlos kyis btso ras srab mo zhig lus la gyon zhing / rang nyid kyis yul ras 'thag rgyu'i 'dun pa bcangs pa dang tha na rang nyid gcig pu khang ba'i yang steng du bud de bsam gzhigs gnang khul sogs mdzad par/ khong gi yab kyis 'di lta bu tsam gyis e cib mi rigs dang rgyal khab kyi mdun lam la phan ci yang mi thogs pas mi tshad/ rang nyid kyi lus po'i bde thang la'ang gnod nges red ces bka' slob gnang bar brten khos da gzod lan zlos byed mtshams bzhag khe ro'i dmag don slob gling du slob gnyer gnang skabs ci mar gyi rtogs brjod la gzigs pa na/ ci mar kyis thur khe'i mi dmangs la 'go khrid mdzad de drag po'i 'os langs kyis btsan 'dzul mkhan mthar skyod btang zhing / su'u tan gyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin dbang sgyur mgo rting bslogs te 'byor ldan gral rim gyi spyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes pa'i snying stobs dang gzi brjid kyis khong la bag chags zab mo thebs shing /khong gis kyang dmag dpung la brten nas dbyin ji'i mi ser spel mkhan la rgol lan sprod rgyu'i dam bca' phul/ dmag sgar du khong 'thab grogs rnams dang lhan du e cib kyi gnas bab dang ma 'ongs par bgro gleng bya rgyur spro snang che la/ de dag gi gras su ming la na ser zer ba'i dmag dpon zhig kyang mchis/ 1938lor rang lo 20son pa'i sa ta thi dmag don slob gli6 rdzus

mthar phyin te skam dmag hra'o we yi dmag thob blangs/ 1941lo'i lo mjug tu sa ta thi skam dmag gi jus dpon i rag (777)tu bros byol du 'gro pa'i gsang jus la zhugs shing / lam bar du gnam gru'i snum zad stabs log spyod pas 'dzin bzung thebs mod/ 'on kyang nag nyes ci yang bgrang du med par gzhigs te kho tshos glod grol btang /khong gis dbyin jir rgol lan bslog ched du 'jar man nas byed nus mtho ba'i tar gtong 'phrul chas mngags nyo dang / mi rtsa 'dzugs kyis me mda' bzo bzhin pa'i gnas tshul sogs log spyod pas thos 'phral/ kho nga nyid yang bskyar 'dzin bzung thebs te dpon gnas phyir 'then par ma zad/mi ser spel ba'i srid gzhung gi bkag sdom srid jus dang 'gal bar khag bzhag ste khrims thag bcad/ khong gis zas kham gang yang ma bzhes par btsonakhang la ya lan sprad de bstud mar nyin 'ga'i mtshams su kho'i dran pa thor zhing sman khang du mi skyel thabs med byung / gnas de ru khong gis sman pa'i gsung bkod nang bzhin ngal gso gang legs gnang rkyen lus phung mgyogs myur ngang bde thang byung / gung tshigs kyi skabs su mi rnams kyis 'tshang kha shig shig tu zas rtsod rgyag bzhin pa'i glags dang bstun/ sngar nas bzung sman khang gi phyi rol du sgug 'dug pa'i rlangs 'khor du bud de mda' mo ltung nas shor ba bzhin log spyod pa'i sdug 'og nas bros/ 'on kyang khong nyid byi ba grong na rgyu ba bzhin da dung log spyod pa'i 'dzin bzung la sems khur bya dgos stabs/ khos rang ming brjes shing 'khyam po'i cha lugs kyis skyel 'dren gla ba'i dpung khag tu zhugs te ngan ngon gyi 'tsho ba rol/ 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa'i rjes su sngar gyi bkag sdom srid jus kyis chab srid kyi byed nus ci yang 'don mi thub pa mthong tshe/ khong nyid yang bskyar mi ltar gasdishā sang dbyin ji'i mi ser spel ba'i dbang sgyur dang e cib gong ma'i lam

lugs kyi mgo rting bslog pa'i gsang jus sna tshogs 'god pa la zhugs shing /khong gi tshogs mi zhig gis dbyin jir rgyab skyor byed mkhan gyi sku drag cig dmar gsod btang bar/ khong yang dogs yod nyes can gyi ming gis 'dzin bzung thebs shing spyi tshogs yongs kyi skyon brjod dang khyad par du gsar 'gyur las rigs kyi rgyab skyor la brten nas/ lo gnyis dang phyed ga'i rjes su khong slar yang btson grol btang / na ser gyi yid rton rung ba'i rjes 'brang ba/na ser gyi thugs khur dang rogs ram 'og khong nyid yang bskyar dmag dpungagi gral du tshud cing dpon gnas slar gso mdzad/ na ser gyis 'go khrid mdzad pa'i rang dbang dmag dpon gyi rtsa 'dzugs la sngar byung ma myong ba'i 'phel rgyas byung ste/ 1950lor na ser gyis gsar brje'i mdzub ston u yon lhan khang (dang thog gsar brje'i u yon lhan khang zhes 'bod )zhes pa dbu brnyes shing / sa ta thi ni de'i khrod kyi u yon zhig yin la na ser gyi dpral ba'i mig dang khog pa'i snying ltar gces pa'i dmag dpon zhig kyang red/1952lor na ser gyis 'go khrid mdzad pa'i gsar brje yis gong ma'i rgyal rabs theg med du btang ste e cib spyi mthun rgyal khab dngos su dbu brnyes/thengs de'i gsar brje'i khrod sa ta thi'i las 'gan ni kha par brgyud nas 'os langs dmag dpung so sor 'brel gtug bya rgyu dang / rjes su rgyang bsgrags bdag gnyer bar bskos te gsar brje'i srid jus sna tshogs khyab bsgrags dang / gong mar mtha' mjug gi tha tshig bsgrags mkhan sogs kyi 'gan rlabs chen bzhes/ gsar brje la rgyal kha lon rjes nang khul du dbang rtsod byung bar sa ta thi blo sems 'gyur med kyis na ser dang lhan du 'greng ste na cis pu'u dang tsung thung gzhon pa a mis ar sogs kyi tshur rgol phastu snar

brgyab/ 1954lor na ser gyis srid 'gan bzhes rjes sa ta thi'i go gnas kyang g.yu 'brug dgung du bgrod pa bzhin rgyal srung blon chen/ gros tshogs kyi tshogs gtso gzhon pa dang tshogs gtso/ tsung thung gzhon pa sogs su bsko 'jog gnang / sa ta this dus dang rnam pa kun tu srid gzhung gi phyi nang srid jus yod tshad la rgyab skyor dang nam yang khengs skyungs dang zhi dul gyi sgo nas na ser la ya thod kyi mig ltar brtsi bkur bla med mdzad pa'i mthus/1971lo'i zla 9bar na ser sku gshegs rjes/ sa ta thi tsung thung gi khrir 〉〉kār+sha ༷rdo ༵༵ nyid kyi mi tshe yi gar stegs su rlabs chen gyi bya gzhag sgrub zla bcu ba'i g.yul 'gyed/sa ta this srid 'gan bzhes ma thag sde bshig gi gte bo dang brag bshig gi a bra zer ba'i dpe bzhin gte bo yod tshad tshar bcad de srid dbang sra brtan du btang / na ser gyi sku ring nas bzung su'u len gyi 'brel ba je sdug tu 'gro bzhin mchis/ 1972lo'i zla 7par sa ta this e cib la rogs skyor du phebs pa'i su'u len gyi ched mkhas 1500dang dmag chas yod tshad phyir 'then bya dgos pa'i bka' phabs/ bod kyi kha dpe la dgra gnyis byung na dgra gcig pang du len zer ba'i dpe bzhin a ri dang 'brel lam legs bcos mdzad/ mi rnams kyis a ri dang 'brel lam legs bcos gnang ba de dbyi si ral (14sto//)dang 'dum 'grig byed 'dod pa red snyam rung / glo bur ba'i don rkyen zhig ni 1973lo'i zla 10tshes 1la sa ta this dmag yongs la g.yul 'gyed kyi sta gon byed pa'i bka' phab/ tshes 6sto spyozhu e zhi'i (7〉〉)sdig bshags kyi nyin mo ru sa ta this phyogs yongs nas phar rgol byed pa'i bka' bsdidī sang zla bcu ba'i g.yul 'gyed28 gzhi nas 'go btsams byung /

phyi dro'i chu tshod 2kyi stong thog las myur ba'i gnam gru 2①dus gcig tu su'u dbyi hri mis bzos gtsang po brgal nas dgra bo'i 'thab rar 'jab rgol byas/ skar ma 20tsam gyi yun du dbyi si ral gyis zhi na'e bkod 'doms khang dang nyen 'gog lte ba/ rdul phran mtshon cha'i dmag sgar/ me phyogs stegs bu sogs rtsa gtor bzos shing me phyogs kyi 'gebs srung la brten nas 'gyig gru 100tsam dus gcig tu gtsang po'i pha rol tu 'phur song ste/ e cib kyi dar cha yang bskyar gtsang po'i shar khul du mtho ru bsgreng thub pa byung / stong phrag las brgal ba'i than khe yis rta pho'i rmig sgra cig car du sgrog pa bzhin dgra bo'i 'dzing rags re re bzhin sil bur gtor te rdul du brlags/ zhi na'o ar g.yul 'gyed ni mi'i rigs kyi lo rgyus su sngar byung ma myong ba'i than khe'i g.yul 'gyed cig ste/ phyogs gnyis kyi than khe 500lhag tsam g.yul 'gyed du mngags gtong gnang / dbyi si ral gyis dmag dpung bsdud mar phyir 'then bya dgos pa'i nyen kha'i 'og a rir skyabs 'jug zhus/ a ris de ma thag stobs shugs yod rgu bton nas rogs skyor gnang bar ma zad tha na tshod lta'i rang bzhin can gyi drag chas gsar ba'ang mang du bstsal cing / mis bzos 'khor skar bed spyad de dbyi si ral la dmag don gyi gsang 'phrin springs par/ e cib la su'u len gyi rgyab skyor cung tsam thob rung phan ci yang ma thogs par dmag dpung rim gyis phyir 'then bya dgos byung / sa ta this dgra bo'i do zlar mi longs pa rtogs rjes gang myur sgos dmag mtshams 'jog pa'i bka' bsgos/ dbyi si ral gyis ches mjug mtha'i skar cha 'ga'i nang du e cib kyi dmag dpung la ya lan drag po sprad/ ji ltar bshad kyang thengs 'di'i g.yul 'gyed du sa ta this mgrin pa gzengs su btegs nas dgra las rnam par rgyal song zhes bshad chog chog yin/ thengs 'di'i g.yul 'gyed kyis dbyi si ral dus rtag tu rnam par rgyal ba'i lha sgrung la rdzogs byang 4)spyad

cing / dbyi si ral dang thob thang 'dra mnyam kyis gros mol byed par cha rkyen bzang po bskrun/zhi bde la brtson pa/sa ta this dgra bor rdung deg gtong ba'i dus mtshungs su dbyi si ral dang zhi bde yong ba'i thabs jus la re/ 1972lo'i zla 2pa ste dmag 'khrug gi snga rol du khong gis zhi ba'i gros gzhi zer ba'i gal te dbyi si ral gyis pha li si than (༅7lo7)gyi yul gyar pa'i gnad don thag gcod thub pa dang 1967lo'i rgyal mtshams su dmag dpung phyir 'then byas tshe/ khong gis dbyi si ral dang lhan du zhi bde'i chings yig 'jog pa'i 'dun pa drag po yod ces gsungs rung / nga'o snyam pa'i khengs dregs kyi mgo bo bar snang du btegs pa'i dbyi si ral gyis kha ya gtan nas byas ma byung / bcu ba'i dmag 'khrug gi rjes su sa ta this sngar bzhin zhi bdes dbus shar sa khul gyi gnad don thag gcod pa'i 'dun pa ma btang bar 1977lo'i zla 6tshes 5la/ lo brgyad tsam du bkag sdom byas pa'i su'u dbyi hri mis bzos gtsang po'i 'grim 'grul gyis sgo mo phyes par/ e cib kyi dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas la skul 'ded kyi nus pa chen po thon/ 1977lo'i zla 11pa'i nyin mo zhig la sa ta thi gros tshogs su phebs te gsung bshad gal chen gnang / zhi bde'i ched du khong nyid gnam 'og gi yul gru gang zhig dang tha na dbyi si ral gros tshogs kyi 'thus mi yongs zhal 'dzoms pa'i mdun sar phebs dgos rung blo 'gyod phran tsam med ces gsungs par/ dbyi si ral gyi chab srid pa rnams kha skyengs ngo shor te 'dug rgyu las thabs ma rnyed/ mthar dbyi si ral gyi tsung li pi cin gyis e cib tu bzhugs pa'i a ri'i phyi bzhugs gzhung tshab brgyud nas/ sa ta thi rgyal sa gyi nos /0 lam (lkolko 〉)du 'tshams 'drir phebs pa'i gdan 'dren zhu yig

phul/ khyod tshos nga tsho dang lhan du gnas 'di ru dpung ba mnyam gshib dang skyid sdug mnyam myong byed 'dod na/ ngas kyang ma gsang drang mor bshad rgyu zhig ni/ nga tsho khyed cag dang lhan du gnas par yid sems spro bas brtas 'dug ces sa ta this dbyi si ral gyi rgyal tshogs su gtam bshad gnang bar/yun ring la dmag 'khrug gi sdug yus myangs pa'i mi tshogs kyis rang dbang bral bar spro sems kyi mchi ma bzhur dgos byung / 1978lo'i zla 9par a ri'i tsung thung gis bar 'dum mdzad de sa ta thi dang pi cin gnyis kyis a ri ru gros chings bzhag chings yig ltar na dbyi si ral gyis lo gsum du zhi ne phyed gling nas dmag dpung phyir 'then bya rgyu dang / rgyal khab gnyis kyis phyogs yongs nas zhi bde'i 'brel lam 'dzugs par gros 'cham byung / lo rjes ma'i zla 3par a ri'i pho brang dkar po'i rtswa thang du chings yig la gzhi nas ming rtags bkod cing / mi lo sum cu'i ring gi e cib dang dbyi si ral bar gyi dmag 'khrug la yongs su 'dum 'grig byung /rgyal nang bcos bsgyur byed thabs spel ba/zla bcu ba'i dmag 'khrug gi rjes su sa ta this phyogs yongs nas rgyal nang dpal 'byor dang chab srid bcos bsgyur la shugs snon brgyab ste/1974lo'i zla 10bar khong gis phyi phyogs su sgo mo 'byed pa'i dgongs don gzhir bzung ba'i dpal 'byor bcos bsgyur gyi srid jus sna tshogs spel/dang po/ ci nus sgos phyi rgyal gyi ma dngul dang lag rtsal nang 'dren bya rgyu dang / phyi rgyal gyi tshong bas rgyal nang gi dpal 'byor las rigs mtha' dag la ma rtsa 'jog chog cing / kho tsho'i khe las la the gtogs mi bya rgyu ma zad lo lnga nas brgyad kyi nang tshun du khral rigs ci yang 'jal mi dgos pa~X /ga

theg gnang /gnyis pa/ rgyal nang gi mi rigs khe las gnyer mkhan la skul ma gtong phyir sngar nas na ser gyi sku ring du gzhung bzhes byas pa'i khe las khag cig phyir sprad/ tha na 1952lo nas bzung rgyal khab kyi khe las gal chen kha shas kyang mi sger gyis do dam byas chog par bzos shing / mi sger gyi tshong pas phyi rgyal nas thad kur rgyu cha nang 'dren dang thon rdzas phyir btsong chog par gtan 'bebs byas/gsum pa/ rgyal gnyer khe las la bcos bsgyur mdzad de rang nyid kyi yong 'bab ltar gla phogs gtan 'bebs gnang bar khe las la 'gran rtsod kyi sgul shugs chen po thebs/bzhi ba/ ngal rtsol mkhan rnams rgyal nang tsam du ma zad rgyal spyi'i stong rang dbang gis 'gro 'ong byed chog pa'i gtan 'bebs gnang /dpal 'byor rang dbang can du 'gyur dgos na chab srid nges par du dmangs gtso yin dgos par dgongs te/ tang khag gcig gis brgya kha gcig gcod bya rgyu las tang khag sna tshogs kyis chab srid la dmangs gtso'i bgro gleng byed par mos mthun byung zhing / spyi dmangs la smra brjod dang khrom skor/ dpar skrun sogs kyi rang dbang dang gsar 'gyur rang mos la su yis kyang bkag 'gog bya mi chog par gtan 'bebs mdzad/ khong gis da dung gros tshogs kyi 'dems bsko'i bkag rgya yod tshad med par btang ste nang srid las khungs legs sgrig (rig rtsal dang phyi 'brel kyi ched mkhas je mang dang dmag dpung je nyung /)dang / sa gnas srid gzhung la shugs snon gyis bca' khrims kyis bstsal ba'i mi dmangs kyi khe dbang srung skyob bya rgyu sogs kyi thad du ba~X /zhigs nan du btang /

ya nga ba'i spyi tshogs kyi gnas bab/lo rabs 70pa'i mjug nas sa ta thi'i dbang sgyur la chags 'jig byung 'go tshugs/ te bis yen chings yig bzhag stabs a rab (loṣ+ṭha44)rgyal khab 17kyis e cib la chab srid dang dpal 'byor gyi bkag sdom byas shing /pha li si than gyi gnad don de chings yig gi nang don gal chen zhig yin yang dbyi si ral gyis lta ba mkhregs 'dzin gyis ya lan ma byin par/ 1980 —1981lo'i bar sa ta this dbyi si ral gyi 'go khrid dang thengs mang po'i mjal 'phrad gnang yang / dbyi si ral gyis ye tan chu bo'i nub ngogs kyi mnga' khongs phyir sprod 'dod gtan nas med phyir grub 'bras ci yang thon ma byung /1978lor ho smi nyis 'go khrid byas pa'i dbyi ran gyi chos lugs gsar brjes pa le we'i rgyal rabs rmog med du btang bar/ sa ta this pa le we rgyal por chab srid kyi 'gebs srung mdzad par ho smi nyi la thugs 'gal chen po bzos/1975— 198)lo'i bar du sa ta the'i sgo 'phar yangs por phye ba'i srid jus kyi sgul shugs 'og rgyal dmangs thon skyed kyi yong 'bab lo rer 7 8nyakyis 'phar snon chen po byung rung / thon skyed kyi 'phel tshad dal zhing 'bru rigs kyis rang kha gso mi thub pa/ 'byor ldan pa dang rgya che'i mi dmangs kyi bar gyi he bag nyin bzhin je zab tu gyur stabs spyi tshogs la zing cha mang du byung / ho smi nyi yi shugs rkyen thebs pa'i chos lugs rtsa 'dzugs kyis sa ta this nub phyogs can du bsgyur ba'i lta bar rgol lan drag po sprad de/ e cib kyi lam lugs kyang khu ran gsung rab kyi lung dang mthun pa'i dngos brgyud dbyi si lan gyi spyi mthun rgyal khab cig tu bsgyur ched khrom skor dang zing cha bslangs te khong la thugs ngal chen po bzos/ mthar snying rje'i yun ring na khong khro'i rgyun mi 'chad ces pa'i dpe bzhin khong gis kyang yod tshad rgya sdu/ du

gtong mi rung bar dgongs te/ 1981lo'i zla 9par srid gzhung la ngo rgol bya ba'i nang don ldan pa'i chos tshogs kyi dus deb dang dpe tshogs la bkag sdom/dgon par dag ther mdzad de de'i rkang 'dzin pa ཿkrolhag tsam btson 'jug byas/ 'on kyang chos lugs la rmongs mgo 'thoms pa'i mi rnams kyis ma 'ongs par rgyang lta byed rgyu las sngar song la phyir mig 'khor cing / chos lugs mtshang 'byin byed mkhan de bdud rgan zhig las su yin snyam ste /981lo'i zla 1)tshes 6la sngar gling zin pa'i blo phangs pa'i don rkyen de byung nga / mdor na sa ta thi ni dpe mtshon rang bzhin ldan pa'i 'byor ldan gral rim gyi chab srid pa zhig yin la/ rgyal nang tsam du ma zad 'dzam gling la'ang shugs rkyen zab mo khong gis thebs yod phyir mi'i rigs kyi lo rgyus su gal 'gangs che ba'i go gnas bzung yod/ khong nyid sku gshegs rjes pha yul gyi sde chung du dur 'jug gnang rogs zhes yang yang gsungs myong mod/ rjes 'brang rnams kyis khong lta bu'i skyes chen zhig de ltar byed ga la rung snyam ste /la sa'i nye 'gram gyi spyi gling zhig tu gzab rgyas ngang dur sbas mdzad yod gyur snacha/ bre/ gang la spyi hrin 52yod/()skya dmag gna' bo ro ma'i bran bdag tshogs khag gi gral rim zhig yin/ spyi lo'i sngon gyi dus rabs gsum pa'i rjes su dngul bun dang khral rigs gtong ba/ tshong las gnyer bzhin pa'i 'byor ldan can la go zhing kho tsho'i skye khungs mi ser yin/ spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi dus mjug tu rgan gras tshogs khag dang dbang cha rtsod res kyi ༵༵ba rtsod yun ring du bya dgos byung /

()tsho dmangs lam lugs/ 'jar pan gyi gna' bo'i bran g.yog lam lugs kyi khyad chos gtso bo zhig yin te/ bran bdag sku drag dag gis dbang log tu bsdus pa'i rus rgyud tsho ba khag btsan gyis zhing las dang lag shes bzo las su bskul ba'i mthus/ rus rgyud tsho mi de dag rim gyis tsho dmangs su gyur/ bran bdag gis rang mos bzhin dmar gsod gtong mi chog rung nor rdzas ltar phan tshun la legs skyes su gnang chog kho tsho tsho dpon gyi gzigs skyong 'og gnas shing rang nyid la 'tsho ba'i yo byad dang rgyu nor cung tsam mchis/ bran bdag gi khral rigs dang 'u lag tu rgyug dgo/ rkye/ tsho dasnangs thun mong nas bran bdag gral rim gyi bshu gzhog dang dusdu /shā sbyis kā gadri da zlo lo/ 'i dus rabs dang por e sha ya'i nub khul du byung zhing dus rabs bzhi bar ro ma'i rgyal khab kyi chos su gtan 'bebs gnang / dus rabs bcu gcig par gnam bdag chos lugs (ro ma'i chos bdag gis 'go khrid mdzad bzhin pa )dang dngos rgyud shar ma'i chos lugs (ro ma shar ba'i rgyal sa cun hri than ting pho brang lte bar bzung ba'i shar khul gyi chos tshogs )gnyis su gyes/dus rabs bcu drug pa'i chos lugs bcos bsgyur gyi rjes su gnam bdag chos lugs nang khul du'ang grub mtha' mang du byung bar gsar ma zhes 'bod la/ krung go'i ye shu'i chos lugs pa rnams kyang gsar mar gtogs/dumachod 'bul/ bag leb dang rgyan chang gis ye shu'i sku gzugs dang zungs khrag dhiswā /sna/ /rdo/ zlo/ dri/ // rdo zhi/sa rabs dkyil ma'i stod tsam du yo rob nub mar dar myong ba'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi sa zhing lam lugs shig yin/ rgyal po h+pha lan khis sa zhing dang der dbang ba'i zhing pa sogs rang la blo sems dkar ba'i sku drag dag la bya dgar bstsal cing / dmag 'khrug gi skabs su mtshon cha dang bzhon rta sogs rang sger gyis gra sgrig bya dgos/ dus rabs dgu ba'i dus smad du slebs tshe bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi 'brel bar 'phel rgyas byung stabs legs skyes su phul ba'i sa zhing de dag kyang rang nyid kyis mi rabs su brgyud chog pas sdunga'

khongs su gyur te/ dus rabs bcu gcig par lam lugs 'di rtsa med du btang /rjodrag bskyod kyi mi chos ring lugs tshogs khag dus rabs dkyil ma'i dus mjug tu yo rob nub ma'i shes ldan mi snas chos tshogs kyi 'ching rgya las grol phyir/ mi lte bar 'dzin dgos pa'i lta tshul bton te mi'i gzi brjid la bstod bsngags byed pa las lha la mi bstod pa dang / mi yod tshad kyi phugs bsam ni tshe 'di'i bde skyid kyi ched du yin pa las tshe phyi ma'i bde skyid ma yin pa/ mi'i stobs shugs la yid ches bya dgos pa las lha'i byin rlabs la yid mi ches par ma zad/ mi zhig yin tshe yod tshad la brtson len bya dgos pa las las kyi bzang ngan la khag dkri mi rung ba'i 'bod skul bsgrags/ 'di lta bu'i shes rig gsar ba la mi chos ring lugs zhes 'bod/0skya dmag dus rabs dkyil ma'i yo rob tu skya dmag ni bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gral rim gyi thob thang ches dma' ba rnams yin/ kho tsho ni sa zhing gi bgo skal thob pa'i dmag mi yin la zhing bdag chen po'i dmag khral du'ang 'gro dgos/༷hu'u zi/(1372— 1415)che khi'i rgyal gces ring lugs pa dang chos lugs bcos bsgyur mkhan zhig ste/ ti dbyi kri'i zhing bdag dang gnam bdag chos tshogs kyis che khi la gnyan gnon dang bshu gzhog byed par ngo rgol dang rang skad nas chos lugs spel rgyu/ lha'i zhal zas gsol skabasachos pa la yang chos dpon tsho dang 'dra kār lhag sprab da~X rgun chang thob dgos pa'i lta ba bton stabs chos tshogs kyis nyutu( mad dunā pabakās ba/cu ba'am bcu gcig pa nas bzung ste cis ko'u lo zi ru sku drag gi tu'u ma btsugs shing / tu'u ma'i tshogs 'du'i steng hra hong dang sku drag chen po dag gas srid don la gros bsdur byed srol yod/〈smogral rim gsum pa/ gral rim gsum pa'i khongs gtogs la dka' sdug gis mnar ba'i zhing pa las gzhan da dung 'byor ldan gral rim dang bzo ba/ lag shes bzo las pa/ grong mi dbul bo bcas 'dus/yirim pa gsum pa'i tshogs 'du/ 1302lor h+pha ran si'i gong mas bkas bkod rgyud ༵༵na gyi zhing bdag dang mtho rim chos pa/ grong khyer gyi 'byor ldan pa rnams kyi

'thus mi bsdus te mang tshogs la khral rigs gang dag bsdu rgyu dang ji ltar bsdu rgyu'i thad du bgro gleng mdzad pa'i lam lugs de las tshogs 'du 'di byung zhing / ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi 'thus mi gcig kyang med/ 1614lo'i rjes su 'di lta bu'i tshogs 'du thengs gcig kyang 'tshogs ma myong /༷hā po'u zi rgyal rabs/ yo rob gling du dbang sgyur gyi dus yun ring ba'i rgyal rabs shig yin/ khyim rgyud 'di si wa dzi lan ḍi'i a ko khul gyi hwa po'u zi pho brang nas byung zhing ro ma'i btsan rgyal (1273—1806lor )dang si phen gyi rgyal rabs (1516—170)phor)/ o si khru ri ya'i btsan rgyal (1804— 1867lor)/ a'o zhung btsan rgyal (18/7— 1918lor )bcas dang da dung rgyal phran kha shas la'ang ༷༵༵ tā gār+sha /sna nga zlo rgya/la khab chen mo/ dus rabs 13pa'i mjug tu a'o zi man zer ba'i dru gu tsho ba'i 'go dpon zhig gis e she ya chung ba'i nub byang gi phyogs su ming la a'o zi man thur khe zhes pa'i rgyal khab cig btsugs/ 1453lor ro ma shar ba pham par brgyab ste sa dkyil rgya mtsho chen mo'i shar phyogs bdag gir bzung zhing /mtsho nag po dang shar phyogs su bgrod pa'i 'gag sgo'i dbang cha thob/ dus rabs 17par slebs tshe e sha ya dang a h+phe ri kha'i gling / yo rob bcas gling chen gsum la khyab pa'i btsan rgyal du gyur/ mthar 1922lor btsan rgyal yongs su nyams dmas zhonasbya zlo/ ṭī /'u khu/ spyir dmag mi 'di dag ni ko cwa so sa khul gyi bran g.yog las grub pa'i dmag dpung zhig yin/ bar skabs shig tu e cib kyi srid dbang 'phrog stabs bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gral rim gyi dmag don tshogs khag cig tu gyur/a lis kyi skabs su kho tsho'i dpung stobs ha cang che ba yin/(yihā zha/ spyir a'o zi man thur khe'i dmag dpon chen mor go yang rjes su zhing chen gyi yilha spya ༵ sna rnyiswā ༵ dī dis sdir ḍā /da/1821lor khos g.yo thabs kyis mo zhi kho bcings 'grol thob rjes srid dbang bzung / 1822lor rang gis rang gong mar ba/sdu 7rung

yistu n+dhe trī sduwa sri/ dbyi bzhi gi / sna /zlo/ mi 'grol dmag 'khrug gi gtso 'dzin zhig ste 153lor zhing pa'i khyim tshang zhig tu sku 'khrungs shing chos lugs mi sna zhig kyang yin/ 1810lo'i zla 9tshes 16nyin khong gis to lo lis zi sa khul nas si phen dbang sgyurabar gyen log byas te/ rgyal khab rang btsan dang bran g.yog lam lugs rtsa med du bzo rgyu/ btsan 'dzul bas zhing pa'i sa zhing phyir sprod dgos pa'i 'bod skul bton/ lo rjes mar g.yul sa ru 'dzin bzung thebs te dmar gsod btang /rkun ma'o lo ligazi/ 1810— 1815lo'i bar gyi mo zhi kho'i bcings 'grol dmag 'khrug skabs kyi gtso 'dzin zhig ste zhing sde yi chos lugs mi sna dkyus ma zhig kyang yin/ 1810lor yus ta ar ki dang lhan du si phen gyi dbang sgyur la rgol lan sprod pa'i zing 'khrug tu zhugs shing / yus ta ar ki sku bkrongs rjes gsar brje'i gtso 'dzinagyi 'gan bzhes/ khos mo zhi kho yang dag par bcings 'grol btang ste spyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes rgyu dang / zhing bdag chen po'i sa zhing mtha' dag zhing ba dbul bor bgo rgyu/ phyug po'i rgyu nor gzhung bzhes dang bran g.yog lam lugs/chos tshogs kyi dmigs bsal dbang cha rtsa med gtong dgos par ma zad mi rnams 'dra mnyam yin pa'i lta ba bton/ 1813lor khong nyid g.yul du pham te 1815lo'i zla 11par 'dzin bzung thebs shing zla 12par sku bkrongs/yidamag shed can/ dus rabs 12—19pa'i dus dkyil du 'jar pan gyi srid skyong mkhan te 'jar pan gong mar dbang cha ci yang med/ ches mtho'i dbang 'dzin paradamag dpon chen mo zhes 'bod cing khong gi mnga' zhabs su chab srid dang dmag don/ khrims lugs bcas kyi dpon gnas rgyud 'dzin byed pa'i zhi drag dpon rigs mchis la/ sa gnas kyi srid dbang dmag dpon chen mor blo sems dkar ba'i mi snas 'gan khur ba dang / rgyal yongasakyi srid 'byor dmag gsum gyi dbang cha mtha' dag dmag dpon chen mo dang sa gnas kyi 'go bas bzung yod/tsho'iper lin tshogs 'du/ nyis zi ma khi yi 'bod skul ltar 188461885lor 'jar /rdokā gyis per lin nas bsdus pa'i btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi rgyal khab khag gis a

h+phe ri kha'i gling bgo bsha' rgyag pa'i rgyal spyi'i tshogs 'du zhiganyu ghan rdi// /rdzu lo / ghanā rdis dang 'phags mchog snyan rdis gnyis rus mtshungs tsosbyishā sdomaspya sa kār+shas dīsna taspya/ / 1885lo'i zla 12par meng ma'i nas dbu brnyes shing rgya gar gyi 'byor ldan gral rim dang zhing bdag gi tshab byed mkhan yin/ thog ma'i dus rim du kho tshos dbyin ji dang mnyam las byas myong yang rjes su tang nang khul du 'byor ldan gral rim chung khag dang rang dbang gi las gnyer ba mang du 'phel ba'i mthus/ dbyin ji'i dbang sgyur la ngo rgol byed pa'i drag bskyod kyi rdokārdokā/ cig tu gyur cing / kho tsho'i 'go khrid 'og rgya gar mi dmangs la rang yi /na ti/ mtsho 'graX gyi sde chung zhig ste/ tshwa la dpung 'jug gi ming gzhan du tan yid ༵ /sna zlo zlo ñcha/sa sdu kyang ༵ rakā/sa 19pa'i lo rabs ——70bar btsugs pa'i u ru su'i gsar brje'i las 'gul khrod kyi 'byor ldan gral rim chung khag gi tshogs pa zhig shes ldan mi snas zhing par 'go khrid mdzad de spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi gsar brje dang lkog gsod sogs kyi lag thabs la brten nas bya gzhag mang du (sgrubs moshā kyang / blo phangs pa zhig la rjes su rul sungs su gyur te mar khe si'i yi/shā ༵ /rdzu tre k+ta gā shā rag nākā// 1921lor 'byor ldan gral rim gyis rgyal khab kyi dpal 'byor la bdag dbang byas pa'i cha rkyen 'og 'bru khral gyis 'bru rigs lhag ma nyo ba'i lam lugs kyi tshab byas shing zhing grong gi tshong las 'phel rgyas su gtong ched tshong rdzas dang ma dngul gyi 'brel ba bed spyad de zhing las las rigs slar gso dang skul 'ded btang / phyogs yongs nas bzo zhing mnyam 'brel gyi rmang gzhi sra brtan du btang ste spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dpal 'byor la yar skul byed rgyu de'o/tsho'i ma chi nu'o 'dzing rags/ h+pha ran si srid gzhung gis 'jar man gyi rgyal mtshams su bzos pa'i ring tshad la spyi le 750lhag mchis pa'i 'dzing rags shig ste/4ཿdzam

gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa'i snga rol du h+pha ran si srid gzhung gis 'dzing rags 'di la yid ches kyis dgra bo snang med du bzhag mthar 'jar man gyi dmag dpung sgyelang/lho tshephyogs dris h+pha ra/ sir dpung 'jug byas stabs mā chi na'o 'dzing tso// kā 'i sna /nā nārnyi da yarnyi zlo bye sna / ṭ+wāṃ /lo'i sngon gyi dus rabs 11par pha li si than sa khul du myu'u e zhi'i rgyal rabs dbu brnyes shing rjes su dbyi si ral dang sgo'u e zhi rgyal khab gnyis su gyes/ spyi lo'i sngon gyi dus rabs 6par pā pi lun gyis tshur rgol dang ro ma rgyal khab chen mo'i btsan gnon thebs/ spyi lo'i sngon gyi dus rabs 1par ho'u e zhi'i mi rigs yod tshad pha li si than dang kha bral te yo rob rgyal khab khag tu 'khyams shing / spyi lo 64zhanas bzung a rab mi rigs sa khul 'di'i bdag por gyur/ 'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po'i rjes su a ri dang dbyin ji/ h+pha ran si sogs kyis rang nyid kyi khe phan la dmigs te myu'u e zhi'i mi rigs kyis pha li si than tu rgyal khab slar gso byed par ram 'degs byas/ 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa'i tshe yang shi the lis myu'u e zhi dmar gsod drag po btang bar brten kho tsho'i rgyal khab slar gso ring lugs kyi las 'gul mgyogs myur ngang 'phel rgyas byung /1946lor pha li si than gyi ho'u e zhi'i mi 'bor khri 60lhag la son zhing 1947lor mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs kyis 〈pha li si than snyoms bgo'i thad kyi gros chod 〉ces pa brgyudanas sa khul de ru a rab kyi rgyal khab cig dang ho'u e zhi'i rgyal khab cig 'dzugs par gros chod byung / 1948lo'i zla 5tshes 14la dbyi si ral rgyal khab dngos su dbu brnyes shing thengs dang po'i dbyi e dmag 'khrug (122lo)gi 'go brtsams/ dbyi si ral gyis dmag 'khrug la brten nas gros chod las brgal ba'i mnga' khongs 'bor chen tshur 'phrog cing / bgrang las 'das pa'i a rab kyi mi ser yul mthar bskrad/ thengs gnyis pa'i dbyi e dmag 'khrug (1956lo'i zla 10tshes 29nas zla 11pa'i tshes 6la )ni dbyin h+pha rgyal khab gnyis kyis na ser gyis 'go khrid mdzad bzhin pa'i e cib kyi gsar brje la rdung deg dang / su'u dbyi hri ༵༵ bzos gtsang bo'i bdag dbang slar gso byed ched du dbyi si ral gyis bslangs

pa'i btsan 'dzul thengs shig red/ dbyi e dmag 'khrug thengs gsum pa ni (1967lo'i zla 6tshes 5nas tshes 10la )a ri'i rgyab skyor 'og tu dbyi si ral gyis e cib dang cor tan(/0768ba)/ siriya(5711 8)bcas la bslangs pa'i myur 'thab thengs shig ste/ gsang 'phrin gyi mgo skor thebs rkyen gra sgrig ci yang med pa'i gnas bab 'og dbyi si ral gyi 'jab rgol thebs shing / rgyal khab 'di dag gi dmag mi khri 5tsam la shi rmas dang mi 7000tsam 'dzin bzung byas/ zhi na'e gling phyed tshud pa'i mnga' khongs spyi le gru bzhi ma 6507tsam btsan 'phrog byas/ dbyi e dmag 'khrug thengs bzhi ba (1973lo'i zla 10pa'i tshes 6nas 24la )ni e cib mi dmangs kyis dus yun ring bor dka' sdug dang btsan 'dzul myangs rjes su rang 'gul sgos dbyi si ral la phar rgol byas pa'i dmag 'khrug thengs shig go/ //441
